main.trap: 先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱
main.stem: A dispute over a rural property boundary is being heard in the Supreme Court of British Columbia. The defendant's lawyer relies on an older British Columbia Court of Appeal decision, while the plaintiff's lawyer points out that the older case involved a commercial port lease with materially different facts and also cites a recent Alberta Court of Appeal ruling. How does the doctrine of stare decisis apply here?
main.zh: BC 最高法院正在审理一起乡村土地边界纠纷。被告律师依赖 BC 上诉法院的一项旧判例，而原告律师指出该旧案涉及商业港口租约、关键事实存在实质差异，并同时援引了阿尔伯塔省上诉法院近期的一项裁决。遵循先例（stare decisis）原则在此处应如何适用？

opts.t: The judge may distinguish the BC Court of Appeal case on its materially different facts and treat the Alberta ruling as persuasive only.
opts.w: 正确：遵循先例（stare decisis）旨在保证法律结果的可预测性，但适用先例的关键动作是区分（distinguish）——若旧案关键事实与本案存在实质差异，法官可以将其区分掉而不受约束；同时，外省上诉法院（Court of Appeal）的判决对本省下级法院仅有说服力（persuasive），没有强制约束力（binding）。

opts.t: The judge must follow the Alberta Court of Appeal ruling because appellate decisions from any Canadian province bind all trial courts nationwide.
opts.w: 错在「先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱」：各省上诉法院（Court of Appeal）的判决只对本省下级法院有约束力，对其他省份的下级法院只有说服力但不约束，唯有加拿大最高法院（Supreme Court of Canada）的判决才对全国法院具有最高约束力。

opts.t: The judge is strictly bound to apply the older British Columbia Court of Appeal decision regardless of how different the underlying facts are.
opts.w: 错在「先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱」：把「先例存在」直接等同于「先例必然适用」，忽略了法官在发现案件关键事实存在实质差异时，有权通过区分（distinguish）不受旧先例约束。

opts.t: The judge must disregard both appellate cases because stare decisis only applies when interpreting federal criminal statutes.
opts.w: 错在曲解普通法核心机制：遵循先例（stare decisis）是整个普通法（common law）体系保持可预测性的根基，广泛适用于民事与商业纠纷，绝非仅限于联邦刑事制定法。

main.pt: 衡平法救济与强制履行
main.trap: 衡平救济当成法定必给权利
main.stem: Marcus signed a binding contract to purchase a unique waterfront cottage from Elena. Elena changed her mind and refused to complete the transfer. Instead of suing promptly, Marcus waited a long and unreasonable time while watching the market before asking the court for an order of specific performance to force Elena to transfer the title. How is the court most likely to view Marcus's request for specific performance?
main.zh: Marcus 签了一份有约束力的合同，向 Elena 购买一套独特的滨水度假屋。Elena 反悔并拒绝完成过户。Marcus 没有及时起诉，而是在观望市场、无理拖延了很长时间之后，才向法院申请强制履行令（specific performance），要求强迫 Elena 过户产权。法院最可能如何看待 Marcus 的强制履行请求？

opts.t: The court must grant specific performance automatically because every buyer under a real estate contract has an absolute common law right to force a transfer.
opts.w: 错在「衡平救济当成法定必给权利」陷阱：强制履行（specific performance）属于衡平法（equity）上的救济而非普通法救济，且它不是原告想要就一定能拿到的绝对权利。

opts.t: The court may refuse specific performance because equitable remedies are discretionary and a plaintiff who delays unreasonably may lose the right to equitable relief.
opts.w: 正确：强制履行（specific performance）是衡平法（equity）上的救济，由法院自由裁量（discretionary）授予；衡平法要求寻求救济的人在合理时间内尽速行动，如果原告拖延太久才起诉，法院可以以此为由拒绝授予这项衡平救济。

opts.t: The court lacks jurisdiction to consider both monetary damages and specific performance in the same proceeding because equity courts remain separate from common law courts.
opts.w: 错在忽略《司法法》（Judicature Acts）合并法院的历史事实：1870 年代普通法法院与衡平法院已合并为同一套法院系统，今天 BC 的同一个法官在同一案件中既能判普通法损害赔偿（damages），也能给衡平救济。

opts.t: The court must apply common law rules to override equitable principles whenever the two systems conflict.
opts.w: 错在颠倒冲突规则：当普通法（common law）规则与衡平法（equity）规则发生冲突时，衡平法优先，而不是普通法优先。

main.pt: 三级政府立法权与成文法优先
main.trap: 先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱
main.stem: An unlicensed individual arranges a residential property sale in British Columbia for a fee and argues in court that under ancient English common law from 1066, anyone was free to act as an agent without a government licence. How will a British Columbia judge resolve this argument?
main.zh: 一名无牌人士在 BC 省居间促成一宗住宅买卖并收取费用，他在法庭上辩称，根据起源于 1066 年的英国普通法，任何人都可以自由担任代理人而无需政府牌照。BC 法官将如何裁决这一抗辩？

opts.t: The judge will uphold the defence because judge-made common law rules always override provincial statutes like the Real Estate Services Act.
opts.w: 错在颠倒成文法与普通法的效力层级：成文法（statute law）最常见的作用就是修改或补充普通法（common law），法官判案时必须先适用有效的成文法。

opts.t: The judge will strike down the Real Estate Services Act because only the federal Parliament has constitutional authority to regulate real estate licensing under its banking power.
opts.w: 错在混淆联邦与省的宪法分权：地产交易、合同与代理关系落在《1867 年宪法》（Constitution Act, 1867）划归省级立法权的「财产与公民权利」（property and civil rights）篮子里，因此《地产服务法》（RESA）是合法有效的省法。

opts.t: The judge will reject the defence because statute law modifies the common law, and the province validly enacted the Real Estate Services Act under its constitutional power over property and civil rights.
opts.w: 正确：法官判案的固定顺序是先看有没有成文法（statute law）回答该问题；虽然普通法（common law）里原本没有做地产经纪必须持牌的规矩，但省议会依据宪法赋予的「财产与公民权利」（property and civil rights）立法权制定了《地产服务法》（RESA），用成文法创设了持牌要求并改变了普通法。

opts.t: The judge will refer the matter to the municipal council because municipalities hold direct constitutional power under the Constitution Act, 1867 to license real estate agents.
opts.w: 错在误解市级权力来源与范围：市（municipality）并非《宪法》直接授权的一级立法机关，其制定 bylaw 的权力是从省的权力里切分出来的（管 zoning、建筑许可等地方事项），地产牌照由省法 RESA 监管。

main.pt: 法院层级、门槛与上诉原则
main.trap: 上诉等于重打官司重新举证
main.stem: After losing a commercial contract trial in the Supreme Court of British Columbia for a claim exceeding $35,000, the defendant files an appeal to the British Columbia Court of Appeal. The defendant plans to bring 3 new eyewitnesses to the Court of Appeal hearing to testify all over again about what was said during the contract negotiations. How will the Court of Appeal handle this plan?
main.zh: 在 BC 最高法院输掉一场金额超过 $35,000 的商业合同初审官司后，被告向 BC 上诉法院（Court of Appeal）提起上诉。被告计划带 3 名新目击证人到上诉法院庭审现场，就合同谈判期间说过的话重新作证。上诉法院将如何处理这一计划？

opts.t: The Court of Appeal will swear in the witnesses and conduct a full trial de novo because every appeal is a brand-new trial on the facts.
opts.w: 错在「上诉等于重打官司重新举证」陷阱：只有小额法庭（Small Claims Court）案件在获 BC 最高法院准许重审时才会进行全新审理（trial de novo），BC 上诉法院绝不把上诉当成重新举证的初审。

opts.t: The Court of Appeal will transfer the case to Small Claims Court because contract disputes must be heard there first.
opts.w: 错在无视金额上限与审级：小额法庭（Small Claims Court）的管辖上限是 $35,000，超过 $35,000 且已在 BC 最高法院初审的案件由 BC 上诉法院审理法律上诉问题。

opts.t: The Court of Appeal will require a panel of 5 to 9 judges from the Supreme Court of Canada to cross-examine the witnesses.
opts.w: 错在记混两级上诉法院的法官人数与审理范围：BC 上诉法院通常由 3 名法官审理（重大先例可能推翻时用 5 名），加拿大最高法院才是 5–9 名法官，且两级上诉法院均不重新听取证人证言。

opts.t: The Court of Appeal will not re-hear witness evidence, as a panel of 3 (or 5) judges only reviews whether the trial judge erred in applying the law.
opts.w: 正确：BC 上诉法院（Court of Appeal）通常由 3 名法官（可能推翻重大先例时用 5 名）组成合议庭，以多数意见定案；上诉法院不重新听取证据，只审查原审法官适用法律有没有错误。

main.pt: CRT 管辖与考试口径救济路径
main.trap: 考试口径与现行规则错位陷阱
main.stem: A strata corporation has a dispute with a unit owner over unpaid strata fees exceeding $35,000, while in an unrelated matter a consultant has a $5,000 unpaid invoice claim that was just decided by the Civil Resolution Tribunal (CRT). According to the course manual, which tribunal hears the strata dispute, and how can a dissatisfied party challenge the $5,000 CRT small claims decision?
main.zh: 某共管物业法团（strata corporation）与一名业主就超过 $35,000 的欠缴共管物业费发生纠纷；而在另一宗无关事项中，一名顾问有一笔 $5,000 未付账单索赔刚刚由民事解决裁判庭（CRT）作出裁决。按照考试口径（course manual），哪个机构管辖这起共管物业纠纷？不服 $5,000 CRT 小额裁决的一方如何提出异议？

opts.t: Small Claims Court hears the strata dispute because it exceeds $5,000, and the $5,000 CRT decision can only be appealed directly to the Supreme Court of Canada.
opts.w: 错在混淆两类门槛：CRT 处理的一般小额纠纷（tribunal small claims）上限是 $5,000，但共管物业纠纷（strata property claims）归 CRT 管辖且无金额上限。

opts.t: The BC Human Rights Tribunal hears the strata dispute, and the $5,000 CRT decision is final with no court review or objection permitted.
opts.w: 错在乱配裁判机构：BC 人权裁判庭只管《人权法》歧视投诉，不管共管物业费欠缴；且 CRT 裁决并非不可挑战。

opts.t: The CRT, since strata claims have no monetary cap; under the course manual, a Notice of Objection leads to a trial de novo in Provincial Small Claims Court.
opts.w: 正确：CRT 对共管物业纠纷（strata property claims）无金额上限；按 ©2020 考试口径，对 CRT 小额纠纷裁决不服可提交异议通知（Notice of Objection）到省法院小额庭进行全新审理（trial de novo）。注意现行 BC 法律自 2022-07-01 起已取消异议通知与全新审理程序，现行对 CRT 裁决不服一律在 60 天内向 BC 最高法院申请司法审查（judicial review）。

opts.t: The Supreme Court of British Columbia has exclusive original jurisdiction over all strata disputes regardless of amount, and the CRT only handles motor vehicle claims up to $35,000.
opts.w: 错在记混管辖权与车祸上限：共管物业纠纷由 CRT 管辖（无金额上限），且 CRT 车祸伤害纠纷（accident claims）的责任与损害赔偿上限是 $50,000 而非 $35,000。

main.pt: 诉讼时效与承认责任重置
main.trap: 时效起算点混淆与承认责任重置陷阱
main.stem: A contractor negligently installed concealed drainage pipes on a commercial property. The owner had no reason to know of any defect until several years later, when flooding revealed the faulty installation and its cause. Before the 2-year basic limitation period and the 15-year ultimate limitation period expired, the contractor sent the owner a signed letter acknowledging responsibility for the defective work. Under the Limitation Act, how do the limitation periods operate?
main.zh: 一名承包商在某商业物业施工时疏忽安装了隐蔽排水管。业主直到数年后发生积水暴露出安装缺陷及其原因时，才知晓或理应知晓该问题。在 2 年基本时效期与 15 年最长时效期届满前，承包商向业主寄出一封签名信，书面承认对该工程缺陷承担责任。根据《时效法》（Limitation Act），诉讼时效期在此情形下如何运作？

opts.t: The owner's right to sue expired 2 years after the negligent installation because the 2-year basic limitation period always runs from the date the act or omission occurred.
opts.w: 错在「时效起算点混淆与承认责任重置陷阱」：2 年基本时效期（basic limitation period）是从「发现」（discovery）当天起算，而不是从行为发生日起算；从行为发生日起算的是 15 年最长时效期（ultimate limitation period）。

opts.t: The 2-year period ran from discovery, and the signed acknowledgment restarted both the 2-year basic and the 15-year ultimate periods from that date.
opts.w: 正确：《Limitation Act》规定 2 年基本时效期（basic limitation period）从发现（discovery）之日起算，15 年最长时效期（ultimate limitation period）从行为或不作为发生之日起算；一旦被告承认责任（如部分还款或书面确认），基本时效期与最长时效期都会从承认之日重新起算。

opts.t: The contractor's written acknowledgment extends the ultimate limitation period to 30 years but has no effect on the 2-year basic limitation period.
opts.w: 错在沿用 2013 年前的 30 年旧数字且漏算重置效果：现行最长时效期（ultimate limitation period）是 15 年而非 30 年，且承认责任会让 2 年基本时效期和 15 年最长时效期双双重新起算。

opts.t: Because the claim involves construction on land, the Limitation Act does not apply unless the owner first obtains leave within 60 days from the Civil Resolution Tribunal.
opts.w: 错在编造前置程序：《Limitation Act》是全省民事索赔的默认时效法，统一适用 2 年基本时效与 15 年最长时效，60 天是 CRT 裁决申请司法审查的期限。

main.pt: 人权法受保护理由与租赁红线
main.trap: 考试口径与现行规则错位陷阱
main.stem: A landlord instructs a licensed rental agent to turn away any prospective tenant whose income comes from government social assistance, explaining that the landlord has no prejudice against anyone and only wants tenants with traditional employment salaries. Which statement accurately describes the legal position under the British Columbia Human Rights Code?
main.zh: 一名房东指示持牌租赁经纪拒绝任何收入来自政府社会救济金的潜在租客，并解释说自己对任何人没有偏见，只是想要有传统工薪收入的租客。下列哪项陈述准确描述了 BC 省《人权法》（Human Rights Code）下的法律定性？

opts.t: The refusal breaches the Code: lawful source of income is a protected ground in tenancy, intent is not required, and complaints go to the BC Human Rights Tribunal.
opts.w: 正确：《人权法》（Human Rights Code）在租赁场景（s.10）中明确将「合法收入来源」（lawful source of income）列为受保护理由（protected grounds），因申请人靠社会救济金或伤残津贴付房租而拒租即构成歧视；且第 2 条明定歧视不要求主观意图，独立投诉由 BC 人权裁判庭（BC Human Rights Tribunal）受理。注意 2021-11-25 生效的修法还把原住民身份（Indigenous identity）加入了现行受保护理由清单（©2020 考试资料尚未收录该新增项）。

opts.t: The instruction is lawful because a landlord cannot violate the Human Rights Code without proof of malicious intent to discriminate.
opts.w: 错在误以为需要主观恶意：《人权法》（Human Rights Code）第 2 条明文规定，构成违法歧视并不要求行为人具有歧视的主观意图（intent）。

opts.t: The instruction is lawful because lawful source of income is only a protected ground when selling commercial real estate, not when renting residential premises.
opts.w: 错在记反适用条款：「合法收入来源」（lawful source of income）恰恰是租赁场景（s.10）比一般住宿/服务（s.8）和购房场景额外多出的受保护理由。

opts.t: Refusing the applicant is a breach that must be filed as an independent Human Rights Code complaint in the Civil Resolution Tribunal (CRT).
opts.w: 错在把人权投诉塞进 CRT：CRT 一般不受理《人权法》（Human Rights Code）本身的独立投诉，这类投诉走的是独立于 CRT 与法院之外的 BC 人权裁判庭（BC Human Rights Tribunal）。

main.stem: A real estate team is reviewing British Columbia's regulatory framework to determine which legislation establishes who is required to hold a licence, how licences are issued, and the statutory penalties for contraventions, versus which instrument sets out the specific rules on trust accounts and agency disclosures. Which pairing is accurate?
main.zh: 一个地产团队正在梳理 BC 省的监管框架，以确定哪部法律规定了谁必须持牌、牌照如何发放以及违规的法定处罚，而哪部文件规定了信托账户与代理披露的具体细则。下列哪项配对是准确的？

opts.t: RESA sets out who must be licensed, how licences issue and the penalties, while the Rules (B.C. Reg. 209/2021) cover conduct such as trust accounts and disclosures.
opts.w: 正确。《地产服务法》（Real Estate Services Act, RESA）负责规定谁需要牌照、牌照怎么发、违规怎么罚；而依 RESA s. 89.2 制定的《地产服务规则》（Real Estate Services Rules, B.C. Reg. 209/2021）负责规定披露、信托账户、广告、代理关系等执业行为细则。

opts.t: The Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA) governs licensing requirements, while the Real Estate Services Act (RESA) governs developer disclosure statements.
opts.w: 属于法规层级混淆陷阱。REDMA 管的是开发商卖楼花/共管单位的披露声明（disclosure statement）与撤销权，不管持牌要求；管持牌要求的是 RESA。

opts.t: The pre-2021 Council Rules continue to govern licence issuance under their original section numbers, while REDMA governs brokerage trust accounts.
opts.w: 属于旧规则残留陷阱。自 2021-08-01 起，旧的「地产议会规则（Council Rules）」已被整体重编号的《地产服务规则》（B.C. Reg. 209/2021）取代，且发牌依据是 RESA、信托账户归 Rules 管而非 REDMA。

opts.t: The Finance Statutes Amendment Act, 2021 governs agency disclosures and advertising, while the repealed Real Estate Act governs disciplinary fines.
opts.w: 属于法规名称拼凑陷阱。《2021 年金融成文法修正案》是合并监管机构的立法依据，旧《地产法》（Real Estate Act）早于 2005 年初被 RESA 取代。

main.stem: A member of the public wishes to file a formal complaint regarding a licensee's conduct, and an applicant who recently passed the licensing exam needs to submit a licence application through a brokerage. Under British Columbia's regulatory framework in effect since August 1, 2021, how are these matters handled?
main.zh: 一名公众人士希望对某持牌人的执业行为提出正式投诉，同时一名刚通过牌照考试的申请人需要经由经纪行递交牌照申请。在 2021 年 8 月 1 日生效的 BC 省现行监管框架下，这些事务如何处理？

opts.t: The licence application goes to the Real Estate Council of BC (RECBC), while the public complaint goes to the Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate (OSRE).
opts.w: 属于旧机构名残留陷阱。RECBC 已解散，OSRE 已并入 BCFSA；虽然 ©2020 旧版考试资料曾将两者分开描述，但自 2021-08-01 起已不再存在这两个独立机构。

opts.t: Both the licence application and the complaint investigation are handled by the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) as the single regulator.
opts.w: 正确。依《Finance Statutes Amendment Act, 2021》，自 2021-08-01 起 RECBC 解散、OSRE 并入 BC 金融服务管理局（BC Financial Services Authority, BCFSA）；尽管旧版考试资料仍提及 RECBC/OSRE，现行规则下从考牌、发牌、执业规则、投诉调查到纪律处分全部只面对 BCFSA 一个机构。

opts.t: The licence application is issued by the Real Estate Foundation of BC, while discipline is handled by the Real Estate Errors and Omissions Insurance Corporation.
opts.w: 属于四大保护机构张冠李戴陷阱。地产基金会负责研究与公益资助，E&O 保险公司负责职业责任保险，均无发牌或纪律处分权。

opts.t: Both matters are adjudicated directly by the Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation.
opts.w: 属于四大保护机构张冠李戴陷阱。赔偿基金公司（Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation）仅负责赔付持牌人挪用信托资金造成的损失，不负责发牌和日常投诉调查。

main.trap: 牌照类别与独立执业陷阱
main.stem: Clara holds a representative-level licence in the Trading Services category. She wants to operate independently under her own name without being engaged by a brokerage, and she also wants to collect strata fees and manage common property for a strata corporation. Which statement accurately describes her status under the Real Estate Services Act (RESA)?
main.zh: Clara 持有交易服务（Trading Services）类别的代表（representative）级别牌照。她想以个人名义独立执业而不挂靠任何经纪行，并且还想为某共管物业法团收取物业费及管理公共物业。根据《地产服务法》（RESA），下列哪项陈述准确描述了她的执业资格？

opts.t: As a licensed representative, she may practice independently without a brokerage, provided she restricts her work to Trading Services.
opts.w: 属于独立执业误区陷阱。在 RESA 牌照体系下，不管是代表（representative）、副经纪（associate broker）还是管理经纪（managing broker），每个持牌人都必须挂靠在一家持牌经纪行（brokerage）之下执业，不能脱离经纪行单干。

opts.t: Her Trading Services licence automatically authorizes her to perform Strata Management Services and Rental Property Management Services.
opts.w: 属于牌照类别混同陷阱。RESA 将需要牌照的地产服务分为三大类别（Trading Services 交易服务、Rental Property Management Services 出租物业管理服务、Strata Management Services 共管物业管理服务），单一交易服务牌照不能跨类别从事共管物业管理。

opts.t: She must be licensed in relation to a brokerage, and managing a strata corporation needs the separate Strata Management Services category.
opts.w: 正确。RESA 规定每个持牌人必须挂靠在一家持牌经纪行（brokerage）之下执业；且需要牌照的地产服务分为交易服务（Trading Services）、出租物业管理服务（Rental Property Management Services）和共管物业管理服务（Strata Management Services）三类，不可无相应类别牌照跨界执业。

opts.t: She may operate without a brokerage once she upgrades from representative directly to associate broker.
opts.w: 属于牌照级别误解陷阱。副经纪（associate broker）同样是个人牌照级别（level），依然必须挂靠在持牌经纪行（brokerage）之下执业。

main.trap: 考牌与申牌时间窗混淆
main.stem: Marcus completed all assignments for the Real Estate Trading Services Licensing Course 1 year ago. He wrote the licensing examination for the first time today and scored 60%. Under the current Real Estate Services Rules and examination policies, which rule applies to Marcus?
main.zh: Marcus 在 1 年前完成了地产交易服务牌照课程的全部作业。他今天第一次参加牌照考试，考了 60%。根据现行《地产服务规则》及考试政策，下列哪项规定适用于 Marcus？

opts.t: A score of 60% meets the passing standard, so he has two years from today to apply for his licence.
opts.w: 属于及格线与申牌期限双重混淆陷阱。牌照考试及格分数线为 70%（60% 未及格），且通过考试后申请牌照的期限是 1 年内而非 2 年。

opts.t: Because he failed his first attempt, he must immediately re-enroll and repeat the entire licensing course before writing again.
opts.w: 属于重修触发条件混淆陷阱。规则规定「连续两次不及格（failing twice consecutively）」才必须重修课程，第一次不及格无需重修课程。

opts.t: He must wait at least 90 days to rewrite, within 2 years of finishing his assignments, and a second consecutive failure means repeating the course.
opts.w: 正确。牌照考试 70% 及格；考试须在完成课程作业后 2 年内参加（Rules s. 8、s. 9）；不及格须等至少 90 天才能重考，且连续两次不及格须重修课程。

opts.t: He may rewrite the examination after 7 days, and sitting a supplemental exam will extend his post-exam licence application window by an additional year.
opts.w: 属于考牌与申牌时间窗混淆陷阱。7 天是 REDMA 撤销期而非重考等待期（重考需等至少 90 天）；且通过考试后须在 1 年内提交牌照申请，参加补考（supplemental）不延长这一年期限。

main.trap: 四大保护机构张冠李戴
main.stem: A buyer delivers a deposit to a brokerage to be held in trust for a residential purchase. Before completion, a licensee at the brokerage unlawfully misappropriates the trust funds for personal use. Under British Columbia's four-pillar public protection framework, which organization exists specifically to compensate the buyer for this loss of trust funds?
main.zh: 一名买家将购房定金交给一家经纪行存入信托账户。在交易完成前，该经纪行的一名持牌人非法挪用了这笔信托资金供个人使用。在 BC 省公众保护的「四件套」框架下，哪一个机构专门负责赔付买家因信托资金被挪用而遭受的损失？

opts.t: The Real Estate Errors and Omissions Insurance Corporation
opts.w: 属于四大保护机构张冠李戴陷阱。地产错误与遗漏保险公司（E&O Insurance Corporation）承保的是持牌人执业中的错误与疏忽（errors and omissions），不赔付故意挪用信托资金。

opts.t: The Real Estate Foundation of British Columbia
opts.w: 属于四大保护机构张冠李戴陷阱。BC 地产基金会（Real Estate Foundation of BC）的职责是地产研究与公益资助，不负责客户资金损失赔付。

opts.t: The Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation
opts.w: 正确。地产赔偿基金公司（Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation）是公众保护四件套之一，专门负责赔付因持牌人挪用信托资金（misappropriation of trust funds）造成的损失。

opts.t: The Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate (OSRE)
opts.w: 属于旧机构名残留陷阱。OSRE 作为独立办公室已不存在（职权已并入 BCFSA），且监管机构不充当信托挪用赔偿基金。

main.trap: 纪律罚款与行政罚款混同
main.stem: After a BCFSA disciplinary hearing, an individual representative and that representative's brokerage are each found to have breached the Real Estate Services Act (RESA) through professional misconduct. Under RESA as currently in force, what is the maximum disciplinary penalty per contravention for each of them, in addition to forfeiture of remuneration?
main.zh: 在 BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）举行的纪律听证会后，一名个人代表及其挂靠的经纪行均被裁定违反《地产服务法》（RESA）构成专业失当。根据 RESA 的现行法定条款，除追缴违规报酬外，每次违规可科处的最高纪律罚款（disciplinary penalties）上限分别是多少？

opts.t: Up to $250,000 for the individual licensee and up to $500,000 for the brokerage per contravention.
opts.w: 正确。根据现行 RESA s. 43(2)(i)(j) 及 s. 43(2.1)，纪律罚款（disciplinary penalty）每次违规个人最高 $250,000、经纪行最高 $500,000，可就每一次违规分别科处并追缴该次违规所收报酬（注意：©2020 旧版考试资料中的较低罚款金额已经过时）。

opts.t: Up to $100,000 for the individual licensee and up to $250,000 for the brokerage per contravention.
opts.w: 属于纪律罚款与行政罚款混同陷阱。$100,000 是 RESA s. 56(2) 规定的单笔行政罚款（administrative penalty）法定上限，而非纪律罚款上限。

opts.t: Up to $500,000 for the individual licensee and up to $250,000 for the brokerage per contravention.
opts.w: 属于纪律罚款主体倒置陷阱。该选项把个人上限（$250,000）与经纪行上限（$500,000）写反了。

opts.t: A combined maximum of $100,000 across all contraventions, with no authority to recover remuneration.
opts.w: 属于纪律罚款与行政罚款混同陷阱。纪律罚款不仅上限为个人 $250,000 / 经纪行 $500,000，而且可以就每一次违规分别科处，并可另行追缴该次违规所收报酬。

main.trap: REDMA 与 HBRP 撤销权混淆
main.stem: A developer is marketing pre-sale strata lots in a new condominium project. A buyer receives the required disclosure statement and signs a written acknowledgment confirming an opportunity to read it on Day 1, and then signs the purchase agreement on Day 3. Under section 21(2) of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA), what is the buyer's statutory rescission right?
main.zh: 一家开发商正在销售新建共管公寓项目的楼花单位。买家于第 1 天收到法定披露声明并签署了确认「已有机会阅读披露声明」的书面确认，随后于第 3 天签订了购买协议。根据《地产开发营销法》（REDMA）第 21(2) 条，买家享有的法定撤销权是什么？

opts.t: The buyer may rescind within 7 days starting from Day 1, the date the disclosure acknowledgment was signed.
opts.w: 属于起算日选早不选晚陷阱。REDMA s. 21(2) 规定 7 天撤销期从「签订购买协议」与「开发商取得买家已有机会阅读披露声明书面确认」这两天中较晚的一天（the later of the two dates，即第 3 天）起算，而非较早的第 1 天。

opts.t: The buyer may rescind within 3 business days starting from Day 3, provided the buyer pays a 0.25% rescission fee to the developer.
opts.w: 属于 REDMA 与 HBRP 撤销权混淆陷阱。3 个工作日及 0.25% 撤销费是 2023-01-03 生效的住宅买家冷静期（Home Buyer Rescission Period, HBRP），适用于转售交易，不适用于 REDMA 下的开发商楼花销售。

opts.t: The buyer has 90 days from Day 3 to rescind the contract without penalty by notifying the BC Financial Services Authority.
opts.w: 属于时间窗与通知对象混淆陷阱。REDMA 撤销期为 7 天（90 天是考牌挂科重考间隔），且撤销通知须书面发给开发商（developer）而非 BCFSA。

opts.t: Written notice to the developer within 7 days counted from Day 3, the later of the contract date and the acknowledgment date.
opts.w: 正确。根据 REDMA s. 21(2)，买家享有法定撤销权（rescission rights）：从签订购买协议（第 3 天）与开发商取得买家「已有机会阅读披露声明（disclosure statement）」书面确认（第 1 天）这两天中较晚的一天（第 3 天）起 7 天内，可书面通知开发商撤销。

main.pt: 终身产权转让与本息费用分担
main.trap: 混淆按揭本息与运营费分担
main.stem: Evelyn holds a life estate in a residential property, with her nephew Marcus named as the remainderman in fee simple. Evelyn later transfers her entire interest in the property to her friend Diana. While Evelyn is still alive, whose life measures the duration of Diana's estate, and how are the property expenses allocated between the holder of the life estate and Marcus?
main.zh: Evelyn 持有一处住宅物业的终身产权（life estate），其侄子 Marcus 被指定为完全保有产权的剩余权人（remainderman）。随后 Evelyn 将她在该物业中的全部权益转让给朋友 Diana。在 Evelyn 在世期间，Diana 的产权存续期按谁的寿命计时？终身产权持有人与 Marcus 之间的物业费用应如何分担？

opts.t: Diana holds an estate pur autre vie measured by Evelyn's lifetime; the life estate holder pays property taxes and mortgage interest, while Marcus is responsible for mortgage principal and insurance.
opts.w: 正确。终身权人（life tenant）将权利转让给他人后，受让人拿到的是按原终身权人（Evelyn）寿命计时的产权（estate pur autre vie），一旦 Evelyn 身故，Diana 的权利即告终止；费用分担上，终身权人承担年度运营费用（水电、地税）与按揭利息（不含本金），剩余权人（remainderman）为保护未来权益负责偿还按揭本金与保险费。

opts.t: Diana holds a new life estate measured by her own lifetime; Diana pays both mortgage principal and interest, while Marcus pays property taxes and insurance.
opts.w: 错误。这是“转让即改按受让人寿命计时”及“住户全包按揭本息”的双重陷阱：终身权人不能转让出超出自己寿命的权利，故仍按 Evelyn 的寿命计时（estate pur autre vie）；且按揭本金由剩余权人承担，地税由终身权人承担。

opts.t: Diana holds an estate pur autre vie measured by Evelyn's lifetime; the life estate holder must pay mortgage principal and insurance, while Marcus pays operating expenses and mortgage interest.
opts.w: 错误。虽然正确识别了按他人寿命计时的产权（estate pur autre vie），但把终身权人与剩余权人的费用义务完全颠倒了：日常运营费与按揭利息归终身权人，按揭本金与保险费归剩余权人。

opts.t: Evelyn's transfer to a third party automatically extinguishes the life estate and vests immediate fee simple possession in Marcus.
opts.w: 错误。终身产权属于自由保有产权（freehold），可以在终身权人在世时转让给他人成为 estate pur autre vie，转让行为本身不会导致终身产权自动消灭。

main.pt: 限制性契约的消极性质要件
main.trap: 误把积极义务当成随地转移的限制性契约
main.stem: A developer sells Lot 1 to a buyer and registers a covenant against Lot 1 for the benefit of the neighbouring Lot 2, which the developer retains. The registered document contains two clauses: Clause I prohibits the owner of Lot 1 from operating any commercial business on the land, and Clause II requires the owner of Lot 1 to contribute money each year to repaint a fence on Lot 2. When Lot 1 is later resold to a new purchaser, which clause runs with the land to bind the new purchaser?
main.zh: 一名开发商将 1 号地卖给买方，并在 1 号地产权上登记了一份契约，以造福开发商自己保留的相邻 2 号地。已登记的文件包含两项条款：条款一禁止 1 号地业主在土地上经营任何商业业务；条款二要求 1 号地业主每年出钱重新粉刷 2 号地上的围栏。当 1 号地后来转卖给新买家时，哪一项条款会“随地转移”并约束新买家？

opts.t: Both Clause I and Clause II bind the new purchaser because registration under the Torrens system makes every covenant run with the land.
opts.w: 错误。这是“只要登记就能随地转移”的常见陷阱。限制性契约（restrictive covenant）要随地转移，必须同时满足五个要件，其中第一条就是内容必须是消极性质；要求出钱干活的积极契约（positive covenant）即使登记也不随地转移。

opts.t: Neither clause binds the new purchaser unless the new purchaser signs a fresh assumption contract with the owner of Lot 2.
opts.w: 错误。满足五个要件的消极限制性契约（条款一）一经在 BC 的 Torrens 制度下登记，即构成对后手买家的知悉并随地转移，无需新买家另签承担协议。

opts.t: Only Clause II binds the new purchaser, because maintaining physical improvements directly increases the value of the dominant tenement.
opts.w: 错误。虽然让受益地获益是要件之一，但条款二要求业主履行积极行为（出钱刷围栏），属于积极契约（positive covenant），违反了“内容必须是消极性质”的首要条件，不能约束后手买家。

opts.t: Only Clause I, because a covenant that runs with the land must be negative in nature, and Clause II is a positive covenant.
opts.w: 正确。限制性契约（restrictive covenant）随地转移（runs with the land）的五个要件之首是内容必须为消极性质——业主只需“不做某事”（如不经营商业）即算遵守；要求“必须做某事或出钱”的属于积极契约（positive covenant），仅在原签约当事人之间有约束力，不随地转移约束新买家。

main.pt: 地役权要件与法定路权例外
main.trap: 以为没有受益地就绝无地役权，或有便利就算地役权
main.stem: Consider two arrangements affecting rural land in British Columbia: Arrangement 1 grants a municipal government the right to run a water main across a farmer's field, even though the municipality owns no adjacent land; Arrangement 2 gives a distant city resident a personal right to park a camper on the farmer's field during summer holidays. Which statement correctly identifies the legal nature of these two arrangements?
main.zh: 考虑不列颠哥伦比亚省影响乡村土地的两项安排：安排一授予市政府在农夫田地里铺设主水管的权利，尽管市政府在附近没有拥有任何相邻土地；安排二授予一名远方城市居民在暑假期间将露营车停在农夫田地里的个人权利。哪项陈述正确指出了这两项安排的法律性质？

opts.t: Both arrangements are invalid as easements and operate only as personal licences because neither holder owns a dominant tenement.
opts.w: 错误。落入了“没有受益地就绝不可能是地役权”的陷阱，忽略了 Land Title Act s.218 规定的法定路权（statutory right of way）例外。

opts.t: Arrangement 1 is a statutory right of way under Land Title Act s.218 that needs no dominant tenement; Arrangement 2 is only a licence.
opts.w: 正确。普通法地役权（easement）要求必须有受益地（dominant tenement）和负担地（servient tenement），且必须真正让受益地本身受益；安排二没有受益地（easement in gross）且仅方便个人，只能算合同性质的许可（licence）。但安排一适用 Land Title Act s.218 的法定路权（statutory right of way）例外，允许王室、市政府或经指定的其他人在没有受益地的情况下设立地役权。

opts.t: Arrangement 1 is a profit à prendre because water pipes are placed in the soil, while Arrangement 2 is a valid common law easement.
opts.w: 错误。铺设市政水管属于法定路权（statutory right of way），并非取走土地自然产出物的收益权（profit à prendre）；且安排二没有受益地，不构成普通法地役权。

opts.t: Both arrangements are valid easements that run with the land as long as the parties describe the boundaries of the field clearly.
opts.w: 错误。范围清楚只是地役权的第三个要件；私人安排二既无受益地、也未让受益地受益，无法成为随地转移的地役权。

main.pt: 未登记短租约与自然支撑权边界
main.trap: 以为未登记租约一概无效或自然支撑权保护房屋
main.stem: A purchaser buys a fee simple residential property after reviewing the certificate of title, which shows no registered leases or easements. After taking title, the purchaser finds two problems: a tenant is living in the house under an unregistered 2-year lease signed with the seller, and a neighbour's excavation on the adjacent lot has made the purchaser's land and house subside, although the land would have slumped even with no house on it. What are the purchaser's legal rights regarding the tenant and the neighbour's excavation?
main.zh: 一名买方在查阅产权证、确认没有任何已登记的租约或地役权后，买下了一处完全保有产权（fee simple）住宅物业。接手产权后，买方发现两个问题：一是一名租客正根据与卖方签订的一份未登记的 2 年期租约住在房内；二是邻居在相邻地块挖地基，导致买方的土地及地上房屋沉降，而且即使地上没有房屋，这块地本身也会塌陷。关于该租客与邻居挖地基，买方的法律权利是什么？

opts.t: The purchaser can evict the tenant immediately because the lease was unregistered, and the natural right of support automatically covers both the land and the house.
opts.w: 错误。两项判断均错：3 年以内且实际占用的未登记租约受 Land Title Act s.23(2)(d) 保护，买方必须认；且自然支撑权只保护土地本身，不延伸到地上的建筑物。

opts.t: The purchaser is not bound by the unregistered lease under the Torrens system, and the neighbour is only liable if the provincial government granted a subsurface mineral licence.
opts.w: 错误。Torrens 制度下的无可争辩产权证有明确法定例外，3 年内实际占用的未登记短租约即属其一；且相邻支撑权与地下矿产许可是两码事。

opts.t: The purchaser is bound by the unregistered 2-year lease, and the natural right of support automatically guarantees full structural support for any residential building erected on fee simple land.
opts.w: 错误。虽然正确判断了 2 年未登记租约的约束力，但误以为自然支撑权（support）天然涵盖地面建筑物——保护建筑物必须另外设立支撑地役权。

opts.t: The buyer is bound by the occupied lease of 3 years or less, but natural support protects only the land, not the house, absent a support easement.
opts.w: 正确。第一，Land Title Act s.23(2)(d) 规定，产权证的无可争辩（indefeasible）效力并不排除期限 3 年以内、且承租人已实际占用的未登记租约，故 2 年期租约对新买方有约束力；第二，相邻土地天然享有的垂直与水平支撑权（right of support）只保护“地”本身，不延伸到地上的建筑物，想保护建筑物需要另外设立支撑地役权。

main.pt: 附着物与动产两步测试
main.trap: 看到固定就判附着物，忽略固定目的
main.stem: A ranch property is sold under a contract of purchase and sale that does not mention agricultural equipment or garden statues. Before completion, the seller removes (1) heavy steel livestock fencing equipment welded to metal posts in the ground solely to keep the equipment steady while in use, and (2) a massive stone sculpture that is not bolted down and rests by its own weight, which the original owner placed as the permanent centrepiece of the landscaped garden design. How would a court classify these two items under the common law two-step test?
main.zh: 一处牧场物业按买卖合同出售，合同中未提及农业设备或庭院雕像。交割前，卖方拆走了：（1）焊接固定在地面金属桩上的重型钢制牲畜围栏设备，焊接的目的仅仅是让设备在使用时保持稳定；（2）一座没有用螺栓固定、仅凭自身重量放置的巨型石雕，它是原业主作为景观花园设计的永久核心而摆放的。法院根据普通法两步测试会如何界定这两件物品？

opts.t: The welded livestock equipment is a fixture because welding is permanent, and the stone sculpture is a chattel because it is unattached.
opts.w: 错误。只看物理固定、不看固定意图：焊接设备的目的是让设备本身稳定好用，而不是改良土地，可判为动产；石雕虽然只凭自身重量放置、先推定为动产，但原业主把它作为景观设计的永久核心摆放，有意让它成为土地的一部分，推定被推翻。

opts.t: Both items are chattels because a seller is entitled to remove any item not expressly listed in the contract of purchase and sale.
opts.w: 错误。合同未写明时，附着物（fixture）依法随不动产自动转移给买方，卖方无权带走。

opts.t: The welded equipment may be a chattel since welding only steadied the equipment, while the sculpture placed as part of the garden design is a fixture.
opts.w: 正确。两步测试：（1）只凭自身重量放置、没有其他固定的物品先推定为动产，但有证据表明当事人有意让它成为土地的一部分时推定被推翻——石雕是原业主作为景观设计永久核心摆放的，属于附着物（fixture）；（2）固定的物品先推定为附着物，但按「更佳用途测试」，焊接围栏设备是为了让设备本身稳定好用而非改良土地，可判为动产（chattel）。

opts.t: Both items are fixtures because any item located outdoors on fee simple acreage automatically becomes part of the land.
opts.w: 错误。户外物品并非自动成为附着物，仍须经过固定程度与固定意图（更佳用途测试）的两步检验。

main.pt: 共有默认推定与联权共有单方分割
main.trap: 默认多人买房就是联权共有，或以为分割需全员同意
main.stem: Consider two co-ownership situations in British Columbia: In Situation 1, a transfer deed conveys a cottage to 'Liam and Noah' without stating whether they take as joint tenants or tenants in common, and without stating their share proportions. In Situation 2, three sisters—Ava, Mia, and Zoe—properly hold a house as registered joint tenants, and Ava secretly sells her share to a stranger, Leo, without telling Mia or Zoe, and then Ava dies leaving a will. What is the legal outcome in both situations?
main.zh: 考虑不列颠哥伦比亚省的两个共有情形：情形一，一份转让契据将一栋度假屋转让给“Liam 和 Noah”，但未写明他们是联权共有还是分权共有，也未写明各自的份额比例；情形二，三姐妹 Ava、Mia 和 Zoe 合法登记为一套房屋的联权共有人（joint tenants），随后 Ava 瞒着 Mia 和 Zoe 私下将自己那份卖给了陌生人 Leo，不久后 Ava 去世并留有遗嘱。这两种情形的法律结果是什么？

opts.t: Situation 1: joint tenancy is presumed. Situation 2: Ava's sale is void, because severance needs the consent of every joint tenant.
opts.w: 错误。两处均踩中核心陷阱：第一，Property Law Act s.11 规定未写明时默认推定为分权共有（tenancy in common），而非联权共有；第二，联权共有人单方出售自己的权益不需要征得其余共有人的同意或知情。

opts.t: Situation 1: tenancy in common in equal shares. Situation 2: Ava's sale makes Leo, Mia and Zoe tenants in common with one another.
opts.w: 错误。虽然情形一正确指出了分权共有（tenancy in common）默认推定，但在情形二中犯了“一人分割导致全员解除联权共有”的错误：三名联权共有人中有一人单方转让份额时，仅就转让出去的那一份转化为分权共有，其余共有人（Mia 和 Zoe）之间仍维持联权共有（joint tenancy）关系。

opts.t: Situation 1: tenancy in common in equal shares. Situation 2: Leo holds Ava's severed share in common, while Mia and Zoe remain joint tenants.
opts.w: 正确。情形一：依 Property Law Act s.11，转让文件将土地转让给两人或以上（个人代表或受托人除外）且未明确表达相反意图时，一律推定为分权共有（tenancy in common），且份额推定相等。情形二：任何一位联权共有人（joint tenant）都可以单方出售、抵押或处分自己的权益，无需其余共有人同意或知情；一旦处分即发生分割（severance），受让人 Leo 就该份权益成为分权共有人，而其余共有人 Mia 与 Zoe 之间仍维持联权共有关系。

opts.t: Situation 1: tenancy in common. Situation 2: Ava's share passes under her will, because a will on its own severs a joint tenancy.
opts.w: 错误。联权共有（joint tenancy）的核心是生存者取得权（right of survivorship），联权共有人不能通过遗嘱（will）处分或分割联权共有份额；Ava 是在生前通过出售完成了分割（severance），故其份额已归买受人 Leo，同样不会进入她的遗产。

main.pt: 原住民地权考试口径与现行判例
main.trap: 混淆考试资料考试口径与最新法院判例
main.stem: A prospective buyer is considering a $450,000 waterfront parcel registered in fee simple near a historic Indigenous settlement. First, how does the licensing course manual (the exam standard) classify Aboriginal title in relation to estates in land? Second, how should the licensee handle the transaction in practice in light of the 2025 BC Supreme Court ruling in Cowichan Tribes v. Canada?
main.zh: 一名潜在买家正在考虑购买一块估值 $450,000、位于历史原住民聚落遗址附近、登记为完全保有产权（fee simple）的滨水地块。第一，牌照课程考试资料（考试口径）如何界定原住民地权（Aboriginal title）与地产权（estates）的关系？第二，鉴于 2025 年 BC 最高法院在 Cowichan Tribes v. Canada 案中的裁决，持牌人在实务中应如何处理这笔交易？

opts.t: Exam: Aboriginal title is a freehold estate identical to fee simple. Practice: assure the buyer that a Torrens title certificate removes all legal risk.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径明确指出原住民地权（Aboriginal title）不是一种 estate，不能像 fee simple 一样自由转让；且实务中遇到敏感地块绝不能替客户打包票说“产权证没问题”。

opts.t: Exam: a title certificate is weak evidence that must be traced through old deeds. Practice: the licensee should draft an Aboriginal title indemnity clause.
opts.w: 错误。考试口径下，Torrens 产权证具有无可争辩（indefeasible）效力，是对王室及所有其他人证明业主享有 fee simple 的决定性证据；且持牌人不应越界自行起草复杂的产权法律意见，应转介产权律师。

opts.t: Exam: Aboriginal title is a leasehold estate limited to 18 months. Practice: the 2025 ruling has already been overturned by the Supreme Court of Canada.
opts.w: 错误。原住民地权不是租赁产权（leasehold estate）；18 个月是 Cowichan 案对部分政府所持 fee simple 无效宣告的延后生效期，且该案目前正在上诉中。

opts.t: Exam: Aboriginal title is not an estate and the title certificate is conclusive. Practice: given the 2025 ruling (under appeal), refer the buyer to a property lawyer.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，原住民地权（Aboriginal title）不是一种地产权（estate），不能像 fee simple 那样自由转让，且 Land Title Act 下的产权证具有无可争辩（indefeasible）效力；而在现行实务中，2025 BCSC 1490（正在上诉）认定原住民地权与 fee simple 可并存且两者均非绝对，因此针对这宗估值 $450,000 的敏感滨水地块，正确动作是提醒买方在尽调阶段咨询产权律师。

main.pt: 第73条分割禁令与租约例外
main.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
main.stem: An owner of a commercial property in British Columbia plans to enter into two new leases without applying to the approving officer for subdivision approval: Lease X is an eight-year lease for a single retail unit inside the existing building, and Lease Y is an eight-year lease for a fenced portion of the unimproved parking lot land. Under section 73 of the Land Title Act, which statement is correct?
main.zh: BC 省一处商业物业的业主计划在不向审批官申请分割批准的情况下签订两份新租约：租约 X 是出租现有建筑物内一个零售铺面的八年期租约，租约 Y 是出租未开发停车场土地一角围栏区域的八年期租约。根据《土地产权法》第 73 条，下列哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: Lease X is exempt as a lease of part of a building; Lease Y needs approval because it divides land for a lease longer than three years.
opts.w: 正确。依《土地产权法》（Land Title Act）第 73 条，任何人不得在未经第 7 部审批的情况下为签订超过三年（含终身）的租约而把土地分成更小地块（因此租土地一角的八年租约 Y 必须按分割办）；但第 73(3) 条规定，为出租建筑物或建筑物的一部分（part of a building）而做的划分不算分割，故八年商铺租约 X 豁免分割审批。

opts.t: Both Lease X and Lease Y are exempt from subdivision approval because neither lease exceeds the ten-year threshold set by provincial legislation.
opts.w: 错误。掉进了「三年与十年租约线混用」陷阱：十年线是《土地所有人透明法》（LOTA）触发透明申报的门槛，而《土地产权法》第 73 条禁止未批分割的租约年限线是三年。

opts.t: Both Lease X and Lease Y require subdivision approval from the approving officer because both leases have terms longer than three years.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了第 73(3) 条的关键例外：出租建筑物或建筑物的一部分不算分割，所以一栋楼可以租给许多长租租户而不必先做土地分割。

opts.t: Neither Lease X nor Lease Y requires subdivision approval if the municipal zoning bylaw already permits commercial retail and parking uses on the parcel.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了分区（zoning）与分割（subdivision）：地方政府分区允许的用途或户数走的是《地方政府法》，并没有取消《土地产权法》第 73 条的分割禁令或审批官审批。

main.pt: 裸地共管与传统分割差异
main.trap: 裸地共管道路当市政路
main.stem: A buyer is comparing two detached houses that look identical from the street: Property M was created by a conventional subdivision plan, while Property N was created by a bare land strata plan. Which statement accurately describes the legal difference between the two properties?
main.zh: 一名买家正在比较两栋从街上看一模一样的独立屋：物业 M 由传统分割图创设，而物业 N 由裸地共管图创设。下列哪项准确描述了这两处物业之间的法律差异？

opts.t: Internal roads in both Property M and Property N vest in the Crown and are maintained by the municipality at public expense.
opts.w: 错误。掉进了「裸地共管道路当市政路」陷阱：只有传统分割图上标为道路的部分依第 107 条献给公众由公共一方维护，裸地共管（bare land strata）的内部道路是共有财产。

opts.t: M's roads are dedicated to the public, while N's roads are common property repaired at the owners' shared cost, and N's plan is labelled bare land strata.
opts.w: 正确。传统分割的道路献给公众并由公共一方维护，没有共管治理；裸地共管切的是土地，内部道路属于共有财产（common property），维修铲雪等费用由全体业主按单位权益分摊，且法规要求必须在审批官签名旁明写自己是裸地共管图（bare land strata plan）。

opts.t: Owners in Property N have no strata corporation, bylaws, or contingency reserve fund because bare land strata lots contain no shared building walls.
opts.w: 错误。裸地共管虽然切的是土地，但同样设有共管法团（strata corporation）、章程（bylaws）与专项储备金（contingency reserve fund）。

opts.t: Boundaries in Property N are determined by the centre line of the house walls rather than by survey markers on the plan.
opts.w: 错误。依《共管物业法》第 68(4) 条，裸地共管单位的边界是按图上的测量标记（survey markers）确定的，而不是按墙体中心线。

main.pt: 欺诈、善意对价与押记推定
main.trap: 把押记当成不可推翻产权
main.stem: A rogue forges the registered owner's signature on a transfer and becomes the registered fee simple owner of a parcel. Before the fraud is discovered, the rogue grants and registers a mortgage to an innocent bank in exchange for a loan, and also transfers a neighbouring lot (acquired through the same forgery) by way of gift to his innocent cousin. When the true owner discovers the fraud and brings an action to recover both parcels, what is the legal outcome under the Land Title Act and BC case law?
main.zh: 一名骗子伪造注册所有人的签名办理过户，成为一块土地的注册完全所有权人。在欺诈被发现前，骗子向一家无辜的银行设定并登记了一份按揭以换取贷款，同时把（通过同一伪造手段取得的）相邻地块以赠与方式过户给了对此不知情的表弟。当真正的所有人发现欺诈并起诉追回两块地时，根据《土地产权法》及 BC 判例法，法律结果是什么？

opts.t: Both the bank's mortgage and the cousin's fee simple title are protected by indefeasibility because neither party participated in the rogue's fraud.
opts.w: 错误。同时踩中两个陷阱：第一，押记（charge，如按揭）依第 26 条不享有不可推翻性；第二，表弟是以赠与（gift）方式取得，未支付合理有价对价（valuable consideration），不能靠第 25.1 条保住产权。

opts.t: The cousin loses title because a gift is not valuable consideration under section 25.1, and the bank's mortgage is kept valid on title because the bank gave full loan value.
opts.w: 错误。前半句对，后半句掉进「把押记当成不可推翻产权」陷阱：依第 26 条及 Gill v. Bucholtz 案，伪造转让之后设立的按揭即使银行无辜且放了款，在原所有人恢复产权时按揭也一并被涂销。

opts.t: The cousin loses title since a gift is not valuable consideration, and the bank's mortgage is cancelled with no assurance fund claim.
opts.w: 正确。依第 25.1(2) 条，无效文书下只有善意且支付按当时市价属合理的有价对价（valuable consideration）的完全所有权受让人才受保护，赠与或象征性一元均不成立；而依第 26 条及 Gill v. Bucholtz（2009），押记（charge）的登记只是可反驳的推定，不享有不可推翻性（indefeasibility），产权恢复给原所有人时按揭一并涂销，且不能向保证基金（assurance fund）索赔。

opts.t: The cousin keeps indefeasible title as an innocent family member, while the bank's mortgage is cancelled and fully reimbursed by the LTSA assurance fund.
opts.w: 错误。表弟未付有价对价不能保住产权；银行的按揭属于押记，普通法上原本就什么都没拿到，并非《土地产权法》剥夺其权益，因此不能向保证基金索赔。

main.pt: 不可推翻性例外与短租约
main.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
main.stem: A buyer completes the purchase of a residential property and becomes the registered fee simple owner. On moving day, she discovers a tenant living in the basement suite under an unregistered three-year lease signed with the previous owner. How do sections 20(3) and 23(2)(d) of the Land Title Act apply to this tenant?
main.zh: 一名买家完成了住宅物业的购买并成为注册完全所有权人。搬家当天，她发现地下室套间里住着一名租客，该租客持有与前业主签订的一份未登记的三年期租约。根据《土地产权法》第 20(3) 条和第 23(2)(d) 条，这项规定对该租客如何适用？

opts.t: The lease is void against the new owner because section 20(1) states that no unregistered instrument passes any estate or interest in land.
opts.w: 错误。忽略了第 20(3) 条的明文排除：不超过三年且有实际占用的租约不受第 20(1) 条「不登记不生效」规则的限制。

opts.t: The lease is valid only between the tenant and the previous owner, so the new owner may evict the tenant immediately as a trespasser.
opts.w: 错误。「未登记转让仅在当事人之间有效」适用于完全所有权转让或超过三年的租约；而看到有人实际占着房子且租期不超过三年，不能下「无权占用」的结论，该短租约对新业主同样有效。

opts.t: The tenant's lease is valid only if it was disclosed in the Land Owner Transparency Registry before the transfer completed.
opts.w: 错误。LOTA 只管超过十年的租约，且 LOTR 与产权效力无关。

opts.t: The lease binds the new owner without registration because it is for 3 years or less with actual occupation, an exception to indefeasibility.
opts.w: 正确。依《土地产权法》第 20(3) 条，不超过三年且有实际占用（actual occupation）的租约不登记也有效；同时依第 23(2)(d) 条，同样条件的短租约是不可推翻性（indefeasibility）的十项法定例外之一，直接约束新注册所有人。

main.pt: 产权负担时限与留置权保留金
main.trap: 留置权 10% 与共管买家 7% 混淆
main.stem: A buyer is completing the purchase of a newly constructed strata apartment directly from the developer, while across town a homeowner is paying a general contractor for a major house addition. Under the Strata Property Act regulations and the Builders Lien Act, what holdback percentages apply to the strata buyer and the homeowner respectively, and what is the deadline for a contractor to file a claim of builders lien?
main.zh: 一名买家正在直接从开发商手中完成一套新建共管公寓的购买，而城另一头的一名房主正在向总承包商支付房屋重大扩建工程款。根据《共管物业法规》和《建筑留置权法》，共管买家和房主分别适用多少的保留金扣留比例？承包商提交建筑留置权申请的时限又是多久？

opts.t: Strata buyer holds back 7% of the gross purchase price; homeowner holds back 10% of the greater of contract price or payments; liens within 45 days.
opts.w: 正确。从开发商手上买共管单位的买家，依《共管物业法》第 88(2) 条及法规第 5.2 条须扣留总购价（gross purchase price）的 7%；而工程业主依《建筑留置权法》（Builders Lien Act）第 4(1) 条须扣留合同价或已付款中较大者的 10%（保留金期 55 天）；提交留置权申请（claim of lien）的时限依第 20 条为完工证明书签发或合同完成/废止/终止后 45 天内。

opts.t: Both the strata buyer and the homeowner must retain 10% of the purchase or contract price, and a builders lien claim must be filed within 55 days.
opts.w: 错误。掉进了「留置权 10% 与共管买家 7% 混淆」陷阱，同时把 55 天的保留金期（holdback period，第 8 条）当成了 45 天的留置权申报期（第 20 条）。

opts.t: The strata buyer retains 10% of the assessed value, the homeowner retains 7% of the contract price, and a builders lien claim must be filed within 21 days.
opts.w: 错误。把 7% 和 10% 颠倒了，且 21 天是业主发出「限期起诉」通知后留置权人起诉并登 CPL 的时限（第 33(2) 条），不是初次提交留置权的时限。

opts.t: The strata buyer automatically deducts 7% from the purchase price of any resale home without needing a contract clause, and the lien claim deadline is 1 year.
opts.w: 错误。7% 法定规则针对向开发商买共管单位；对于一般新建或翻新房买卖，《建筑留置权法》并不自动授权买家单方面扣钱，必须事先把保留权写进买卖合同；且 1 年是已登记留置权起诉并登 CPL 的失效期（第 33(1) 条）。

main.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
main.stem: A British Columbia corporation (not listed as exempt in Schedule 1) signs and applies to register a twelve-year commercial lease over a freestanding warehouse parcel. One individual shareholder holds 10% of the issued voting shares of that corporation. Under the Land Owner Transparency Act (LOTA), what are the filing obligations for this registration?
main.zh: 一家 BC 省公司（未列入附表 1 豁免名单）签订了一份针对独立仓库地块的十二年期商业租约并申请办理登记。一名个人股东持有该公司 10% 的已发行有表决权股份。根据《土地所有人透明法》（LOTA），本次登记的申报义务是什么？

opts.t: No LOTA filings are required because only fee simple transfers trigger LOTA, and corporate shareholders are only disclosed if they hold at least 25% of the shares.
opts.w: 错误。同时记错两个核心门槛：LOTA 下的「土地权益（interest in land）」包含期限超过 10 年的租约（第 1 条），且公司权益持有人（interest holder）的门槛是 10% 股份或表决权（第 3 条），不是 25%。

opts.t: The corporation files a transparency declaration and, as a reporting body taking a lease over 10 years, a transparency report naming the 10% shareholder.
opts.w: 正确。十二年租约超过了 LOTA 第 1 条的「10 年租约线」，属于必须申报的土地权益；非豁免公司属于申报主体（reporting body），除提交透明申报表（transparency declaration）外，还必须提交透明报告（transparency report）；个人持有相关公司 10% 或以上已发行股份或表决权即构成权益持有人（interest holder），故持股 10% 的股东必须被披露。

opts.t: The registrar will register the lease first and give the corporation 2 years to submit a transparency declaration.
opts.w: 错误。依 LOTA 第 11(1) 条，受让人未随登记申请提交透明申报表的，登记官必须当场拒绝受理该登记申请。

opts.t: Once the transparency report is filed, any subsequent buyer dealing with the landlord is bound by constructive notice of all beneficial owners named in the report under section 29 of the Land Title Act.
opts.w: 错误。依《土地产权法》第 29(5)(6) 条，与注册所有人打交道的人不受任何已提交的透明申报表、透明报告或公开可检索信息的影响，知情也不构成欺诈证据。

main.pt: 制造房屋登记与移动规则
main.trap: 2020 考试口径与 2026 现行接口错位
main.stem: An owner of an unregistered manufactured home wants to list the home for sale and move it to a new pad across town next month. Under the Manufactured Home Act and the course manual, which statement correctly describes the legal requirements and registry system?
main.zh: 一名未登记制造房屋的业主想要把该房屋挂牌出售，并在下个月把它移到城另一头的新地台上。根据《制造房屋法》及课程考试资料，下列哪项正确描述了相关法律要求和登记系统？

opts.t: An unregistered manufactured home can be offered for sale as long as it has an MHR safety label, and the buyer receives an indefeasible title certificate upon closing.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了多处规则：依第 18 条，未登记的制造房屋不得出售、要约出售或移动；安全认证是 CSA 标签而非 MHR 标签（MHR 只是登记编号身份标识）；且制造房屋登记没有产权证、没有不可推翻性。

opts.t: A transport permit remains valid for 2 months from issue, and a creditor's caution in the Manufactured Home Registry lapses after 21 days.
opts.w: 错误。把产权登记处 caveat 的时限套到了制造房屋上：制造房屋的运输许可（transport permit）自签发日起 30 天失效（第 17(1) 条），而诉讼警示（caution）是 3 个月后失效（第 22(3) 条）。

opts.t: It must not be sold, offered or moved while unregistered; moving needs registration and a 30-day transport permit, now handled via BC Registry Services.
opts.w: 正确。依《制造房屋法》（Manufactured Home Act）第 15(1)、17(1) 及 18 条，未登记的制造房屋不得出售、要约出售或移动，移动前必须先登记并取得有效期 30 天的运输许可（transport permit），违规最高罚 $2,000；考试口径说登记通常只接受通过 BC OnLine 电子提交，而现行入口已改为 BC Registry Services。

opts.t: Once the wheels are removed from a manufactured home on a rented pad, the Manufactured Home Act no longer applies and tenancy disputes are governed by the Residential Tenancy Act.
opts.w: 错误。有没有轮子不影响制造房屋的法定定性；且制造房屋停在出租地台（pad）上时，业主与地台出租人之间适用的是《制造房屋园区租赁法》（Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act），不是《住宅租赁法》。

main.pt: 过失三要件与免责声明的效力
main.trap: 通用免责声明护身陷阱
main.stem: Before publishing a residential listing, a listing licensee notices that the homeowner's sketch shows a finished basement area that clearly includes an unheated detached garage. The licensee still advertises the total figure as finished living area, adding the standard phrase 'Information believed to be correct but not guaranteed.' After purchasing the property, the buyer sues for loss caused by the overstated living area. Which statement best describes the licensee's liability?
main.zh: 在发布住宅挂牌信息前，挂牌持牌人注意到业主草图中的已装修地下室面积明显把一间无暖气的独立车库算了进去。持牌人仍将该总数字作为已装修居住面积发布，并附上一句标准用语「此信息据信正确但不作保证」。买方购入物业后，就居住面积虚高造成的损失提起诉讼。下列哪项最准确地描述了持牌人的责任？

opts.t: The licensee is protected because the standard disclaimer eliminates any duty of care owed to an unrepresented buyer.
opts.w: 错误。这是「通用免责声明护身陷阱」；法院认定泛泛的通用免责声明（general disclaimer）不足以推翻卖方持牌人对买方负有的注意义务（duty of care），更何况持牌人已看出数据有误。

opts.t: The licensee is liable because no form of disclaimer can protect a person who publishes information while knowing it to be inaccurate.
opts.w: 正确。在过失（negligence）与虚假陈述原则下，泛泛的免责声明本就难以免责，而最重要的一条底线是：没有任何形式的免责声明（哪怕是具体免责声明）能够保护一个明知信息不准确却仍照常发布的人。此外在现行《地产服务规则》s.34 下，未尽合理注意与技能还可直接触发 C 档行政罚款。

opts.t: The licensee owes a duty of care only to the seller client, so the buyer's sole legal remedy is against the homeowner.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了受托义务与过失注意义务的边界；共同法上的注意义务（duty of care）及于一切可合理预见会受其行为影响的人（包括买方），现行 Rules s.34 的合理注意与技能义务同样对所有人成立。

opts.t: The buyer's loss is considered too remote in law because floor area discrepancies affect property value rather than physical safety.
opts.w: 错误。损害是否过于遥远（remoteness）看的是损害类型在被告行为时是否可合理预见；报错居住面积导致买方遭受经济损失完全属于可预见的损害类型。

main.pt: 过失性虚假陈述与欺诈的要件区分
main.trap: 专家身份与欺诈心理状态混淆
main.stem: Which statement accurately distinguishes the tort of negligent misrepresentation (under the Hedley Byrne principle) from the tort of deceit (fraudulent misrepresentation)?
main.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确区分了（Hedley Byrne 原则下的）过失性虚假陈述侵权与欺诈（欺诈性虚假陈述）侵权？

opts.t: Negligent misrepresentation requires a special relationship involving a skilled advisor and carelessness, whereas deceit requires moral fraud and can be committed by a non-expert.
opts.w: 正确。过失性虚假陈述（negligent misrepresentation）要求陈述人是具备特殊技能的专家、与合理依赖者存在特殊关系（special relationship），且心理状态为粗心（carelessness）；而欺诈（deceit）的核心是道德上的欺骗（moral fraud，即明知不实或鲁莽不顾真假），且不需要行为人是专家。

opts.t: Deceit can only be committed by a licensed professional in the course of business, whereas negligent misrepresentation applies only to casual social conversations.
opts.w: 错误。恰好把两者的身份要求颠倒了：需要专家身份、在业务过程中产生特殊关系的是过失性虚假陈述，而欺诈不要求专家身份，任何人均可构成。

opts.t: Negligent misrepresentation is actionable per se without proof of loss, whereas deceit requires proof that the property was physically damaged.
opts.w: 错误。本身即可诉（actionable per se，无须证明损害）是侵入（trespass）的特征；过失性虚假陈述与欺诈均要求依赖导致了可预见的损失。

opts.t: A skilled advisor can avoid liability for deceit simply by refusing to charge a commission for the transaction.
opts.w: 错误。欺诈源于明知不实或鲁莽不顾真假的陈述，不收佣金绝不能免除欺诈的侵权与合同法责任。

main.pt: 受托义务举证责任倒置与丧失佣金
main.trap: 受托义务举证与后果错位陷阱
main.stem: A seller discovers after completion that their listing licensee privately agreed to rebate a portion of the commission to the buyer without informing the seller. When the seller refuses to pay the commission and the dispute reaches court, how does the law of fiduciary duty govern the burden of proof and the licensee's entitlement to commission?
main.zh: 卖方在交易完成后发现，其挂牌持牌人曾私下与买方约定将一部分佣金返还给买方，且未告知卖方。当卖方拒绝支付佣金且争议诉至法院时，受托义务法如何规范举证责任以及持牌人收取佣金的权利？

opts.t: The seller bears the burden of proving that the rebate reduced the final sale price, and the licensee keeps the remaining net commission.
opts.w: 错误。这是「受托义务举证与后果错位陷阱」；受托义务（fiduciary duty）不要求委托人证明价格受损，且举证责任不在卖方身上，违约持牌人也不能保留剩余佣金。

opts.t: Because the licensee reduced their own income rather than making a secret profit, no breach of fiduciary duty occurred.
opts.w: 错误。法院明确裁定，受托人的披露义务不限于持牌人从中获利、影响物业价值或存在利益冲突的情形，而是涵盖一切与合同标的有关、可能影响委托人行为的事项。

opts.t: The burden of proof is on the licensee to show full compliance with fiduciary duties, and the licensee forfeits the right to collect the claimed commission.
opts.w: 正确。在受托义务四原则下，举证责任倒置在持牌人身上（burden of proof is on the licensee）；持牌人不得自行判断什么会影响委托人决定，私下与买方分佣未告知卖方构成违反受托义务，法院判例的第一顺位后果是持牌人无权收取所主张的佣金（丧失佣金）。在现行规则下，这还同时违反 Rules s.30 与 s.56（C 档）。

opts.t: The dispute must be decided by the Errors and Omissions Insurance Corporation, which reimburses the licensee for lost commission.
opts.w: 错误。E&O 保险保的是对第三方的过失赔偿责任，绝不会替违反受托义务的持牌人补发被法院剥夺的佣金。

main.pt: 替代责任与代表职务行为的边界
main.trap: 独立承包商免除替代责任陷阱
main.stem: A real estate representative signs an independent contractor agreement with a brokerage. On Tuesday afternoon, the representative negligently misstates zoning bylaws to a buyer during a property tour. That night, after finishing work, the representative drives a company-owned car to a movie theatre and negligently causes a traffic collision. For which incident(s) is the brokerage vicariously liable?
main.zh: 某地产代表（representative）与一家经纪行签订了独立承包商协议。周二下午，该代表在带看物业期间过失向买方报错了分区附例。当晚下班后，该代表驾驶公司所有的汽车去看电影，途中因过失引发交通事故。经纪行对哪一（些）事件承担替代责任？

opts.t: Neither incident, because signing an independent contractor agreement shields the brokerage from vicarious liability for all actions of the representative.
opts.w: 错误。这是「独立承包商免除替代责任陷阱」；在共同法替代责任（vicarious liability）上，法院看的是职务关系而非合同标签，明确将代表（representative）当作雇员对待。

opts.t: Both incidents, because the representative used a company-owned vehicle at night and held a licence through the brokerage during the day.
opts.w: 错误。替代责任的分界线是「是否发生在通常雇佣过程中（in the ordinary course of employment）」，而不是「有没有用公司的东西」；下班开公司车去看电影撞人，法院认定不在雇佣过程中，雇主不负责。

opts.t: Only the nighttime traffic collision, because motor vehicle accidents automatically bind the registered owner of the brokerage.
opts.w: 错误。下班看电影属于私人活动，不构成替代责任；而白天带看报错分区附例恰恰发生在履行地产职务的过程中。

opts.t: Only the zoning misstatement during the property tour, because courts treat a representative as an employee for acts committed in the ordinary course of employment.
opts.w: 正确。即使签有独立承包商协议，法院在替代责任（vicarious liability）上仍将代表视为雇员；白天带看报错信息发生在通常雇佣过程中，经纪行须承担替代责任；而下班看电影途中撞人不在履行职务范围内，由行为人独自承担。

main.pt: 《占用人责任法》与开放日多重占用人
main.trap: 单一占用人或排除更高标准陷阱
main.stem: A homeowner gives a listing licensee control of a residence for a Sunday afternoon open house. While walking through the kitchen, a prospective buyer slips on water leaking from a faulty appliance and is injured. Under the BC Occupiers Liability Act (OLA), how is responsibility determined?
main.zh: 某业主将住宅交由挂牌持牌人控制，以举办周日下午的开放日活动。一名潜在买方走过厨房时，因故障家电漏水滑倒受伤。根据 BC《占用人责任法》（OLA），责任如何认定？

opts.t: The homeowner and the hosting licensee can both be occupiers at once, each owing reasonable care to keep visitors and their property reasonably safe.
opts.w: 正确。依据《占用人责任法》（Occupiers Liability Act, OLA）s.1，同一场所可以有不止一个占用人（more than one occupier）；主持开放日的持牌人因被交付对场所状况、活动及获准进入者的控制权而与业主同为占用人，均须依 s.3(1) 尽合理注意使访客及其财物合理安全。

opts.t: Once the licensee takes the keys for the open house, the homeowner's liability as an occupier is completely extinguished for the whole afternoon.
opts.w: 错误。同一场所可同时存在多个占用人，业主作为占用人的责任不会因为持牌人也是占用人而自动消失。

opts.t: The OLA overrides and lowers any higher standard of repair imposed on landlords by the Residential Tenancy Act.
opts.w: 错误。OLA s.3(4) 明文规定，本法的标准不免除其他法律（如《住宅租赁法》RTA s.32 或现行《工人赔偿法》s.25，考试口径旧称 s.119）对特定人群施加的更高注意标准。

opts.t: Open house visitors are classified as bare licensees at common law and are deemed to willingly assume all indoor hazards.
opts.w: 错误。OLA 已经废除了 invitee / licensee / trespasser 的旧共同法分档，对所有获准进入者适用统一的合理注意标准；开放日访客也不属于 s.3(3.1)–(3.3) 推定自甘风险（willingly assumed risks）的犯罪擅入或荒野免费休闲情形。

main.pt: 侵入与私人妨害的构成要件与抗辩
main.trap: 侵入与妨害要件互换陷阱
main.stem: A homeowner purchases a residence next to a small manufacturing plant that has operated in the area for many years. Corrosive fumes escaping from the plant's vents cause physical blistering to the exterior paint of the homeowner's house. When sued in private nuisance, the plant owner argues that the homeowner voluntarily moved next to an existing plant and that the plant uses industry-best filtration. How will a court evaluate these defences?
main.zh: 某屋主在一间已在该地区运营多年的小型制造厂旁购买了一处住宅。从工厂排风口逸出的腐蚀性烟气导致屋主房屋外墙油漆出现物理起泡剥落。在被诉私人妨害时，工厂主辩称屋主是自愿搬到既有工厂旁边的，且工厂已采用了行业最佳过滤设备。法院将如何评判这些抗辩理由？

opts.t: Both defences succeed because moving next to a known nuisance constitutes voluntary assumption of risk, and exercising utmost care defeats nuisance liability.
opts.w: 错误。这是典型的「侵入与妨害抗辩陷阱」；法院明确否定「你自己搬到妨害旁边来的（coming to the nuisance / volenti non fit injuria）」以及「我已经尽了最大注意与技能」作为私人妨害的有效抗辩。

opts.t: The homeowner must refile the action as trespass because escaping fumes are an intentional and direct entry actionable per se.
opts.w: 错误。烟气、异味、噪音从自己土地逸出影响到邻地是私人妨害（private nuisance）的典型形态，而非直接针对他人土地的侵入（trespass）。

opts.t: Neither succeeds: coming to the nuisance and taking utmost care are not defences, and reasonableness is no answer to physical damage.
opts.w: 正确。在私人妨害（private nuisance）中，①「你自己搬到妨害旁」与「已尽最大注意和技能」均被法院明确判定为无效抗辩；② 更重要的是，当妨害造成实际物理损害（actual physical damage，如外墙油漆腐蚀剥落）而非仅干扰享用时，行为本身是否合理不再是抗辩理由。

opts.t: The plant owner is immune as long as other factories in the district also contribute to the corrosive fumes.
opts.w: 错误。「不是我一个人造成的，是几家凑起来才有的」同样被法院明确否定——每一家制造妨害者都必须为自己造成的那一份负责。

main.pt: 错误遗漏保险、赔偿基金与纪律处分口径
main.trap: 保险与赔偿基金混袋陷阱
main.stem: A managing broker misappropriates trust deposits belonging to three separate households and flees. Meanwhile, an associate broker at the same brokerage faces a $5,000 Category C administrative penalty for failing to exercise reasonable care and skill on an unrelated file. How do the Real Estate Compensation Fund and the Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance plan respond?
main.zh: 某管理经纪从经纪行信托账户中侵吞了属于三户不同家庭的定金后潜逃。与此同时，同一经纪行的一名副经纪因在另一宗无关交易中未尽合理注意与技能而面临 C 档 $5,000 行政罚款。特别赔偿基金与错误与遗漏（E&O）保险计划将如何应对？

opts.t: E&O insurance reimburses the stolen trust deposits, and the Compensation Fund pays the associate broker's $5,000 administrative penalty.
opts.w: 错误。这是「保险与赔偿基金混袋陷阱」；E&O 保的是「不小心（过失）」，不保侵吞定金；特别赔偿基金保的是「不老实（侵吞托付资金）」，而行政罚款无论哪个钱袋都不替付。

opts.t: The Compensation Fund covers up to $1,000,000 per household without a brokerage cap, and E&O insurance covers the $5,000 administrative penalty because it arose from carelessness.
opts.w: 错误。特别赔偿基金有明确法定上限（单一申请人 $200,000、同一责任经纪行全部申请合计 $1,000,000，而非每户 $1,000,000），且 E&O 保险只赔民事过失责任，绝不报销 BCFSA 的行政罚款、纪律罚款或执法开支。

opts.t: Each household is capped at $200,000 within a shared $1,000,000 brokerage limit, and the associate broker pays the $5,000 penalty personally, as E&O excludes penalties.
opts.w: 正确。托付资金被侵吞属特别赔偿基金（Real Estate Compensation Fund，RESA s.60）范围，受单一申请人上限 $200,000 及同一责任经纪行全部申请合计上限 $1,000,000 限制（超出时按比例分摊 prorated）；而 Rules s.34 触发的 C 档 $5,000 行政罚款不在 E&O 保障范围内，须由持牌人自己掏钱。

opts.t: Both the stolen deposits and the administrative penalty are paid out of BCFSA's discipline enforcement budget after a 30-day appeal to the Financial Services Tribunal.
opts.w: 错误。行政罚款是交给 BCFSA 的，BCFSA 不会替违规持牌人交罚款，被侵吞定金则由全体持牌人缴费设立的特别赔偿基金在上限内补偿。

main.pt: 租赁与许可的排他占有判准
main.trap: 抬头名称与实质排他占有倒置
main.stem: A property owner signs a document titled 'Personal Licence Agreement' with a florist for a street-level shop. Although the document calls the florist a 'licensee,' it grants the florist the sole keys and the right to exclude everyone, including the owner, from the premises for a two-year period at a monthly fee. If the owner sells the building six months later, how will a court most likely classify the florist's interest?
main.zh: 一名业主与花店店主就一间临街商铺签署了一份题为「个人许可协议」的文件。尽管文件称花店店主为「被许可人（licensee）」，但协议授予店主唯一的钥匙，并允许其在两年期内按月付费、排除包括业主在内的任何人进入该处所。如果业主在六个月后卖掉该栋楼，法院最可能如何认定花店店主的权益？

opts.t: As a contractual licence that does not run with the land, because the document is explicitly titled a licence agreement.
opts.w: 掉入「抬头名称与实质排他占有倒置」陷阱。合同抬头写「licensor / licensee」并不决定法律性质，法院看重的是当事人的真实意图与是否授予排他占有。

opts.t: As a lease that creates an interest in land and binds the new building owner, because the agreement grants exclusive possession.
opts.w: 正确。判断协议是租赁（lease）还是许可（licence）看当事人的意图，而最有分量的证据是是否授予排他占有（exclusive possession）。给了排他占有，法院通常认定它是租赁，从而创设随地而走（runs with the land）的土地权益（interest in land），约束新业主。

opts.t: As a residential tenancy governed by the Residential Tenancy Act, because any exclusive possession triggers the RTA.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。花店商铺属于商业用途，创设的是商业租赁（commercial tenancy），受普通法与《商业租赁法》（CTA）调整，而非《住宅租赁法》（RTA）。

opts.t: As a tenancy at will that terminates automatically the moment the building is transferred to a new buyer.
opts.w: 混淆了固定期商业租赁与意愿租赁（tenancy at will）。该协议有明确的两年期限与按月租金，且赋予排他占有，属于固定期商业租赁而非随时终止的意愿租赁。

main.pt: 商业租赁的租期类型与终止
main.stem: A seller agrees to let the buyer of a commercial office unit move in three weeks before the completion date so the buyer can set up office furniture. Their agreement does not mention rent or a fixed duration, and either party may end the occupancy at any time. What type of tenancy exists during those three weeks, and what happens if the closing is delayed and the seller starts accepting monthly rent payments?
main.zh: 卖方同意商业写字楼单元的买方在成交日前三周提前搬入，以便买方布置办公家具。双方的协议未提租金或固定期限，任何一方随时可以结束占有。这三周内存在何种租赁关系？如果交易推迟且卖方开始按月收取租金，会发生什么变化？

opts.t: A periodic tenancy exists initially, which converts into a 99-year fixed-term lease once rent is accepted.
opts.w: 颠倒了因果且夸张了期限。成交前无固定期、随时可终止的提前入住创设的是意愿租赁（tenancy at will），按期收租只会使其被推定为周期性租赁，不会变成 99 年固定期。

opts.t: A fixed-term lease exists initially, which terminates automatically without notice only after an RTB order is issued.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱，且混淆了固定期与意愿租赁。商业写字楼不受 RTB 管辖，且随时可终止的安排不是固定期租赁（fixed-term tenancy）。

opts.t: A tenancy at will; once the seller starts taking periodic rent, the law may imply a periodic tenancy that needs reasonable notice to end.
opts.w: 正确。占用人经业主同意占有土地且任何一方随时可终止的（最常见于买方在成交前获准先行入住），属于意愿租赁（tenancy at will）；一旦业主开始按期收取租金，法律会推定它已变成周期性租赁（periodic tenancy），终止就必须给合理通知（reasonable notice）。

opts.t: A mere licence exists that prohibits the owner from claiming any compensation for use and occupation even if no rent waiver was agreed.
opts.w: 记错了意愿租赁的补偿规则。在意愿租赁（tenancy at will）下，只要双方不是明确约定免租，业主就有权就「使用与占有（use and occupation）」获得合理补偿。

main.pt: 住宅自住收房通知与异议期
main.trap: 考试旧口径与现行新法混淆
main.stem: According to the course manual, when a residential landlord serves a Notice to End Tenancy so that the landlord or a close family member can occupy the rental unit, what is the minimum notice period required, how many days does the tenant have to dispute the notice, and how much compensation must the landlord provide?
main.zh: 根据课程手册（考试口径），当住宅房东为了本人或近亲入住该出租单元而送达终止租赁通知时，要求的最短通知期是多久？租客有多少天可以对该通知提出异议？房东必须提供多少补偿？

opts.t: 2 months' notice, 15 days for the tenant to dispute, and compensation equal to 1 month's rent.
opts.w: 正确。按课程手册（©2020 考试口径），房东或买家自住收房适用两个月通知（Two Month Notice to End Tenancy）、租客 15 天异议期，以及相当于 1 个月租金的补偿。注意：2026 年现行 BC 省法律已将自住与买家自住收房改为必须由 RTB 网上门户生成的 3 个月通知与 21 天租客异议期（1 个月租金补偿不变，未履约赔偿为 12 个月租金）。

opts.t: 1 month's notice, 10 days for the tenant to dispute, and no monetary compensation.
opts.w: 混淆了无过错自住收房（s.49）与有过错因由终止（s.47）。1 个月通知、10 天异议期且无补偿金，是租客违约、扰邻或损坏财物等因由终止的规则。

opts.t: 4 months' notice, 30 days for the tenant to dispute, and compensation equal to 2 months' rent.
opts.w: 张冠李戴了拆除/改用途的通知期并记错了补偿月数。4 个月通知配 30 天异议期适用于拆除、改共管或改非住宅用途（s.49(6)），且补偿金同样是 1 个月租金而非 2 个月。

opts.t: 10 days' notice, 5 days for the tenant to dispute, and compensation equal to half a month's rent.
opts.w: 把欠租终止通知（10 天通知、5 天异议）与保证金上限（半个月租金）拼凑在一起，完全不符合自住收房规定。

main.pt: 商业追租扣押权与住宅禁止扣押
main.stem: Two tenants in the same mixed-use building fall behind on their rent: Tenant X operates a ground-floor dry-cleaning business under a commercial lease, and Tenant Y lives in an upstairs apartment under a residential tenancy agreement. Both owe two months' rent. Which statement correctly describes the landlord's right to use distress (seizing and selling the tenant's personal property to recover rent arrears)?
main.zh: 同一栋商住混合楼里的两名租客拖欠租金：租客 X 依据商业租约在一楼经营干洗店，租客 Y 依据住宅租赁协议住在楼上公寓。两人都欠了两个月租金。下列哪项正确描述了房东使用扣押权（distress，查封并变卖租客动产以抵偿欠租）的权利？

opts.t: The landlord may exercise distress against both Tenant X and Tenant Y as long as the rent is at least 15 days overdue.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。住宅租赁由 RTA s.26(3) 明文禁止扣押租客财物，无论欠租多少天都不能对住宅租客 Y 行使扣押权。

opts.t: The landlord is prohibited from exercising distress against either tenant because distress was abolished for all tenancies in British Columbia.
opts.w: 以偏概全。只有住宅租赁废除了扣押权；商业租赁下《商业租赁法》（CTA ss.3–7）与《租金扣押法》（Rent Distress Act）仍然现行有效。

opts.t: The landlord may exercise distress against residential Tenant Y, but must sue commercial Tenant X in Small Claims Court first.
opts.w: 把商业与住宅的规则完全颠倒了。住宅严禁扣押，商业才允许扣押。

opts.t: Distress is available against commercial Tenant X under the CTA and Rent Distress Act, but the RTA bars seizing residential Tenant Y's goods.
opts.w: 正确。商业房东对欠租拥有扣押（distress）租客动产变卖抵租的权利（受 CTA ss.3–7 与《Rent Distress Act》规制）；而在住宅租赁中，RTA s.26(3) 严格禁止房东扣押租客财物。

main.pt: 住宅保证金与宠物押金上限及退还
main.stem: When a residential tenancy agreement is signed, the tenant has a dog. Under the Residential Tenancy Act, what is the maximum amount the landlord may collect for a security deposit and for a pet damage deposit, and within how many days must the landlord return the deposits (with interest) or apply to the RTB after the later of the tenancy end date and the date the landlord receives the tenant's forwarding address in writing?
main.zh: 订立住宅租赁协议时，租客养有一只狗。根据《住宅租赁法》，房东可收取的保证金（security deposit）与宠物损坏押金（pet damage deposit）各自的最高限额是多少？在「租赁结束日」与「收到租客书面转发地址日」二者较晚者之后，房东必须在多少天内退还押金（连同利息）或向 RTB 提出索赔申请？

opts.t: Up to half a month's rent for each deposit, and within 30 days of the later of those two dates.
opts.w: 押金上限说对了（各自不超过半个月租金），但把退还或申请索赔的法定期限从 15 天错记成了 30 天。

opts.t: Half a month's rent for the security deposit and another half month for the pet deposit; within 15 days.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RTA s.19(1)，保证金（security deposit）与宠物损坏押金（pet damage deposit）各自不得超过半个月租金；根据 RTA s.38(1)，房东须在租赁结束日与收到租客书面转发地址日二者较晚者起 15 天内退还押金及利息，或向 RTB 提出索赔申请。

opts.t: Up to half a month's rent in total for both deposits combined, and within 15 days of the later date.
opts.w: 误以为两项押金加起来不能超过半个月租金。RTA s.19(1) 规定保证金和宠物损坏押金「各自（each）」不得超过半个月租金。

opts.t: Any amount the parties negotiate in the written agreement, and within 21 days of the later date.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。只有商业押金才是完全自由谈判的事项，且 21 天是房东向租客交付书面协议副本的期限（或现行自住收房异议期），不是退还押金的 15 天期限。

main.pt: 住宅房东法定进入权与提前通知
main.stem: There is no emergency, no abandonment, and no housekeeping agreement, and the residential tenant has not given consent to enter. Under section 29 of the Residential Tenancy Act, what must a landlord do to lawfully enter the rental unit for a routine monthly inspection?
main.zh: 在没有紧急情况、租客未弃租、无家政服务协议且住宅租客未同意进入的情况下，根据《住宅租赁法》第 29 条，房东必须怎么做才能合法进入出租单元进行每月例行检查？

opts.t: Written notice 24 hours to 30 days ahead, giving a reasonable purpose and an entry time between 8 a.m. and 9 p.m.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RTA s.29，在无租客同意或紧急等例外情形下，房东进入单位须提前至少 24 小时、且不超过 30 天发出书面通知（written notice），写明合理的进入目的与日期时间，且进入时间须在上午 8 点至晚上 9 点之间；依 s.29(2) 房东每月可检查一次。

opts.t: Send a text message 12 hours in advance and enter at any time before midnight.
opts.w: 时间与形式均违规。通知必须提前至少 24 小时采用书面形式（且需注意送达视为收到日规则），进入时间限于早 8 点至晚 9 点之间。

opts.t: Enter at any time without notice as long as a clause in the residential tenancy agreement reserves the landlord's right of unrestricted entry.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。商业租约可以通过合同条款保留房东随时进入权；但住宅租赁的安宁享用与进入权被 RTA ss.28–29 钉死，合同条款不得规避法定限制。

opts.t: Obtain a Writ of Possession from the BC Supreme Court before each monthly inspection.
opts.w: 混淆了例行检查进入权与驱逐拒不搬离租客的强制执行令状（Writ of Possession）。

main.pt: 商业与住宅的转租转让及减损义务
main.trap: 商业重租构成交回租赁陷阱
main.stem: A commercial tenant abandons a retail store with three years left on a five-year fixed-term lease. Under common law rules, including the Supreme Court of Canada decision in Highway Properties, which statement accurately describes the commercial landlord's options and duty to mitigate?
main.zh: 一名商业租客在五年固定期租约尚余三年时弃租了一家零售铺位。根据包括加拿大最高法院 Highway Properties 案在内的普通法规则，下列哪项准确描述了商业房东的选择权与减损损失义务？

opts.t: The commercial landlord has a strict statutory duty to re-rent the store immediately, and failing to do so forfeits all rent claims.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。RTA s.7(2) 对住宅租赁双方课以法定减损义务（mitigation）；但普通法上商业房东没有重新出租以减损损失的义务，甚至可以放空铺位逐月起诉追租。

opts.t: If the landlord re-lets the store without notifying the defaulting tenant, the landlord automatically preserves the right to sue for future rent deficits over the remaining three years.
opts.w: 掉入「商业重租构成交回租赁陷阱」。在普通法下，如果商业房东未事先明确通知租客就擅自把处所重新出租，可能被法院认定为接受交回租赁（surrender），从而丧失对原租客其后租金的请求权。

opts.t: There is no general duty to re-let, but under Highway Properties the landlord may end the lease and claim lost future benefit after clearly notifying the tenant.
opts.w: 正确。普通法上商业房东没有重新出租以减损损失（mitigation）的义务，且直接重租有被认定为交回租赁（surrender）而丧失后续追租权的风险；但依据最高法院 Highway Properties 案，房东只要向租客发出明确通知（clear notice），表明其意图终止租约并就剩余租期的利益损失索赔损害赔偿，即可既收回处所又保住对租金差额的请求权。

opts.t: The landlord must apply to the Residential Tenancy Branch within 15 days to claim damages under the doctrine of caveat lessee.
opts.w: 把住宅 RTB 15 天押金索赔期限与商业维修原则（caveat lessee 租客当心）混作一团。商业租约违约归法院管辖，且 caveat lessee 指的是商业房东无维修义务而非违约追租。

main.pt: 共用财产专用与车位四种形态
main.trap: 车位四种法律形态混同
main.stem: A strata corporation wishes to grant an owner the exclusive right to use a standard surface parking stall located on common property. If the strata corporation does NOT amend the strata plan and does NOT pass a 3/4 vote to designate the stall as limited common property (LCP), what is the maximum duration for which short-term exclusive use of this non-EV stall may be granted under Section 76 of the Strata Property Act?
main.zh: 某共管物业法团希望授予一名业主排他使用位于共用财产上的一个普通地面车位的权利。如果法团既不修改共管物业图则，也不通过 ¾ 票将该车位指定为限定共用财产（LCP），根据《共管物业法》第 76 条，该非电动车充电车位的短期专用许可最长期限是多久？

opts.t: Up to 1 year, subject to renewal, conditions, and cancellation on reasonable notice
opts.w: 根据 SPA s.76，共用财产（common property）上非 EV 充电车位的短期专用许可（short-term exclusive use）最长期限为 1 年，期满可续、可附条件，且法团可在给予合理通知后撤销。

opts.t: Up to 5 years, which is the standard statutory period for all common property parking stalls
opts.w: 最长 5 年仅适用于业主依 SPA s.90.1 申请安装电动车充电设施获批后的 EV 充电车位专用（条例 s.5.101），普通车位短期专用最长只有 1 年，这是车位形态与期限混淆陷阱。

opts.t: Permanently, because any exclusive use permission granted by the strata council runs with the land
opts.w: 永久且随单元走（runs with the land）的是限定共用财产（limited common property, LCP），短期专用许可随时可在合理通知后收回，绝不随产权转让。

opts.t: Up to 60 days, matching the statutory validity period of a Certificate of Payment
opts.w: 60 天是付清证明书（Form F）的有效期及理赔款决定不修复的期限，与共用财产短期专用许可无关。

main.pt: 清盘80%票与¾票的分母差异
main.trap: 80% 票与 ¾ 票的分母混淆
main.stem: An aging strata building has 100 strata lots, each entitled to one vote. At a duly called Special General Meeting (with 4 weeks' written notice), 80 eligible voters attend in person or by proxy and all 80 cast valid votes—none abstain. If 70 of those voters vote in favour, what is the outcome for (1) a resolution to amend the bylaws, and (2) a resolution to wind up the strata corporation and cancel the strata plan?
main.zh: 一栋老旧共管物业共有 100 个单元，每个单元享有一票投票权。在一次合法召开（已给足 4 周书面通知）的特别业主大会上，有 80 名有资格投票者亲自或委托出席，且 80 人全部投出有效票（无人弃权）。如果有 70 票赞成，对于（1）修订章程的决议，以及（2）清盘法团并注销图则的决议，结果分别是什么？

opts.t: Both resolutions pass, because 70 out of 80 votes cast equals 87.5%, which exceeds both the 75% and 80% thresholds
opts.w: 这是最典型的分母混淆陷阱：清盘的 80% 票分母是全体 100 名有投票权者（70 ÷ 100 = 70% < 80%），而不是到场投票的 80 人。

opts.t: The bylaw amendment passes (70 of 80 votes cast beats 3/4), but the winding-up fails because 70 is below 80% of all 100 eligible voters
opts.w: 修订章程需 ¾ 票（3/4 vote），分母是当场（含委托）投出的 80 张有效票，¾ 即 60 票，70 票足够故通过；而清盘（winding up）需 80% 票（SPA s.272），分母是全体有资格投票的 100 户，需至少 80 票赞成，缺席的 20 户在效果上等同于反对票，因此 70 票未通过。

opts.t: Neither resolution passes, because both a bylaw amendment and a winding-up resolution need a unanimous vote of all 100 owners
opts.w: 修订章程只需出席有效票的 ¾ 票，清盘自 2016-07-28 起也已从全体一致（unanimous vote）改为全体有投票权者的 80% 票加法院批准。

opts.t: The winding-up passes because a simple majority of those present is enough to wind up, but the bylaw amendment fails for lack of quorum
opts.w: 过半数（majority vote）仅够决定是否聘请经纪行去市场试水，正式清盘决议必须取得全体有资格投票者的 80% 票并经 BC 最高法院批准；本题出席 80 人，也不存在法定人数不足的问题。

main.pt: CRF年度强制缴款的考纲与现行规则
main.trap: 考试口径与 2023–2024 新规错位
main.stem: A strata corporation has an annual operating fund budget of $200,000, and its contingency reserve fund (CRF) currently holds $80,000. According to the traditional exam course manual rule (the pre-November 2023 rule), what is the mandatory minimum annual contribution to the CRF, and how does this compare with the current BC rule?
main.zh: 某共管物业法团的年度营运基金预算为 $200,000，其应急储备金（CRF）当前余额为 $80,000。根据传统考试考试口径（2023 年 11 月之前的规则），向 CRF 缴款的法定最低年度强制金额是多少？这与现行 BC 规则相比有何不同？

opts.t: Under the exam manual rule, $20,000 is mandatory because 10% is always required; under current law, $0 is required once the CRF exceeds 25%
opts.w: 这把考试口径与现行法完全说反了：考试口径是超过营运基金 25% 后变为可选（$0 强制），现行法才是无论余额多少每年都必须至少缴营运基金的 10%。

opts.t: Exam rule: $50,000 is mandatory every year as a flat 25% top-up; current rule: only 5% ($10,000) is required each year
opts.w: 25%（$50,000）在旧版考试口径里是触发强制缴款的余额门槛而非每年必须缴的金额，5% 则是旧版开发商首年 CRF 种子款比例。

opts.t: Exam rule: $0 is mandatory because the CRF already exceeds 25% of the operating fund; current rule: at least 10% ($20,000) every year
opts.w: 按考试口径（©2020 考试资料），当应急储备金（contingency reserve fund, CRF）已达或超过营运基金的 25%（$200,000 × 25% = $50,000，本题已达 $80,000）时，继续缴款变为可选（强制最低额为 $0）；而自 2023-11-01 起的现行法取消了 25% 免缴门槛，要求每年至少缴营运基金预算缴款总额的 10%（$20,000）并须参酌最新折旧报告。

opts.t: Under both the exam rule and the current rule, the mandatory yearly contribution is capped at $2,000 unless the bylaws allow more
opts.w: $2,000 是章程无规定时议会未经批准自主支出的金额上限之一，与 CRF 年度预算缴款毫无关系。

main.pt: 折旧报告周期与豁免的新旧对比
main.trap: 考试口径与 2023–2024 新规错位
main.stem: A strata corporation with 40 residential strata lots is reviewing its obligation to obtain a depreciation report. Under the traditional exam course manual rule (the 2011 regime), how often must a depreciation report be obtained and how can it be waived, versus the current BC regulation effective July 1, 2024?
main.zh: 一个拥有 40 个住宅单元的共管物业法团正在核查其取得折旧报告的义务。在传统考试考试口径（2011 年制度）下，折旧报告多久做一次、如何豁免？这与 2024 年 7 月 1 日起生效的现行 BC 条例有何不同？

opts.t: Exam rule: every 5 years with no waiver allowed; current rule: every 3 years unless waived by a majority vote
opts.w: 这把考试口径与 2024 年现行新规的数字和豁免方向完全颠倒了。

opts.t: Exam manual: only required for buildings over 100 lots; Current law: exempt if the building is outside Metro Vancouver
opts.w: 无论是考试口径还是现行法，免除折旧报告（depreciation report）的单元数门槛都是少于 5 个 strata lots，而非 100 个或按地区免除。

opts.t: Exam manual: every year unless waived by the strata council; Current law: every 10 years with a unanimous vote waiver
opts.w: 折旧报告从来不是每年一份，议会也无权自行豁免；这些数字不属于考试资料或现行法规。

opts.t: Exam rule: every 3 years, waivable by a 3/4 vote renewed within 18 months; current rule: every 5 years with no waiver
opts.w: 按考试口径（©2020 考试资料），5 个单元及以上的法团在首份折旧报告（depreciation report）后每 3 年须更新一份，但业主大会可在 18 个月周期内以 ¾ 票（3/4 vote）豁免；而自 2024-07-01 起的现行法将周期改为每 5 年一份，并彻底取消了 ¾ 票豁免机制（2025-07-01 起还须由工程师、估价师、注册储备金规划师等指定专业类别出具）。

main.pt: 跨交割日特别摊派与保险免赔额
main.trap: 80% 票与 ¾ 票的分母混淆
main.stem: On April 1, a strata corporation passes a 3/4 vote approving a special levy for balcony repairs payable in two equal instalments: $4,000 due on May 1 and $4,000 due on July 1. An owner sells her strata lot with a completion and conveyance date of June 1, and their contract of purchase and sale says nothing about special levies. Under Section 109 of the Strata Property Act, how is liability for the $8,000 levy allocated between the seller and the buyer?
main.zh: 4 月 1 日，某共管物业法团以 ¾ 票通过了一笔阳台修缮特别摊派，分两期等额缴纳：5 月 1 日到期 $4,000，7 月 1 日到期 $4,000。某业主出售其单元，成交过户日为 6 月 1 日，而买卖合同中未就特别摊派作任何约定。根据《共管物业法》第 109 条，这 $8,000 摊派的法定缴款责任在卖方与买方之间如何分配？

opts.t: The seller owes the $4,000 instalment due on May 1 (before conveyance), and the buyer owes the $4,000 instalment due on July 1 (on or after conveyance)
opts.w: 根据 SPA s.109，在物业过户前已获批准的分期特别摊派（special levy），按每一期的到期日（due date）切分法定责任：过户日（6 月 1 日）之前到期的那期（5 月 1 日 $4,000）由卖方承担，过户日当天及之后到期的那期（7 月 1 日 $4,000）由买方承担。因此买方经纪通常应在合同中另加卖方补偿条款。

opts.t: The seller owes the entire $8,000 because the special levy resolution was approved on April 1 while the seller was still the owner
opts.w: 虽然决议在 4 月 1 日通过，但 SPA s.109 看的是各期款项的到期日而非决议通过日；若合同不另写条款，7 月 1 日到期的那期会直接落到买方头上。

opts.t: The buyer owes the entire $8,000 because all special levies approved in the current fiscal year attach exclusively to the incoming purchaser
opts.w: 过户日（6 月 1 日）之前已经到期的第一期 $4,000 属于卖方的法定债务，不会因过户而全部转嫁给买方（除非卖方拖欠被登记留置或卡住 Form F）。

opts.t: The strata corporation must pay the $8,000 out of the contingency reserve fund whenever a lot changes hands mid-levy
opts.w: 单元买卖过户不会免除该单元应分摊的特别摊派，更不会改由法团用 CRF 替买卖双方买单。

main.pt: Form B与Form F及欠缴罚款后果
main.trap: 罚款登记留置权（Certificate of Lien）陷阱
main.stem: An owner who is selling his strata lot is up to date on his monthly strata fees, but he owes the strata corporation $600 in validly imposed bylaw fines that he refuses to pay. When the buyer's lawyer prepares to register the transfer of title at the Land Title Office, what enforcement tool does the strata corporation have regarding the $600 in unpaid fines?
main.zh: 一位正在出售其单元的业主按时缴纳了每月物业费，但他欠共管物业法团 $600 合法处以的章程罚款且拒绝缴纳。当买方律师准备在土地产权登记处办理产权转让过户登记时，法团针对这 $600 未付罚款拥有什么执行手段？

opts.t: The strata corporation can register a super-priority Certificate of Lien against the strata lot title for the $600 in bylaw fines
opts.w: 这是高频考题陷阱：根据 SPA s.116，留置权（Certificate of Lien）只能针对欠缴的物业费、特别摊派、法团代做修缮费及分摊判决额登记，罚款（fines）与整改费用不能登记留置。

opts.t: It cannot register a lien for fines, but it can withhold the Form F, without which the registrar will not accept the transfer
opts.w: 虽然章程罚款（bylaw fines）不能登记留置权（Certificate of Lien），但法团可以拒绝出具付清证明书（Form F, Certificate of Payment，收费 $15、有效期 60 天）直至罚款付清或达成满意安排；而除法院命令出售外，没有现行 Form F 土地产权登记处不予办理过户登记（SPA s.256）。

opts.t: The strata corporation must issue the Form F immediately, because fines automatically expire after 60 days under the Limitation Act
opts.w: 《时效法》（Limitation Act）的一般债务时效是 2 年而非 60 天，且 BC 法院与 CRT 裁决表明两年时效并不适用于罚款的催收；法团有权因欠罚款扣发 Form F。

opts.t: It can cancel the owner's unit entitlement and convert the strata lot into common property until the fines are paid
opts.w: 法团无权因业主欠缴罚款而注销其单位权益或没收其独立单元。

main.pt: 房屋合作社与Strata的法律差异
main.trap: 合作社（Co-op）套用 Strata 或 RTA 规则
main.stem: A buyer is comparing a fee simple strata apartment with a unit in a residential housing cooperative incorporated under the Cooperative Association Act. How does purchasing and financing the cooperative unit differ legally from purchasing the strata lot?
main.zh: 一位买家正在比较一套完全保有地产的共管物业公寓与一套依《合作社协会法》设立的住宅合作社单元。购买和融资合作社单元在法律上与购买共管物业单元有何不同？

opts.t: The buyer acquires shares plus a long-term lease rather than fee simple title, the board usually must approve the buyer, and conventional financing is harder
opts.w: 合作社（cooperative）持有整块土地的产权或长租权，买家买到的是协会股份（shares）外加长期承租某单元的租约，而非单元的完全保有地产（fee simple）；转让通常须经合作社董事会（board of directors）批准买家（理由未必限于财务能力），且融资需走《动产担保法》（PPSA）股份质押或租约抵押，比常规按揭更难、利率常更高。

opts.t: The cooperative buyer receives a separate fee simple title in the Land Title Office and is protected against board screening by Section 141 of the Strata Property Act
opts.w: 合作社不存入共管物业图则，买家拿不到单元的独立完全保有地产（fee simple），且不受《共管物业法》（SPA）管辖。

opts.t: The cooperative board cannot reject any buyer who has a 20% down payment, and any developer selling cooperative interests is exempt from the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA)
opts.w: 合作社董事会对买家人选有很大裁量权，拒批理由未必与财务能力有关；且《地产开发营销法》（REDMA）的披露义务同样适用于销售两个以上合作社权益。

opts.t: If three members in a 10-unit cooperative default on their share of the blanket mortgage, the remaining seven members have no financial exposure because each unit has a separate title
opts.w: 协会以整块地产做抵押贷款时，若部分会员断供，其余会员必须凑出这笔钱，否则整个合作社协会可能面临止赎（foreclosure）。

main.trap: 股份交易一刀切免牌照
main.stem: Clara wants to acquire a dry-cleaning business that owns the commercial building in which it operates. In which of the following scenarios must the intermediary representing Clara hold a real estate licence?
main.zh: Clara 想收购一家拥有自用商业楼宇产权的干洗店生意。在以下哪种情形中，代理 Clara 的中间人必须持有地产牌照？

opts.t: Clara purchases 100% of the shares of the corporation that holds title to the commercial building and operates the dry-cleaning business.
opts.w: 根据考试口径，如果持有地产的是一家公司，且本次交易是买下该公司的全部股份（100% of the shares），则视为涉及地产的交易，需要持有地产牌照。

opts.t: Clara purchases only a partial shareholding in the corporation that owns the commercial building, while the founder retains the remaining shares.
opts.w: 如果只买下持有地产公司的部分股份（partial shares），这属于证券交易，受《证券法》（Securities Act）管辖，不需要地产牌照（股份交易一刀切免牌照陷阱）。

opts.t: Clara purchases only the dry-cleaning machines, customer list, and chemical inventory, and moves them to a building she already owns.
opts.w: 只购买机器、客户名单与化学品存货而不包含任何物业产权或租约转让，不涉及地产成分，不需要地产牌照。

opts.t: Clara purchases all the shares of a mobile laundry delivery company that owns delivery vans but neither owns nor leases any real estate.
opts.w: 如果目标生意完全不持有任何地产资产，即使买下全部股份也不需要地产牌照。

main.pt: 企业组织形式的责任与纳税
main.trap: 公司或有限合伙挡住一切个人责任
