opts.t: Both methods sit under Price, and Price means the fee charged for the service, not the sale price of the home.
opts.w: 营销组合（marketing mix）的价格指服务收费，不是房屋成交价。课程列出的声望定价、渗透定价、成本加成等方法，都是在给服务怎么收费，不是在给房子定挂牌价。

main.stem: Before hiring a licensee, the Chen family compares several licensees' experience, reads how their recent listings sold, and visits open houses. They hire a licensee rarely, and the fee is large beside an everyday purchase. In the Shopping Behaviour Model, how does the course class the real estate service?
main.zh: 聘请持牌人之前，陈一家比较了几位持牌人的经验，读了他们近期房源的成交情况，还去看了开放日。他们很少聘请持牌人，费用相对日常采购也高。按购物行为模型，课程把地产服务归入哪一类？

opts.t: As a shopping good: buyers compare quality and price, they buy infrequently, and the unit price is high.
opts.w: 选购品（shopping goods）的特征就是购买前比价比质、购买频率低、单价高。课程明确把地产服务和住房本身都归在这一类，不归在另外三类的一般情形里。

opts.t: As a convenience good: buyers purchase often, use the service at once, and do little comparing.
opts.w: 便利品（convenience goods）是高频、即时使用的日用品，例如日常杂货。陈一家正在认真比较，而且很少购买。把地产服务放进便利品，是便利品误套。

opts.t: As a specialty good: buyers accept no substitute and will hire only one named person.
opts.w: 特殊品（specialty goods）是只认一个牌子、不做替代比较。课程说这只出现在极少数极端案例，例如指名某一位专家，不是地产服务的一般归类。陈一家正在比较好几位，更不是这一类。

opts.t: As an unsought good: buyers do not look for the service, and fear or prevention is what drives the purchase.
opts.w: 非渴求品（unsought goods）是消费者本来不主动想要、靠恐惧或预防推动的东西，课程举的例子是人寿保险。陈一家在主动比较持牌人。地产服务不属于这一类。

main.stem: After the seller signs the listing agreement, the licensee stops calling, saying cognitive dissonance can arise only at the moment of signing. Later the seller accepts a conditional offer and asks whether a higher asking price would have been wiser. What does the course say?
main.zh: 卖方签完上市协议后，持牌人就不再联系，说认知失调只可能在签字那一刻出现。后来卖方接受了一份附条件要约，又问当初把挂牌价定高一点是不是更明智。课程怎么说？

opts.t: It appears once, at signing, and it ends when the listing agreement is in force.
opts.w: 签完委托协议并不等于拿下了客户。认知失调不是签约那一次就结束。持牌人因此停止联系，接不住后面的节点。这是失调只算一次。

opts.t: It appears only when the client moves, because that is the first moment the decision feels real.
opts.w: 搬家前确实可能再出现，但不是唯一的节点，也不是第一次觉得决策真实的时刻。接受附条件要约时就可以再犯。这是把多个节点收成了搬家那一次。

opts.t: It can return at several points, including acceptance of an offer, removal of conditions, and the move itself.
opts.w: 认知失调（cognitive dissonance），俗称买家的忧郁，在签约、接受附条件要约、解除条件、实际搬家等多个节点都可能反复出现。卖方问挂牌价是不是该定得更高，正是这种自我怀疑。持续沟通比签约时说服一次更重要。

opts.t: It appears only if the licensee never used listening skills in the first meeting, and it cannot return later.
opts.w: 倾听和同理心重要，是因为失调会反复，需要持续沟通，不是因为第一次会面听得够仔细，后面就不会再出现。这是失调只算一次，又把原因收成了第一次会面。

main.stem: Luis writes the goal 'Improve my service.' A colleague writes 'By a stated deadline, contact every client whose file closed in that period, and record how many agreed to a referral conversation.' Which comparison matches the course?
main.zh: Luis 写下的目标是：把我的服务做得更好。同事写下的是：在写明的期限之前，联系该期间内结案的每一位客户，并记下有多少人同意谈一次转介。哪一种比较符合课程？

opts.t: Both goals are SMART, because each one expresses a wish to do better with clients.
opts.w: 有改进客户工作的愿望，还不等于具体、可衡量。只写把服务做得更好，没有可计算的结果，也没有完成标准。这是空泛也算 SMART。

opts.t: Only the colleague's goal is SMART. It is specific, measurable, able to be met, tied to the work, and set to a deadline. Luis's sentence is not specific or measurable.
opts.w: SMART 要同时满足具体（Specific）、可衡量（Measurable）、可达成（Achievable）、相关（Relevant）、有时限（Timely）。同事那句有对象、有计数、做得到、和转介这项工作相关、又有期限。只写把服务做得更好，和课程里「多拿些新盘」一样，不是 SMART 目标。

opts.t: Only Luis's goal is SMART, because a short goal is always achievable and a goal that names a count is not.
opts.w: 短，不等于可达成，更不能代替具体和可衡量。写出可以计数的结果，正是可衡量这一项要的东西，不是扣分点。这是把 SMART 读成了越短越好。

opts.t: Neither goal is SMART, because a SMART goal may not name clients, a count, or a deadline.
opts.w: 客户、计数和期限正是具体、可衡量、有时限的写法。课程对照的合格例子就是带着对象、数量和期限的那一种。禁止这些要素，是把标准颠倒了。

main.stem: On the licensing exam, an item asks for the advertising-penalty schedule set out in the course manual. A licensee's advertisement breaches the rules the manual is describing. Which schedule does the exam want?
main.zh: 执照考试有一题，问课程原文里的广告罚款是怎么排的。持牌人的广告违反了原文正在讲的那些规则。考试要的是哪一套？

opts.t: A fixed $250 the first time, $500 the second time, and $1,000 for a third or later breach.
opts.w: 考试口径引旧规则通报：第一次 $250、第二次 $500、第三次或以上 $1,000，按单一固定金额算。现行广告条款落在 D 档，首次基础罚款 $1,000、再次 $2,000，并按持续天数每天另加 $250。

opts.t: A base of $1,000 the first time and $2,000 the next time, plus $250 for each day the breach continues.
opts.w: 这是现行规则第 26、27 条下，广告条款第 39、40、41、42 条所在的 D 档，不是课程原文那套一次性固定金额。这是用现行档次答卷。

opts.t: A base of $5,000 the first time and $10,000 for a later breach.
opts.w: 首次 $5,000、再次 $10,000 是团队实体性约束所在的 C 档，不是普通广告条款，也不是考试口径的三级固定金额。这是把团队那一档套到了广告罚款上。

opts.t: A warning only, with no dollar figure, because the course manual treats an advertising breach as advice rather than a penalty.
opts.w: 课程原文写了三级递增的固定罚款，不是只有提醒、没有金额。把纪律读成没有罚款，和原文相反。

main.stem: A licensee whose work has been residential listings agrees to market a small warehouse the licensee has never handled, and sets aside no time to learn that work, because the month has been slow. What does the course say?
main.zh: 一直做住宅上市的持牌人答应去营销一处自己从未经手的小仓库，也没有留出时间学习这项工作，因为这个月生意清淡。课程怎么说？

opts.t: This is the niche marketing the course prefers, because adding a second property type always creates a niche.
opts.w: 利基营销（niche marketing）是挑一个能发挥专长、竞争可控、有利润的细分市场深耕。临时接一项自己没有专长的业务，不是利基，课程还提醒个人持牌人贪多嚼不烂。这是把跨界误当成利基。

opts.t: This is required undifferentiated marketing, because one plan must cover every property type on the market.
opts.w: 无差异营销（undifferentiated marketing）是一套方案打全市场，它是三种差异化策略之一，不是要求每人来者不拒。这里的问题是没有时间和专长。这是用策略名称盖过了胜任力。

opts.t: Accepting the work without adequate time or expertise may be a breach of professional ethics.
opts.w: 课程原话是：没有投入足够的时间或专长（failure to devote adequate time/expertise），可能构成违反职业伦理（a breach of professional ethics）。住宅持牌人临时接手自己不会的商业物业，就是这个例子所指的跨界。

opts.t: Product positioning requires the licensee to take every property type a client brings.
opts.w: 产品定位（product positioning）回答的是消费者心里怎么看你，不是要求接下每一种物业。定位做不好，也不能成为越过胜任力的理由。这是把定位读成了来者不拒。

main.stem: Priya posts listing commentary in Chinese on a business social-media account. The profile page shows a Chinese translation of the brokerage's name and a group emblem. It does not show the brokerage's licensed name in the form on the licence. The posts themselves do not repeat a brokerage name. Priya says the guidance does not require every post to carry the brokerage name, so the account complies. Which statement is correct?
main.zh: 普丽娅在一个业务社交账号上用中文发布房源评论。个人资料页上是经纪行名称的中文翻译和一个集团标志，没有执照上那种形态的经纪行持牌名。帖子本身也没有再写一遍行名。普丽娅说，指引并不要求每一条帖子都写行名，所以这个账号是合规的。哪一句话是对的？

opts.t: The account complies. The brokerage name is required on a post only when that post names the individual licensee, and these posts do not.
opts.w: 不要求每一条帖子都写行名，前提是资料页已经写了登记原样的经纪行名称。这些帖子没重复行名并不是合规的理由。这是把“帖子可以不重复”读成了“资料页也可以不写登记名”，属于译名当持牌名。

opts.t: The account does not comply. The profile page must show the brokerage's licensed name as registered, and a translation or emblem does not meet that requirement.
opts.w: 规则第40条第2款要求，任何情况下经纪行的持牌名（licensee name）都必须显著且易读。出于业务目的使用社交媒体时，个人资料页必须写上所属经纪行名称，不要求每一条帖子重复。外语广告不得把经纪行名称翻译成其他语言，行名必须按登记形态原样出现。资料页只有译名和标志，第40条第2款没有满足，每一条帖子都处在违规状态。

opts.t: The account complies. A group emblem on the profile page is the licensed name, so later posts may omit any further identification.
opts.w: 集团标志不是持牌名。持牌名是登记上的名称，不是标志、缩写或译名。规则第39条还要求在提供地产服务时标明自己的持牌名，代表、副经纪和管理经纪必须同时标明经纪行的持牌名。这是用标志代替行名。

opts.t: The account fails only because each post omitted the name. A translated brokerage name on the profile page would have been enough by itself.
opts.w: 原因说反了。资料页已经按登记原样写了行名之后，帖子可以不重复。不能过关的是资料页上的译名，翻译不能代替登记名称。这仍是译名当持牌名。

main.stem: Owen keeps copies of a buyer's government identification on a phone, and the copies are later exposed. Owen says this is only a privacy-statute problem, so the real estate regulator cannot treat it as a licensing breach. Which statement matches this lesson?
main.zh: 欧文把一份买方政府身份证件的复印件存在手机里，后来这些复印件外泄了。欧文说，这只是隐私法的问题，所以地产监管机构不能把它当成牌照违规。哪一句话符合这一课？

opts.t: The regulator may still act under the duties of honesty and of reasonable care and skill; another statute does not displace them.
opts.w: 四层各管一段，互不替代。四层里只有执业监管由BCFSA主管，但隐私、营销触达或电子形式出了问题，仍可用规则第33条的诚实义务（duty of honesty）和第34条的合理谨慎与技能（reasonable care and skill）追究。说“违反的是隐私法，不关地产监管的事”不成立。使用人工智能的指引也是同一句：使用工具不豁免任何法律与道德义务。

opts.t: Only the privacy commissioner can respond. The licensing statute stops at advertising signatures and does not reach a privacy failure.
opts.w: 隐私专员可以处理隐私这一层，包括命令和事后的损害赔偿之诉，但并不独占后果。牌照规则不止广告署名，保密、诚实和合理谨慎都可以用上。这是把四层读成只有一层能动手。

opts.t: The four regimes are alternatives. Once a privacy statute applies, the licensing rules and the other two regimes drop away.
opts.w: 四层是同时压在同一部手机上，不是四选一。隐私法适用，不能把执业监管、营销触达和电子形式取消。这是四层互相替代。

opts.t: A phone the licensee owns is outside all four regimes, because those regimes apply only to paper files kept at the brokerage office.
opts.w: 这一章的出发点就是用手机做业务时四层同时适用。设备归个人所有，不能把客户身份证明移出隐私法，也不能移出牌照上的合理谨慎。这是用设备所有权开脱。

main.stem: A seller and a buyer have signed a contract of purchase and sale by tapping a signature screen. The seller now asks to transfer title the same way, on that screen, with no lawyer or notary and no paper execution copy. Which statement matches this lesson?
main.zh: 卖方和买方已经在签名屏幕上点选，签了买卖合同。卖方现在要求用同样的方式、在同一个屏幕上转让产权，没有律师或公证人，也没有纸质执行本。哪一句话符合这一课？

opts.t: Both the contract and the transfer sit outside the electronic-transactions statute, so the contract also had to be signed in wet ink.
opts.w: 买卖合同、挂牌协议和披露表可以电子签署。被排除的是遗嘱、遗嘱设立的信托、涉及财务或人身照护的授权书，以及须登记的土地权益文件。把合同也排除，是把排除范围扩大了。

opts.t: The seller may sign the transfer on the screen. An electronic signature satisfies every signing and witnessing rule used at the land title office.
opts.w: 电子签名可以满足一般法律对签名的要求，但满足不了这类须登记的转让。被指定人的电子签名证明的是纸质执行本已按要求签署并见证，而且该执行本或其真实副本在被指定人手中。这是电子签套到转让。

opts.t: The transfer may be signed on the screen if the buyer signs that same screen on the same day.
opts.w: 买方是否在同一天点同一个屏幕，不能把被排除的转让文件拉回《电子交易法》。缺的是纸质签署、见证和被指定人认证。这仍是电子签套到转让。

opts.t: The contract could be signed on screen, but a registrable transfer of a land interest cannot be completed by the seller's own e-signature.
opts.w: 《电子交易法》（Electronic Transactions Act）不得仅因电子形式而否定买卖合同的效力。创设或转让土地权益、且须经登记才能对抗第三人的文件被排除。产权转让表（Form A）走《土地所有权法》（Land Title Act）的电子提交：卖方仍须在纸质执行本（execution copy）上签署并经律师或公证人见证，再由被指定人（designate）认证后提交。卖方不能只在屏幕上签名就完成转让。这一段考试口径与现行制度一致。

main.stem: On the licensing exam, the item follows the course manual's wording on implied consent for a commercial electronic message. Ten months ago a visitor at an open house wrote down an email address and asked about that one property. There was no purchase, no lease, and no written contract. Which period does the exam want?
main.zh: 执照考试这一题按课程原文对商业电子讯息默示同意的写法来答。十个月前，一名访客在开放日写下电子邮箱，并询问了那一处物业。之后没有购买、没有租赁，也没有书面合同。考试要的是哪一个期间？

opts.t: Six months from the inquiry, so ten months is already too late and implied consent has ended.
opts.w: 六个月是现行法对询价或申请的窗口，不是课程原文。开放日只问了这套房，现行法下十个月已经不能再靠默示同意群发。用这个期间答卷，会和考试要的两年相反。这是用现行口径答卷。

opts.t: No fixed period, because an open-house sheet is a conspicuous publication of the address for any later message.
opts.w: 没有固定期限的，是对方显著公开发布电子地址，或向你披露该地址，讯息还须与其商业或公务身份相关，并且没有声明不愿接收未经请求的商业电子讯息。开放日登记表不是这种公开发布。这是把另一类默示同意套到了询问人身上。

opts.t: Two years. The manual sets one two-year window for prior dealings and no shorter period for inquiries.
opts.w: 考试口径把默示同意（implied consent）写成过去两年内存在既有商业或非商业关系，没有把询价拆成更短的窗口。十个月仍在课程原文的两年之内。现行法把购买、租赁或书面合同定为两年，把询价或申请定为讯息发出日前的六个月。

opts.t: Ten business days, because that is the manual's entire life of implied consent after any open house.
opts.w: 十个工作日是收到退订指示后必须生效的期限，不是默示同意能维持多久。六十天才是讯息里的联系方式和退订地址自发出日起至少要有效的时间。这是把退订时限当成了同意窗口。

main.stem: A brokerage in BC loses a laptop that holds application forms collected in BC from local buyers. A colleague says the brokerage must notify those buyers without unreasonable delay under the public-sector privacy statute, because that statute has a breach-notification section. Which statement matches this lesson?
main.zh: 一家在BC的经纪行丢失了一台笔记本电脑，里面有向本地买方在BC收集的申请表。同事说，经纪行必须按公共机构隐私法、在没有不合理延迟的情况下通知这些买方，因为那部法有泄露通报条款。哪一句话符合这一课？

opts.t: The public-sector notification section applies to every organization in BC that holds personal information, including a brokerage.
opts.w: 《信息自由与隐私保护法》（Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act，FIPPA）管的是公共机构。经纪行不是公共机构，第36.3条的强制通报不能套过来。这是通报义务套错法。

opts.t: That notification section governs public bodies, not a brokerage. The private-sector statute for this collection inside BC has no mandatory breach-notification provision.
opts.w: 省内日常收集适用《个人信息保护法》（Personal Information Protection Act，PIPA）。PIPA现行文本没有强制泄露通报条款。FIPPA第36.3条只在合理预期会造成重大伤害时，要求公共机构无不合理延迟地通知个人和专员。没有强制通报不等于没有后果：第34条的合理安全安排仍在，规则第30条第e项和第34条仍可能被追究。考试口径的隐私一节只写取得同意、按目的使用、不再需要就销毁，没有写这套差别。

opts.t: The federal private-sector statute is the main statute for this collection inside BC, and the brokerage must follow that statute's notification timetable.
opts.w: 联邦豁免令认定PIPA与PIPEDA第1部实质相似。发生在BC省内的收集、使用和披露，除联邦事业外，豁免PIPEDA第1部。不能把联邦通报流程讲成这家经纪行的主法。信息离开BC时才可能回到PIPEDA。这是主法套错。

opts.t: No privacy statute applies to a lost laptop. Protection of the information is optional, and the only possible consequence is a licensing file with no privacy duty.
opts.w: PIPA第34条要求以合理的安全安排保护个人信息，防止未经授权的访问、使用或披露。丢失客户申请表可以同时触到隐私义务和牌照义务。这是用“没有强制通报”推出“没有保护义务”。

main.stem: Farah posts a seller's unpublished bottom price and reason for selling in a members-only group of other licensees. The public cannot see the group. Farah uses a personal account kept separate from the business profile. Which statement matches this lesson?
main.zh: 法拉把卖方未公开的心理底价和出售原因，发在一个只有其他持牌人能进的群里。公众看不到这个群。法拉用的是与业务资料页分开的个人账号。哪一句话符合这一课？

opts.t: The post can still breach the confidentiality duty. A closed group is not an exception, and conduct on a personal account can be conduct unbecoming.
opts.w: 指引写明不得在社交媒体上发布客户保密信息，即使在封闭或私密的群组里。保密义务在规则第30条第e项，没有私下场合除外。个人账号也在管辖范围内。有失体面的行为（conduct unbecoming）包括私人生活中的言行。未经允许公开出售动机或心理底价，还违反保密义务；若认为写出来对客户有利，须先取得书面许可。考试口径没有这套行为守则；现行指引于2025-11-13发布。

opts.t: A closed group of licensees is safe, because the social-media guidance applies only to posts the public can already see.
opts.w: 封闭或私密的论坛同样不能发客户保密信息。截图没有成本，条文也没有“私下除外”。这是私密群当例外。

opts.t: The post is allowed once the personal account is set to a more private visibility, because a private account is outside the guidance.
opts.w: 把个人账号的可见性调得更私密，是指引要求的做法，但不能用来发布保密信息，也不能把个人账号用于业务。私密设置不是豁免。这是私密群当例外。

opts.t: The post is allowed if the brokerage's licensed name appears, because confidentiality yields when the advertising signature is complete.
opts.w: 写上经纪行持牌名满足的是广告署名，不是保密。底价和出售原因不会因为署名完整就变成可以公开。两套规则不能互相抵销。这是用署名代替保密。

main.stem: The licensing exam follows the course manual on how electronic brokerage records are kept and who can demand a printout. Which statement does the exam want?
main.zh: 执照考试按课程原文，问经纪行的电子记录如何保存、谁可以要求打印件。考试要的是哪一句话？

opts.t: The records must be convertible to paper at any time under rule 91, kept at least seven years under rule 92, and printed when the superintendent or an authorized person asks.
opts.w: 这是现行规则第91条和第92条：须能随时转成纸质，有权的人可以要求立即打印，至少保存七年，除非总监书面批准更短。索要打印件的是总监及其授权人。它不是课程原文的条号和索要主体。这是用现行口径答卷。

opts.t: A cloud copy is enough even if nobody can print it on request, and the manual sets the retention period at one year.
opts.w: 云端备份不是判据，要的时候拿不出打印件就不算满足。一年是PIPA对直接影响个人的决定之后的最短保存，不是课程原文的经纪记录年限，也不是现行的七年。这是把两个期限拧在一起，又把备份当成了可打印。

opts.t: The manual rejects electronic records. Only paper originals count, and a printout of an electronic file is never a record.
opts.w: 课程原文允许电子记录，条件是应议会的要求能够打印。现行第91条同样允许电子形式，前提是能立即转成打印件，第92条还允许保存副本而非原件。这一项把两套口径都读成了禁止电子保存。

opts.t: The manual cites its former rules on electronic records and on how long they are kept, and it says a printout is produced when the Council asks for one.
opts.w: 考试口径把电子记录写成规则第8-9.1条、把保存年限写成规则第8-10条，并说应议会（Council）要求打印。现行是规则第91条须能随时转成纸质、向有权的人立即提供打印件，以及规则第92条至少保存七年；索要打印件的是总监（superintendent）及其授权人。

variants.trap: 先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱
variants.stem: Why does the common law system rely on the principle of stare decisis, and how should a British Columbia trial judge treat a judicial precedent from the United Kingdom when no Canadian precedent exists on the issue?
variants.zh: 普通法体系为什么要依赖遵循先例（stare decisis）原则？当某一问题没有加拿大先例可循时，BC 初审法官应如何对待来自英国的司法判例？

opts.t: To ensure every judge can invent brand-new rules at will, meaning United Kingdom decisions are automatically binding on Canadian courts.
opts.w: 错在颠倒遵循先例的目的及外国判例效力：遵循先例（stare decisis）是为了可预测性而非随意造法，且英国或其他普通法国家的判例本身对加拿大法院没有法律约束力。

opts.t: To replace all provincial statute law with judge-made rules, meaning foreign decisions override local legislation.
opts.w: 错在混淆成文法与普通法的顺位：法官判案时先看有没有成文法（statute law），普通法先例不能凌驾于有效制定的省法之上。

opts.t: To make legal outcomes predictable, and the judge may consult the United Kingdom decision as a persuasive guide that binds only if a Canadian court adopts it.
opts.w: 正确：遵循先例（stare decisis）的核心价值在于让人能够预判自己行为的法律后果（确定性与可预测性）；找不到加拿大先例时，法官可以参考英国或其他普通法联邦国家的判例，但这些判例本身没有法律约束力，除非被加拿大法院采纳。

opts.t: To guarantee that factual differences between cases are always ignored, meaning the judge must dismiss the lawsuit whenever no Canadian precedent exists.
opts.w: 错在「先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱」：法官在适用先例时必须对比关键事实并区分（distinguish）实质差异，且无加拿大先例时可参考其他普通法国家判例而非直接驳回起诉。

variants.pt: 衡平法救济与强制履行
variants.trap: 衡平救济当成法定必给权利
variants.stem: A developer builds a retaining wall that encroaches onto a neighbour's land in breach of a restrictive agreement. The neighbour asks a British Columbia Supreme Court judge for an order requiring the developer to actively demolish and remove the encroaching wall. What type of remedy is the neighbour seeking, and which body of law does it come from?
variants.zh: 某开发商修建的一道挡土墙违反限制性协议侵入了邻居的土地。邻居向 BC 最高法院法官申请一项法院令，要求开发商主动拆除并移走越界的挡土墙。邻居寻求的是哪一类救济？它源自哪一套法律体系？

opts.t: A mandatory injunction, which is a discretionary remedy originating from equity.
opts.w: 正确：命令一方停止或做某事的法院令叫禁制令（injunction），其中要求「必须去做某事」（如拆除越界建筑）的叫强制性禁制令（mandatory injunction），属于源自衡平法（equity）的自由裁量救济。

opts.t: A writ of specific performance, which is a mandatory monetary award originating from common law.
opts.w: 错在混淆概念：强制履行（specific performance）是命令按合同完成交易的衡平救济，不是金钱赔偿，也不属于普通法（common law）。

opts.t: Common law damages, because modern courts can only order payment of money and cannot compel a party to perform an act.
opts.w: 错在无视衡平救济：普通法救济主要是损害赔偿（damages，即赔钱），但合并后的现代法院同时拥有衡平法管辖权，可以发布强制性禁制令（mandatory injunction）命令当事人作为。

opts.t: A garnishing order, which is an equitable remedy granted automatically without judicial discretion.
opts.w: 错在张冠李戴且落入「衡平救济当成法定必给权利」陷阱：扣薪令（garnishing order）是判决后的金钱执行工具，而衡平救济均属法院自由裁量。

variants.pt: 三级政府立法权与成文法优先
variants.trap: 先例必死套与跨省强制陷阱
variants.stem: A property owner challenges a municipal zoning bylaw in British Columbia, claiming that the Constitution Act, 1867 only mentions federal and provincial powers and therefore municipalities have no legal authority to pass bylaws. Why does this argument fail?
variants.zh: 一名业主在 BC 省质疑某项市级分区法规（zoning bylaw），声称《1867 年宪法》只提到了联邦和省的权力，因此市政府没有通过 bylaw 的合法权限。这一观点为什么不能成立？

opts.t: Because the Supreme Court of Canada transferred the federal residual power to municipalities in the 1870s, giving them independent law-making authority.
opts.w: 错在张冠李戴：联邦剩余权力（residual power）属于联邦议会，1870 年代是英国《司法法》（Judicature Acts）合并普通法与衡平法院的时期，与市政授权无关。

opts.t: Because the province holds constitutional power over municipal institutions and delegates part of that authority to municipalities to pass local bylaws.
opts.w: 正确：虽然市本身不是《宪法》（Constitution Act, 1867）直接授权的一级立法机关，但省在宪法上负责「财产与公民权利」（property and civil rights）及市政机构，市议会制定分区（zoning）和建筑法规等 bylaw 的权力是从省的立法权里切分授权而来的。

opts.t: Because municipal zoning bylaws are really federal statutes passed under Parliament's criminal law power and only administered by city councils.
opts.w: 错在混淆三级政府职权：分区（zoning）与建筑许可属于纯地方性质事项，由省授权市议会通过 bylaw 管理，不是联邦刑法。

opts.t: Because zoning rules are unwritten common law customs inherited from England in 1066, so councils need no grant of legislative power at all.
opts.w: 错在把成文法当成普通法：市议会制定的地方法规（bylaw）属于成文法（statute law）范畴，并非 1066 年起源的普通法判例。

variants.pt: 法院层级、门槛与上诉原则
variants.trap: 上诉等于重打官司重新举证
variants.stem: A landscaping company is owed a sum slightly above $35,000 by a client who lives and carries on business in British Columbia. The company wants to resolve the dispute in Small Claims Court rather than the Supreme Court of British Columbia. Is this permitted?
variants.zh: 一家园艺公司被一名在 BC 省居住并经营业务的客户拖欠了一笔略高于 $35,000 的款项。该公司希望在小额法庭（Small Claims Court）而不是 BC 最高法院解决这起纠纷。这被允许吗？

opts.t: No, because any claim exceeding the old $25,000 limit is barred from Small Claims Court under current regulations.
opts.w: 错在记成 2017-06-01 以前的旧数字：小额法庭（Small Claims Court）的金额上限早在 2017-06-01 就已从 $25,000 上调至 $35,000，且至今未变。

opts.t: Yes, if the company abandons the excess and limits its claim to $35,000, filing where the claim arose or where the client lives or does business.
opts.w: 正确：小额法庭（Small Claims Court）管辖金额为 $35,000 或以下，且要求诉因发生在该法庭辖区内或被告在辖区内居住/营业；当实际索赔超过 $35,000 时，原告可以选择减少诉求金额至 $35,000 留在小额法庭起诉。

opts.t: Yes, and the company can still recover the entire amount above $35,000 in Small Claims Court because commercial debts have no monetary cap.
opts.w: 错在混淆小额法庭与无上限机构：没有金额上限的是 BC 最高法院（Supreme Court of BC）或处理共管物业纠纷的 CRT，小额法庭有严格的 $35,000 上限。

opts.t: No, because Small Claims Court has no territorial restrictions and only hears strata property disputes.
opts.w: 两处皆错：小额法庭（Small Claims Court）附带地域限制，而没有省内地域限制的是 BC 最高法院；共管物业纠纷归 CRT 管辖。

variants.pt: CRT 管辖与考试口径救济路径
variants.trap: 考试口径与现行规则错位陷阱
variants.stem: Which combination of claim type and monetary limit accurately reflects the jurisdiction of the Civil Resolution Tribunal (CRT)?
variants.zh: 下列哪一组「纠纷类型与金额上限」的搭配准确反映了民事解决裁判庭（CRT）的管辖范围？

opts.t: Tribunal small claims up to $5,000 (mandatory), accident liability and damages up to $50,000, and strata property claims with no cap.
opts.w: 正确：CRT 的三大核心数字分别是：一般小额纠纷（tribunal small claims）$5,000 或以下为强制管辖、车祸伤害纠纷（accident claims）责任与损害赔偿上限 $50,000、共管物业纠纷（strata property claims）无金额上限。注意现行法下这些金额门槛已改为由内阁规例（regulation）规定，但 2026 年核实数值本身均未变。

opts.t: Tribunal small claims up to $35,000, motor vehicle accident claims up to $5,000, and defamation claims up to $50,000 against any party.
opts.w: 错在张冠李戴与纳入排除事项：$35,000 是省法院小额法庭（Small Claims Court）的上限而非 CRT 小额上限（$5,000），且 CRT 明确不受理诽谤（libel / slander）诉讼。

opts.t: Independent Human Rights Code complaints up to $50,000 and strata property claims capped at $35,000.
opts.w: 两处皆错：《人权法》（Human Rights Code）的独立投诉归 BC 人权裁判庭管辖，不属于 CRT；且 CRT 处理共管物业纠纷（strata property claims）没有金额上限。

opts.t: Constitutional challenges against the provincial government up to $50,000 and debt claims up to $25,000.
opts.w: 错在纳入 CRT 排除事项：CRT 管不了涉及宪法问题的诉求及政府作为被告的一般诉求，且 CRT 一般小额债务纠纷的门槛是 $5,000。

variants.pt: 诉讼时效与承认责任重置
variants.trap: 时效起算点混淆与承认责任重置陷阱
variants.stem: Under the British Columbia Limitation Act (in force since June 1, 2013), what is the length of the ultimate limitation period, and from what point in time is it measured if the defendant never acknowledges liability?
variants.zh: 根据 BC 省《时效法》（Limitation Act，2013 年 6 月 1 日生效），在被告从未承认责任的情况下，最长时效期（ultimate limitation period）是多长时间？从哪个时间点开始起算？

opts.t: 2 years, measured from the date the plaintiff discovers that a court proceeding is an appropriate remedy.
opts.w: 错在「时效起算点混淆与承认责任重置陷阱」：发现之日起算 2 年是基本时效期（basic limitation period），不是最长时效期（ultimate limitation period）。

opts.t: 30 years, measured from the date the plaintiff first suffers financial loss.
opts.w: 错在记成 2013 年修法前的旧期限：2013 年 6 月 1 日生效的现行《Limitation Act》已将最长时效期从 30 年大幅缩短为 15 年。

opts.t: 60 days, measured from the date the defendant refuses to participate in mediation.
opts.w: 错在混淆 CRT 司法审查期限：60 天是现行对 CRT 裁决向 BC 最高法院申请司法审查（judicial review）的期限，不是《Limitation Act》的最长时效期。

opts.t: 15 years, measured from the date the act or omission took place.
opts.w: 正确：《Limitation Act》规定的最长时效期（ultimate limitation period, ULP）为 15 年，从行为或不作为发生之日起算。

variants.pt: 人权法受保护理由与租赁红线
variants.trap: 考试口径与现行规则错位陷阱
variants.stem: When comparing the protected grounds under the British Columbia Human Rights Code as listed in the ©2020 course manual with the current statute in force after November 25, 2021, how should a candidate handle the ground of 'Indigenous identity'?
variants.zh: 在对比 ©2020 考试资料所列的 BC 省《人权法》受保护理由清单与 2021 年 11 月 25 日之后生效的现行法条时，考生应如何对待「原住民身份」（Indigenous identity）这一理由？

opts.t: It was removed from the Human Rights Code in 2021 and replaced by lawful source of income.
opts.w: 错在记反修法方向：2021-11-25 生效的《人权法修正案》（Bill 18）是新增而非删除「原住民身份」（Indigenous identity），且合法收入来源本来就在租赁条款中。

opts.t: It applies only to federal banking employees and never applies to real estate advertising, sales, or tenancy.
opts.w: 错在缩小适用范围：2021 年修法将「原住民身份」（Indigenous identity）加进了《人权法》几乎全部歧视条款，包括住宿/服务、购房、租赁、招聘广告与就业。

opts.t: It was added on November 25, 2021, so it is missing from the ©2020 manual's list, but current compliance requires treating it as a protected ground.
opts.w: 正确：「原住民身份」（Indigenous identity）不在 ©2020 考试资料的受保护理由（protected grounds）清单里，是因为它是 2021-11-25 生效的 Bill 18 新增的；考场上若题目照抄 2020 年前的考试资料清单出题会不包含它，但实务执业中它已是法定的受保护理由。

opts.t: It has been the only protected ground in the Human Rights Code since 1066 and is enforced exclusively through Small Claims Court actions.
opts.w: 两处皆错：《人权法》是现代成文法（statute law）而非 1066 年普通法，且人权投诉由 BC 人权裁判庭（BC Human Rights Tribunal）而非小额法庭管辖。

variants.stem: A developer preparing to market pre-sale strata lots to the public must file a disclosure statement and grant buyers statutory rescission rights. Under British Columbia's three-tier real estate regulatory structure, which statute specifically governs these developer obligations?
variants.zh: 一家准备向公众销售共管公寓楼花的开发商必须备案披露声明并给予买家法定撤销权。在 BC 省的三层地产监管结构中，哪一部法律专门管辖开发商的这些义务？

opts.t: The Real Estate Services Act (RESA)
opts.w: 属于法规层级混淆陷阱。RESA 管的是地产服务持牌要求、发牌及违规处罚，而非开发商卖楼花的披露声明与撤销权。

opts.t: The Real Estate Services Rules (B.C. Reg. 209/2021)
opts.w: 属于法规层级混淆陷阱。Real Estate Services Rules 管的是持牌人的披露、信托账户、广告和代理关系等执业行为细则。

opts.t: The Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA)
opts.w: 正确。作为配套法的《地产开发营销法》（Real Estate Development Marketing Act, REDMA）专门管辖开发商销售楼花/共管单位等开发单位时的披露义务与买家法定撤销权。

opts.t: The Finance Statutes Amendment Act, 2021
opts.w: 属于法规层级混淆陷阱。该法案是 2021 年将 RECBC 与 OSRE 并入 BCFSA 的立法依据，不管开发商楼花营销。

variants.stem: Why did the British Columbia legislature enact the Finance Statutes Amendment Act, 2021 to dissolve the Real Estate Council of BC (RECBC) and merge the Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate (OSRE) into the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA)?
variants.zh: BC 省立法机关为何通过《2021 年金融成文法修正案》，解散 BC 地产议会（RECBC）并将地产总监办公室（OSRE）并入 BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）？

opts.t: To answer criticism of fragmented oversight after the Cullen money-laundering inquiry and shadow flipping, by creating one regulator.
opts.w: 正确。这次合并的政策背景是 Cullen 反洗钱调查与「影子炒楼（shadow flipping）」丑闻后对监管碎片化的批评，因此将原 RECBC 与 OSRE 整合进单一监管者 BCFSA（旧考试资料中的 RECBC/OSRE 现仅作历史背景理解）。

opts.t: To transfer all licensing examinations and pre-licensing courses from UBC Sauder to the Real Estate Foundation of BC.
opts.w: 属于机构职责捏造陷阱。牌照课程与考试仍由 UBC Sauder 房地产部承办，并未移交给负责公益与研究资助的地产基金会。

opts.t: To eliminate mandatory Errors and Omissions insurance and replace brokerage trust accounts with a single provincial account.
opts.w: 属于公众保护机制捏造陷阱。E&O 强制保险与经纪行信托账户（trust accounts）资金隔离制度在现行框架下依然保留。

opts.t: To delegate unlicensed real estate enforcement back to individual managing brokers.
opts.w: 属于职权归属混淆陷阱。原 OSRE 负责的规则制定与未持牌行为执法已并入 BCFSA 统一行使，而非下放给管理经纪。

variants.trap: 牌照类别与独立执业陷阱
variants.stem: Under the Real Estate Services Act (RESA), how are licence categories and individual licence levels structured in British Columbia?
variants.zh: 根据《地产服务法》（RESA），BC 省的牌照类别（categories）与个人牌照级别（levels）是如何划分的？

opts.t: There are two categories (Residential and Commercial) and two levels (Representative and Principal), with principals free to practise without a brokerage.
opts.w: 属于类别与实务课程方向混淆陷阱。住宅（Residential）与商业（Commercial）是实务课程（Applied Practice Course）的方向，法定牌照类别是三类而非两类。

opts.t: Three categories (trading, rental property management, strata management), each with representative, associate broker and managing broker levels under a brokerage.
opts.w: 正确。RESA 将地产服务牌照分为三大类别（Trading Services、Rental Property Management Services、Strata Management Services），每类之内再分三个级别：代表（representative）、副经纪（associate broker）、管理经纪（managing broker），且每个持牌人必须挂靠在一家持牌经纪行（brokerage）下执业。

opts.t: There are four categories including Mortgage Brokerage Services, and associate brokers are exempt from any brokerage supervision requirement.
opts.w: 属于牌照类别捏造陷阱。RESA 下的地产服务牌照只有三类，且副经纪（associate broker）必须挂靠在经纪行之下执业。

opts.t: Representative, Associate Broker, and Managing Broker are the three licence categories, while Trading and Strata are optional endorsements added later.
opts.w: 属于类别与级别颠倒陷阱。Trading、Rental、Strata 是三大类别（categories），而 Representative、Associate Broker、Managing Broker 是每类之内的三个级别（levels）。

variants.trap: 考牌与申牌时间窗混淆
variants.stem: Elena passed the Real Estate Trading Services Licensing Examination on her second attempt (via a 2-hour, 60-question supplemental exam) and plans to specialize in residential trading services. Which set of requirements must she meet to apply for her representative licence?
variants.zh: Elena 在第二次尝试（通过 2 小时 60 题的补考）中通过了地产交易服务牌照考试，并计划从事住宅交易服务。她必须满足下列哪组要求才能申请代表牌照？

opts.t: Be at least 19, finish Parts 1 and 2 of the residential Applied Practice Course, provide a criminal record check, and apply through a brokerage within 1 year of passing.
opts.w: 正确。根据现行规则（Rules s. 9(1)(c)、s. 14 及 BCFSA 指引），住宅方向交易服务申请人须先完成实务课程（Applied Practice Course）第 1、2 部分，年满 19 岁，附现行无犯罪记录核查并披露破产/纪律史，在通过考试后 1 年内（补考不延长这一年）经由挂靠经纪行向 BCFSA 申请。

opts.t: She must complete all parts of the Applied Practice Course within 2 years after licensing, and she has 2 years from passing her supplemental exam to apply for a licence.
opts.w: 属于考牌与申牌时间窗混淆陷阱。申牌期限是通过考试后 1 年内（2 年是完成作业后参加考试的期限）；实务课程第 1、2 部分须在申牌前完成，其余部分在拿牌后 6 个月内完成。

opts.t: She may apply directly to UBC Sauder within 90 days without a brokerage, and her initial licence term will be 3 years.
opts.w: 属于发牌机构与有效期混淆陷阱。牌照须经由挂靠经纪行向 BCFSA（而非 UBC Sauder）申请，且牌照每期为 2 年而非 3 年。

opts.t: Because she wrote a supplemental exam, her licence application window is extended to 2 years, and she only needs to complete Part 1 of the residential Applied Practice Course before applying.
opts.w: 属于考牌与申牌时间窗混淆陷阱。补考不延长通过考试后 1 年内申牌的期限；且只有商业方向（Commercial）才只需在申请前完成实务课程第 1 部分，住宅方向（Residential）必须完成第 1、2 部分。

variants.trap: 四大保护机构张冠李戴
variants.stem: When comparing the pre-2021 exam descriptions of public protection organizations with British Columbia's current regulatory structure, which statement accurately reflects the current status of these institutions?
variants.zh: 对比 2021 年前旧考试资料对公众保护机构的描述与 BC 省现行监管架构，下列哪项陈述准确反映了这些机构的现状？

opts.t: The Real Estate Foundation of BC was dissolved in 2021, while the Office of the Superintendent of Real Estate remains an independent office.
opts.w: 属于机构现状颠倒陷阱。BC 地产基金会（Real Estate Foundation of BC）照常运作，而「地产总监（Superintendent of Real Estate）」作为独立办公室已不存在，其职权在 BCFSA 内部行使。

opts.t: The E&O insurance corporation, along with the Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation, was abolished when BCFSA took over regulation in 2021.
opts.w: 属于机构现状误判陷阱。E&O 保险公司和赔偿基金公司（Compensation Fund Corporation）在现行框架下均继续存在并照常运作。

opts.t: Brokerage trust accounts are no longer required because all client deposits must be sent directly to BCFSA.
opts.w: 属于信托账户规则捏造陷阱。信托账户（trust accounts）依然是公众保护四件套之一，客户资金必须存入经纪行信托账户并与经纪行自有资金隔离。

opts.t: The four protections still operate under BCFSA, the Real Estate Foundation of BC continues, and the Superintendent's powers are exercised inside BCFSA.
opts.w: 正确。公众保护四件套（BCFSA 发牌门槛、信托账户隔离、E&O 强制保险、赔偿基金）结构长青，BC 地产基金会（Real Estate Foundation of BC）照常运作（研究与公益资助），而原独立地产总监办公室（OSRE）职权现已在 BCFSA 内部行使。

variants.trap: 纪律罚款与行政罚款混同
variants.stem: Which statement accurately describes the enforcement powers and penalty limits administered by the BC Financial Services Authority (BCFSA) under the current Real Estate Services Act (RESA)?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确描述了现行《地产服务法》（RESA）下 BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）执行的处分权限与罚款上限？

opts.t: BCFSA handles complaints and investigations, but only the Real Estate Council of BC (RECBC) can suspend or cancel a licence.
opts.w: 属于旧机构名残留陷阱。RECBC 已于 2021-08-01 解散，投诉、调查、听证、处分（包括谴责、附条件、暂停、吊销牌照）全链条均由 BCFSA 执行。

opts.t: Disciplinary penalties are capped at $250,000 for an individual and $500,000 for a brokerage in total, regardless of how many contraventions occurred.
opts.w: 属于按次科处规则漏读陷阱。RESA 明确规定纪律罚款个人最高 $250,000、经纪行最高 $500,000 是按「每次违规（per contravention）」计算，可就每一次违规分别科处。

opts.t: Administrative penalties have a statutory maximum of $500,000 per penalty under section 56(2) of RESA, matching the brokerage disciplinary cap.
opts.w: 属于纪律罚款与行政罚款混同陷阱。RESA s. 56(2) 规定的行政罚款（administrative penalty）单笔法定上限是 $100,000，$500,000 是经纪行纪律罚款上限。

opts.t: BCFSA may reprimand, suspend or cancel, fine up to $250,000 (individual) or $500,000 (brokerage) per contravention, and impose administrative penalties up to $100,000.
opts.w: 正确。现行 RESA 框架下，BCFSA 统管投诉、调查、听证与处分，处分工具包括谴责、附条件、暂停、吊销牌照，纪律罚款每次违规个人最高 $250,000、经纪行最高 $500,000（另可追缴违规报酬），行政罚款单笔法定上限 $100,000（按规则 A–F 六档定价；旧考试资料中的旧金额已过时）。

variants.trap: REDMA 与 HBRP 撤销权混淆
variants.stem: A buyer signs a contract to purchase a fractional interest in a resort development from a developer on Day 1, and the developer obtains the buyer's written acknowledgment of having had an opportunity to read the disclosure statement on Day 2. Under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA), how is the buyer's rescission period determined?
variants.zh: 一名买家于第 1 天与开发商签订购买某度假开发项目共有权益的合同，开发商于第 2 天取得买家确认「已有机会阅读披露声明」的书面确认。根据《地产开发营销法》（REDMA），买家的撤销期如何确定？

opts.t: The buyer has 3 business days from Day 1 and must pay 0.25% of the purchase price under the Home Buyer Rescission Period.
opts.w: 属于 REDMA 与 HBRP 撤销权混淆陷阱。开发商销售开发单位（包括 strata lots、合作社份额、分时度假、共有权益等）适用 REDMA 的 7 天无条件撤销权，而非转售住宅的 3 个工作日 HBRP 冷静期。

opts.t: 7 days from Day 2, the later of the agreement date and the acknowledgment date, by written notice to the developer.
opts.w: 正确。根据 REDMA s. 21(2)，买家从签订购买协议（第 1 天）与开发商取得买家「已有机会阅读披露声明（disclosure statement）」书面确认（第 2 天）这两天中较晚的一天（第 2 天）起 7 天内，可书面通知开发商撤销。

opts.t: The buyer has 7 days starting from Day 1, because the purchase agreement date always triggers the rescission clock.
opts.w: 属于起算日选早不选晚陷阱。REDMA 规定从签订购买协议与取得已读披露声明书面确认两者中「较晚的一天（later date）」起算，此处第 2 天晚于第 1 天，故应从第 2 天起算。

opts.t: REDMA does not apply because fractional interests and time shares are exempt from disclosure statement requirements.
opts.w: 属于适用范围误判陷阱。REDMA 明确适用于开发商向公众销售的开发单位，包括共管单位（strata lots）、合作社份额、分时度假（time shares）、共有权益（shared interests）等。

variants.pt: 终身产权转让与本息费用分担
variants.trap: 混淆按揭本息与运营费分担
variants.stem: Arthur grants a life estate in a rental cottage to his sister Clara, while retaining the future fee simple interest for himself as the reversioner. Clara collects all the rental income from the cottage. Which of the following statements accurately describes the legal obligations of Clara and Arthur during Clara's lifetime?
variants.zh: Arthur 将一栋出租度假屋的终身产权（life estate）授予妹妹 Clara，同时为自己保留将来的完全保有产权，作为归复权人（reversioner）。Clara 收取该度假屋的全部租金收益。下列哪项准确描述了在 Clara 在世期间她与 Arthur 的法律义务？

opts.t: Because Clara receives all rental income, she must pay the mortgage principal, mortgage interest, property taxes, and insurance premiums.
opts.w: 错误。落入了“谁收租谁就付清全部本息和保险”的直觉陷阱：终身权人（life tenant）虽然享有全部租金收益，但只承担年度运营费用（水电、地税）和按揭利息，按揭本金与保险费由归复权人（reversioner）承担。

opts.t: Clara pays operating costs such as utilities and property taxes plus mortgage interest; Arthur pays the mortgage principal and insurance.
opts.w: 正确。终身权人（life tenant）在有生之年享有占有、使用和收取全部收益的权利，对应的义务是承担年度运营费用（水电、地税）与按揭利息（不含本金）；归复权人（reversioner）Arthur 为保护自己未来的完整产权，负责偿还按揭本金与保险费。

opts.t: Arthur must pay the annual property taxes and utilities because the life estate is only registered as a charge on his fee simple title.
opts.w: 错误。终身产权虽然作为一项负担（charge）登记在完全保有产权名下，但占有和收益归终身权人 Clara，因此日常水电和地税由终身权人承担，而非归复权人。

opts.t: Clara may intentionally demolish the cottage without liability to Arthur as long as she keeps the property taxes current.
opts.w: 错误。终身权人负有不得造成损耗（waste）的义务；主动拆毁建筑属于主动损耗（voluntary waste），终身权人须对归复权人承担赔偿责任。

variants.pt: 限制性契约的消极性质要件
variants.trap: 误把积极义务当成随地转移的限制性契约
variants.stem: An owner of two adjoining parcels sells Parcel A while retaining Parcel B. In the transfer deed registered at the Land Title Office, the buyer of Parcel A promises (1) never to build any structure higher than one storey, and (2) to plant and maintain a row of cedar hedges along the boundary every spring. Five years later, Parcel A is sold to a subsequent purchaser who was not a party to the original deed. What is the legal effect of these promises on the subsequent purchaser?
variants.zh: 一名拥有两块相邻土地的业主出售了 A 地块并保留 B 地块。在土地产权处登记的转让契据中，A 地块买方承诺：（1）绝不建造超过一层的建筑物；（2）每年春季沿边界种植并维护一排雪松树篱。五年后，A 地块卖给了一名并非原契据当事人的后手买家。这两项承诺对后手买家的法律效力如何？

opts.t: Only the promise to plant and maintain the cedar hedges runs with the land because it visibly benefits Parcel B.
opts.w: 错误。种植并维护树篱属于要求业主必须采取行动的积极契约（positive covenant），即使对 B 地块有利，也不能随地转移约束后手买家。

opts.t: Both promises run with the land because registration under the Land Title Act constitutes notice to all subsequent purchasers.
opts.w: 错误。登记确实解决了第五个要件“新业主知悉”（notice），但并不能把积极契约变成可随地转移的限制性契约。

opts.t: The height limit binds the purchaser as a negative covenant; the hedge-planting duty is positive and does not run with the land.
opts.w: 正确。限制性契约（restrictive covenant）随地转移必须满足五个要件，第一条就是内容必须为消极性质（不做某事，如不建超过一层的建筑）；要求每年种树维护属于积极契约（positive covenant），不随地转移。

opts.t: Neither promise binds the subsequent purchaser because a restrictive covenant cannot exist without at least three lots in a building scheme.
opts.w: 错误。单笔限制性契约只需有受益地和受限地两块地即可成立，不需要像建筑方案（building scheme）那样涉及多块细分土地的统一规则。

variants.pt: 地役权要件与法定路权例外
variants.trap: 以为没有受益地就绝无地役权，或有便利就算地役权
variants.stem: A homeowner enters into an agreement allowing the owner of the neighbouring lot to use the homeowner's private tennis court on weekends because the neighbour personally enjoys playing tennis. A crown utility authority also registers an agreement over the homeowner's lot to string overhead power transmission lines, without owning any neighbouring parcel. Which statement is correct if the homeowner sells the lot to a new buyer?
variants.zh: 一名业主达成协议，允许隔壁地块的业主周末使用自家的私人网球场，因为这位邻居个人很喜欢打网球。同时，一家公用事业机构也在该业主地块上登记了一份架设高空输电线路的协议，但该机构在附近并不拥有任何相邻地块。如果该业主将地块卖给新买家，哪项陈述是正确的？

opts.t: The neighbour's tennis arrangement binds the new buyer as an easement because the neighbour owns an adjacent parcel, while the utility line agreement fails for lack of a dominant tenement.
opts.w: 错误。两处都踩中陷阱：邻居虽然有相邻地块，但打网球只是方便邻居个人而非让受益地本身受益，不构成地役权；而公用事业输电线属于法定路权，依法无需受益地。

opts.t: Both the tennis arrangement and the power line agreement bind the new buyer as valid easements running with the land.
opts.w: 错误。私人网球场协议只是方便邻居个人的合同许可（licence），不满足地役权“必须真正让受益地本身受益”的第二要件，不约束新买家。

opts.t: Neither arrangement binds the new buyer because neither improves the agricultural productivity of the servient tenement.
opts.w: 错误。地役权从不要求提升“负担地（servient tenement）”的农业产出，且已登记的法定路权完全约束新买家。

opts.t: The power line agreement binds the buyer as a s.218 statutory right of way; the tennis arrangement is a personal licence that does not bind the buyer.
opts.w: 正确。依 Land Title Act s.218，法定路权（statutory right of way）无需受益地即可有效登记并随地转移；而地役权（easement）的第二要件是“必须真正让受益地本身受益，而不是只方便了业主个人”，周末打网球仅方便邻居个人，属于许可（licence），不约束新买家。

variants.pt: 未登记短租约与自然支撑权边界
variants.trap: 以为未登记租约一概无效或自然支撑权保护房屋
variants.stem: An investor purchases a small commercial property relying solely on a clean title search. After completion, the investor learns that a tenant is in actual occupation of the premises under an unregistered lease for a term of 2 years. At the same time, the investor wants to know whether the property's natural right of lateral support from the adjoining lot automatically protects the heavy brick warehouse built on the boundary. Which statement is legally accurate?
variants.zh: 一名投资者仅凭干净的产权检索结果买下一处小型商业物业。交割后，投资者得知一名租客正根据一份未登记的 2 年期租约实际占用该场所。同时，投资者想知道该物业对相邻地块享有的自然水平支撑权是否自动保护建在边界上的重型砖砌仓库。哪项陈述在法律上是准确的？

opts.t: Under Land Title Act s.23(2)(d) the investor is bound by the occupied lease of 3 years or less; natural support covers the land only, not the warehouse.
opts.w: 正确。依 Land Title Act s.23(2)(d)，产权证的无可争辩效力不排除期限 3 年以内且承租人已实际占用的未登记租约；同时，每块地对相邻地天然享有的垂直与水平支撑权只保护“地”本身，不延伸到地上的建筑物（保护建筑物需另设支撑地役权）。

opts.t: The unregistered 2-year lease is void against the investor under the Torrens principle of indefeasibility, though the warehouse is protected by natural support.
opts.w: 错误。3 年以内且实际占用的未登记租约是产权证无可争辩效力的法定例外，对新买家有效；而建筑物不受自然支撑权的自动保护。

opts.t: The unregistered lease binds the investor only if the term exceeds 3 years, and the natural right of support covers both soil and buildings.
opts.w: 错误。把时间门槛记反了：受保护的是“3 年以内（not exceeding 3 years）”且实际占用的未登记租约，且自然支撑权不延伸到建筑物。

opts.t: Neither the unregistered 2-year lease nor the natural right of support applies to fee simple land once a transfer is registered.
opts.w: 错误。3 年内实际占用的未登记租约以及对土地本身的自然支撑权均在过户后继续有效。

variants.pt: 附着物与动产两步测试
variants.trap: 看到固定就判附着物，忽略固定目的
variants.stem: In a dispute over whether an item passes with the sale of real estate when the contract is silent, a court applies the classic two-step test. Which of the following accurately states the initial presumptions and the 'better use' (object of annexation) test?
variants.zh: 在买卖合同未作约定时，针对某件物品是否随不动产一并转移的争议，法院适用经典的两步测试。下列哪项准确表述了初始推定以及“更佳用途”（固定意图）测试？

opts.t: Items resting on the land only by their own weight are presumed to be fixtures unless the contrary is proven.
opts.w: 错误。把第一步推定说反了：只凭自身重量放置、没有其他固定的物品，初始推定是动产（chattel），而非附着物（fixture）。

opts.t: Even slight attachment presumes a fixture, unless the attachment served the better use of the item itself rather than of the land.
opts.w: 正确。两步测试规则：（1）只凭自身重量放置、没有其他固定的物品推定为动产（有证据表明有意让它成为土地一部分时除外）；（2）哪怕只是轻微固定，也先推定为附着物（fixture），除非能证明固定的意图（更佳用途测试）是为了让该物品本身作为动产（chattel）更好用，而不是为了改良土地本身。

opts.t: Once an item is attached to a wall or floor by nails, screws, or welds, the presumption of a fixture becomes irrebuttable regardless of intent.
opts.w: 错误。轻微固定或焊接产生的附着物推定是可推翻的，法院会进一步通过“更佳用途测试”考察固定的客观意图。

opts.t: The subjective secret wish of the seller at the time of listing determines whether an attached appliance is a chattel or a fixture.
opts.w: 错误。法院通过固定程度和客观可见的“更佳用途”来判断固定意图，而不是听凭卖方挂牌时未写入合同的私下想法。

variants.pt: 共有默认推定与联权共有单方分割
variants.trap: 默认多人买房就是联权共有，或以为分割需全员同意
variants.stem: Two business partners acquire a warehouse under a transfer instrument that names both of them as transferees but says nothing about the form of co-ownership. Meanwhile, on a separate residential property held by two brothers in a valid joint tenancy, one brother executes a last will and testament leaving 'all my share in the house to my daughter' without taking any inter vivos step to sever the joint tenancy before he dies. What is the legal result for the warehouse and the residential property?
variants.zh: 两名商业合伙人通过一份将两人列为受让人但只字未提共有方式的转让文件购入一间仓库。与此同时，在两兄弟以有效联权共有（joint tenancy）方式持有的另一处住宅物业上，其中一名兄弟立下一份遗嘱，写明“将我在该房屋中的全部份额留给我的女儿”，但在去世前并未采取任何生前法律行为来分割该联权共有。该仓库与该住宅物业的法律结果分别是什么？

opts.t: The warehouse is held in common in equal shares, and the brother's house share passes to the surviving brother by survivorship, not under the will.
opts.w: 正确。依 Property Law Act s.11，转让文件未明确表达相反意图时，默认推定为份额相等的分权共有（tenancy in common）；而在联权共有（joint tenancy）中，由于生存者取得权（right of survivorship），一名共有人身故时其份额自动归于在世的共有人，不能通过遗嘱处分。

opts.t: The warehouse is presumed to be a joint tenancy because there are two buyers, and the deceased brother's daughter inherits half of the house under the will.
opts.w: 错误。两个结论全反了：法律默认推定是分权共有而非联权共有；且联权共有份额不能用遗嘱处分。

opts.t: The warehouse is held in tenancy in common, and executing a will automatically severs the unity of title so the daughter takes as a tenant in common.
opts.w: 错误。立遗嘱不会导致联权共有分割（severance），联权共有人必须在生前通过出售、抵押、协议或法院申请等方式分割，否则死后由生存者取得权自动转移给在世共有人。

opts.t: Both properties revert to the Crown until a court determines the proportions under the Partition of Property Act.
opts.w: 错误。这两处物业均有合法共有人，根本不适用绝嗣无继承人的归复（escheat）制度。

variants.pt: 原住民地权考试口径与现行判例
variants.trap: 混淆考试资料考试口径与最新法院判例
variants.stem: When answering an examination question based on the licensing course manual regarding the Torrens registration system and Aboriginal title, which statement represents the exam answer, and what is the current legal context noted for practice?
variants.zh: 在回答基于牌照课程考试资料的关于 Torrens 登记制度与原住民地权的考试题时，哪项陈述代表考试标准答案？为实务指出的现行法律背景又是什么？

opts.t: Exam: Aboriginal title automatically extinguishes any registered fee simple. Practice: the 2025 decision confirmed that fee simple always extinguishes Aboriginal title.
opts.w: 错误。无论考试口径还是现行判例都不支持这两句话：考试口径认为产权证具有无可争辩效力，而 2025 年判决明确拒绝了“批出 fee simple 就自动消灭原住民地权”的主张。

opts.t: Exam: the title certificate is conclusive and Aboriginal title is not an estate. Practice: a 2025 BC ruling (under appeal) held the two can coexist, case by case.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径下，产权证具有无可争辩（indefeasible）效力，且原住民地权（Aboriginal title）不是一种 estate；现行实务中，Cowichan Tribes v. Canada (2025 BCSC 1490，上诉中) 认定原住民地权与 fee simple 可以并存、两者都不是绝对产权，重叠时须逐案调和。

opts.t: Exam: Aboriginal title is a profit à prendre registered under section 218 of the Land Title Act. Practice: it is recorded as a statutory right of way.
opts.w: 错误。收益权（profit à prendre）是进入他人土地取走产出物的权利，s.218 规定的是无需受益地的法定路权，两者都不是原住民地权；考试口径只说原住民地权不是一种 estate。

opts.t: Exam: DRIPA requires ministerial approval before any residential sale is registered. Practice: the same approval now applies to every strata transfer.
opts.w: 错误。DRIPA 要求 BC 政府逐步让省法与联合国原住民权利宣言保持一致，本身不直接规范某一笔交易的产权登记程序，更没有给住宅或共管转让设部长审批。

variants.pt: 第73条分割禁令与租约例外
variants.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
variants.stem: A rural landowner wishes to lease an orchard portion of her land to a neighbouring farmer for a term of life, while also leasing the upper floor of her farmhouse to a tenant for eight years. Under section 73 of the Land Title Act, how are these two arrangements treated?
variants.zh: 一名农村土地所有人希望把她土地上的一片果园区域租给邻近农夫，租期为终身；同时把她农舍的楼上一层租给一名租客，租期为八年。根据《土地产权法》第 73 条，这两项安排如何处理？

opts.t: Both arrangements require subdivision approval because both terms exceed three years.
opts.w: 错误。农舍楼上一层属于建筑物的一部分（part of a building），依第 73(3) 条豁免分割审批。

opts.t: The orchard lease needs approval as a life lease of part of the land, while the farmhouse floor lease is exempt as part of a building.
opts.w: 正确。依《土地产权法》第 73 条，为签订超过三年（含终身，for life）的租约而切分土地必须按第 7 部办分割审批；但依第 73(3) 条，出租建筑物的一部分（农舍楼上一层）不算分割。

opts.t: Neither arrangement requires subdivision approval because a life lease has no fixed calendar number of years.
opts.w: 错误。第 73 条明文将「超过三年（含终身）」的土地部分租约一并纳入分割禁令范围。

opts.t: The farmhouse floor lease requires subdivision approval, whereas agricultural orchard land is exempt from the Land Title Act.
opts.w: 错误。正好颠倒了规则：私有农业地块切分租超三年受第 73 条约束，而建筑物内部划分依第 73(3) 条豁免。

variants.pt: 裸地共管与传统分割差异
variants.trap: 裸地共管道路当市政路
variants.stem: A licensee searches the title and plan for a gated community of detached homes and notices the words 'bare land strata plan' written next to the approving officer's signature. What should the licensee advise the buyer regarding the community's private roadway and drainage system?
variants.zh: 一名持牌人查询了一个门禁独立屋社区的产权和图纸，注意到审批官签名旁写着「裸地共管图（bare land strata plan）」字样。关于该社区的内部道路和排水系统，持牌人应向买家提供什么建议？

opts.t: The roadway and drainage were transferred to the provincial Crown upon deposit of the plan under section 107 of the Land Title Act.
opts.w: 错误。第 107 条道路献公适用于传统分割图上标为道路的部分，不适用于裸地共管的共有内部道路。

opts.t: Only the owners whose driveways directly touch the main road are legally responsible for paving and drainage repairs.
opts.w: 错误。共有财产的维修费用由全体共管单位业主按单位权益分摊，而非仅由沿路业主承担。

opts.t: They are strata common property, so all owners share repair costs and the buyer should review the reserve fund study and recent resolutions.
opts.w: 正确。裸地共管（bare land strata）里的内部道路和排水设施属于共有财产（common property），维修费由全体业主分摊；持牌人应当把这一区别讲清，并提醒买家调阅共管法团的储备金研究与近期决议。

opts.t: A bare land strata is identical to a leasehold strata, so the road reverts to the developer when the lease expires.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了裸地共管（按土地切分的共管产权）与租赁式共管（leasehold strata，承租人权益）。

variants.pt: 欺诈、善意对价与押记推定
variants.trap: 把押记当成不可推翻产权
variants.stem: An imposter forges a transfer of fee simple title into his own name and then sells the house for full market price to an innocent buyer who registers the transfer. Which statement correctly describes the rights of the innocent buyer and the defrauded original owner?
variants.zh: 一名冒名顶替者伪造完全所有权转让文书将房产过户到自己名下，随后按全额市场价将房子卖给了一名不知情的善意买家，买家办妥了过户登记。下列哪项正确描述了善意买家与被骗原所有人的权利？

opts.t: The buyer gets indefeasible title as a good-faith purchaser for value; the owner may claim from the assurance fund within 3 years, capped at value when lost.
opts.w: 正确。骗子本人因参与欺诈属第 23(2)(i) 条例外不受保护，但善意且按市场价支付有价对价（valuable consideration）的买家依第 25.1(2) 条在登记时取得不可推翻产权；失去土地的原所有人可在发现被剥夺之日起 3 年内（第 294.2(7) 条）向保证基金（assurance fund）求偿，赔偿额以损失发生当时的土地价值封顶且不含事后改良（第 294.61 条）。

opts.t: Under the rule nemo dat quod non habet, the forged transfer is void and every subsequent transfer is automatically void regardless of the buyer's good faith.
opts.w: 错误。nemo dat quod non habet（无效契据令其后整条链条无效）是普通法契据制度的痛点，Torrens 制度正是通过第 23 条和第 25.1 条保护善意有价受让人来解决这一问题。

opts.t: The innocent buyer keeps the land, and the original owner is entitled to recover the current market value of the land plus the value of all new buildings constructed by the buyer after the loss.
opts.w: 错误。依第 294.61 条，保证基金赔偿不得高于损失发生当时该土地的价值，且不计入损失之后建造或做出的建筑与改良。

opts.t: The buyer keeps the land even if she paid only a nominal one-dollar consideration to the imposter.
opts.w: 错误。第 25.1 条要求的「有价对价」必须按当时市场价看合理的价格，象征性一元或赠与不能靠该条保住产权。

variants.pt: 不可推翻性例外与短租约
variants.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
variants.stem: An investor signs a three-year lease for a vacant commercial storage yard, pays a deposit, does not register the lease, and never moves any equipment onto the land or takes possession. Before the investor moves in, the landowner sells and transfers fee simple title to a third-party buyer who registers title. Is the third-party buyer bound by the three-year lease?
variants.zh: 一名投资人就一块空置的商业储物场地签了一份三年期租约并付了定金，既没有登记该租约，也从未把任何设备搬入场地或实际占有。在投资人搬入前，土地所有人将完全所有权出售并过户给了一名办妥登记的第三方买家。该第三方买家是否受这份三年期租约约束？

opts.t: Yes, because every lease for a term of three years or less is automatically protected against third parties regardless of possession.
opts.w: 错误。漏掉了短租约例外的第二个必备条件——必须有「实际占用（actual occupation）」。

opts.t: No, the short-lease exception needs both a term of three years or less and actual occupation, and the investor never occupied.
opts.w: 正确。第 20(3) 条和第 23(2)(d) 条保护未登记短租约必须同时满足两个条件：租期不超过三年，且承租人有实际占用（actual occupation）；未实际占用且未登记的租约仅在原当事人之间有效，不能对抗已登记的第三方买家。

opts.t: Yes, because the investor can claim compensation from the assurance fund for the loss of an unregistered lease.
opts.w: 错误。依第 294.6(f) 条，因申请人自己的疏忽或未登记所致损失，保证基金不予赔偿。

opts.t: No, because commercial leases of any length must be approved by the municipal approving officer to be valid.
opts.w: 错误。不超过三年的租约根本不触发第 73 条分割审批。

variants.pt: 产权负担时限与留置权保留金
variants.trap: 留置权 10% 与共管买家 7% 混淆
variants.stem: A listing licensee runs a title search on a residential property and discovers two entries: a judgment registered by an unsecured creditor, and a note reading 'Duplicate Indefeasible Title: Issued / Outstanding'. How do these two items affect the upcoming transaction?
variants.zh: 一名上市持牌人对一处住宅物业进行产权查询，发现两条记录：一条是无担保债权人登记的判决，另一条写着「重复产权证：已签发／在外未交回」。这两项会如何影响即将进行的交易？

opts.t: The judgment expires 2 months after registration like a caveat, and an outstanding duplicate title only blocks short-term leases.
opts.w: 错误。2 个月是异议登记（caveat）的失效期，判决（judgment）是登记 2 年后自动失效；且重复产权证在外会阻断转让、按揭或长期租约的登记。

opts.t: The judgment lapses 2 years after registration unless renewed, and while the duplicate is outstanding the registry will not accept a transfer, mortgage or long-term lease.
opts.w: 正确。依《法院命令执行法》第 83(1) 条，判决登记 2 年后自动失效（除非到期前续展）；而只要重复产权证（duplicate indefeasible title）被取出在外而没交回，登记处就不办转让、按揭或长期租约的登记，若丢失须依第 193 条申请补发。

opts.t: The outstanding duplicate title means a certificate of pending litigation (CPL) is on title, which completely freezes all filings with no exceptions.
opts.w: 错误。混淆了重复产权证与待决诉讼证明书（CPL）；而且今天的 CPL 也不再绝对冻结一切登记，申请人可在书面选择从属于诉讼最终结果的前提下推进登记。

opts.t: Both items are placed in the Legal Notations section along with Community Charter section 57 notices and never expire.
opts.w: 错误。《社区宪章》第 57 条通知、第 392 条特殊废物通知和遗产建筑指定出现在「法律注记（Legal Notations）」栏，而判决属于押记（charge）且 2 年失效，重复产权证则有专门状态栏。

variants.trap: 三年与十年租约线混用
variants.stem: After a relevant corporation properly files a transparency report upon buying land in BC, a share transfer occurs and a new individual acquires 10% of the corporation's shares, while the land title itself remains unchanged. Under section 16(1) of the Land Owner Transparency Act, what must the corporation do?
variants.zh: 一家相关公司在 BC 省买地并妥善提交透明报告后，发生了股权转让，一名新个人取得了该公司 10% 的股份，而土地产权本身没有任何变动。根据《土地所有人透明法》第 16(1) 条，该公司必须怎么做？

opts.t: Nothing until the corporation sells or mortgages the land at the land title office.
opts.w: 错误。这是实务中最常漏掉的合规点：即使土地产权一动没动，公司股权或信托受益人变动照样触发 LOTA 补报义务。

opts.t: File a caveat at the land title office within 45 days of the share transfer.
opts.w: 错误。股权变动走的是 LOTA 透明报告更新，与产权登记处的异议登记（caveat）或 45 天建筑留置权期无关。

opts.t: Apply for a new nine-digit Parcel Identifier (PID) because the corporate beneficial ownership behind the registered title has changed.
opts.w: 错误。PID 与地块终身绑定，只有土地分割或合并时才会改变，股权变动不改变 PID。

opts.t: File a new transparency report within 2 months of knowing, or when it ought to know, that the old report no longer reflects its interest holders.
opts.w: 正确。依 LOTA 第 16(1) 条，申报主体（reporting body）知道或理应知道其已交报告不再反映现时权益持有人（interest holder，新股东持股达 10% 门槛）之后，须在 2 个月内另交一份新的透明报告。

variants.pt: 制造房屋登记与移动规则
variants.trap: 2020 考试口径与 2026 现行接口错位
variants.stem: A claimant who has commenced a court action over ownership of a manufactured home registers a caution in the Manufactured Home Registry. How long does that caution remain effective unless a court orders otherwise, and what is the maximum fine for moving a manufactured home without a transport permit?
variants.zh: 一名已就制造房屋所有权提起诉讼的索赔人在制造房屋登记处登记了一条警示（caution）。除非法院另有命令，该警示的有效期是多久？在没有运输许可的情况下移动制造房屋的最高罚金又是多少？

opts.t: The caution expires after 3 months, and the maximum fine for violating movement, permit, or sale rules is $2,000.
opts.w: 正确。依《制造房屋法》第 22(3) 条，已提起诉讼的人提交的警示（caution）在 3 个月后失效，除非法院在此期间下令注销或延续；违反移动、运输许可（30 天有效）与销售规定的，罚金上限为 $2,000。

opts.t: The caution expires after 2 months like a land title caveat, and the maximum fine is $25,000.
opts.w: 错误。2 个月是《土地产权法》下异议登记（caveat）的失效期，$25,000 是 LOTA 个人罚款的数字，均不适用于《制造房屋法》。

opts.t: The caution expires after 30 days, and the maximum fine is $50,000.
opts.w: 错误。30 天是运输许可（transport permit）的有效期（第 17(1) 条），不是警示（caution）的 3 个月有效期。

opts.t: The caution remains in effect for 1 year, and losses are compensated from the Manufactured Home Assurance Fund.
opts.w: 错误。1 年是建筑留置权起诉期，且制造房屋登记系统完全没有保证基金（assurance fund）或不可推翻性。

variants.pt: 过失三要件与免责声明的效力
variants.trap: 通用免责声明护身陷阱
variants.stem: A listing licensee copies septic system capacity figures from a decade-old brochure without checking municipal records or advising the buyer to verify them, relying solely on a general footnote stating 'All information is believed accurate but not warranted.' When the septic system proves undersized for the listed bedroom count, why does the licensee's defence fail in a negligence action?
variants.zh: 某挂牌持牌人未核查市政记录，也未建议买方核实，便直接照抄十年前宣传册上的化粪池容量数据，仅依赖页脚一句泛泛的「所有信息据信准确但不作保证」。当化粪池被证实无法满足挂牌所列卧室数量时，为什么持牌人在过失之诉中的抗辩不能成立？

opts.t: A general blanket disclaimer has been held insufficient by the courts to override the duty of care a listing licensee owes to a buyer.
opts.w: 正确。法院判例明确指出，「此信息据信正确但不作保证」这类泛泛的通用免责声明（general disclaimer）不足以推翻卖方持牌人对买方负有的注意义务（duty of care）；可能有效的是要求独立核实的具体（specific）免责声明。

opts.t: Septic capacity is governed strictly by the Real Estate Compensation Fund rather than common law tort principles.
opts.w: 错误。特别赔偿基金（Real Estate Compensation Fund）只管托付资金被侵吞或欺诈取得，化粪池信息失实属于民事过失（negligence）与过失性虚假陈述范畴。

opts.t: Licensees are held to the lowest standard of care in property transactions because buyers always hire home inspectors.
opts.w: 错误。风险越大，注意标准（standard of care）越高；鉴于房产交易金额巨大且公众依赖持牌人的特殊技能，BC 法院对持牌人施加的是「非常接近完美」的高标准。

opts.t: Disclaimers are legally valid only if countersigned by the Superintendent prior to publication.
opts.w: 错误。免责声明的有效性取决于其是否具体明确（specific disclaimer）以及陈述人是否明知不实，法律并无由 Superintendent 预先联署免责声明的规定。

variants.pt: 过失性虚假陈述与欺诈的要件区分
variants.trap: 专家身份与欺诈心理状态混淆
variants.stem: During a property showing, a prospective buyer asks the licensee for an opinion on projected commercial rental yields. Because a real estate licensee is treated at law as an expert in real estate matters, which set of options represents the three courses of action open to the licensee under the Hedley Byrne principle?
variants.zh: 在带看物业期间，潜在买方请持牌人就预期商业租金回报率给出意见。由于地产持牌人在法律上被视为地产领域的专家，根据 Hedley Byrne 原则，持牌人面对该咨询有哪三条路可选？

opts.t: Guarantee the yield in writing, split the commission with the buyer, or refer the matter to the Compensation Fund.
opts.w: 错误。私下分佣或转交赔偿基金与 Hedley Byrne 规则毫无关系，专家也不应盲目书面担保未经核实的回报率。

opts.t: Give a careless estimate orally, hide behind the seller's disclosure statement, or backdate the listing contract.
opts.w: 错误。口头粗心估算同样构成过失性虚假陈述（negligent misrepresentation），卖方披露声明与倒签合同更不是合法选项。

opts.t: Decline to advise; advise with an express disclaimer of responsibility; or advise without qualification and take reasonable care.
opts.w: 正确。在 Hedley Byrne 确立的过失性虚假陈述规则下，有技能的专家面对合理依赖者的咨询有三条路：① 拒绝提供该建议；② 提供建议但明确声明不对其准确性或可靠性负责；③ 不加任何限定地提供建议，但此时必须尽合理注意（reasonable care），否则须为损失负责。

opts.t: Obtain a consent order from the Superintendent, file an undertaking, or request a letter of advisement.
opts.w: 错误。同意令、承诺与告诫函是纪律线（discipline proceedings）的处理工具，不是民事咨询时的应对路径。

variants.pt: 受托义务举证责任倒置与丧失佣金
variants.trap: 受托义务举证与后果错位陷阱
variants.stem: A brokerage acting for a seller receives a higher offer from a third party before closing, fails to disclose that higher offer to the seller, and subsequently arranges a quick resale at the higher price. In the ensuing court action for breach of fiduciary duty, who bears the onus of proof and what is the primary consequence regarding the brokerage's commission?
variants.zh: 代表卖方的某经纪行在成交前收到第三方提出的更高报价，却未将该更高报价告知卖方，事后又以该更高价格安排了转售。在随后提起的违反受托义务之诉中，谁承担举证责任，且关于经纪行佣金的首要后果是什么？

opts.t: The seller must prove beyond a reasonable doubt that the brokerage acted with criminal intent before commission can be withheld.
opts.w: 错误。民事受托义务之诉不适用刑事证明标准，更关键的是受托义务实行举证责任倒置，由持牌人/经纪行自证已完全履行最高诚信义务。

opts.t: The licensee/brokerage must prove every fiduciary duty was met, and the breach costs it the commission it claims.
opts.w: 正确。受托义务（fiduciary duty）四原则要求成交价不得低于通过尽职努力可从第三方取得的价格、充分披露一切重大事实，且举证责任在持牌人身上；隐瞒更高报价安排转售直接导致丧失所主张的佣金（现行规则下还违反 Rules s.30(f)(g)，属 C 档）。

opts.t: The brokerage keeps its commission as long as the original sale price matched the initial listing appraisal.
opts.w: 错误。受托义务第 3 条原则要求所得价格必须不低于持牌人本可通过尽职努力从第三方取得的任何其他价格，不能以达到初始评估价为由隐瞒更高报价。

opts.t: The seller's only recourse is to claim up to $200,000 from the Real Estate Compensation Fund.
opts.w: 错误。特别赔偿基金仅针对托付资金被侵吞或不当转用，卖方就隐瞒报价拒付佣金或索赔走的是民事法院与纪律线。

variants.pt: 替代责任与代表职务行为的边界
variants.trap: 独立承包商免除替代责任陷阱
variants.stem: A buyer sues both a representative and the representative's brokerage after the representative fraudulently alters a property inspection summary while negotiating an offer on behalf of the brokerage. The brokerage argues it cannot be held vicariously liable because the representative had an independent contractor tax status and committed an intentional wrong. How do the courts treat the brokerage's defence?
variants.zh: 某代表在代表经纪行洽谈要约期间欺诈性地篡改了一份验房摘要，买方随后同时起诉该代表及其所属经纪行。经纪行辩称，该代表在税务上属于独立承包商且实施的是故意不当行为，因此经纪行不应承担替代责任。法院如何对待经纪行的这一抗辩？

opts.t: The defence succeeds because vicarious liability applies only to minor clerical carelessness by salaried staff.
opts.w: 错误。替代责任（vicarious liability）不限于拿固定薪水的职员或轻微笔误；只要发生在雇佣过程中，即便是欺诈或殴打等行为，雇主也可能被判承担替代责任。

opts.t: It fails: representatives are treated as employees here, and an employer can be liable even for fraud done in the ordinary course of employment.
opts.w: 正确。法院将代表（representative）当作雇员对待，独立承包商协议不能免除经纪行的替代责任；且只要不当行为发生在通常雇佣过程中（ordinary course of employment），即便是欺诈行为，经纪行同样可能被判承担替代责任。

opts.t: The defence succeeds unless the managing broker personally typed the altered inspection summary.
opts.w: 错误。替代责任是共同法上的无过错连带归责原则，不以管理经纪亲自参与篡改为前提（此外现行 Rules s.28 还对管理经纪施加了独立的法定监督义务）。

opts.t: The court must dismiss the civil suit against the brokerage because fraud by licensees is handled exclusively by the Financial Services Tribunal.
opts.w: 错误。受害方有权在民事法院同时起诉行为人与雇主（经纪行），与纪律线或上诉仲裁庭互不排斥。

variants.pt: 《占用人责任法》与开放日多重占用人
variants.trap: 单一占用人或排除更高标准陷阱
variants.stem: Which statement accurately describes the relationship between the general duty of care under the Occupiers Liability Act (OLA) and higher standards of care found in other statutes such as the Residential Tenancy Act or the Workers Compensation Act?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述准确描述了《占用人责任法》（OLA）下的一般注意义务与《住宅租赁法》或《工人赔偿法》等其他制定法中更高注意标准之间的关系？

opts.t: The OLA replaces all other statutory safety duties so that landlords and workplace owners only ever face a single minimum standard.
opts.w: 错误。OLA 取代的是 1974 年以前的共同法访客分类规则，绝非废除其他制定法的安全标准。

opts.t: Under OLA s.3(4), the Act does not relieve an occupier from any higher standard of care imposed by another enactment on a particular class of persons.
opts.w: 正确。OLA s.3(4) 明确规定，OLA 的统一合理注意标准不免除其他法律对特定人群施加的更高注意标准——例如《住宅租赁法》RTA s.32 业主对租客的维修义务，以及《工人赔偿法》工作场所业主的一般义务（考试口径引旧条号 s.119，2026 现行合并本为 s.25）。

opts.t: Higher statutory standards apply only when a trespasser enters agricultural or wilderness land for criminal purposes.
opts.w: 错误。擅入并实施犯罪或免费进入荒野/农地属于 OLA s.3(3.1)–(3.3) 视为「自甘风险（willingly assumed risks）」的情形，此时注意标准是降低（仅不得故意加害或罔顾安全），而非提高。

opts.t: The OLA applies only to personal injury and excludes any duty regarding a visitor's personal property brought onto the premises.
opts.w: 错误。OLA s.3(1) 明确规定占用人的合理注意义务同时保护进入场所的人及其财物（甚至包括未亲自进入者放在场所内的财物）。

variants.pt: 侵入与私人妨害的构成要件与抗辩
variants.trap: 侵入与妨害要件互换陷阱
variants.stem: Which statement correctly contrasts the tort of trespass to land with the tort of private nuisance?
variants.zh: 下列哪项陈述正确对比了土地侵入侵权与私人妨害侵权？

opts.t: Trespass requires proof of substantial financial damage, whereas private nuisance is actionable per se without any harm.
opts.w: 错误。这是「侵入与妨害要件互换陷阱」；无须证明任何损害即可起诉（actionable per se）的是侵入（trespass），而私人妨害（private nuisance）必须证明对使用与享用的实质干扰或实际物理损害。

opts.t: Trespass is a direct, intentional entry actionable per se; nuisance arises from use of one's own land, harms a neighbour's enjoyment, and needs proof of damage.
opts.w: 正确。侵入（trespass）是故意、直接针对他人土地实施的行为，且本身即可诉（actionable per se，无须证明损害）；私人妨害（private nuisance）则通常是在自己土地上实施、反复或持续影响到邻地，且必须证明实质干扰或物理损害。

opts.t: Honest mistake is a complete defence to trespass when a courier leaves packages on the wrong driveway, whereas mistake is never relevant in negligence.
opts.w: 错误。在侵入之诉中，「不知情」或「放错地方」均非有效抗辩（判例中快递公司误送到错误地址仍被判构成不法置物侵入）。

opts.t: Abatement allows a landowner to use unlimited force to eject a trespasser without prior request.
opts.w: 错误。除害（abatement）是私人妨害的救济（如修剪越界树枝，移除他人土地上妨害前一般须先通知）；驱逐侵入者叫自助（self-help），且必须先要求对方离开、不得使用超过必要限度的武力。

variants.pt: 错误遗漏保险、赔偿基金与纪律处分口径
variants.trap: 保险与赔偿基金混袋陷阱
variants.stem: According to the 2020 course manual wording, which body was described as the industry disciplinary body and what three traditional sanctions were listed — even though under current BC law (RESA Part 4) the Superintendent at BCFSA exercises all disciplinary powers with expanded statutory penalties?
variants.zh: 按照 2020 版课程手册的考试口径表述，哪个机构曾被称为行业纪律机关、列出了哪三项传统处分工具——尽管在现行 BC 法律（RESA 第 4 部分）下，所有纪律职权已由 BCFSA 的地产总监（Superintendent）行使并配备了大幅扩充的法定罚款工具？

opts.t: The Financial Services Tribunal, with powers limited to letters of advisement, undertakings, and mediation.
opts.w: 错误。金融服务仲裁庭（FST）是受理上诉的机构（30 天内、$850 上诉费），无论旧版还是现行法都不是一审纪律机关。

opts.t: The Real Estate Errors and Omissions Insurance Corporation, with powers to reprimand, fine up to $500,000, and seize trust accounts.
opts.w: 错误。E&O 保险公司自 1988 年设立以来一直是非营利自保机构，从来不是监管或纪律处分机关。

opts.t: The Real Estate Compensation Fund Corporation, with powers to suspend licences, award civil damages, and prosecute criminal offences.
opts.w: 错误。赔偿基金法团只负责管理托付资金被挪用时的补偿基金，不负责发牌或纪律处分。

opts.t: The Real Estate Council of BC, with traditional sanctions listed as reprimand, licence suspension, and licence cancellation.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径（©2020）将 Real Estate Council of BC 表述为纪律机关，且处分工具只列了训诫（reprimand）、停牌（suspension）与吊牌（cancellation）三项；而 2026 年现行 RESA 下 Real Estate Council 已解散，由 BCFSA 任命的 Superintendent 决定全部处分，拥有 s.43(2) 十项纪律命令工具（含个人最高 $250,000、经纪行最高 $500,000 纪律罚款）及最高 $100,000 的六档行政罚款。

variants.pt: 租赁与许可的排他占有判准
variants.trap: 抬头名称与实质排他占有倒置
variants.stem: An artist signs a contract with a studio owner to use one open workbench inside a shared hall. The owner retains full access to the hall at all hours and can move the artist to any available bench each morning. When the studio owner sells the hall to a developer, the artist claims to hold a lease that binds the developer. Is the artist's claim valid?
variants.zh: 一名画师与画室业主签了一份合同，使用共享大厅内的一张开放式工作台。业主保留全天候进出大厅的完整权限，且每天早上可以把画师调换到任何空置的工作台。当画室业主把大厅卖给开发商时，画师声称自己持有约束开发商的租约。画师的主张成立吗？

opts.t: Yes, because any written agreement to use space inside a building for a fee creates an interest in land.
opts.w: 混淆了合同特权与土地权益。付费使用空间若没有排他占有，只构成许可（licence），不创设土地权益（interest in land）。

opts.t: Yes, because commercial licences automatically convert into periodic tenancies when the property is sold.
opts.w: 捏造了法律规则。物业出售不会把许可变成周期性租赁；相反，正因为许可不随地而走，物业易主时新业主不受其约束。

opts.t: No, because a studio workbench is governed by the Residential Tenancy Branch rather than common law.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。工作台既非住宅，也无排他占有，完全不属 RTB 管辖。

opts.t: No, without exclusive possession of a defined space the artist holds only a licence, which does not bind a buyer.
opts.w: 正确。画师没有固定空间的排他占有（exclusive possession），因此只持有许可（licence）；许可只是一份合同特权，不创设土地权益（interest in land），也不随地而走（does not run with the land），不能约束买下物业的开发商。

variants.pt: 商业租赁的租期类型与终止
variants.stem: A bakery signs a commercial lease for a definite two-year term starting January 1, 2025, and ending December 31, 2026. Neither the landlord nor the bakery gives any written notice before December 31, 2026, and the bakery vacates on that final day. Under the rules governing commercial fixed-term tenancies, did the bakery terminate the lease properly?
variants.zh: 一家面包店签了一份商业租约，固定期限两年，自 2025 年 1 月 1 日起至 2026 年 12 月 31 日止。在 2026 年 12 月 31 日之前，房东和面包店均未发出任何书面通知，面包店在最后一天搬离。根据支配商业固定期租赁的规则，面包店是否妥当终止了租约？

opts.t: Yes, because a commercial fixed-term lease expires automatically at the end of the term without either party having to give notice.
opts.w: 正确。商业固定期租赁（fixed-term tenancy）在期限届满时自动终止（expires automatically），任何一方都不需要提前发通知。

opts.t: No, because a commercial fixed-term lease automatically converts into a month-to-month tenancy unless one month's notice is given.
opts.w: 错在把住宅思路套到商业：商业固定期租约届满即自动终止，任何一方都不需要发通知，也不会因为没发通知就自动转成月租。

opts.t: No, because any lease exceeding one year requires six months' reasonable notice before the end date.
opts.w: 混淆了固定期租赁与年对年周期性租赁（periodic tenancy）。六个月合理通知适用于终止商业年租（周期性租赁），不适用于有确定到期日的固定期租约。

opts.t: Yes, but only if the bakery generates a termination notice through the online portal at least 21 days before moving out.
opts.w: 把住宅收房门户通知与异议期的规则错搬到了商业固定期租赁上。

variants.pt: 住宅自住收房通知与异议期
variants.trap: 考试旧口径与现行新法混淆
variants.stem: According to the course manual, if a residential landlord intends to end a tenancy to perform major renovations or demolition that require the rental unit to be vacant, how much notice must the landlord give the tenant, and how many days does the tenant have to apply for dispute resolution?
variants.zh: 根据课程手册（考试口径），如果住宅房东打算为了进行必须清空出租单元的大修或拆除而终止租赁，房东必须提前多久通知租客？租客有多少天可以申请争议解决？

opts.t: 1 month's notice, with 10 days for the tenant to apply for dispute resolution.
opts.w: 混淆了大修/拆除收房与因由终止（for cause，RTA s.47）的通知期和异议期。

opts.t: 2 months' notice, with 15 days for the tenant to apply for dispute resolution.
opts.w: 混淆了考试口径下的大修/拆除（4 个月通知）与自住收房（考试口径为 2 个月通知、15 天异议）。

opts.t: 4 months' notice, with 30 days for the tenant to apply for dispute resolution.
opts.w: 正确。按课程手册（©2020 考试口径），因拆除、改用途或大修（renoviction）终止租赁适用 4 个月通知与 30 天租客异议期。注意：自 2021-07-01 起现行 BC 省法律（RTA s.49.2）规定，大修/改造收房房东不能再直接发通知，必须先向 RTB 申请争议解决取得占有令（生效日不早于裁令作出后 4 个月），而拆除/改用途仍维持 4 个月通知与 30 天异议期。

opts.t: 12 months' notice, with 5 days for the tenant to apply for dispute resolution.
opts.w: 混淆了《房车园租赁法》整体改用途的 12 个月通知与欠租的 5 天异议期。

variants.pt: 商业追租扣押权与住宅禁止扣押
variants.stem: A residential landlord increases a tenant's rent 14 months after the tenancy began, giving three full months' written notice on the approved form RTB-7. Last year, the landlord did not raise the rent at all. Can the landlord add last year's unused allowable percentage to this year's annual allowable rent increase limit?
variants.zh: 一名住宅房东在起租 14 个月后使用批准表格 RTB-7 提前整三个月发出书面涨租通知。去年房东完全没有涨租。房东能否把去年未用掉的允许涨租比例累加到今年的年度涨租上限中？

opts.t: Yes, unused annual rent increase limits can be banked and carried forward for up to two years.
opts.w: 违反了「不能补涨」规则。住宅年度涨租上限按当年规定执行，以前年度未涨或未涨满的额度作废，不得结转累加。

opts.t: No, a landlord cannot carry forward or add unused rent increase room from a previous year, and cannot round the calculated amount up.
opts.w: 正确。住宅涨租即使距离上次涨租或起租已满 12 个月且提前 3 个月用 RTB-7 通知，今年也只能按今年的年度涨租上限（inflation rate，考试口径曾有一处旧表印作 CPI + 2%）执行，不能补涨去年未用的额度，也不能向上取整。

opts.t: Yes, provided the landlord gives at least six months' notice instead of three months' notice.
opts.w: 捏造了靠延长通知期突破涨租上限的规则。无论提前几个月通知，都不能擅自突破当年法定年度上限或补涨往年额度。

opts.t: No, unless the property is sold to a new landlord, because a change of landlord resets the right to increase rent immediately.
opts.w: 踩中「换房东即能涨租」的误区。讲义明确指出：换房东不产生涨租权，只有距该租客起租或上次涨租满 12 个月、或换了新租客重新出租时才能涨租。

variants.pt: 住宅保证金与宠物押金上限及退还
variants.stem: A residential tenant moves into an apartment without any pets and pays a half-month security deposit when signing the tenancy agreement. Eight months into the tenancy, the landlord gives the tenant permission to get a cat. Under the Residential Tenancy Act, what may the landlord require regarding deposits at that time?
variants.zh: 一名住宅租客在没有宠物、订立租赁协议时缴付了半个月保证金并入住公寓。起租八个月后，房东批准租客养一只猫。根据《住宅租赁法》，此时房东可以就押金提出什么要求？

opts.t: A pet damage deposit of up to half a month's rent when the cat is first allowed, together with a condition inspection.
opts.w: 正确。虽然保证金（security deposit）只能在订立协议时收取（RTA s.20(a)），但宠物损坏押金（pet damage deposit）可在租期中途租客首次获准养宠时收取（不超过半个月租金），且依 RTA s.23 在新增宠物时须做状况检查。（注：考试口径 ©2020 将押金收取时点笼统写在一起，现行规则明确区分保证金与中途养宠押金。）

opts.t: The landlord cannot collect a pet damage deposit because all deposits must be collected on the day the tenancy agreement is signed.
opts.w: 把仅适用于保证金（security deposit）的订约时点限制（s.20(a)）错误扩大到了租期中途首次获准养宠的情形。

opts.t: The landlord may collect a second security deposit plus a full month's rent as a pet deposit.
opts.w: 双重违规：每个出租单位只能收取一份保证金，且宠物押金上限为半个月租金而非一个月租金。

opts.t: The landlord may increase the monthly rent immediately by 10% without using form RTB-7 because a cat is an additional occupant.
opts.w: 混淆了养宠与涨租规则。宠物不是入住人（occupant），房东不能借批准养宠绕过 12 个月间隔、3 个月 RTB-7 通知及年度涨租上限。

variants.pt: 住宅房东法定进入权与提前通知
variants.stem: A seller's licensee is hired to sell a tenanted residential condo. On Tuesday afternoon, the licensee mails a written notice of entry to the tenant's mailbox address for a buyer showing scheduled for Thursday morning. Based on the deemed service rules in section 90 of the Residential Tenancy Act and best practices for showing tenanted properties, why is this approach problematic?
variants.zh: 一名卖方持牌人受聘出售一套有租客的住宅共管公寓。周二下午，持牌人向租客邮寄了一份书面进入通知，安排在周四上午带买家看房。根据《住宅租赁法》第 90 条的视为收到规则以及带看有租客物业的实务规范，为什么这种做法有问题？

opts.t: Mailed notices are deemed received on the 10th day after mailing, and showings of tenanted units are only permitted after 9:00 p.m.
opts.w: 记错了视为收到天数与进入时段。邮寄是寄出后第 5 天视为收到（而非第 10 天），且法定进入时段是早 8 点至晚 9 点之间。

opts.t: A licensee is never permitted to enter a tenanted unit until the tenant has moved out completely.
opts.w: 过于绝对。只要取得租客同意（最好先商定书面看房日程）或合规送达至少 24 小时书面通知，持牌人可以在早 8 点至晚 9 点之间带看。

opts.t: Showings of a tenanted unit require an Order of Possession generated through the RTB online web portal before any buyer visits.
opts.w: 张冠李戴了看房进入通知与终止租赁占有令。带看房屋不终止租赁，不需要占有令。

opts.t: Mail is deemed received only on the 5th day, so the 24-hour clock has not begun by Thursday; agree a showing schedule with the tenant first.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RTA s.90，邮寄送达在寄出后第 5 天才视为收到（贴门上、传真或投信箱为第 3 天），而 24 小时通知期从「视为收到日」起算，周二邮寄到周四根本未满期；且挂牌持牌人第一步应先联系租客谈成双方接受的书面看房日程，谈不成才退守 24 小时书面通知。

variants.pt: 商业与住宅的转租转让及减损义务
variants.trap: 商业重租构成交回租赁陷阱
variants.stem: A residential tenant holds a one-year fixed-term tenancy agreement with eight months remaining. The tenant gets a job in another province and asks the landlord for written consent to assign the tenancy to a qualified replacement tenant. Under section 34 of the Residential Tenancy Act, what are the landlord's rights and obligations?
variants.zh: 一名住宅租客持有一份尚余八个月的一年期固定期租赁协议。租客在外省找到工作，请求房东书面同意将租赁转让给一名合格的接替租客。根据《住宅租赁法》第 34 条，房东有哪些权利和义务？

opts.t: The landlord may refuse consent arbitrarily for any reason, or charge the tenant an administrative fee for granting consent.
opts.w: 双重违反 RTA s.34。固定期尚余 6 个月以上的，房东不得无理拒绝同意；且房东在任何时候都不得为同意转让或转租收费（收费构成 s.95(1)(i) 的罪行）。

opts.t: Because the fixed-term tenancy has six months or more remaining, the landlord must not unreasonably withhold written consent and must not charge a fee for consenting.
opts.w: 正确。根据 RTA s.34，住宅租客未经房东书面同意不得转让（assign）或转租（sublet）；但如果固定期租赁尚余 6 个月或以上，房东不得无理拒绝同意（must not unreasonably withhold consent），且任何时候都不得为同意收取费用。

opts.t: The tenant does not need the landlord's consent unless the residential tenancy agreement contains an express clause prohibiting assignment.
opts.w: 掉入「商业与住宅规则串台」陷阱。未明文禁止即无须房东同意是商业租赁的普通法规则；住宅租赁由 RTA s.34 明文规定一律须经房东书面同意。

opts.t: If the tenant abandons the apartment instead of assigning it, the residential landlord has no duty to mitigate losses by trying to re-rent the unit.
opts.w: 再次把商业普通法规则套到了住宅上。住宅租赁下 RTA s.7(2) 明文课以双方减损损失义务（duty to mitigate），租客提前弃租的，房东仍须尝试以合理经济租金重新出租。

variants.pt: 共用财产专用与车位四种形态
variants.trap: 车位四种法律形态混同
variants.stem: A seller tells his listing licensee that his apartment comes with two parking stalls that 'belong to the unit forever.' Upon checking the strata plan and Land Title Office filings, the licensee discovers that Stall 12 is designated as limited common property (LCP) for the seller's strata lot, while Stall 45 is common property used under a permission from the strata council. Which statement accurately describes how these stalls can be dealt with in a sale?
variants.zh: 一位卖家告诉他的挂牌持牌人，他的公寓带有两个“永久属于该单元”的车位。经核查共管物业图则与土地产权登记处备案文件，持牌人发现 12 号车位被指定为卖方单元的限定共用财产（LCP），而 45 号车位是凭议会许可使用的共用财产。下列哪项陈述准确描述了这两个车位在买卖中的处理方式？

opts.t: Both stalls can be sold separately to another owner in the building by transferring a fee simple title for each stall, since both are recorded against the lot
opts.w: 限定共用财产（LCP）和短期专用（short-term exclusive use）都不是独立的共管物业单元（strata lot），不能单独转让完全保有地产产权。

opts.t: Stall 12 passes with the strata lot to the buyer as LCP, while Stall 45 is a revocable permission of up to 1 year that the strata corporation may cancel on reasonable notice
opts.w: 限定共用财产（limited common property, LCP）随单元走（runs with the land）但不能单独拆卖；而议会许可的短期专用（short-term exclusive use）最长 1 年（EV 车位 5 年），法团可合理通知后收回，若在挂盘文案中直接写成含两个永久车位将构成失实陈述。

opts.t: Neither stall can be used by the buyer until the strata corporation passes a fresh unanimous vote at the next annual general meeting confirming the transfer
opts.w: 已备案的限定共用财产（LCP）自动随单元转让给买方使用，无需在年度大会上重新进行全体一致投票（unanimous vote）。

opts.t: Stall 12 expires one year after completion and must be re-granted by council, while Stall 45 is permanently attached to the strata lot and passes on transfer
opts.w: 这把限定共用财产（LCP，永久随单元走）与短期专用许可（最长 1 年、可撤销）的法律后果完全颠倒了。

variants.pt: 清盘80%票与¾票的分母差异
variants.trap: 80% 票与 ¾ 票的分母混淆
variants.stem: A 50-unit residential strata corporation is considering selling the entire property to a developer. Before calling a formal winding-up vote, the owners want to pass a resolution authorizing the strata council to hire a brokerage to market the building and test buyer interest. What voting threshold is required for hiring the brokerage versus passing the later winding-up resolution?
variants.zh: 一个有 50 个单元的住宅共管物业法团正在考虑将整栋物业打包卖给开发商。在召开正式清盘投票之前，业主们希望先通过一项决议，授权议会聘请一家经纪行去市场推广试水。聘请经纪行与随后通过正式清盘决议分别需要什么表决门槛？

opts.t: Both steps require an 80% vote of all 50 eligible voters, because hiring the brokerage is legally the first step of a winding-up
opts.w: BC 最高法院判例明确拒绝把清盘的 80% 票门槛套用到前期的“聘请经纪行（hiring a brokerage）”阶段。

opts.t: Hiring the brokerage requires a 3/4 vote of voters present, and winding up requires a unanimous vote of all 50 owners
opts.w: 聘请经纪行只需过半数（majority vote），且清盘自 2016 年起需要全体有投票权者的 80% 票加法院批准，不再要求全体一致。

opts.t: Hiring the brokerage needs only a majority vote; the winding-up needs 80% of all eligible voters plus BC Supreme Court approval
opts.w: 决定是否聘请经纪行去市场试水只需过半数（majority vote）；而正式清盘（winding up，SPA s.272）需要全体有资格投票者的 80% 票（50 户中的 40 票）通过，并取得 BC 最高法院批准。

opts.t: Hiring the brokerage requires a majority vote, and winding up requires a 3/4 vote of those present at the meeting without court involvement
opts.w: 清盘不是按出席者计算的 ¾ 票，而是按全体有投票权者计算的 80% 票，且必须取得 BC 最高法院批准以保护少数不同意业主与押记权人。

variants.pt: CRF年度强制缴款的考纲与现行规则
variants.trap: 考试口径与 2023–2024 新规错位
variants.stem: A strata corporation's annual operating fund budget is $100,000, and its contingency reserve fund (CRF) currently has a balance of $18,000. Under the traditional exam course manual rule (the 25% threshold rule), what is the minimum mandatory contribution to the CRF for the upcoming fiscal year?
variants.zh: 某共管物业法团的年度营运基金预算为 $100,000，其应急储备金（CRF）当前余额为 $18,000。根据传统考试考试口径（25% 门槛规则），下一财年向 CRF 缴款的最低强制金额是多少？

opts.t: $7,000, the lesser of 10% of the operating fund ($10,000) and the amount needed to bring the CRF up to 25% ($7,000)
opts.w: 按考试口径旧规，当应急储备金（CRF）低于营运基金的 25%（$25,000）时才强制缴款，且金额取「营运基金的 10%（$10,000）」与「补足到 25% 所需金额（$25,000 - $18,000 = $7,000）」中的较小者，即 $7,000。（注：2023-11-01 起的现行 BC 法规要求每年至少缴营运基金预算的 10% 即 $10,000，已取消 25% 封顶门槛。）

opts.t: $25,000, because the strata corporation must contribute a flat 25% of the operating budget whenever the fund is low
opts.w: 考试口径的 25% 是 CRF 余额的目标门槛（$25,000），不是要求当年一次性缴入营运基金的 25%。

opts.t: $0, because the CRF balance of $18,000 already exceeds the 10% minimum reserve threshold set for the fund
opts.w: 旧规的免缴门槛是营运基金的 25%（$25,000）而非 10%，余额 $18,000 尚未达标，因此必须强制缴款。

opts.t: $50,000, because the 50% ceiling on the developer's seed contribution also applies to annual budgets
opts.w: 50% 是现行法下开发商在首个单元转让时向 CRF 注资的最高上限比例，不适用于业主每年的预算缴款。

variants.pt: 折旧报告周期与豁免的新旧对比
variants.trap: 考试口径与 2023–2024 新规错位
variants.stem: In 2026, a strata corporation with 25 strata lots calls a general meeting to repair the roof exactly as recommended in its most recent depreciation report, using $90,000 from the contingency reserve fund (CRF). What voting threshold is required to approve this CRF expenditure?
variants.zh: 2026 年，一个拥有 25 个单元的共管物业法团召开业主大会，拟完全按照其最新折旧报告的推荐修缮屋顶，并从应急储备金（CRF）中支取 $90,000。批准这笔 CRF 支出需要什么表决门槛？

opts.t: An 80% vote of all eligible voters in the strata corporation
opts.w: 全体有资格投票者的 80% 票适用于法团清盘（winding up），不适用于动用应急储备金做修缮。

opts.t: A majority vote of the voters present in person or by proxy at the general meeting
opts.w: 根据 SPA s.96，动用应急储备金（contingency reserve fund, CRF）支付取得折旧报告的费用或支付折旧报告（depreciation report）推荐的修缮项目（以及 EV 充电设施相关支出），只需业主大会过半数票（majority vote）批准，无需 ¾ 票。

opts.t: A unanimous vote of all 25 strata lot owners because the expenditure exceeds $2,000
opts.w: $2,000 是议会未经业主大会批准自主支出的上限；提交业主大会表决的折旧报告推荐修缮只需过半数票，绝不需要全体一致。

opts.t: A 3/4 vote, because every expenditure from the CRF without exception requires a 3/4 vote
opts.w: 非折旧报告推荐的常规 CRF 支出确实需要 ¾ 票，但折旧报告推荐的修缮及 EV 充电相关支出属于法定降门槛事项，只需过半数。

variants.pt: 跨交割日特别摊派与保险免赔额
