variants.trap: 80% 票与 ¾ 票的分母混淆
variants.stem: Water overflows from a strata lot's plumbing and causes $120,000 in damage to common property hallways. The strata corporation's property insurance policy has a $25,000 deductible. Under Section 158 of the Strata Property Act, how can the strata corporation pay this $25,000 deductible and when can it recover the amount from the owner of the strata lot where the leak originated?
variants.zh: 某共管物业单元的水管溢水，对共用财产走廊造成了 $120,000 的损失。法团财产保险单的免赔额为 $25,000。根据《共管物业法》第 158 条，法团如何支付这 $25,000 的免赔额？在什么情况下可以向漏水起源单元的业主追偿该笔免赔额？

opts.t: The council must first obtain a 3/4 vote at a Special General Meeting to pay the deductible, and it can only sue the owner if it proves the owner was legally negligent
opts.w: 为支付保险免赔额（insurance deductible）而动用 CRF 或发起特别摊派不需要通常的业主大会 ¾ 票批准（SPA s.158(3)）；且追偿只需业主对损失“负有责任（responsible）”，不必证明其存在过失（negligent）。

opts.t: The insurer pays the deductible out of the $2,000,000 liability coverage, so the strata corporation cannot bill any individual owner for it
opts.w: $2,000,000 是法团第三者责任险的最低保额，不能用来抵扣法团自身财产险的免赔额，且 SPA s.158(2) 明确允许向负有责任的业主追偿。

opts.t: It may pay from the CRF or by special levy without the usual owner approval, and may sue a responsible owner to recover it without proving negligence
opts.w: 根据 SPA s.158，免赔额（deductible）原则上是共用开支，法团为支付免赔额而动用 CRF 或发起特别摊派无需业主大会批准（以便迅速拿理赔款开工）；若某位业主对引发理赔的损失负有责任（responsible），法团可起诉该业主追偿免赔额，且不以认定该业主存在过失（negligent）为前提。

opts.t: It must wait 60 days and pass an 80% vote of all eligible voters before it may pay the deductible or begin repairing the hallway
opts.w: 60 天内以 ¾ 票表决是决定“不修复受损财产（not to repair or replace）”的程序（SPA s.159），正常支付免赔额与修复必须不迟延地进行。

variants.pt: Form B与Form F及欠缴罚款后果
variants.trap: 罚款登记留置权（Certificate of Lien）陷阱
variants.stem: A buyer's licensee orders a Form B (Information Certificate) during the subject-removal period. Which statement accurately describes the statutory rules governing Form B under the Strata Property Act?
variants.zh: 买方持牌人在条件解除期内申请了一份 Form B（信息证明书）。下列哪项陈述准确描述了《共管物业法》关于 Form B 的法定规则？

opts.t: It costs a maximum of $15, remains valid for 60 days, and is required by the Land Title Office registrar to transfer title
opts.w: 收费上限 $15、有效期 60 天、过户登记必备文件是付清证明书（Form F, Certificate of Payment），而非信息证明书（Form B）。

opts.t: Its summary of the strata corporation's insurance coverage is unconditionally binding on the strata corporation even if provided by an insurance broker
opts.w: 虽然 Form B 上的信息原则上对法团有约束力（SPA s.59(5)），但 SPA s.59(5.1) 明文规定法团保险摘要（summary of insurance coverage）若来自保险人或保险代理人，则不对法团产生约束力。

opts.t: It only discloses special levies that have already been passed, and never mentions proposed resolutions that have merely been noticed for an upcoming meeting
opts.w: Form B 不仅披露已批准的特别摊派，还必须披露「已发出通知但尚未表决的 ¾ 票、80% 票、全体一致决议或章程修订议案」，这是尽职调查中最关键的预警格。

opts.t: It must be issued within 1 week for up to $35 plus 25 cents a page, and must disclose noticed but unvoted resolutions such as 3/4 vote levies
opts.w: 信息证明书（Form B, Information Certificate）须在 1 周内出具（考试口径旧值为 8 天），收费上限 $35 加每页复印费不超过 25 分；必须披露月物业费、欠款、已发通知尚未表决的高门槛议案及保险摘要，并附上规则、当期预算、最近一份折旧报告及已取得的电力规划报告。

variants.pt: 房屋合作社与Strata的法律差异
variants.trap: 合作社（Co-op）套用 Strata 或 RTA 规则
variants.stem: A seller lists a residential unit in a 12-unit housing cooperative. Before accepting an offer, what key risks and legal rules about housing cooperatives should the licensee explain to the parties?
variants.zh: 一位卖家挂牌出售一个 12 户住宅合作社中的单元。在接受要约前，持牌人应当向交易双方解释关于住宅合作社的哪些关键风险与法律规则？

opts.t: The buyer must obtain a Form F Certificate of Payment from the strata council before the Land Title Office will transfer the fee simple lot
opts.w: Form F 和单元完全保有地产过户属于《共管物业法》（SPA）下的 strata 制度，合作社转让的是协会股份与长期租约。

opts.t: The cooperative board of directors cannot refuse a transfer once a licensed brokerage has completed a satisfactory credit check on the buyer
opts.w: 合作社董事会（board of directors）对买家人选拥有实质批准权，即使买方财务信用良好仍可能被拒，因此合同与周期存在较大不确定性。

opts.t: Any dispute between a non-profit cooperative and its member over occupancy charges is decided by the Residential Tenancy Branch under the RTA
opts.w: 《住宅租赁法》（RTA s.4(a)）明文排除非营利房屋合作社租给其会员的居住单位。

opts.t: The board usually has wide discretion to reject a buyer, and if a few members default on the blanket mortgage, the others must cover it to avoid foreclosure
opts.w: 合作社（cooperative）转让通常须经董事会批准买家且裁量空间很大；同时合作社内部融资以整块地产做抵押，小型合作社若有几户断供，其余会员必须补足差额，否则整个协会面临止赎风险。

variants.trap: 股份交易一刀切免牌照
variants.stem: Marcus is negotiating to buy a neighbourhood restaurant. Under which of the following transaction structures is a real estate licence NOT required for the representative handling the sale?
variants.zh: Marcus 正在洽谈收购一家社区餐馆。在以下哪种交易结构下，经办该笔交易的代表不需要持有地产牌照？

opts.t: Marcus buys the kitchen equipment, furniture, and goodwill together with an assignment of the restaurant's retail lease.
opts.w: 按资产打包出售（asset sale）且包含转让租约（assignment of lease）等地产成分时，必须持有地产牌照。

opts.t: Marcus buys the restaurant's physical land, building, and dining room fixtures as a combined asset package.
opts.w: 包含出售物业产权的资产打包出售涉及地产成分，必须持有地产牌照。

opts.t: Marcus buys a partial block of shares in the incorporated restaurant company that owns the restaurant building.
opts.w: 当持有地产的公司仅出售部分股份（而非 100% 全部股份）时，该交易属于证券交易（可能需按《证券法》Securities Act 注册），不算地产交易，不需要地产牌照。

opts.t: Marcus buys 100% of the issued shares of the corporation that owns the land and building where the restaurant operates.
opts.w: 买下持有地产公司的全部（100%）股份属于需要地产牌照的情形（股份交易一刀切免牌照陷阱）。

variants.pt: 企业组织形式的责任与纳税
variants.trap: 公司或有限合伙挡住一切个人责任
variants.stem: Two accountants form a general partnership to invest in rental properties. Without consulting his partner, Partner A signs a supply contract on behalf of the partnership that results in a large unpaid debt. How is Partner B affected?
variants.zh: 两名会计师成立了一家一般合伙企业（general partnership）来投资出租物业。在未征求合伙人意见的情况下，合伙人 A 代表合伙企业签下一份采购合同并导致大额欠款。合伙人 B 会受到什么影响？

opts.t: Partner B has no personal liability because he neither knew about nor consented to the supply contract.
opts.w: 在一般合伙（general partnership）中，各合伙人互为代理人，不论本人是否知情或同意，都对全部合伙债务负连带无限责任。

opts.t: Partner B is only liable up to the amount of capital he originally contributed to the partnership.
opts.w: 以出资额为限是有限合伙人（未参与日常经营时）或公司股东的待遇，一般合伙人承担的是无限责任（公司或有限合伙挡住一切个人责任陷阱）。

opts.t: Partner B is protected because the partnership itself pays corporate tax and absorbs all commercial debts as a separate legal entity.
opts.w: 一般合伙不是独立纳税的公司实体，而是税务导管，且合伙人个人资产可被追偿。

opts.t: Partner B is jointly and severally liable to an unlimited extent for the entire partnership debt, even though he did not know of or consent to it.
opts.w: 一般合伙（general partnership）的各合伙人互为代理人，对全部合伙债务负连带无限责任（joint and several unlimited liability），不论本人是否知情或同意。

variants.pt: 权责发生制与配比原则
variants.trap: 把收现日当成收入或费用确认日
variants.stem: On January 1, a commercial landlord pays an annual property insurance premium covering the entire calendar year. When preparing monthly financial statements, the accountant allocates one-twelfth of the premium to each month rather than expensing the full payment in January. Which accounting principle requires this treatment?
variants.zh: 1 月 1 日，一名商业房东一次性支付了覆盖整个日历年度的物业保险费。在编制月度财务报表时，会计师将保费的十二分之一分摊到每个月，而不是在 1 月份将整笔付款全部列为费用。哪一条会计原则要求采用这种处理方式？

opts.t: The matching principle, which spreads expenses not tied to one revenue item over the periods that benefit.
opts.w: 配比原则（matching principle）要求与某笔收入不直接相关的跨期费用（如覆盖全年的保险费）按受益期间按月摊销，而不是一交保费就整笔计入当月。

opts.t: The materiality principle, which requires all prepaid items regardless of value to be written off immediately.
opts.w: 重要性原则（materiality principle）是允许把文具、清洁用品等低价值支出在当期一次性费用化，恰恰与按月分摊全年保费相反。

opts.t: The cost principle, which requires insurance policies to be revalued to market replacement cost each quarter.
opts.w: 成本原则（cost principle）规定资产按取得时实付的历史成本入账，不涉及按季度重估保单市价。

opts.t: The cash basis principle, which records expenses only when the cheque is written in January.
opts.w: 把保费在 1 月一次性计入费用正是错误的收付实现制思维，违反了权责发生制与配比原则（把收现日当成收入或费用确认日陷阱）。

variants.pt: 成本原则与双轨会计准则
variants.trap: 把账面净值当市场价或把信托款当经纪行资产
variants.stem: Since 2011, Canadian Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) have been divided into two tracks: IFRS and ASPE. Which statement correctly describes how a typical private real estate brokerage in BC fits into this framework?
variants.zh: 自 2011 年起，加拿大公认会计准则（GAAP）分为 IFRS 与 ASPE 两轨。以下哪项正确描述了 BC 省一家典型私营地产经纪行在这一框架下的适用情况？

opts.t: It is legally prohibited from using either IFRS or ASPE and must report exclusively using Capital Cost Allowance (CCA) tax rules.
opts.w: 资本成本折让（CCA）仅用于向国税局（CRA）报税，不能替代财务报表所遵循的 GAAP（IFRS 或 ASPE）准则。

opts.t: It is forced to use IFRS even if it has no publicly traded shares or bonds, because ASPE was abolished.
opts.w: 国际财务报告准则（IFRS）仅强制适用于股票或债券在交易所交易的公开问责实体，且 AcSB 至今仍维持 IFRS 与 ASPE 双轨体系，并未废止 ASPE。

opts.t: It must revalue its office equipment to fair market value every year under ASPE, disregarding historical cost.
opts.w: ASPE 遵循成本原则（历史成本减累计折旧），不允许像 IFRS 那样对物业设备定期按公允价值重估（把账面净值当市场价陷阱）。

opts.t: As a private enterprise, it may choose between IFRS and ASPE, and most private brokerages choose ASPE for cost-effectiveness.
opts.w: 除公开问责实体强制适用 IFRS 外，其余私营企业可自由选用 IFRS 或私营企业会计准则（ASPE），绝大多数经纪行作为私营企业因成本效益而选用 ASPE。

variants.pt: 三张表勾稽与折旧对比CCA
variants.trap: 把折旧当成真金白银的流出或报税扣除额
variants.stem: When a sole proprietor prepares a year-end balance sheet after earning $6,500 in net profit and recording $11,500 in building depreciation on the income statement, how do these two figures connect to the year-end balance sheet and statement of cash flows?
variants.zh: 当一名独资业主在损益表上算出 $6,500 净利润并记录了 $11,500 建筑折旧后编制年末资产负债表与现金流量表时，这两个数字如何与另外两张表衔接？

opts.t: Net profit is added to owner's equity; depreciation lowers the building's carrying amount and is added back on the cash flow statement.
opts.w: 三张表的咬合关系是：损益表算出的净利润 $6,500 直接加进资产负债表的业主权益（owner's equity）；累计折旧 $11,500 在资产负债表上抵减建筑原值（$460,000 减 $11,500 = $448,500），同时因折旧无现金流出，在间接法现金流量表中加回。

opts.t: Both the $6,500 net profit and the $11,500 depreciation are deducted from the land's carrying value on the balance sheet.
opts.w: 土地按历史成本 $220,000 入账且不可折旧，净利润则进入业主权益，两者都不会抵减土地账面价值。

opts.t: The $11,500 depreciation is placed in a separate bank account on the balance sheet and deducted as a cash outflow on the statement of cash flows.
opts.w: 折旧只是分摊历史成本的会计分录，既不是省下来存进银行的现金，也不是现金流出（把折旧当成真金白银的流出陷阱）。

opts.t: The $6,500 net profit is recorded as a current liability, and the $11,500 depreciation replaces the need to calculate Capital Cost Allowance (CCA) for the CRA.
opts.w: 净利润增加的是业主权益而非流动负债；且会计折旧与报税用的资本成本折让（CCA）是两回事，报税只能用 CCA。

variants.pt: 经纪行信托款与财务比率监管
variants.trap: 把账面净值当市场价或把信托款当经纪行资产
variants.stem: Under Rules s.76(1)(c), which of the following conditions disclosed in a brokerage's annual financial filing will trigger regulatory intervention by the superintendent?
variants.zh: 根据《地产服务规则》s.76(1)(c)，经纪行年度财务申报中披露的以下哪种情形会触发监管长官（superintendent）的监管介入？

opts.t: The brokerage excludes unearned client trust deposits from its corporate balance sheet assets.
opts.w: 将未赚得的客户信托存款排除在经纪行自身资产负债表之外，正是遵循会计主体假设与 Rules s.79(2) 的正确做法（把信托款当经纪行资产陷阱）。

opts.t: The brokerage's year-end current liabilities exceed its current assets, or its year-end total liabilities exceed its total assets.
opts.w: 根据现行 Rules s.76(1)(c)，年末流动负债超过流动资产（流动比率小于 1），或年末总负债超过总资产（总负债 ÷ 总资产超过 100%），属于触发监管长官介入的法定情形（此外还有申报无力偿债或信托台账出现负余额）。

opts.t: The brokerage files its financial statements, accountant's report, and brokerage activity report within 120 days after its fiscal year-end.
opts.w: 在会计年度结束后 120 天内报送这三份文件是遵守 Rules s.75(1) 的正常合规行为，不会触发异常介入。

opts.t: The brokerage maintains a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.55 and a current ratio of 2.88 at year-end.
opts.w: 流动比率 2.88（远大于 1）与负债权益比 0.55 代表短期偿债能力充裕、杠杆温和，完全符合监管要求。

variants.pt: 购买生意的财务尽调文件指引
variants.trap: 把账面净值当市场价或把信托款当经纪行资产
variants.stem: When a licensee assists a buyer in acquiring an operating business that includes real estate, which income statement satisfies the minimum due diligence timeline recommended in the course guidance?
variants.zh: 当持牌人协助买方收购一家包含地产的在营生意时，哪一份损益表符合课程指引建议的最低尽调时间要求？

opts.t: A projected income statement for the next 40 years prepared by the listing representative.
opts.w: 40 年是王芳案例中建筑折旧的经济寿命年限，指引要求的是最近 12 个月的历史损益表而非代表自编的远期预测。

opts.t: Any historical income statement from the last 3 consecutive fiscal years, regardless of how many months have passed since its cutoff date.
opts.w: 连续 3 个会计年度是经纪行申请核编报告（compilation engagement report）的合规年限，买生意损益表的截止日距签约不得超过 120 天。

opts.t: An income statement covering the business's most recent 12 months, with a statement cutoff date no more than 120 days before the contract date.
opts.w: 根据课程引用的指引，买方应获取该生意最近 12 个月、且报表截止日距签约不超过 120 天的损益表（连同资产负债表及不包含在交易内的资产清单）。

opts.t: A handwritten summary of the last 53 weeks of cash withdrawals from the owner's personal bank account.
opts.w: 53 周是公司会计年度的最长跨度，手写个人取款流水不满足正式损益表与资产负债表的最低文件标准。

variants.pt: 吊销牌照权限与考试现行机构错位
variants.stem: A REALTOR® is found guilty of breaching both the REALTOR® Code and the Real Estate Services Rules. Under the course manual's framework, how do the enforcement powers of a local real estate board differ from those of the statutory regulator?
variants.zh: 一名 REALTOR® 被认定同时违反了《地产经纪守则》与《地产服务规则》。在课程考试资料的框架下，本地地产局的执法权限与法定监管机构的权限有何不同？

opts.t: The local real estate board can cancel a real estate licence for up to one year, whereas the statutory regulator can cancel it permanently.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。本地地产局在任何情况下都不能暂停或吊销牌照（cannot suspend or cancel a licence），哪怕一天也不行。

opts.t: Both bodies can suspend a real estate licence, but only the local real estate board can revoke MLS® access.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。地产局只能管会籍与 MLS® 使用权，不能暂停牌照。

opts.t: The local real estate board can suspend or expel a member from the board, whereas only the statutory regulator can suspend or cancel a real estate licence.
opts.w: 正确。地产局只能停权或开除会籍（suspend or expel from membership），只有法定监管机构能暂停或吊销牌照（suspend or cancel a licence）。注意：考试口径将法定吊牌机构表述为 Real Estate Council 或 Superintendent，而 2026 现行法下该权限专属于 BCFSA 的 superintendent（且纪律罚款上限已达经纪行 $500,000、个人 $250,000）。

opts.t: The statutory regulator enforces the REALTOR® Code for non-members, while the local board enforces RESA for members.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。管辖对象与文件完全颠倒：法定监管机构依 RESA 和 Rules 管所有持牌人，地产局依 REALTOR® Code 只管会员。

variants.pt: 客户十项义务与冲突独立书面披露
variants.trap: 关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉
variants.stem: Clara represents a seller client under a listing agreement. Halfway through the listing period, a conflict of interest arises between Clara and her seller client. Clara types a disclosure paragraph into an addendum to the Contract of Purchase and Sale. Why does Clara's action fail to comply with s. 30(j) of the Real Estate Services Rules?
variants.zh: Clara 根据挂牌协议代表一位卖方客户。在挂牌期中途，Clara 与卖方客户之间产生了利益冲突。Clara 在《房屋买卖合同》的附录中打入了一段披露文字。为什么 Clara 的做法不符合《地产服务规则》第 30(j) 条的规定？

opts.t: Because conflict of interest disclosures must be delivered orally in the presence of a notary public.
opts.w: 编造程序陷阱。法规要求的是独立书面披露，并无在公证人面前口头宣读的规定。

opts.t: Because s. 30(j) requires the written conflict disclosure to be a separate document, not buried inside a service agreement or transaction contract.
opts.w: 正确。Rules s. 30(j) 强制要求利益冲突书面披露必须与服务协议及任何交易协议分开（separate from the service agreement and any agreement for the trade in real estate），夹在买卖合同附录里会导致客户签字时容易忽略，违反了独立成文的法定要求。

opts.t: Because conflicts arising after a listing agreement is signed only need to be reported to the local real estate board after completion.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」及迟延披露陷阱。向客户立即作独立书面披露是 s. 30(j) 的法定义务，不能等到成交后报告地产局。

opts.t: Because s. 31 automatically waives conflict disclosure duties whenever a listing addendum is used.
opts.w: 曲解 s. 31 陷阱。使用合同附录绝不会自动豁免 s. 30(j) 的冲突披露义务。

variants.pt: 交易中的利益披露与关系人规则
variants.trap: 关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉
variants.stem: Fiona holds only a trading services licence. She decides to sell a vacation cottage that she owns personally without listing it through her brokerage. She claims she does not need to make a s. 53 disclosure of interest in trade because s. 97 allows licensees to trade on their own behalf. Is Fiona's claim valid?
variants.zh: Fiona 仅持有交易服务（买卖代理）牌照。她决定不通过自己的经纪行挂牌，私下出售自己名下的一套度假小屋。她声称自己不需要作第 53 条的交易利益披露，因为第 97 条允许持牌人以个人身份自买自卖。Fiona 的说法成立吗？

opts.t: No, because s. 97 covers only licensees who hold rental property management or strata management licences, not trading services.
opts.w: 正确。Rules s. 97 允许持牌人在不作为持牌人的情况下自买自卖，但该条只适用于仅持有出租物业管理或共管物业管理牌照（rental property management or strata management only）的人；持有交易服务（trading services）牌照的 Fiona 必须严格遵守 s. 53 用核准表格在签约前披露，且现行 REALTOR® Code 第 29 条亦规定以本人身份（principal）交易时仍受守则全部约束。

opts.t: Yes, as long as the vacation cottage is located outside her local real estate board's jurisdiction.
opts.w: 落入「关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉」陷阱。法定线 RESA 与 Rules s. 53 在全 BC 省适用，不因物业在某个地产局辖区外而豁免。

opts.t: Yes, provided she does not collect a commission from the buyer.
opts.w: 落入「关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉」陷阱。不收佣金并不能免除持牌人出售自有物业时的 s. 53 核准表格披露义务。

opts.t: No, because s. 97 only exempts short-term residential tenancies of three years or less with an option to purchase.
opts.w: 数字与概念拼接陷阱。自住短租豁免要求租期不超过 1 年（≤1 year）且无购买选择权、无优先购买权，且那是 s. 53 的小豁免而非 s. 97。

variants.pt: 多买方竞争同一物业的双重代理冲突
variants.trap: 指定代理误判为双重代理
variants.stem: When two buyer clients represented by the same licensee want to bid on the same property, s. 65 of the Real Estate Services Rules allows the licensee to continue representing one of them ONLY if both clients sign an agreement in the approved form. Which of the following statements MUST be included in that s. 65 approved form?
variants.zh: 当同一名持牌人代表的两位买方客户想要竞标同一处物业时，《地产服务规则》第 65 条允许该持牌人仅在双方客户均签署核准表格协议的前提下继续代表其中一方。下列哪一项内容必须包含在该第 65 条核准表格中？

opts.t: A statement that the licensee is now permitted to share the terminated client's confidential financial limits with the remaining client.
opts.w: 违反保密铁底陷阱。无论依 s. 31/32 还是 s. 65，持牌人永远不得泄露前客户的机密信息（confidential information）。

opts.t: That the licensee holds the other client's confidential information, cannot disclose it, and so may give the remaining client limited advice.
opts.w: 正确。根据 Rules s. 65，留下一方的核准表格里必须写明：冲突是什么、被终止代理的一方将失去哪些义务、持牌人仍持有他的机密信息且被禁止泄露（prohibited from disclosing confidential information）、因此能给留下一方的建议也会受限（advice may be limited），并建议双方各自寻求独立专业意见。

opts.t: A guarantee that the terminated client will receive half of the buyer agency commission if the remaining client wins the bid.
opts.w: 无中生有陷阱。s. 65 核准表格中没有任何关于分一半佣金给被终止买家的规定。

opts.t: An undertaking by the managing broker to act as dual agent for both buyers until completion.
opts.w: 落入「指定代理误判为双重代理」陷阱。管理经纪同样受 s. 63(1) 约束，不得同时代表两个竞争买家充当双重代理。

variants.pt: 重大隐蔽缺陷与拒绝继续提供服务
variants.stem: Which of the following conditions is explicitly defined as a 'material latent defect' under s. 59(1) of the Real Estate Services Rules, requiring disclosure to all other parties before any agreement is entered into?
variants.zh: 根据《地产服务规则》第 59(1) 条，下列哪一种情况被明确定义为「重大隐蔽缺陷」（material latent defect），必须在任何协议订立前向交易的所有其他方披露？

opts.t: A worn-out living room carpet and scratched kitchen cabinet doors that are clearly visible during a standard walk-through.
opts.w: 混淆显性缺陷与隐蔽缺陷陷阱。肉眼查验即可轻易看出的地毯磨损和橱柜划痕属于显性缺陷（patent defect），不属于合理查验发现不了的重大隐蔽缺陷（material latent defect）。

opts.t: A neighbourhood rumour that a nearby grocery store might close next year.
opts.w: 非物业本身缺陷陷阱。周边商铺传闻不属于物业本身的隐蔽结构或法律许可缺陷。

opts.t: A lack of required municipal building or other permits for the property that a reasonable inspection would not reveal.
opts.w: 正确。Rules s. 59(1) 将重大隐蔽缺陷（material latent defect）定义为合理查验发现不了的重大缺陷，明确包含：使物业危险或潜在危险、不宜居住、不适合对方已告知的用途、修复代价巨大、地方政府已发出须整改的通知，以及缺少应有的建筑等许可（lack of appropriate building or other permits）。

opts.t: An outdated paint colour in the bedrooms that would cost $800 to repaint.
opts.w: 混淆显性外观与重大隐蔽缺陷陷阱。肉眼可见的油漆颜色既非隐蔽缺陷，也不构成巨额修复代价。

variants.pt: 向管理经纪报告不当行为与直接报监管方
variants.stem: According to BCFSA's reporting guidelines and s. 29(5) of the Real Estate Services Rules, what potential consequence does an associate broker or representative face if they knowingly fail to report suspected professional misconduct to their managing broker?
variants.zh: 根据 BCFSA 的举报义务指引及《地产服务规则》第 29(5) 条，如果副经纪或代表明知存在涉嫌专业不当行为的情况却不向管理经纪报告，可能面临什么后果？

opts.t: No consequence, because the duty to monitor compliance rests exclusively on the managing broker under s. 28.
opts.w: 推卸责任陷阱。虽然 s. 28 规定了管理经纪的监督责任，但 s. 29(5) 明确赋予代表与副经纪立即报告的独立法定义务。

opts.t: A mandatory criminal felony conviction prosecuted by the Financial Services Tribunal.
opts.w: 定性夸大陷阱。讲义明确指出，专业不当行为不能直接称为刑事「重罪（felony）」，且金融服务仲裁庭（Financial Services Tribunal）是处理上诉的机构而非刑事公诉机关。

opts.t: An automatic Category A administrative penalty of $1,000 issued by the local real estate board.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。行政罚款（administrative penalty）由 BCFSA 依 RESA 开出而非本地地产局，且 A 档是记录类违规。

opts.t: Knowingly failing to report may itself be found to be conduct unbecoming and lead to discipline.
opts.w: 正确。BCFSA 的举报义务指引明确指出，持牌人明知不当行为而不报，其不作为本身可能被认定为有失体面的行为（conduct unbecoming a licensee）并受到纪律处分。

variants.pt: 纪律处分罚款上限、开单清单与上诉路径
variants.stem: Why can BCFSA NOT issue a direct fixed-tariff administrative penalty ticket solely for a breach of s. 33 (duty to act honestly), s. 59 (disclosure of material latent defects), or s. 63 (prohibition against dual agency) of the Real Estate Services Rules?
variants.zh: 为什么 BCFSA 不能仅以违反《地产服务规则》第 33 条（诚实行事义务）、第 59 条（重大隐蔽缺陷披露）或第 63 条（禁止双重代理）本身为由，直接开出定额行政罚单（administrative penalty）？

opts.t: Those sections are not designated in the s. 26 penalty list, so breaches of them alone go through discipline, such as a consent order or hearing.
opts.w: 正确。判断能否开行政罚单（administrative penalty）必须先查条款是否在 Rules s. 26 的 A–F 六档指定清单内：s. 33（诚实）、s. 59（重大隐蔽缺陷）与 s. 63（禁止双重代理）均不在 s. 26 清单内，因此不能仅凭违反这三条本身开行政罚单，而需按证据、情节与公众风险通过纪律程序（如 RESA s. 41 同意命令或 s. 42 正式听证等）处理。

opts.t: Because breaches of honesty, latent defects, and dual agency are governed exclusively by the REALTOR® Code and enforced only by local real estate boards.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。s. 33、s. 59 与 s. 63 全都是法定线 Rules 的核心条文，由 BCFSA 执法。

opts.t: Because the maximum administrative penalty in BC is $1,000, which is too small for serious contraventions.
opts.w: 数字错误陷阱。BC 行政罚款的法定上限是 $100,000（RESA s. 56(2)），并非 $1,000。

opts.t: Because every breach of s. 33, s. 59, or s. 63 automatically triggers a mandatory $500,000 fine without a hearing or consent order.
opts.w: 程序与金额绝对化陷阱。未列入行政罚单清单不代表每案必罚上限或无需程序；持牌人可依 RESA s. 41 提出书面同意命令（consent order）方案或依 s. 42 举行听证，且 $250,000/$500,000 是法定上限而非必罚金额。

variants.pt: LEA s.59 书面要求与行为确认路径
variants.stem: A landowner orally agrees to sell a parcel of land to a developer. Relying reasonably on this oral agreement, the developer alters its position to its detriment before any written contract is signed, such that refusing to enforce the deal would produce an inequitable result. If the landowner claims the deal is void for lack of writing, what is the legal position?
variants.zh: 一位业主口头同意将一块土地卖给开发商。在签署任何书面合同之前，开发商因合理信赖该口头约定而改变了自身处境并承受不利，以至于不强制执行该约定将造成不公平的结果。如果业主声称交易因缺少书面文件而无效，法律立场是什么？

opts.t: It is void, because the common law has never recognized detrimental reliance as a ground for enforcing an unwritten land transaction.
opts.w: 缺少书面形式不会令合同无效（void），且现行成文法已将部分履行与信赖原则写入条文。

opts.t: It is illegal unless both parties promptly sign an option agreement for $1 that converts the oral promise into a written one.
opts.w: 口头土地协议不属于非法（illegal）合同，也不需要通过补签选择权合同（option agreement）来洗白。

opts.t: Land contracts generally need writing to be enforceable, but LEA s.59(3)(c) allows enforcement where reasonable reliance makes refusal inequitable.
opts.w: 考试口径强调土地合同一般须书面作出否则不可执行（unenforceable）；同时现行《衡平法》（Law and Equity Act）第 59(3)(c) 条明文规定了不利变更依赖路径，当一方合理信赖合同改变处境、不执行会造成不公时，合同仍可执行。

opts.t: The developer's only remedy is to claim a penalty clause under the Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act for its lost costs.
opts.w: 罚金条款（penalty clause）在合同法下不可执行，且 BPCPA 一般不适用于土地买卖。

variants.pt: 要约撤回与邮寄承诺规则
variants.trap: 把邮寄规则套用到撤回上
variants.stem: A buyer pays a landowner $1 in exchange for a signed option agreement keeping an offer to purchase open until the end of the month. Halfway through the month, before the buyer exercises the option, the landowner delivers a written revocation directly into the buyer's hands. What is the legal effect of the landowner's revocation?
variants.zh: 买方向业主支付了 $1，换取一份签署好的选择权合同，约定将购房要约保留至月底。月中旬，在买方行使选择权之前，业主将一份书面撤回通知亲手交给买方。业主这一撤回行为的法律效力是什么？

opts.t: It is effective immediately, because $1 is inadequate consideration to support any option or contract that involves land.
opts.w: 法院不审查对价是否划算，「$1 及其他有价对价」在法律上和十万加元一样有效，足以支撑选择权合同。

opts.t: It is effective, because the landowner communicated it directly to the buyer before the buyer had exercised the option.
opts.w: 一般要约确实只要在承诺前传达即可撤回，但本题双方已另付对价成立了选择权合同（option agreement），业主已失去随意撤回的权利。

opts.t: It is ineffective, because the separate $1 consideration created a binding option that bars revocation during the agreed period.
opts.w: 选择权合同（option agreement）是要约人另外收取一笔独立对价（哪怕是 $1），换来在约定期限内不能撤回、也不能另卖给别人的承诺；一旦成立，要约人便不能在期限内撤回原要约。

opts.t: It converts the option agreement into a mere invitation to treat that the buyer can no longer accept.
opts.w: 已成立的选择权合同具有独立法律约束力，单方违约撤回不会将其降级为邀请磋商（invitation to treat）。

variants.trap: 反要约后试图回头接受原要约
variants.stem: A seller offers to sell a property for $700,000. The buyer crosses out $700,000, writes in $680,000, initials the change, and sends it back to the seller. When the seller refuses to accept $680,000, the buyer says, 'Fine, I accept your original offer of $700,000.' Is the seller bound to sell for $700,000?
variants.zh: 卖方提出以 $700,000 出售一套物业。买方划掉 $700,000，改写为 $680,000 并初签确认后退回给卖方。当卖方拒绝接受 $680,000 时，买方说：「好吧，我接受你最初 $700,000 的要约。」卖方是否有义务按 $700,000 出售？

opts.t: No, because altering the price created a counter-offer of $680,000, which legally terminated the seller's original $700,000 offer.
opts.w: 受要约人对要约条款做出任何改动（如把 $700,000 改为 $680,000）即构成反要约（counter-offer）；反要约一旦提出，原 $700,000 要约在法律上就终止了，买方无法再回头接受。

opts.t: Yes, because crossing out a figure is merely a price inquiry that leaves the original offer intact.
opts.w: 单纯询问（inquiry）不能改动条款；直接划改价格数字并退回属于典型的反要约（counter-offer），会杀死原要约。

opts.t: Yes, as long as the buyer's statement of acceptance is communicated before the original offer's time limit expires.
opts.w: 原要约并非因期限届满而失效，而是在买方提出反要约的那一刻就已经终止了，剩余期限不再有任何意义。

opts.t: No, unless the buyer attaches a red adhesive seal to the $700,000 acceptance.
opts.w: 印鉴（seal）解决的是无对价问题，不能把已经被反要约消灭的原要约复活。

variants.pt: 未成年人与心智失能者的缔约能力
variants.stem: An adult with a mental incapacity transfers an interest in property to a buyer. The court has not appointed a committee, and there is no enduring power of attorney in place. Under Section 60.2 of the Adult Guardianship Act, under which circumstance is this transfer NOT voidable on behalf of the incapacitated adult?
variants.zh: 一位心智失能的成年人将一项财产权益转让给买方。法院尚未指定监护人，也不存在持久授权书。依《成年人监护法》第 60.2 条，在下列哪种情形下，这次转让对该心智失能成年人而言是「不可撤销」的？

opts.t: Where full and valuable consideration was paid or secured, or a reasonable person would not have known of the incapacity.
opts.w: 依《成年人监护法》（Adult Guardianship Act）第 60.2 条，心智失能成年人转让财产权益对其本人是可撤销的（voidable），除非满足两个例外之一：受让方支付了充分且有效的对价（full and valuable consideration）且已支付或有担保，或转让当时一个理性人不会知道该成年人已丧失行为能力。

opts.t: Where the adult fails to repudiate the transfer within one year of signing the document.
opts.w: 「成年后一年内未反悔（repudiate）」是《未成年人法》（Infants Act）第 19(1) 条针对未成年人的例外，不是《成年人监护法》第 60.2 条的规则。

opts.t: Where a court had already appointed a committee prior to the transfer, but the adult appeared lucid during the meeting.
opts.w: 如果法院已经指定了监护人（committee）或已有持久授权书在先，即使当事人交谈时显得思路清楚，他仍然没有独立缔约的权利，决定权在监护人手上。

opts.t: Where the buyer paid a nominal consideration of $1 and attached a corporate stamp to the transfer.
opts.w: 《成年人监护法》第 60.2 条的例外明确要求「充分且有效的对价（full and valuable consideration）」，仅付 $1 象征性对价或加盖公司印章不能满足该例外。

variants.pt: 无心与故意虚假陈述的救济差异
variants.trap: 混淆无心与故意虚假陈述的过户后救济
variants.stem: To induce a buyer to purchase his house, a seller knowingly lies about a material fact regarding the foundation. The signed contract of purchase and sale contains a standard exclusion clause stating that there are no representations or warranties other than those written in the contract. After completion, the buyer discovers the lie. What are the buyer's rights?
variants.zh: 为了诱使买方购买房屋，卖方故意就地基的一项重要事实撒谎。签署的买卖合同包含一条标准排除条款，声明除合同载明外不存在任何其他陈述或保证。完成过户后，买方发现了这一谎言。买方享有什么权利？

opts.t: The buyer has no remedy because the standard exclusion clause bars all claims for pre-contractual statements.
opts.w: 标准买卖合同里的排除条款（exclusion clause）只能挡住无心虚假陈述，绝对挡不住故意虚假陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）。

opts.t: The buyer can claim damages only before completion, because completion extinguishes all misrepresentation remedies.
opts.w: 过户完成只消灭无心虚假陈述的撤销权；对于故意虚假陈述，买方在过户完成后依然可以主张撤销并索赔。

opts.t: Rescission even after completion and/or tort damages, because an exclusion clause cannot shield a fraudulent misrepresentation.
opts.w: 卖方明知是假话仍故意说出以诱使签约，构成故意虚假陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）：买方在任何时候（包括过户后）都能主张撤销（rescission）并/或按侵权法索赔损害赔偿（damages），且标准排除条款无法替故意欺诈免责。

opts.t: The seller's licensee can personally rely on the contract's exclusion clause to defeat any tort claim brought by the buyer.
opts.w: 买卖合同的当事人是卖方与买方，持牌人不是合同的一方，依合同相对性原则（privity of contract）从来无法援引合同里的排除条款保护自己。

variants.pt: LEA s.54 单方放弃先决条件三要件
variants.trap: 以为任何条件先决都能单方放弃、任何义务都能转让
variants.stem: A buyer inserts a financing condition precedent into an offer solely for the buyer's own benefit, with a deadline of next Wednesday. The contract can easily be performed with cash if financing is not used. On Friday—two days after the Wednesday deadline has passed without the condition being met—the buyer sends a notice waiving the financing condition. Is the waiver valid?
variants.zh: 买方在要约中加入了一条仅为买方自身利益而设的按揭贷款先决条件，期限为下周三。如果不使用贷款，合同完全可以用现金履行。在周五——即周三期限已过两天且条件并未满足之后——买方发出通知放弃该贷款条件。该放弃是否有效？

opts.t: Yes, because the financing condition was solely for the buyer's benefit and the contract can be performed without it.
opts.w: 《衡平法》第 54 条的三个条件必须「同时满足」，虽然满足了前两条（仅对买方有利、无该条件仍可履行），但违反了第三条期限要求。

opts.t: Yes, under the decision in Rosas v. Toca, deadlines for condition precedents never require timely notice.
opts.w: Rosas v. Toca 讨论的是双方合意延长履行期限时的对价问题，并不是允许一方在先决条件过期失效后单方面起死回生。

opts.t: No, only a court can waive a financing condition through an order of specific performance.
opts.w: 只要在期限前且满足《衡平法》第 54 条三要件，买方自己就可以书面单方放弃，无须法院下达特定履行令。

opts.t: No, because the waiver must be made before the time set for the condition to be fulfilled.
opts.w: 依《衡平法》（Law and Equity Act）第 54 条，放弃条件先决条款必须同时满足三项要件，其中第三项明确要求放弃必须发生在条件约定的履行期限「之前」；周三期限届满未成就时合同已因条件不成就（nonfulfillment of a condition precedent）而终止。

variants.pt: LEA s.36 法定转让与特定履行救济
variants.trap: 以为任何条件先决都能单方放弃、任何义务都能转让
variants.stem: A buyer signs a contract to purchase a mass-produced investment condominium unit in a large suburban development. When the seller breaches the contract and refuses to complete, the buyer sues for specific performance rather than damages. Based on recent judicial trends discussed in the course, how is a court likely to approach the buyer's claim for specific performance?
variants.zh: 买方签约购买一处大型郊区开发项目中批量建造的投资型公寓单元。当卖方违约拒绝完成过户时，买方起诉要求特定履行而非损害赔偿。根据课程讨论的近年判例趋势，法院很可能会如何处理买方的特定履行诉求？

opts.t: Grant specific performance automatically, because common law treats every square inch of real estate as unique without exception.
opts.w: 特定履行（specific performance）是衡平法（equitable）上的酌情救济而非普通法常规救济，且近年判例已不再默认每一处批量开发的房产都是独一无二的。

opts.t: Require proof that the property is truly unique and not readily replaceable, and otherwise award damages instead.
opts.w: 特定履行（specific performance）是衡平法酌情救济，只在损害赔偿（damages）不足以弥补、标的物独一无二时才适用；近年判例趋势不再默认大规模开发的住宅独一无二，除非买方能证明该物业对其确有不可替代性，否则只能拿到损害赔偿。

opts.t: Award both a punitive penalty clause and a mandatory injunction to imprison the seller.
opts.w: 合同法下不执行惩罚性的罚金条款（penalty clause），且强制性禁令（mandatory injunction）用于命令当事人为特定行为，并非直接判处监禁。

opts.t: Dismiss the lawsuit entirely under the rule in Hadley v. Baxendale unless the buyer waives all damages.
opts.w: Hadley v. Baxendale 原则是用来界定损害赔偿（damages）的可预见性范围，而不是在买方请求特定履行时直接驳回全部诉讼。

variants.pt: 《法律与衡平法》第59条书面要求与例外
variants.stem: Elena verbally agrees to grant Victor a two-year lease on a small house, and in a separate deal, verbally agrees to sell her vacant acreage to Nadia without any writing, deposit, or change of position by either party. Under section 59 of the Law and Equity Act, how does the law treat these two oral agreements?
variants.zh: Elena 口头同意授予 Victor 一份为期两年的小屋租约；而在另一笔独立交易中，她口头同意将一块空地卖给 Nadia，双方没有任何书面文件、未收付定金、也没有任何一方因信赖而改变处境。根据《Law and Equity Act》第59条，法律如何对待这两份口头协议？

opts.t: Both oral agreements are void from the start, because section 59 invalidates every unwritten interest in land regardless of its duration.
opts.w: 错误。第59条的后果是「不可执行（not enforceable）」而非「无效（void）」，且三年或以下的租约根本不受第59条限制，属于「无效与不可执行混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: The two-year lease is unenforceable unless Victor pays a deposit, while the vacant acreage sale is automatically enforceable against Elena.
opts.w: 错误。把两者的适用规则完全颠倒了：两年租约在三年或以下豁免范围内，无需书面即可执行；而空地买卖既无书面又无行为或信赖例外，属于不可执行。

opts.t: Both oral agreements are illegal under the Real Estate Services Rules and subject the parties to administrative penalties.
opts.w: 错误。口头土地买卖协议并不违法（not illegal），也不受针对持牌人的《Real Estate Services Rules》处罚，只是在法院拿不到强制执行救济。

opts.t: The two-year lease is exempt and enforceable as a lease of three years or less; the acreage sale exists but cannot be enforced in court.
opts.w: 正确。《Law and Equity Act》第59(2)(a)(b)条将三年或以下租期的租约（leases of three years or less）排除在书面要求之外，因此两年口头租约完全可执行；而出售空地的口头协议因无书面且未触发第59(3)条的行为或信赖例外，虽然合同存在（非无效），但在法院不可执行（not enforceable）。

variants.pt: 重大隐蔽缺陷的披露与拒绝服务义务
variants.trap: 中立保管人擅自退定金
variants.stem: A seller tells his listing licensee that an addition to the house was built without the required municipal building permit, which cannot be discovered on a normal viewing. However, before any offer is prepared, the seller personally delivers a signed written disclosure statement describing the missing permit directly to the prospective buyer. Under section 59 of the Real Estate Services Rules, what is the listing licensee's obligation?
variants.zh: 卖方告诉其挂牌持牌人，房屋的扩建部分是在缺少市政建筑许可的情况下建造的，且在常规看房时无法发现。不过，在准备任何要约之前，卖方已亲自将一份描述缺少许可情况的书面披露声明直接交给了潜在买方。根据《Real Estate Services Rules》第59条，挂牌持牌人的义务是什么？

opts.t: No separate disclosure is needed, because the other party already received written disclosure of the defect from the client.
opts.w: 正确。缺少相应市政建筑许可属于《Real Estate Services Rules》第59(1)条下的重大隐蔽缺陷（material latent defect），但第59(4)条明确规定了例外：若交易对方已经从处分方客户那里收到了对该缺陷的书面披露（written disclosure），持牌人就不必重复作单独披露。

opts.t: The licensee must still refuse to act for the seller because a property lacking a municipal building permit cannot legally be sold in BC.
opts.w: 错误。存在重大隐蔽缺陷的物业并非禁止出售，只要在订立协议前如实披露即可合法交易；只有在客户指示隐瞒时才必须拒绝服务。

opts.t: The licensee must pay 10% of the purchase price into court as a builders lien holdback before presenting any offer.
opts.w: 错误。10% 建筑留置权扣款（builders lien holdback）是《Builders Lien Act》针对改建工程付款的规定，与重大隐蔽缺陷披露义务毫无关系。

opts.t: The licensee must require the buyer to waive the 3-business-day Home Buyer Rescission Period to acknowledge the missing permit.
opts.w: 错误。住宅买家冷静期依规例第7条不可放弃（cannot be waived），且与隐蔽缺陷披露是两套完全独立的制度。

variants.pt: 要害条款与次要条款的违约救济区分
variants.trap: 条款性质与违约救济错配
variants.stem: During an open house, a seller casually remarks to a prospective buyer that the roof is in great shape. The buyer's licensee does not write any clause about the roof into the Contract of Purchase and Sale. After completion, the roof leaks and the buyer wants to sue on a breach of warranty. What advice should a licensee keep in mind when drafting an offer for a buyer who relies on a seller's verbal assurance?
variants.zh: 在一次开放看房中，卖方随口对潜在买方说屋顶状况很好。买方持牌人没有把任何关于屋顶的条款写进买卖合同。交割后屋顶漏水，买方想以违反保证为由起诉。当买方依赖卖方的口头保证时，持牌人在起草要约时应牢记什么原则？

opts.t: Every casual verbal remark made by a seller during a viewing automatically merges into the contract as an essential condition allowing termination after completion.
opts.w: 错误。卖方在看房时随口说的话，成交后一般跟不进合同，更不会自动变成允许解除合同的要害条款（essential term / condition），属于「条款性质与违约救济错配」陷阱。

opts.t: Oral remarks about physical condition are protected for 10 years on all resale homes under the Homeowner Protection Act.
opts.w: 错误。《Homeowner Protection Act》针对的是新房（new home）的法定保证，不适用于普通二手房卖方的随口夸赞。

opts.t: Write it into the contract as an express warranty, because proving an unwritten collateral warranty means showing a definite contractual promise.
opts.w: 正确。卖方在看房时的口头陈述在成交后一般不构成合同条款；若要让买方在交割后仍能依赖某句话，买方持牌人应将其写进合同成为明示保证（express warranty）。虽然法院有时会承认附随保证（collateral warranty），但那要求证明该陈述构成一个确定的、被当真的合同性承诺而非诱使签约的泛泛之词，门槛极高，不能当作后备方案。

opts.t: The buyer can simply file a Form B Information Certificate claim against the listing brokerage within 60 days after completion.
opts.w: 错误。Form B 是共管物业公司（strata corporation）出具的信息证书，60天则是 Form F 付款证明的有效期，均与独立屋口头保证无关。

variants.pt: 定金止付处理与中立保管人职责
variants.trap: 中立保管人擅自退定金
variants.stem: While negotiating a residential purchase, the buyer proposes that instead of paying the deposit to a brokerage trust account, the deposit will be held by the buyer's own lawyer. From the perspective of protecting the seller, what must the seller's licensee understand about this arrangement?
variants.zh: 在洽谈一笔住宅买卖时，买方提议不将定金存入经纪行信托账户，而是把定金放在买方自己的律师那里保管。从保护卖方的角度出发，卖方持牌人必须对这种安排明白什么？

opts.t: Every lawyer in BC is automatically bound by section 28 of the Real Estate Services Act as a statutory stakeholder on exactly the same terms as a licensed brokerage.
opts.w: 错误。《Real Estate Services Act》第28条的 stakeholder 规则只约束依该法持牌的经纪行与持牌人，买方的律师并不自动受 RESA 第28条约束。

opts.t: The buyer's lawyer is not a RESA stakeholder and may return the deposit without the seller's consent unless he gives the seller a stakeholder undertaking.
opts.w: 正确。RESA 的中立保管人（stakeholder）条款只约束依该法持牌的人；买方律师代表买方行事，除非该律师另行向卖方作出以 stakeholder 身份保管定金的书面承诺（undertaking），否则他可以不问卖方就把钱退给买方。因此卖方持牌人要么坚持入经纪行信托账户，要么先拿到律师的书面 undertaking。

opts.t: Placing a deposit with a lawyer renders the Contract of Purchase and Sale unenforceable under section 59 of the Law and Equity Act.
opts.w: 错误。定金甚至不是合同成立的要件（对价是双方互换的承诺），定金放在谁那里更不会导致书面买卖合同违反《Law and Equity Act》第59条，属于「无效与不可执行混淆」陷阱。

opts.t: The Real Estate Services Act prohibits principals from ever agreeing in a separate written agreement to have deposit funds paid to a payee other than a brokerage.
opts.w: 错误。RESA 第27(4)条及《Real Estate Services Rules》第68条允许全体委托人在独立于交易文件之外的另一份书面协议中约定不入经纪行信托账户，前提是款项直接付给或抬头开给并立即交付给约定的收款人。

variants.pt: 条件条款的主客观分类与合同成立
variants.trap: 主观条件当成已成立合同
variants.stem: A buyer and seller enter into a properly executed Contract of Purchase and Sale subject to the buyer obtaining a conventional first mortgage from a local credit union on specified objective terms by Friday. Two days after signing, the buyer finds another house he likes better, makes no application for a mortgage at all, and tells the seller on Friday that the contract is at an end because financing was not obtained. What is the legal position?
variants.zh: 买卖双方签订了一份正式签立的买卖合同，条件是买方在周五前按明确规定的客观条件从当地信用社取得常规第一按揭。签约两天后，买方看中了另一套更喜欢的房子，根本不去申请按揭，并在周五告诉卖方因为没拿到贷款所以合同终止。法律处境如何？

opts.t: A contract exists, with an implied duty to try honestly and reasonably to satisfy the objective condition; not applying breaches it, so the seller may keep the deposit.
opts.w: 正确。当先决条件（condition precedent）具备客观标准时，买卖合同已经成立，只是主要履行义务被悬置；此时法律会默示一项条款（implied term），要求享有条件利益的买方必须公平、诚实、善意地采取合理步骤去促成条件成就（act honestly and in good faith to fulfill the condition）。买方故意不去申请按揭构成对该默示条款的违约，卖方有权把定金作为损害赔偿留下。

opts.t: Because every subject clause is a whim and fancy clause, the buyer had complete discretion not to apply for the mortgage and gets the deposit back automatically.
opts.w: 错误。附有明确客观标准的融资条件不是完全主观（whim and fancy）条款，买方没有故意不申请按揭而无责退出的自由裁量权，属于「主观条件当成已成立合同」的反向误区。

opts.t: The buyer's failure to apply is merely a breach of a minor warranty, so the contract must still be completed in cash without any forfeiture of deposit.
opts.w: 错误。故意令先决条件落空违反的是关于条件成就的默示义务，卖方有权将定金作为损害赔偿主张，并非次要条款违约。

opts.t: The buyer is excused from applying for the mortgage as long as he verbally tells the listing licensee before Friday that he waives the condition.
opts.w: 错误。移除条件必须采用书面通知（written notice），且买方在这里是想退出合同而非放弃条件继续买房。

variants.pt: 标准转让条款与缺省时的双向通知义务
variants.trap: 考试口径与现行新规或楼花混同
variants.stem: Unless the client instructs otherwise in writing, what are the two Standard Assignment Terms that a licensee must include in a proposed Contract of Purchase and Sale for real estate (other than a development unit marketed by a developer under REDMA) under section 8.2(3) of the Real Estate Services Regulation?
variants.zh: 除非客户书面另行指示，根据《Real Estate Services Regulation》第8.2(3)条，持牌人在拟备不动产买卖合同（开发商依 REDMA 销售的开发单位除外）时，必须写入的两条标准转让条款（Standard Assignment Terms）是什么？

opts.t: That the contract cannot be assigned during the first 3 business days, and that any assignee must pay a 7% holdback into court.
opts.w: 错误。3个工作日是住宅冷静期，7% 是向开发商买共管物业时的建筑留置权扣款，都不是标准转让条款的内容。

opts.t: That the buyer may freely assign the contract to a family member or corporation without consent, and that the listing brokerage receives half of any assignment profit.
opts.w: 错误。标准转让条款要求任何转让均须取得卖方书面同意，且全部转让利润归卖方所有；若买方需要以公司名义接手或家庭成员加名而保留转让权，必须书面指示修改并走通知流程。

opts.t: That the assignment must be registered in the land title office within 60 days, and that the assignor guarantees the assignee's mortgage for 10 years.
opts.w: 错误。60天是 Form F 有效期，10年是新房结构质保期，与标准转让条款无关。

opts.t: No assignment is allowed unless the seller consents in writing, and any profit from an assignment by the buyer or a later assignee goes to the seller.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Real Estate Services Regulation》第8.2(3)条，标准转让条款（Standard Assignment Terms）包含两项核心内容：(1) 未经卖方书面同意，本合同不得转让（must not be assigned without the written consent of the seller）；(2) 买方或任何后手转让人转让本合同所产生的任何利润，归卖方所有（the seller is entitled to any profit resulting from an assignment）。

variants.pt: 《竞争法》刑事合谋与民事条款对比
variants.trap: 考试口径与现行新规或楼花混同
variants.stem: Three competing real estate brokerages in a BC municipality quietly reach an informal agreement that none of them will charge less than a specified commission rate on residential listings and each brokerage will stay out of the others' designated neighbourhoods. Under section 45 of the federal Competition Act, what is the legal consequence?
variants.zh: BC 省某市的三家竞争性地产经纪行暗中达成一项非正式默契：任何一家在住宅挂牌上收取的佣金率均不低于某一特定比例，且各家互不进入对方划定的街区。根据联邦《Competition Act》第45条，法律后果是什么？

opts.t: There is no offence under section 45 because the agreement was informal and not recorded in a signed contract.
opts.w: 错误。第45(3)条明确允许法院凭间接证据（circumstantial evidence）推断合谋存在，非正式默契或君子协定同样构成刑事合谋罪。

opts.t: Fixing commission rates and splitting territories among competitors are s.45 conspiracies, punishable by up to 14 years, a discretionary fine, or both.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Competition Act》第45(1)及(2)条，与竞争者约定固定/维持价格（含佣金率）或分配销售、地域、客户或市场（allocating sales, territories, customers or markets），均构成可公诉刑事合谋罪，最高可判处14年监禁、或由法院裁量的罚金、或两者并处。（注：2022年修法新增的第45(1.1)条还将非关联雇主之间固定薪酬条件、互不招揽或互不挖角的协议一并纳入该刑事罪名。）

opts.t: The agreement is lawful as long as the brokerages disclose the fixed commission rate in their written service agreements under section 43 of the Rules.
opts.w: 错误。向客户披露佣金是《Real Estate Services Rules》第43条对单家经纪行服务协议的要求，绝不能使竞争者之间合谋固定价格或瓜分市场的刑事犯罪合法化。

opts.t: The maximum penalty under section 45 is a 60-day suspension of the brokerages' Form F privileges by the strata council.
opts.w: 错误。第45条是联邦刑法级别的重罪（最高14年监禁与不封顶裁量罚金），与共管物业 Form F 的60天有效期毫无关系。

variants.pt: 无代理方有限服务与隐含代理边界
variants.stem: Sonia is the listing licensee for a detached home. At an open house, an unrepresented buyer named Victor asks Sonia to write up his offer. After Sonia delivers the required s.54 and s.55 disclosures, which action by Sonia would cross the line into implied agency and breach the dual agency ban under s.63?
variants.zh: Sonia 是一套独立屋的挂牌持牌人。在开放日上，一位名叫 Victor 的无代理买家请 Sonia 帮他写购买要约。在 Sonia 交付了法定的 s.54 与 s.55 披露表之后，Sonia 的下列哪一项行为会越界构成隐含代理并违反 s.63 的双重代理禁令？

opts.t: Giving Victor recent comparable sales statistics from the neighbourhood without recommending what price he should offer.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」的反向干扰。向无代理方提供客观的一般市场统计信息（general market information）属于合规的有限服务，不会构成隐含代理。

opts.t: Explaining the standard boilerplate wording of the Contract of Purchase and Sale and estimating Victor's standard closing costs.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」的反向干扰。解释标准表格术语和估算常规购房成本属于允许对无代理方提供的事实性、有限服务。

opts.t: Advising Victor that his initial offer is too high and recommending a strategic opening bid to test the seller's resolve.
opts.w: 正确。一旦给无代理方（unrepresented party / non-client）提供定价策略建议或替其谈判，持牌人的行为就推翻了先前的无代理披露，构成隐含代理（implied agency），使自己同时欠买卖双方互相排斥的受托义务，直接违反现行规则 s.63（旧版 5-16）的双重代理禁令。

opts.t: Delivering Victor's signed offer promptly and objectively to the seller client as instructed.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」的反向干扰。在无代理方与客户之间传递要约（transmitting offers）既是允许的有限服务，也是对卖方客户履行 s.30(g) 及时转达全部要约的法定义务。

variants.pt: 当前客户利益冲突的s.65处置
variants.stem: Leo represents two buyer clients, Carla and Devon, who decide to bid on the same property. Carla signs the Agreement Regarding Conflict of Interest Between Clients allowing Leo to continue representing Devon alone, but Devon refuses to sign the agreement because he objects to Leo's advice being restricted by Carla's confidentiality. What MUST Leo do?
variants.zh: Leo 代表的两位买方客户 Carla 和 Devon 决定竞标同一处物业。Carla 签署了《客户间利益冲突协议》，同意释放自己、让 Leo 单独继续代表 Devon；但 Devon 拒绝签署该协议，因为他不接受 Leo 给他的建议因对 Carla 的保密义务而受限。Leo 必须怎么做？

opts.t: Cease providing trading services to both Carla and Devon with respect to this trade and refer both clients to other licensees.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.65(1)(b)，只继续代表其中一位客户的前提是必须取得全部相关客户（all clients）的书面同意（三方协议：持牌人、继续被代理的客户、被释放的客户）；只要有一方拒签，唯一的合规结果就是走 s.65(1)(a)，就该笔交易对两位客户都停止提供交易服务并转介他人。

opts.t: Proceed to represent Devon anyway, since Carla is the released client and only the released client's signature is legally required.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。s.65(3) 要求的是三方协议，因为继续被代理的客户（Devon）也会受到影响——持牌人不能向他披露被释放客户的保密信息，导致能给他的建议受限，所以 Devon 也必须签字同意。

opts.t: Switch to representing Carla instead, since Carla already demonstrated good faith by signing the form.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。无论改为代表谁，都必须取得两位客户的共同书面同意；在 Devon 拒签的情况下，Leo 不能代表任何一方。

opts.t: Disclose Carla's maximum price to Devon so that Devon feels comfortable signing the conflict agreement.
opts.w: 属于「保密与瑕疵混淆陷阱」。对被释放客户的保密义务（duty of confidentiality）永久延续，泄露 Carla 的最高出价直接违反 s.30(e) 与 s.65(3)。

variants.pt: 重大隐蔽瑕疵披露与客户指示隐瞒
variants.stem: Gavin is the listing licensee for a house where an unpermitted structural addition was built without a required municipal building permit—a fact not discoverable on a reasonable inspection. The seller agrees that this must be disclosed. How and when must Gavin make this disclosure under s.52 and s.59?
variants.zh: Gavin 是一套房屋的挂牌持牌人，该房屋有一处未取得应有市政建筑许可的扩建结构，且经合理检查无法发现。卖家同意必须披露此事。根据规则 s.52 和 s.59，Gavin 应当在何时、以何种方式作出这项披露？

opts.t: Tell each buyer orally at the showing and have the buyer confirm verbally, before subjects are removed, that the addition was explained.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.52 与 s.59 要求重大隐蔽瑕疵必须以书面形式（in writing）披露，口头告知不合规。

opts.t: In writing to every other party, promptly and before any purchase or sale agreement is signed, in a document kept apart from the contract.
opts.w: 正确。缺少应有的市政建筑许可（lack of required municipal building permit）属于规则 s.59 定义的四类重大隐蔽瑕疵（material latent defect）之一；依 s.52 与 s.59(2)，持牌人必须及时、在任何取得或处分协议订立之前，以独立于买卖合同的书面形式向交易的所有其他方披露（若对方已从卖方本人处收到同一书面披露则可不重复）。

opts.t: By adding a sentence to the Contract of Purchase and Sale after the buyer submits an offer, so the defect becomes part of the deal.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。依 s.52，重大隐蔽瑕疵披露必须独立于使交易生效的合同（separate from any contract giving effect to a trade），写进买卖合同里不算完成法定披露。

opts.t: By filing a confidential notice with the superintendent within ten days after completion, without telling the buyer beforehand.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.59 的披露对象是交易的所有其他方（如买家），且必须在订立协议之前给出，而非交割后报送总监。

variants.pt: 指定代理与注册地产团队分边禁令
variants.stem: Wendy and Zack are two licensees at the same brokerage who are NOT members of any real estate team and never hold themselves out as a single entity or regularly co-list. Wendy is the designated agent for a seller, and Zack is the designated agent for a buyer who wants to buy that seller's home. Under s.32 and s.63(2), is this arrangement permitted?
variants.zh: Wendy 和 Zack 是同一家经纪行的两名持牌人，两人不属于任何地产团队，也从未以单一实体形象面向公众或经常共同代理。Wendy 是一位卖家的指定代理人，Zack 是一位想买该卖家房屋的买家的指定代理人。根据规则 s.32 和 s.63(2)，这种安排是否被允许？

opts.t: Yes. Under s.63(2), designating different licensees who are not on the same team to act for opposite sides is not dual agency.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.32（旧版 3-3.2）与 s.63(2)（旧版 5-16(2)），在指定代理（designated agency）模式下，只要两人不是同一个人、也不在同一个注册地产团队（real estate team）里，同一家经纪行指定不同的持牌人分别代表买卖双方并不构成双重代理，经纪行只需按 s.32(4) 保守双方秘密并以不偏不倚、客观、公平的方式对待双方利益。

opts.t: No; since the 2018 dual agency ban, two licensees at the same brokerage can never represent a buyer and a seller in the same trade.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。2018-06-15 的双重代理禁令禁止的是同一名（或同一团队）指定代理人同时代表冲突双方，而正是因为有 2012 年引入的指定代理制度，同经纪行不同指定代理人（非同一团队）分别代表买卖双方是完全合法的。

opts.t: Only if the property is located in a remote, under-served area under s.64.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」。因为同经纪行不同指定代理人分边代表根本不属于双重代理（s.63(2)），所以不需要满足 s.64 偏远地区双重代理例外的条件。

opts.t: Only if both clients sign an Agreement Regarding Conflict of Interest Between Clients releasing the brokerage from confidentiality.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。s.65 的《客户间利益冲突协议》用于同一名（或同一团队）指定代理人的两名客户撞单的情形，且经纪行在任何情况下都不得免除保密义务（s.32(4)）。

variants.pt: 代理成立路径：禁反言与表见授权
variants.stem: Licensee Owen, whose authority under a buyer agency agreement was strictly limited to residential properties in Burnaby, exceeded his authority by submitting an offer on behalf of his client for a warehouse in Richmond without prior permission. When the client learned of the deal the next morning, she was delighted with the price and formally adopted the transaction as her own. By which legal mechanism did this agency authority become valid retroactively?
variants.zh: 持牌人 Owen 在买方代理协议下的权限被严格限制在本拿比的住宅物业，但他未经事先许可，越权代表客户就列治文的一处仓库提交了购买要约。当客户第二天早上得知这笔交易时，对价格非常满意，正式决定接受并承认该笔交易。通过哪一种法律机制，这项代理权限得以溯及既往地生效？

opts.t: Ratification, whereby a principal subsequently agrees to be bound by an agent's unauthorized act, giving it retroactive effect.
opts.w: 正确。追认（ratification）是指代理人事先无权或越权行事，但委托人事后同意受其约束，其法律效果溯及既往（retroactive）。不过实务中持牌人绝不能指望追认，因为若客户拒绝追认，越权责任（违反授权担保 warranty of authority）将全部落在持牌人自己身上。

opts.t: Agency by estoppel, because the warehouse seller relied on Owen's business card.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。禁反言（estoppel）的前提是委托人自己先向第三方作出了令其相信代理人有权限的表示；本题中委托人事先毫不知情，而是事后主动追认（ratification）。

opts.t: Implied actual authority, because buying a warehouse in Richmond is necessary and incidental to buying a house in Burnaby.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。默示实际授权（implied actual authority）仅限于为完成明示授权所必需且附随的行为，跨城市买商业仓库显然直接违背了明示权限。

opts.t: Modification of duties under s.31, which automatically cures any unauthorized act if the managing broker initials the file.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。规则 s.31 是事先在服务协议中约定修改 s.30 的法定义务，并非事后追认越权行为的共同法机制。

variants.pt: 推荐费披露与禁止净额挂牌
variants.stem: A property owner tells listing licensee Diana: 'I want to walk away with $980,000 clear from the sale of my house; anything you can get above $980,000 you can keep as your commission.' How do the Real Estate Services Rules treat this remuneration arrangement?
variants.zh: 一位业主对挂牌持牌人 Diana 说：「我卖这套房子要净拿 $980,000；只要你能卖到 $980,000 以上，高出来的部分全部归你当佣金。」《地产服务规则》如何对待这种酬金安排？

opts.t: It is a net listing, which s.60 prohibits, and Diana is not entitled to keep any remuneration calculated on that basis.
opts.w: 正确。以「挂牌价（或业主底价）与实际成交价之差」作为报酬基础的约定叫净额挂牌（net listing）；依现行规则 s.60（旧版规则 5-14），严禁达成或要约达成净额挂牌，且以此方式计算的酬金，持牌人无权取得也不得留存（not entitled to and must not retain）。

opts.t: It is a valid exclusive listing as long as Diana splits the excess above $980,000 into three figures on the written service agreement under s.43.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.43 的三笔酬金拆分适用于合法的佣金约定，而净额挂牌（net listing）本身被 s.60 直接禁止，写进服务协议里同样违法。

opts.t: It is permitted if the managing broker signs a conflict disclosure form and submits it to BCFSA before the property is advertised.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。管理经纪签字并上报 BCFSA 是 s.64 偏远地区双重代理例外的程序，净额挂牌（s.60）没有任何豁免程序。

opts.t: It is enforceable in court under the common law doctrine of quantum meruit if the buyer pays cash.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。违反法规 s.60 禁令的净额挂牌在法律上无效，持牌人无权取得或留存该报酬，法院也不会按合理报酬原则（quantum meruit）支持违规的净额差价。

variants.pt: s.54代表关系披露与s.57.1撤销权披露
variants.stem: Under the general disclosure rule in s.52 of the Real Estate Services Rules, disclosures under Division 2 must be in writing and separate from any service agreement or contract giving effect to a trade, EXCEPT for which two specific disclosures?
variants.zh: 根据《地产服务规则》s.52 的披露总纲，第 2 分部项下的各项披露都必须是书面的，且独立于任何服务协议或使交易生效的合同，但有哪两项特定披露属于例外？

opts.t: Disclosure of Interest in Trade under s.53 and Disclosure of Material Latent Defects under s.59, both of which may go in the contract.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.53（交易中利益的披露）和 s.59（重大隐蔽瑕疵的披露）都必须严格独立于买卖合同，写进合同里不算完成披露。

opts.t: The s.54 representation disclosure and the s.55 risks disclosure, which may both be printed inside the service agreement itself.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.54 和 s.55 都必须使用总监批准的独立表格在提供服务前给出，不能混入服务协议或买卖合同。

opts.t: Disclosure to Sellers of Expected Remuneration (s.57) and the s.65 conflict-between-clients agreement, which may be attached to the offer.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.57（每次呈交要约时向卖方披露预期酬金）和 s.65（客户间利益冲突协议）均须独立成件。

opts.t: The s.56(1)(a) remuneration disclosure, which may sit in the service agreement, and the s.57.1 rescission disclosure, which may sit in the contract.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.52，除两处例外外，第 2 分部的一切披露均须书面且独立于服务协议与买卖合同；这两处例外分别是：s.56(1)(a) 因提供地产服务而从客户以外获得酬金的披露（可写在服务协议里或另立文件），以及 s.57.1 的买家撤销权披露（可写在买卖合同里或另立文件）。

variants.stem: Mei enters j₂ = 6.00%, compounded semi-annually, into a spreadsheet and divides by 12. The sheet labels 0.5% as the monthly rate for her home-loan payments. Which description of that 0.5% figure is right?
variants.zh: Mei 把按半年复利的 j₂ = 6.00% 输入表格，再除以 12，表格把 0.5% 标成她住房贷款的月利率。对这个 0.5%，哪一种说法正确？

opts.t: It is the wrong monthly rate. She first divides 6.00% by 2, then converts that half-year rate into an equivalent monthly rate.
opts.w: 正确。同一考点：j₂ 为 6.00% 不能直接除以 12 得到 0.5% 当月利率。先算半年周期利率 i_sa = j₂ ÷ 2，再换算成等价的月周期利率（periodic rate）。

opts.t: It is acceptable, because a rate quoted with a subscript of 2 is already the rate to apply once each month.
opts.w: 错误。j₂ 的下标 2 表示一年复利两次，即按半年复利的名义年利率（nominal rate），不是按月报价。

opts.t: It is the effective annual rate, so the sheet should compound that 0.5% only once at the end of each year.
opts.w: 错误。0.5% 不是等价年利率（effective annual rate, EAR）。EAR 等于 (1+i) 的 m 次方减 1，而且大于等于名义年利率；复利次数多于一次时，两者会拉开。

opts.t: It is required by the Interest Act, which says every monthly payment uses exactly one-twelfth of the quoted annual rate.
opts.w: 错误。《利息法》（Interest Act）s.6 要求以年或半年复利披露利率，并没有规定月利率必须等于报价除以 12。直接除以 12 正是讲义点名的最常见算错方式。

variants.stem: A buyer's notes show Lender R at 5.85% compounded monthly and Lender S at 5.90% compounded semi-annually. The buyer underlines 5.85% as the cheaper loan. Which conclusion is right?
variants.zh: 一位买家的笔记上，贷款人 R 是 5.85%、按月复利，贷款人 S 是 5.90%、按半年复利。买家在 5.85% 下面画线，认为它更便宜。哪一个结论正确？

opts.t: Lender R costs less per year in real terms, because 5.85 is a smaller number than 5.90.
opts.w: 错误。这仍是「名义数字直接比」陷阱。5.85% 按月复利，和 5.90% 按半年复利，复利频率不同，不能凭印在合同上的数字大小定贵贱。

opts.t: Lender S must cost more, because semi-annual compounding always produces a higher effective annual rate than monthly compounding.
opts.w: 错误。在名义利率相同的前提下，复利频率越高，等价年利率（effective annual rate）越高，所以按月复利会比按半年复利滚得更贵，不是半年复利永远更贵。本题两家的名义利率还不相同。

opts.t: Both quotes share one effective annual rate once each nominal rate is divided by the number of times it compounds.
opts.w: 错误。j_m 除以 m 得到的是周期利率（periodic rate），还不是等价年利率，也不能让这两份报价变成同一个年成本。讲义演算出来的两个 EAR 并不相等。

opts.t: Lender S has the lower effective annual rate, about 5.9870%, compared with about 6.0094% for Lender R.
opts.w: 正确。与课程演算一致：按半年复利的 5.90% ，EAR 约 5.9870%；按月复利的 5.85%，EAR 约 6.0094%。名义利率更低的 R，真实年成本更高。

variants.stem: A buyer asks why one residential mortgage can be described with both a 5-year term and a 25-year amortization. What is the course distinction?
variants.zh: 一位买家问：同一笔住宅按揭为什么既能说成 5 年合同期，又能说成 25 年摊还。课程怎样区分这两个数字？

opts.t: The 25-year figure is the term, so the rate is renegotiated every 25 years while the payments are calculated over 5 years.
opts.w: 错误。两个数字对调了。合同期（term）是要重新谈的那一段，这里是 5 年；摊还期（amortization period）是用来计算还款节奏的那一段，这里是 25 年。

opts.t: Payments follow a 25-year amortization, but the contract term is only 5 years, so a balloon balance is still owing when that term ends.
opts.w: 正确。这是部分摊还（partially amortized）：月供按 25 年摊还来算，合同只签 5 年，5 年到期余额还在，就是尾款（balloon payment），需要偿还、续约或转贷。

opts.t: The two numbers are different names for one date, so the debt is gone after either 5 years or 25 years.
opts.w: 错误。这是「摊还期当成还清日」陷阱。部分摊还里摊还期不等于合同期，5 年结束并不是本金已经还清的那一天。

opts.t: The 5-year figure means interest may be charged for only 5 years, after which the unpaid principal is forgiven.
opts.w: 错误。合同期结束不会免除剩余本金。到期的余额要一次偿还或另行安排融资，贷款人没有义务把未还本金勾销。

variants.stem: An individual, not a corporation, mortgaged a rental house for a term longer than five years. The fifth anniversary of the mortgage date has arrived. What may that individual do under the Interest Act?
variants.zh: 一位个人，不是公司，以出租屋作抵押，合同期长于五年。按揭日期的第五个周年已经到来。依《利息法》，这个人可以做什么？

opts.t: Prepay only the interest then owing. The principal must stay in place until the original maturity date.
opts.w: 错误。s.10 允许提前还清的是全部欠款，不是只付当时的利息、把本金留到原到期日。

opts.t: Demand that the lender forgive three months of payments as a statutory rebate for waiting five years.
opts.w: 错误。三个月利息是借款人提前还清时要多付给贷款人的代价，不是贷款人要退给借款人的减免。

opts.t: Do nothing until the original term ends, because section 10 applies only to corporate borrowers.
opts.w: 错误。说反了保护对象。《利息法》（Interest Act）s.10 保护的是个人（individuals），把法人借款人排除在外，不是只保护公司。

opts.t: Pay off the entire amount owing, together with an extra three months' interest, from that anniversary onward.
opts.w: 正确。从按揭日期满五年那天起，个人借款人有权随时提前还清全部欠款，只需额外多付三个月利息。本题借款人是个人、抵押物是不动产、合同期超过五年，三个条件都齐。考试口径与现行条文一致。

variants.stem: A developer's construction facility requires interest to be paid every month. The entire principal is repaid in one sum when the project is sold. Unpaid interest is not added to the principal during construction. Which design is this?
variants.zh: 开发商的建筑贷款要求每个月支付利息，全部本金在项目售出时一次偿还。施工期间未付利息不会滚进本金。这是哪一种设计？

opts.t: Interest only. Principal stays outstanding while the lender collects interest each period, a pattern common in construction financing.
opts.w: 正确。纯利息贷款（interest only）每期只付利息，本金到期一次还清。贷款人本金仍悬在外面，但至少定期收到利息。讲义指出这种安排常见于开发建设期融资；建筑贷款通常按纯利息计息，完工出售后一次还本。

opts.t: Interest accruing. Nothing is paid until the sale, and unpaid interest is rolled into the principal and earns further interest.
opts.w: 错误。只计息不还款（interest accruing）是期间零付款，利息滚入本金再生息。本题每个月都在付利息，未付利息也没有滚进本金。

opts.t: A fully amortized constant payment. The monthly amounts of principal and interest retire the loan before the units are sold.
opts.w: 错误。全额摊还的等额本息（constant payment）会在合同期内把本金陆续还完。本题本金留到出售时一次偿还，每月付的只是利息。

opts.t: A graduated payment. The monthly amount starts low and rises by a step each year while principal is paid from the first month.
opts.w: 错误。递增付款按揭（graduated payment mortgage）是早期还款少、逐年递增，用来帮暂时收入较低的买家先进场。本题没有逐年递增，也没有从第一个月还本金。

variants.pt: 小额还款有再投资难题
variants.stem: A trustee asks why a small saver who is willing to take the credit risk still finds it awkward to hold one whole mortgage. The monthly receipts are too small to fund another full loan. Which explanation fits?
variants.zh: 一位受托人问：小储蓄者即使愿意承担信用风险，为什么仍然不适合自己持有一整笔按揭。每月收到的钱太少，凑不出下一笔完整贷款。哪一种解释成立？

opts.t: The saver must earn the same rate as a government bond, because a mortgage and a government bond are interchangeable assets.
opts.w: 错误。按揭不如政府公债那样可以互换，承诺可靠性更低、流动性更差、管理成本更高，所以同期限的优质第一按揭利率通常高于政府公债收益率，不是必须相等。

opts.t: Administration costs shrink in exact proportion to the loan size, so one mortgage costs the saver the same per dollar as it costs a bank.
opts.w: 错误。管理成本不会因为贷款规模小而等比例缩小。大机构靠规模摊薄单笔成本，小投资人摊不了，这是五个特征里的另一条，不是本题这条的反面。

opts.t: Capital is not a barrier, because any saver can fund a complete mortgage, and the only difficulty is finding a borrower.
opts.w: 错误。资本门槛高是五个特征之一：放出一笔完整按揭往往要凑出很大一笔钱，很多有意愿的储蓄者凑不出来。本题的不便还叠着还款太碎、暂时贷不出去。

opts.t: A reinvestment problem: the receipts wait at a lower savings rate until there is enough to lend again, which reduces the saver's actual yield.
opts.w: 正确。这就是再投资难题（reinvestment problem）。小投资人每月只有一小笔本金加利息，先落进利息更低的储蓄账户，等攒够才能放出下一笔，等待期拉低实际到手的收益率。大机构因为笔数多，可以立刻再贷出去。

variants.stem: A classmate says a firm the course materials name as a private mortgage insurer is "a monoline lender that no longer exists," because it later changed its name. What is the correction?
variants.zh: 课程材料把一家公司当作私营按揭保险公司的举例，这家公司后来改了名。同学说它是「一家已经不存在的专营按揭公司」。应当怎样改正？

opts.t: It should be classed as a chartered bank, and the exam wants the current bank brand written in as the answer to the category question.
opts.w: 错误。这家公司在考试口径里不是银行，也不是要用现行招牌替换类别。银行是机构贷款人里的一类，而且仍是按揭资金最大的单一来源。

opts.t: The old name must be marked wrong, because any firm that has been renamed is treated on the exam as having left the market entirely.
opts.w: 错误。这是「旧名字当现行分类」陷阱。卷面要的不是招牌还在不在。改名之后公司仍在，类别并没有从市场上消失。

opts.t: It is an example of a private mortgage insurer beside CMHC; mark that category, and in practice tell clients the firm's current name.
opts.w: 正确。同一考点：考试口径把它当作 CMHC 之外的私营按揭保险公司举例，卷面答分类。公司未消失，只是换了牌子；实务上对客户要用现在的名字。

opts.t: It belongs to the government lender category, because a renamed private insurer is treated as having been taken over by the province.
opts.w: 错误。政府放贷是另一类（联邦与省级政府直接放贷项目）。改名不等于被政府接管，它在考试口径里仍是私营按揭保险公司的举例。

variants.stem: A constant-payment mortgage is approved but not yet funded. The lender then raises only the periodic rate. The borrowers' payment, the monthly frequency, and the 25-year amortization stay as approved. Which result follows?
variants.zh: 一笔等额本息按揭已获批准，但尚未放款。贷款机构随后只提高周期利率。借款人的还款额、按月还款和25年摊还期都保持原批准数字。哪一项随之发生？

opts.t: The borrowers must switch to interest-only payments, because a higher rate cannot stay inside a constant payment.
opts.w: 错误。这是“第五个被估掉”里换错了变量。利率升高仍然可以留在等额本息（constant payment mortgage）里。变的是同样月供能够支撑的贷款金额，不是必须改成只付利息。

opts.t: The approved principal is unchanged, because a rate change cannot alter any of the other four variables.
opts.w: 错误。这是“第五个被估掉”陷阱。利率就是五个变量之一。月供、频率和摊还期不变时，贷款金额必须跟着变，不能改了一个、其余却全部原样。

opts.t: The principal this payment can support is uniquely smaller, because more of each payment is consumed by interest.
opts.w: 正确。已知月供、期数和升高后的周期利率，能支撑的贷款金额（PV）唯一确定，而且变小。每期还款里利息占得更多，剩下能还本金的部分更少。

opts.t: The ending balance must be set above zero, because a higher rate stops the mortgage from amortizing fully.
opts.w: 错误。这是“第五个被估掉”里改错了被锁定的那个量。完全摊还的到期余额（FV）仍可以是零。利率升高改变的是同样月供能支撑的本金，不是强制把期末余额改成大于零。

variants.stem: Before an offer is written, a buyer asks why a seller's mortgage payout is still close to the loan amount advanced three years earlier. The buyer wants to divide the original loan by the number of years and treat three years as three equal principal reductions. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 写要约之前，买方问：为什么卖方的按揭结欠仍接近三年前放出的贷款金额。买方想把原始贷款按年数平分，把这三年当成三段相等的本金扣减。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: Use that average. Principal on a constant-payment mortgage declines by the same amount each year.
opts.w: 错误。这仍是“加减法算结欠”的一种。等额的是每期还款，不是每年本金。前期本金减得少，不能按年把原贷款切成相等的几块。

opts.t: Add three years of interest to the original loan. A payout is always higher than the amount first advanced.
opts.w: 错误。这是“加减法算结欠”的反方向。正常还款下结欠不会因为付过利息就高于最初放款。付掉的利息不是再加回本金；结欠是剩余还款的现值。

opts.t: Treat the payout as zero. Three years of residential payments are enough to retire the loan.
opts.w: 错误。这是“加减法算结欠”走到了另一个极端，把结欠直接当成零。三年还款没有把按长摊还期计算的等额本息贷款还清。早期本金减得很少，结欠通常仍接近原始贷款。

opts.t: Reject the average. The payout is the present value of the remaining payments at the contract rate, and early payments retire little principal.
opts.w: 正确。结欠余额（outstanding balance，OSB）按合同利率把剩余各期还款折成现值。等额本息前几年利息占大头，所以三年后结欠往往只比原贷款少了个位数百分比，不能按年等额去减。

variants.pt: 利息法只保个人满五年
variants.stem: Amira, an individual, mortgaged her home. The balance is due five years after the mortgage date, not later. Three years have passed. She says the statute already lets her pay the whole balance with only an extra three months' interest, because the mortgage is residential and she is not a company. Which statement is the exam answer?
variants.zh: Amira 是个人，住宅按揭在按揭日期起五年整到期，不是更晚。现在过了三年。她说法律已经允许她只额外付三个月利息就还清全部余额，因为这是住宅而且她不是公司。按考试口径，哪一项正确？

opts.t: The statute does not give her that right yet. It needs a mortgage due more than five years out, and five years must already have passed.
opts.w: 正确。《利息法》（Interest Act）s.10 只适用于约定五年以上才到期的按揭，而且要从按揭日期满五年之后。合同期五年及以内用不上。Amira 的合同是五年整，现在又只过了三年，两道门槛都没过。个人和住宅并不能单独打开这项权利。考试口径与现行条文一致。

opts.t: She may prepay now. A residential mortgage for an individual is covered from the first payment, whatever the term.
opts.w: 错误。这是“利息法对象看宽”陷阱。住宅和个人只是没有把她排除，合同期必须超过五年，并且要自按揭日期满五年。从第一期还款起就能用，不符合这一层。

opts.t: She may prepay now, but only if the extra amount is three months of principal rather than interest.
opts.w: 错误。这是“利息法对象看宽”里把代价偷换掉。即便权利适用，额外支付的也是三个月利息，不是三个月本金。本题两道门槛都没过，改成三个月本金也不能成立。

opts.t: She may prepay now, because three years is more than half of a five-year term and the statute treats that as the five-year mark.
opts.w: 错误。这是“利息法对象看宽”里把五年的起算看错。起算是按揭日期满五年，不是合同期过半。三年还没满五年，合同期五年整本身也用不上这一层。

variants.stem: A borrower asks to stretch the amortization so the interest rate will stay locked for that whole longer period. The payment would be calculated on the longer amortization, while the contract term on offer is a much shorter period. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 借款人要求把摊还期拉长，以便利率在整个更长的时段里被锁住。月供会按更长的摊还期来算，而对方给出的合同期短得多。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The longer amortization both lightens the payment and locks the rate until the amortization itself ends.
opts.w: 错误。这是“摊还节奏当成重谈日”陷阱。拉长摊还期可以让月供变轻，但不能把利率锁到摊还期结束。何时重谈看合同期。

opts.t: Stretching the amortization can lighten the payment. It does not lock the rate. The term is when the contract is renegotiated.
opts.w: 正确。摊还期（amortization period）拉长，月供变轻，总利息变贵，但它只决定还款节奏。合同期（term）才决定何时重谈，两者完全独立。

opts.t: Stretching the amortization raises the payment and forces the balance to zero when the shorter term ends.
opts.w: 错误。这是“摊还节奏当成重谈日”里把月供方向也看反了。摊还期拉长是月供变轻，不是变重。较短的合同期结束时，按长摊还期计算的贷款也不会已经变成零余额。

opts.t: The shorter term cancels the amortization, so the payment must be calculated as if the whole loan were due in that short term.
opts.w: 错误。这是“摊还节奏当成重谈日”的另一种换算：把合同期当成摊还期。合同期短，不表示月供要在合同期内完全还清。月供仍按摊还期计算，到期再重谈尚未还清的余额。

variants.stem: A borrower reads a fully amortized schedule, sees that the last line is a little under the regular payment, and says, "That line is a large balloon I still have to budget as unpaid principal." Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 借款人查看一份完全摊还的还款表，看到最后一行比常规还款略小，就说：“这一行是我还得当成未还本金来准备的一大笔气球款。”哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The borrower is right. Full amortization always ends with a large unpaid principal called the final payment.
opts.w: 错误。这是“尾款当成气球款”陷阱。完全摊还结束时余额是零，最后一期略小，不是一大笔未还本金。

opts.t: The borrower is right. The small last line is interest still owing, and the principal remains unpaid until a separate balloon.
opts.w: 错误。这是“尾款当成气球款”陷阱。完全摊还不是利息另付、本金留到一笔气球款。期末余额为零，略小的最后一期（final payment）把剩余金额收掉。

opts.t: The borrower is wrong. That line is the final payment, slightly smaller than a regular instalment, and the ending balance is zero.
opts.w: 正确。尾款（final payment）是完全摊还到期时略小于常规还款额的最后一期。到期余额是零，不能把这一行预算成一大笔未还本金。

opts.t: The borrower is wrong because a fully amortized loan has no last instalment at all once the term begins.
opts.w: 错误。这是“尾款当成气球款”之后又走到另一头。完全摊还有最后一期。错在把它当成一大笔气球款，不是错在根本不存在最后一期。

variants.stem: A practice item is expressly limited to the course manual. A buyer puts more than 20 percent down, the mortgage is not insured, and the item asks what the manual says government rules allow for the amortization. Which selection is the exam answer?
variants.zh: 一道练习题明确限定按课程手册作答。买方首付高于20%，按揭不需要保险。题目问手册说政府规则允许的摊还期是什么。按考试口径，应当选哪一项？

opts.t: The manual allows no amortization above 25 years, and it uses 25 years for every down payment.
opts.w: 错误。这是“旧上限当现行法”里拿错了那一段。25年是考试口径写给保险按揭的上限。本题首付高于20%、不需要保险，手册没有把这一段也写成25年封顶。

opts.t: The manual says there is no government rule, so it never states a range for this down payment.
opts.w: 错误。这是“旧上限当现行法”陷阱，用现行定性去改手册。现行确实没有联邦法定上限，但手册把这一段写成了政府规则，而且写了30到35年。题目要的是手册怎么说。

opts.t: The manual says government rules allow only the same maximum as an insured mortgage, which it states as 30 years.
opts.w: 错误。这是“旧上限当现行法”里把数字搬错了位。保险按揭在手册里是25年，不是30年。首付高于20%这一段，手册写的是政府规则允许30到35年，不是把保险按揭的年限再搬过来。

opts.t: The manual says government rules allow an amortization of 30 to 35 years for this uninsured mortgage.
opts.w: 正确。题目限定课程手册，就要复述考试口径：首付达到或超过20%的非保险按揭，政府规则允许30到35年。现行规则不同，这一段没有联邦法定上限，年限由贷款机构自定，不能把现行说法填进这道历史题。

variants.stem: A borrower adds an amount above the minimum on each payment and worries that the loan will last longer and cost more interest because the payment got larger. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 借款人在每期最低还款之外又多付一笔，并担心：因为还款变大，贷款会拖得更久、总利息也会更多。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The worry is misplaced. The extra amount is an accelerated payment: it shortens the amortization and reduces total interest.
opts.w: 正确。比最低还款额多付，称为加速还款（accelerated payment）。效果是缩短摊还期、少付利息，不是把贷款拖长、把总利息抬高。

opts.t: The worry is correct. A larger payment always stretches the amortization and increases total interest.
opts.w: 错误。这是“加速还款方向反了”陷阱。更大的还款如果是在最低额之上多付，摊还期变短，总利息变少。

opts.t: The extra amount is the final payment, so it can be made only on the last day and must be slightly smaller than the minimum.
opts.w: 错误。这是“加速还款方向反了”里把名字换成了尾款。尾款（final payment）是完全摊还结束时略小的最后一期，不是还款中途在最低额之上多付的那一笔。

opts.t: The extra amount is added to the balance, so the loan grows even though the borrower paid more than the minimum.
opts.w: 错误。这是“加速还款方向反了”陷阱。多付出去的钱不会加进结欠。负摊还是月供不够付利息时余额不减反增，和主动在最低额之上多付不是一回事。

variants.trap: 止赎两条路的后果记反
variants.stem: In a British Columbia foreclosure the property is worth more than the debt, and the borrower neither pays nor sells during the redemption period. The lender then obtains conduct of sale, and the approved price does not cover the debt. The borrower asks whether a final order of foreclosure would have left the same personal liability. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 在不列颠哥伦比亚的一宗止赎里，物业价值高于欠款，借款人在赎回期内既没有补款也没有卖出。贷款人随后取得处置权，法院批准的售价不够清偿欠款。借款人问：如果当时走的是最终止赎令，个人责任是不是一样。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: Both routes are the same. After either a final order or an approved sale, the borrower owes any difference and also loses any surplus.
opts.w: 错误。这是止赎两条路的后果记反，把两条路说成结果相同。最终止赎令消灭个人契诺，不能再追差额。司法拍卖售价不足时，被申请人对差额仍然要负责。

opts.t: The short sale price ends the personal covenant, while a final order of foreclosure would have preserved it for a later lawsuit.
opts.w: 错误。这是止赎两条路的后果记反，方向颠倒了。售价不足并不消灭个人契诺。会消灭个人契诺、因而不能再追差额的，是最终止赎令。

opts.t: The borrower may keep the existing listing until the sale completes, and a shortfall is payable only if a final order is made.
opts.w: 错误。这是止赎两条路的后果记反，又看错了上市权。法院颁发处置权（conduct of sale）之后，借款人的上市权和既有委托即告终止。差额责任属于售价不足的司法拍卖，不属于最终止赎令。

opts.t: After this approved sale the borrower still owes the unpaid difference. A final order would have extinguished that personal covenant instead.
opts.w: 正确。司法拍卖（judicial sale）经法院批准后，售价不足时被申请人对差额仍要负责。最终止赎令（final order of foreclosure）则使贷款人成为产权人，衡平赎回权与个人契诺一并消灭，不能再追差额。两条路的个人责任相反。

variants.stem: A company sells a warehouse it used in its business. The buyer assumes the mortgage, which financed that business rather than a home. The seller asks which of the three statutory release paths can end its covenant, and whether a later new agreement could release it instead. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 一家公司卖掉自己经营用的仓库。买家承担了按揭。这份按揭是为该生意融资，不是为住宅。卖方问：三条制定法解除路径里，哪一条能结束它的契诺，以及日后另订新约能否反而解除。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: All three statutory paths apply. Every assumed mortgage in British Columbia releases the seller after three months of silence.
opts.w: 错误。这是承担即脱身，把三条路径用到了商业按揭上。这三条只适用于住宅按揭。为生意设定的按揭，不能靠三个月沉默自动解除。

opts.t: None of the three paths applies. A later new agreement can still release the seller if it is a novation fully replacing the old one.
opts.w: 正确。三条解除路径只适用于住宅按揭，商业用途不适用。更替契约（novation）不限于住宅，也不限于按揭。新借款人承担全部责任、被贷款人接受为主债务人、并且新约完全替代旧约时，原借款人彻底解除。

opts.t: The seller is released on completion. A company cannot remain liable once any buyer assumes a mortgage of business premises.
opts.w: 错误。这是承担即脱身。公司卖方不会因为买家承担就在过户时自动解除。商业按揭连那三条住宅路径都不能用，普通法上的默示责任仍在。

opts.t: Only the demand-mortgage path applies, and a novation is available only for an agreement for sale, never for a mortgage.
opts.w: 错误。这是承担即脱身，把路径和更替契约都看窄了。见索即付那一条同样只属于住宅按揭。更替契约（novation）比这三条更广，按揭和 agreement for sale 都可以适用。

variants.stem: A borrower can raise enough money to pay only one of four registered mortgages and asks which one must be paid before any higher-ranking mortgage can be redeemed. There is no priority agreement. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 借款人筹到的钱只够还四份已登记按揭中的一份，并问：在能够赎回任何更高顺位之前，必须先还哪一份。没有优先权协议。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The lowest-ranking mortgage must be paid first. The borrower redeems from the bottom upward and cannot skip a lower charge.
opts.w: 正确。借款人赎回必须从最低顺位往上（redeem up）。只够还一份时，先还清排在最后的那份，才能再碰它上面的一份。这与止赎向下抹掉后面权益的方向相反。

opts.t: The first mortgage must be paid first, because redemption and foreclosure both start with the earliest registration.
opts.w: 错误。这是顺位与赎回方向记反。登记在先的优先受偿，但借款人赎回不是从第一按揭开始。先碰最高顺位、跳过更低的负担，不符合赎上。

opts.t: Any one of the four may be paid first. Registration order decides sale proceeds, not the order of redemption.
opts.w: 错误。这是顺位与赎回方向记反，把分配顺序当成可以随意赎回。登记先后决定优先权，但赎回顺序是从最低顺位往上，不能任选一份先赎。

opts.t: The most recently signed mortgage must be paid first, even if it was registered before the other three.
opts.w: 错误。这是顺位与赎回方向记反，改用了签约日。顺位看的是申请登记的先后，不是合同签订日或放款日。赎回仍从登记顺位的最低一级往上。

variants.stem: A borrower runs a fuel station. The mortgage itself requires the borrower to buy fuel only from a source the lender names, and the clause is written to keep operating after the land is redeemed. The parties did not make that supply arrangement as a separate contract. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 借款人经营一座加油站。按揭本身要求借款人只能向贷款人指定的来源进油，而且该条款写明在土地赎回之后仍然有效。双方没有把这份供货安排做成另一份合同。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The clause remains valid after redemption, because a supply term is never treated as part of the mortgage.
opts.w: 错误。这是设卡看错对象，把附带利益一律当成独立交易。判断标准是双方当时的真实意图。本题写明它是按揭本身的条款，不是各自独立的一笔交易。

opts.t: The clause is valid only if it changes the interest rate. A collateral advantage that leaves the rate untouched can run forever.
opts.w: 错误。这是设卡看错对象，改用利率来判断。附带利益条款（collateral advantage）在赎回后是否仍然有效，取决于它是按揭条款还是独立交易，不取决于它有没有改利率。

opts.t: The clause fails where it is truly a term of the mortgage and it continues after redemption. That is a clog in another form.
opts.w: 正确。附带利益条款（collateral advantage）如果是按揭本身的条款，又持续到赎回之后仍然有效，就会被判无效，等于变相设卡。本题没有把它做成与按揭各自独立的交易，所以赎回之后继续约束借款人这一段不能成立。

opts.t: The clause fails from the first day of the loan, because a lender may not take any collateral advantage before redemption.
opts.w: 错误。这是设卡看错对象，把无效的时点提前了。问题出在赎回之后仍然有效。作为按揭条款的附带利益，不是从贷款第一天起就全部无效。

variants.stem: An exam item marked course manual describes an individual who borrows for household expenses at an effective annual rate over sixty percent. A classmate marks the loan lawful, because a business band sits higher and a still larger principal has no ceiling. Which statement is the exam answer?
variants.zh: 一道标明课程手册的题目写道：一名个人为家庭开支借款，有效年利率超过60%。同学把这笔贷款标成合法，理由是商业贷款有一档更高的上限，更大的本金则没有上限。按考试口径，哪一项正确？

opts.t: The classmate is right. The manual adopts the higher business band for every borrower, so a rate over sixty percent is still lawful.
opts.w: 错误。这是用现行红线答卷面。更高的商业档和无上限档不是课程手册的内容，也不能用到这名个人的家庭开支借款上。手册的红线就是有效年利率超过60%。

opts.t: The classmate is right on the exam and wrong only in practice. The manual has already replaced sixty percent with the later business bands.
opts.w: 错误。这是用现行红线答卷面，还把手册说成已经改写。考试口径仍是超过60%的有效年利率。商业档是现行条例，不是这道题的得分句。

opts.t: The classmate is wrong. On this item a rate over sixty percent effective annual is the criminal rate, and the business bands are not the manual's test.
opts.w: 正确。这名个人的家庭借款按课程手册已经超过60%有效年利率（effective annual rate），应当认定为犯罪利率，商业档不是手册的判断标准。现行法自2025-01-01起以年百分率超过35%为红线，自然人的消费借款也进不了商业例外，但不能用那一套改这道题的答案。

opts.t: The classmate is wrong only because a household loan is criminal at any rate once the borrower is an individual.
opts.w: 错误。这是用现行红线答卷面，把个人借款说成任何利率都犯罪。考试口径不是个人即犯罪，而是有效年利率有没有超过60%。没超过这条线的个人借款，手册并不把它写成犯罪利率。

variants.stem: A candidate is told to answer from the course manual. The candidate wants to select the statement that a registered mortgage is a charge whether or not the document uses words of transfer. The item asks for the manual's mainstream view. Which statement is the exam answer?
variants.zh: 考生被要求按课程手册作答。考生想选这一句：已登记按揭是一项押记，不论文件里有没有使用转让字样。题目问的是手册的主流观点。按考试口径，哪一项正确？

opts.t: Reject that selection on this item. The manual's mainstream view is that a mortgage retains the common-law character of a transfer.
opts.w: 正确。题目要手册的主流观点，就答按揭仍保留普通法上的转让性质。现行《土地产权法》第231(1)条才写明登记按揭首先是押记、不论有没有转让字样，这一句不能填进这道题。

opts.t: Accept that selection. The manual is written as a charge, and it denies any character of a transfer.
opts.w: 错误。这是用现行定性答卷面。押记是现行法第231(1)条的定性，不是手册的主流观点。手册保留的是转让性质。

opts.t: Accept that selection only when the document avoids the word transfer. If it says transfer, the manual makes the lender the registered owner.
opts.w: 错误。这是用现行定性答卷面，又加了一层登记簿改名。手册的主流观点不取决于文件里有没有转让字样，也没有把贷款人写成注册所有人。现行法第231(1)条同样说，不论有没有转让字样，效果首先是押记。

opts.t: Reject every characterisation. The manual says a mortgage is not an interest in land, so neither transfer nor charge can be marked.
opts.w: 错误。手册否认的是按揭等于贷款本身，不是否认土地上的权益。转让性质和押记都是在描述那份土地权益，不能答成土地上什么都没有。

variants.trap: 两种卖方融资当成同一种
variants.stem: A buyer under an agreement for sale wants proof of being the registered owner so a new mortgage can be granted before the last instalment is paid. The seller is still shown as the owner. The buyer's right to purchase is already on title as a charge. Which statement matches the course?
variants.zh: 分期付款合约的买家想证明自己已经是登记所有人，以便在付清最后一期之前再办一份新按揭。卖方的名字仍在所有人栏。买家的购买权已经作为押记登在产权上。哪一项符合课程？

opts.t: The buyer is already the registered owner. A charge called a right to purchase is another name for a transfer of the fee simple.
opts.w: 错误。这是两种卖方融资当成同一种。购买权（right to purchase）是买家权益的押记，不是完全所有权已经过户。登记所有人仍然是卖方。

opts.t: The buyer became the registered owner when the charge was filed. Filing that charge is the transfer of the fee simple.
opts.w: 错误。这是两种卖方融资当成同一种，把 Form C 当成了过户。这份登记是买家的购买权押记。完全所有权要等最后一期付清，才由卖方过户。

opts.t: The seller's name on title is a mistake. In every instalment sale the buyer is the registered owner from the first payment.
opts.w: 错误。这是两种卖方融资当成同一种，把卖方分期融资的结果套了过来。买家先拿到完全所有权，是 take-back 的结构。agreement for sale 故意把卖方留在登记所有人的位置上。

opts.t: The buyer is not the registered owner yet. That interest is only a charge until the last payment, when the seller transfers title.
opts.w: 正确。agreement for sale 里卖方全程是登记所有人，买家的权益是一份押记，付清最后一期才过户。卖方分期融资（vendor take-back mortgage）才是买家先拿完全所有权、卖方再登记按揭。

variants.stem: A seller will carry part of the price because the buyer is a weaker credit. The take-back rate is higher than the current market rate. The rest of the price is cash. Which statement describes the cash-equivalent price of this offer?
variants.zh: 因为买方信用较弱，卖方愿意借出一部分房价，而且要求的利率高于当前市场利率。其余房价以现金支付。这份报价的现金等价价格应当如何描述？

opts.t: It is below the stated price, because any loan from the seller is a concession to the buyer.
opts.w: 错误。这是折价溢价方向记反。合同利率高于市场利率时，买方在多付利息，不是在拿优惠。折价只在合同利率低于市场利率时出现。

opts.t: It equals the stated price, because a higher contract rate does not change the principal the seller will receive.
opts.w: 错误。这是把将来收回的面值当成现在的经济价值。利率更高时，这串还款按市场利率折现的现值高于面值，表面成交价没有把这份风险补偿算进去。

opts.t: It is the cash down payment alone, because an above-market loan has no market value.
opts.w: 错误。高于市场的贷款仍有市场价值，而且高于其面值。现金等价价格要把现金首付和按揭的市场价值加在一起，不能把回按当成零。

opts.t: It is above the stated price. The buyer is paying a risk premium, so the loan's present value exceeds its face.
