opts.t: Whether the licensee can personally issue a formal audit opinion on the solvency of both companies.
opts.w: 持牌人的角色是看懂报表、知道该问什么问题，具体的财务健康判断与审计意见应转介给会计师等专业人士，持牌人不能替代专业意见。

checks.pt: 回答卖家不给正式报表或经纪行获批核编报告时的正确应对
checks.stem: A managing broker informs a newly licensed representative that BCFSA has approved the brokerage to submit a compilation engagement report instead of a review engagement this year. What does this approval indicate?
checks.zh: 管理经纪告知一名新持牌代表，BCFSA 今年已批准该经纪行提交核编报告（compilation engagement report），以代替原来的会计师核阅（review engagement）。这项批准意味着什么？

opts.t: The brokerage has triggered regulatory intervention under s.76 because its current liabilities exceeded its current assets.
opts.w: 流动负债超过流动资产会触发监管介入，而不是获得降级为核编报告的批准；获批核编报告恰恰要求每年年末流动资产大于流动负债。

opts.t: The brokerage is now permanently exempt from keeping trust records that distinguish its own money from client money.
opts.w: 任何经纪行都必须遵守 Rules s.79(2) 区分自身款项与代管款项的记录要求，且一旦财务状况恶化，监管长官可随时根据 s.75(6) 撤销核编报告授权。

opts.t: The brokerage is a publicly accountable enterprise that has switched from ASPE to mandatory IFRS.
opts.w: 上市公司（公开问责实体）不仅强制适用 IFRS，而且其财务报表必须经过审计（audit），不能降级为确信水平最低的核编报告。

opts.t: It met the conditions for 3 straight years, with no major trust or record problems and current assets above current liabilities.
opts.w: 根据 Rules s.75(3)，连续 3 个会计年度合规、期间没有重大信托账户或账簿异常、且每年年末流动资产都大于流动负债的经纪行，可获批将核阅报告降级为核编报告（compilation engagement report）。

checks.pt: 回答考试口径与现行规则在年报、信托及双轨准则上的异同
checks.stem: When comparing the 2020 course manual with current BC rules and Canadian accounting standards for this chapter, which statement is accurate?
checks.zh: 将本章的 2020 版考试考试口径与现行 BC 监管规则及加拿大会计准则相比，以下哪项表述是准确的？

opts.t: The dual-track GAAP structure (IFRS for publicly accountable enterprises and ASPE for private enterprises) has been abolished and merged into a single tax code.
opts.w: 加拿大准则制定机构 AcSB 现行仍原样维持自 2011 年起的 IFRS 与 ASPE 双轨体系，并未合并或废止，此处考试口径没有过时。

opts.t: The IFRS/ASPE dual track is unchanged, but current rules add brokerage trust separation and 120-day annual filing duties the manual omits.
opts.w: 考试口径关于 GAAP 自 2011 年分 IFRS 与 ASPE 两轨的内容原样现行；而现行 RESA s.26/s.27（信托账户代管款不属于经纪行自身资产）及 Rules s.75/s.76（年度后 120 天内报送报表及负债超标触发监管介入）则是考试口径未提及但执业必备的现行规则。

opts.t: The course manual requires client deposit funds held in a brokerage trust account to be recorded as the brokerage's own current assets on its balance sheet.
opts.w: 无论按会计主体假设还是现行 RESA s.26/s.27 与 Rules s.79(2)，信托账户中代客户持有的资金都不属于经纪行自己的资产。

opts.t: Current BC rules allow a brokerage to operate without filing financial statements unless its total liabilities exceed total assets.
opts.w: 现行 Rules s.75(1) 要求每家经纪行每年在会计年度结束后 120 天内都必须报送财务报表；总负债超过总资产是 Rules s.76(1)(c) 触发监管介入的情形，而非免报条件。

checks.pt: 法定线与自律线分别管谁、由谁执法、冲突时听谁的
checks.stem: Marcus holds a BC trading services licence but has chosen not to join the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA) or any local real estate board. When Marcus provides real estate services to a seller, which ethical and regulatory framework governs his conduct?
checks.zh: Marcus 持有 BC 省交易服务牌照，但选择不加入加拿大地产协会（CREA）或任何本地地产局。当 Marcus 为卖方提供地产服务时，哪一套伦理与监管框架管辖他的行为？

opts.t: He is governed solely by the REALTOR® Code because it sets the universal ethical baseline for all licence holders in Canada.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。地产经纪守则（REALTOR® Code）属于自律线，只约束自愿加入的加拿大地产协会（CREA）会员，并不适用于未入会的持牌人。

opts.t: He is bound by RESA and the Rules, which BCFSA enforces against every licensee whether or not they belong to a board.
opts.w: 正确。BC 地产伦理的法定线由《地产服务法》（RESA）与《地产服务规则》（Real Estate Services Rules）构成，由 BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）执法，覆盖每一个持牌人（every licensee），无论其是否为 REALTOR®。

opts.t: He operates outside statutory conduct rules until he voluntarily signs a compliance undertaking with the local real estate board.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。法定线是强制性的，只要持有牌照就自动受《地产服务法》（RESA）与 Rules 约束，不需要跟本地地产局签自愿承诺。

opts.t: He is subject to both the REALTOR® Code and RESA, and where the two conflict, the stricter provisions of the REALTOR® Code override the statute.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。首先 Marcus 不是会员不受守则管辖；其次即便对会员而言，守则义务虽可高于法律，但与法律冲突时永远以法律为准（the law prevails）。

checks.pt: 考试资料旧口径与现行制度在八个高频考点上的差异
checks.stem: According to the course manual, the Standards of Business Practice in the REALTOR® Code contain 28 articles. How does the current version of the REALTOR® Code compare to the manual's description?
checks.zh: 根据课程考试口径，REALTOR® Code 中的业务操守准则（Standards of Business Practice）共有 28 条。现行版本的 REALTOR® Code 与考试资料描述相比有何变化？

opts.t: It now contains 30 articles, having added an article binding REALTORS® acting as principals and an article establishing a duty of cooperation.
opts.w: 正确。考试口径为 28 条（2009-07-01 版），而现行业务操守准则（Standards of Business Practice）已扩充为 30 条：新增了第 29 条（以本人身份 principal 交易时仍受守则约束）和第 30 条（合作义务 duty of cooperation）。

opts.t: It was reduced to 20 articles after statutory duties under the Real Estate Services Rules replaced all conflict-of-interest provisions.
opts.w: 编造数字陷阱。守则并没有因为法定规则的出台而缩减到 20 条，而是从考试口径的 28 条增加到了现行的 30 条。

opts.t: It still contains exactly 28 articles, because CREA froze all amendments when BCFSA assumed single-regulator authority in 2021.
opts.w: 时效错位陷阱。考试卷面若按旧考试资料问条数答 28 条，但现行守则在 2023 年会通过第 30 条后已变为 30 条，并未在 2021 年冻结修订。

opts.t: It has been replaced entirely by BCFSA's standalone Code of Ethics manual, which all licensees must sign every two years.
opts.w: 概念混淆陷阱。BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）不发布独立的伦理守则文件，且 CREA 的 REALTOR® Code 依然有效并管辖会员。

checks.pt: 持牌人十项法定客户义务与不可协议排除的三条铁底
checks.stem: A brokerage and its client sign a written service agreement under s. 31 of the Real Estate Services Rules that modifies several standard duties listed in s. 30, and the brokerage also practices designated agency under s. 32. Which of the following duties can NEVER be waived or excluded by agreement?
checks.zh: 某经纪行与客户根据《地产服务规则》第 31 条签署书面服务协议，修改了第 30 条列出的若干常规义务，且该经纪行依第 32 条实行指定代理。下列哪一项义务永远不得通过协议放弃或排除？

opts.t: The duty to make reasonable efforts to find out facts relevant to any property the client is thinking of buying.
opts.w: 边界混淆陷阱。合理努力发现相关事实属于 s. 30(h) 的常规义务，可以通过 s. 31 由经纪行与客户书面约定修改或排除，不属于三条铁底。

opts.t: The duty to pass every offer on to the client promptly, objectively and without bias, with no exception.
opts.w: 边界混淆陷阱。转达要约属于 s. 30(g) 的义务，在特定协议安排下可依 s. 31 修改，不在 s. 31 与 s. 32 规定的三条不可修改铁底之内。

opts.t: The duty not to reveal the client's confidential information to anyone unless the client allows it or law requires it.
opts.w: 正确。无论依 s. 31 修改义务还是依 s. 32 采用指定代理（designated agency），有三件事永远改不掉：经纪行的监督责任、除非客户授权或法律要求不得泄露客户机密信息（confidential information），以及对所有客户利益一视同仁、客观公正。

opts.t: The duty to recommend that the client get independent expert advice on issues beyond the licensee's own expertise.
opts.w: 边界混淆陷阱。建议寻求独立专业意见属于 s. 30(d)，并非 s. 31/s. 32 明文锁死的三条不可排除铁底之一。

checks.pt: 持牌人或关系人买卖物业时核准表格的披露时点与法定内容
checks.stem: Nadia, a trading services representative, is helping her husband purchase a townhome listed by another brokerage. They plan to renovate the unit and resell it within six months, and her husband is already negotiating resale terms with a prospective buyer. Under s. 53 of the Real Estate Services Rules, what must Nadia do?
checks.zh: 持有交易服务代表牌照的 Nadia 正在帮丈夫购买一套由别家经纪行挂牌的联排别墅。他们计划翻新后在六个月内转售，且丈夫已经在与潜在买家商谈转售条款。根据《地产服务规则》第 53 条，Nadia 必须怎么做？

opts.t: Nothing, because she is not acquiring title in her own name and the property is listed by a different brokerage.
opts.w: 落入「关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉」陷阱。Rules s. 53 覆盖关系人（associate），帮配偶买房必须按同一套规则作交易中的利益披露（disclosure of interest in trade）。

opts.t: Insert a one-line clause in the Contract of Purchase and Sale stating that the buyer's spouse holds a real estate licence.
opts.w: 落入「关系人或夹带披露豁免幻觉」陷阱。s. 30(j) 与 s. 53 要求使用 superintendent 核准的独立表格，不能只在买卖合同里夹带一行字。

opts.t: Rely on the s. 97 exemption for licensees trading on their own behalf, provided she waives her share of the buyer agency commission.
opts.w: 条文误引陷阱。s. 97 只适用于仅持有出租物业管理或共管物业管理牌照（rental or strata management only）的人，做买卖代理（trading services）的持牌人不在该豁免射程内。

opts.t: Before any agreement, promptly give an approved-form disclosure of her licensee status, relationship, expected pay, resale plan and resale terms.
opts.w: 正确。Rules s. 53 要求在任何协议签订前立即用 superintendent 核准表格作交易中的利益披露（disclosure of interest in trade），法定内容包括持牌人身份、与关系人的关系、预期报酬、自用还是转售，以及若已在谈转售时的转售条款。

checks.pt: 双重代理禁令、偏远地区唯一例外及指定代理的合法边界
checks.stem: At a residential brokerage, managing broker Owen assigns designated agent Priya to represent the seller of a residential property and designated agent Quentin to represent a buyer making an offer on that same property. Under s. 63 of the Real Estate Services Rules, how is this arrangement classified?
checks.zh: 在某住宅经纪行，管理经纪 Owen 指派指定代理 Priya 代表一套住宅物业的卖方，并指派指定代理 Quentin 代表对该物业出价的买方。根据《地产服务规则》第 63 条，这一安排属于什么性质？

opts.t: It does not constitute dual agency because two different designated agents at the same brokerage are representing the seller and the buyer separately.
opts.w: 正确。根据 Rules s. 63(2)，同一家经纪行的两名指定代理（designated agents）分别代表买卖双方，不构成双重代理（dual agency），在 BC 属于合法的日常操作；只有同一名指定代理同时代表两方才会变成双重代理。

opts.t: It is illegal dual agency unless the property is located in a remote, underserved location and reported to the superintendent under s. 64.
opts.w: 落入「指定代理误判为双重代理」陷阱。两名不同的指定代理分别代表买卖双方根本不是双重代理，无需动用 s. 64 的偏远地区例外。

opts.t: It is permissible only if Owen steps in to act as sole dual agent for both parties and obtains their written consent.
opts.w: 落入「指定代理误判为双重代理」陷阱。让 Owen 一个人同时代表双方反而真成了被 s. 63(1) 禁止的双重代理。

opts.t: It violates s. 65 unless one of the parties agrees to be treated as an unrepresented party before the offer is drafted.
opts.w: 落入「指定代理误判为双重代理」陷阱。既然由两名不同的指定代理各自代表一方，就不存在同一持牌人代表多方客户的冲突，不必把其中一方降为无代理方（unrepresented party）。

checks.pt: 重大隐蔽缺陷的法定定义、披露时点及卖方已书面披露时的例外
checks.stem: Listing representative Elena learns that her seller client's house has a structural foundation crack hidden behind finished drywall that makes the home potentially dangerous. Before any buyer makes an offer, the seller personally provides a full written disclosure of this defect to the prospective buyer. Under s. 59 of the Real Estate Services Rules, what is Elena's obligation?
checks.zh: 挂牌代表 Elena 得知卖方客户的房屋在装修好的石膏板后方有一处结构性地基裂缝，使房屋存在潜在危险。在任何买家出价前，卖方本人已经将该缺陷完整地书面告知了潜在买家。根据《地产服务规则》第 59 条，Elena 的义务是什么？

opts.t: She must still refuse to continue providing trading services because a potentially dangerous property cannot be traded by a licensee.
opts.w: 条文过度延伸陷阱。Rules s. 59(3) 要求停止服务的前提是客户指示你不披露重大隐蔽缺陷（material latent defect）；只要依法披露，有缺陷的物业仍然可以交易。

opts.t: She need not repeat the disclosure, because the seller has already disclosed the defect in writing to the other party.
opts.w: 正确。虽然使物业危险或潜在危险的缺陷属于重大隐蔽缺陷（material latent defect），但根据 Rules s. 59(4)，如果卖方本人已经向对方书面告知（disclosed in writing），持牌人就不必再重复披露一次。

opts.t: She must file an immediate report with the superintendent under s. 64 before the buyer signs the contract.
opts.w: 条文张冠李戴陷阱。向 superintendent 报备是 s. 64 偏远地区双重代理例外的要求，不是 s. 59 重大隐蔽缺陷的程序。

opts.t: She must keep the foundation crack confidential under s. 30(e) and ask the seller to withdraw the written statement.
opts.w: 落入「盲从客户非法指示」同类陷阱。重大隐蔽缺陷依法必须披露，绝不能以保密义务（confidentiality）为由要求撤回披露。

checks.pt: 守则与人权法在公共服务和购房条款中受保护理由的差异
checks.stem: When comparing s. 8 (discrimination in accommodation, service and facility) and s. 9 (discrimination in purchase of property) of the BC Human Rights Code, which two protected grounds are included in s. 8 but omitted from s. 9?
checks.zh: 对比 BC 省《人权法》（Human Rights Code）第 8 条（住宿、服务或设施中的歧视）与第 9 条（购买物业中的歧视），哪两项受保护理由包含在第 8 条中，但未写入第 9 条？

opts.t: Indigenous identity and gender identity or expression.
opts.w: 落入「人权保护理由与适用条文错位」陷阱。原住民身份（Indigenous identity）与性别认同或表达（gender identity or expression）在现行《Human Rights Code》的 s. 8 和 s. 9 中都包含。

opts.t: Religion and marital status.
opts.w: 落入「人权保护理由与适用条文错位」陷阱。宗教（religion）与婚姻状况（marital status）在 s. 8 与 s. 9 两条中均受保护。

opts.t: Family status and age.
opts.w: 正确。《Human Rights Code》s. 8（管面向公众提供的服务，地产服务本身落在此条）包含家庭状况（family status）与年龄（age），而 s. 9（管购买物业）的受保护理由清单中不含 family status 与 age。

opts.t: Physical or mental disability and sexual orientation.
opts.w: 落入「人权保护理由与适用条文错位」陷阱。身体或精神残疾（physical or mental disability）与性取向（sexual orientation）在 s. 8 和 s. 9 中都有列出。

checks.pt: 家庭办公室与广告合规要求及向管理经纪举报的法定义务
checks.stem: Representative Lucas works partly from a home office in his suburban residence and wants to print new marketing flyers. Under s. 37 and s. 40 of the Real Estate Services Rules, which of the following practices is permitted?
checks.zh: 代表 Lucas 部分时间在郊区住宅的家庭办公室工作，并准备印制新的宣传单。根据《地产服务规则》第 37 条与第 40 条，下列哪一种做法是被允许的？

opts.t: Displaying his brokerage's licensed name in a prominent and easily readable manner while listing only his related brokerage office address.
opts.w: 正确。根据 Rules s. 40，广告中必须显著易读地（in a prominent and easily readable manner）标出经纪行的持牌名称，且若列出办公地址必须是关联经纪行办公室的地址；同时符合 s. 37 家庭办公室地址不得出现在任何广告上的规定。

opts.t: Printing his home office street address on the flyers so neighbourhood clients can drop off deposit cheques conveniently.
opts.w: 违反 s. 37 家庭办公室限制。Rules s. 37 明确规定家庭办公室（home office）的地址不得出现在任何地产广告上。

opts.t: Mounting an illuminated exterior brokerage sign on the front lawn of his home office to attract passing traffic.
opts.w: 违反 s. 37 家庭办公室限制。Rules s. 37 规定家庭办公室不得对外挂牌。

opts.t: Hiring a receptionist at his home office to answer the dedicated landline using the name of his brokerage.
opts.w: 违反 s. 37 家庭办公室限制。Rules s. 37 规定家庭办公室的电话不得以经纪行名义接听。

checks.pt: 违反联邦反洗钱义务为何直接构成省法下的执业纪律问题
checks.stem: How does BCFSA treat a licensee's failure to comply with federal anti-money laundering (FINTRAC) obligations, such as Know Your Client (KYC) and beneficial ownership verification?
checks.zh: 如果持牌人未能遵守联邦反洗钱（FINTRAC）义务，例如「了解你的客户」（KYC）与受益所有权核实，BC 金融服务管理局（BCFSA）会如何定性处理？

opts.t: BCFSA has no jurisdiction because FINTRAC rules are federal statutes that can only be enforced by federal tax auditors.
opts.w: 管辖权误解陷阱。虽然 FINTRAC 是联邦机构，但 BCFSA 明确指出违反联邦反洗钱法规的行为可以直接变成《地产服务法》（RESA）之下的执业纪律问题。

opts.t: It is treated strictly as an internal brokerage bookkeeping matter that carries no disciplinary consequences under RESA.
opts.w: 轻视合规后果陷阱。反洗钱在 2026 年已是职业伦理与法定执业义务的一部分，绝非无纪律后果的内部记账事务。

opts.t: Only local real estate boards can penalize anti-money laundering breaches through MLS® suspension.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。反洗钱合规直接关系消费者与公共利益风险，由法定监管方 BCFSA 依 RESA 追究纪律责任。

opts.t: Misconduct under the Rules is broad enough to cover conduct that puts consumers at risk, including federal AML breaches.
opts.w: 正确。BCFSA 明言，Rules 中「不当行为（misconduct）」的措辞足够宽，涵盖任何可能使消费者面临风险的行为，包括违反反洗钱（FINTRAC）、竞争法与反垃圾邮件等联邦法规，可直接构成 RESA 下的执业纪律问题。

checks.pt: 行政罚款六档金额、纪律罚款上限及是否列名开单的判断规则
checks.stem: A licensee fails to make a required disclosure of interest in trade under s. 53 of the Real Estate Services Rules (a Category C contravention under s. 26). What are the prescribed administrative penalty amounts under s. 27 for a first contravention and a subsequent contravention?
checks.zh: 某持牌人未能按《地产服务规则》第 53 条作交易中的利益披露（属于第 26 条点名的 C 档违规）。根据第 27 条，首次违规与再次违规的既定行政罚款金额分别是多少？

opts.t: $1,000 for a first contravention and $2,000 for a subsequent contravention.
opts.w: 档位金额错位陷阱。首次 $1,000、再次 $2,000 是 A 档（记录类违规）的行政罚款（administrative penalty）金额，不是 C 档。

opts.t: $2,500 for a first contravention and $5,000 for a subsequent contravention.
opts.w: 档位金额错位陷阱。首次 $2,500、再次 $5,000 是 B 档（通知类违规）的行政罚款金额。

opts.t: $5,000 for a first contravention and $10,000 for a subsequent contravention.
opts.w: 正确。根据 Rules s. 26–27，s. 30（十项客户义务）、s. 34（谨慎与技能）、s. 53（交易中的利益披露）、s. 55、s. 56、s. 57.1 与 s. 65 均属于 C 档行政罚款（administrative penalty），首次违规罚 $5,000，再次违规罚 $10,000。

opts.t: $250,000 for an individual licensee and $500,000 for a brokerage.
opts.w: 行政罚款与纪律罚款混淆陷阱。$250,000 与 $500,000 是《地产服务法》（RESA）s. 43(2) 纪律处分令（discipline order）的罚款上限，而行政罚款（administrative penalty）C 档是 $5,000 / $10,000（总上限 $100,000）。

checks.pt: 同业关系规范、佣金争议仲裁及公开推广的合作上架义务
checks.stem: Under Article 30 of the current REALTOR® Code and the accompanying REALTOR® Cooperation Policy (effective January 3, 2024), what must a REALTOR® do when publicly marketing a residential property for sale?
checks.zh: 根据现行 REALTOR® Code 第 30 条及配套的《REALTOR® 合作政策》（2024 年 1 月 3 日生效），当 REALTOR® 向公众公开推广一套待售住宅物业时，必须怎么做？

opts.t: Obtain written permission from the superintendent before posting any public advertisement.
opts.w: 落入「自律与法定权限混同」陷阱。第 30 条合作政策（REALTOR® Cooperation Policy）是 CREA 的行业自律规则，不需要向 BCFSA 的 superintendent 申请广告许可。

opts.t: List it on the MLS® system within the local board's adopted period, at most three days, unless an exemption applies.
opts.w: 正确。根据第 30 条及《REALTOR® 合作政策》（REALTOR® Cooperation Policy），一旦对公众推广某住宅物业出售，就须在本地地产局采纳的期限内（最长三天，up to three days）把挂牌放上 MLS® 系统（除非落入豁免）；而不公开推广的独家私售（exclusive）仍被允许。

opts.t: Refuse all exclusive non-public listings, because the policy bans off-market agreements entirely.
opts.w: 规则过度解读陷阱。合作政策只针对「向公众公开推广（publicly marketed）」的住宅物业，不公开推广的「独家私售（exclusive）」仍然可以做，并未被禁止。

opts.t: Share 50% of the listing commission with every brokerage in the local board regardless of who brings the buyer.
opts.w: 无中生有陷阱。合作义务要求按时上 MLS® 并与同业合作，从未规定不论谁带买家都要向全地产局平分 50% 佣金。

checks.pt: 一笔普通交易中从开口表明身份到递交要约的七个法定披露动作
checks.stem: When a buyer's agent presents an offer to a seller, s. 57 of the Real Estate Services Rules requires a disclosure of remuneration in an approved form. How must cash remuneration be stated on this form?
checks.zh: 当买方代理向卖方呈交购买要约时，《地产服务规则》第 57 条要求使用核准表格作报酬披露。以现金支付的报酬在该表格上必须如何表述？

opts.t: It may be stated purely as a percentage of the final purchase price without a dollar figure.
opts.w: 违反 s. 57 明文规定。Rules s. 57 明确要求以现金支付的报酬不能只写百分比（cannot state only a percentage）。

opts.t: It only needs to show the net amount retained by the listing brokerage, omitting the cooperating brokerage's share.
opts.w: 披露残缺陷阱。s. 57 要求同时写明卖方付给挂牌经纪行多少、挂牌经纪行付给合作经纪行多少、挂牌经纪行自己留多少，以及依 s. 56(1)(a) 预期收到的任何报酬。

opts.t: It must be stated as a specific dollar amount, not merely as a percentage.
opts.w: 正确。根据 Rules s. 57，向卖方呈交要约作报酬披露（disclosure of remuneration）时，以现金支付的报酬必须写成具体金额（specific dollar amount），不能只写百分比。

opts.t: It is required only if the licensee is also receiving a referral fee from a mortgage broker under s. 56.
opts.w: 条件缩水陷阱。s. 57 的递交要约报酬披露适用于向卖方呈交要约的常规情形，并非只有收到按揭转介费（s. 56）时才触发。

checks.pt: 不具名买家、两买家抢房与卖方瞒市政通知三大真题解法
checks.stem: Representative Victor represents a seller client, Ms. Patel. A buyer's agent submits an all-cash offer on behalf of an unnamed corporate buyer and asks Victor not to tell Ms. Patel who controls the buyer entity. Victor discovers that the buyer is a neighbouring land developer assembling adjacent lots for a high-rise project. What must Victor do?
checks.zh: 代表 Victor 为卖方客户 Patel 女士挂牌。一位买方代理代表一位未具名的企业买家提交全现金要约，并要求 Victor 不要告诉 Patel 女士谁控制该买方实体。Victor 随后发现买家其实是隔壁正在整合相邻地块准备建高层项目的开发商。Victor 必须怎么做？

opts.t: Keep the developer's identity confidential to ensure the cash offer closes smoothly for Ms. Patel.
opts.w: 保密对象错位陷阱。Victor 的客户是卖方 Patel 女士，他对买方没有保密义务（no duty of confidentiality to the buyer）；隐瞒买家身份会违反 s. 30(a) 最佳利益与 s. 33 诚实义务。

opts.t: Tell Ms. Patel who the buyer is and why, since it is material to her and he owes the buyer no confidentiality.
opts.w: 正确。在「不具名买家（undisclosed purchaser）」整合地块的场景中，买家身份对卖方属于重大信息（material information），Rules s. 30(f) 要求必须向客户披露；且挂牌代表不是买方的持牌人，对买方不负有保密义务。

opts.t: Say nothing to either party and immediately resign from the transaction under s. 59(3).
opts.w: 条文误用陷阱。s. 59(3) 停止服务适用于卖方客户指示隐瞒重大隐蔽缺陷，而本案是向卖方客户履行 s. 30(f) 披露重大信息的正面义务。

opts.t: Wait until Ms. Patel accepts the offer and then mention the developer's identity on the completion date.
opts.w: 迟延披露陷阱。买家正在整合地块会直接影响卖方对物业价值与谈判筹码的判断，签约后再说已违反 s. 30(a) 最佳利益与 s. 30(f) 披露已知重大信息的义务。

checks.pt: 合同成立需要哪七个要素，以及四种瑕疵状态各自的法律后果是什么
checks.stem: A party enters into an agreement that contains all seven essential elements of a contract, but a procedural defect prevents either party from suing in court to force performance. How does contract law classify this agreement?
checks.zh: 当事人订立了一份具备合同全部七大要素的协议，但因某项程序性缺陷导致任何一方都无法向法院起诉强制对方履行。合同法如何归类这份协议？

opts.t: Void from the outset, meaning neither party ever acquired any legal rights.
opts.w: 无效（void）指合同从一开始就没存在过（如欠缺实质要素或共同错误），而非具备全部要素却因程序性理由无法起诉，这是「把不可执行当成无效」的常见陷阱。

opts.t: Unenforceable, meaning the contract itself is not void but cannot be enforced by legal action.
opts.w: 当合同具备全部七个要素，仅因程序性理由（procedural defect）不能上法院起诉强制履行时，该合同属于不可执行（unenforceable），合同本身并不算无效。

opts.t: Voidable at the option of the party who discovered the procedural defect.
opts.w: 可撤销（voidable）是指至少一方有权选择撤销或继续履行（如受胁迫或虚假陈述），在撤销前依然可以强制执行，与程序性阻碍导致无法起诉不同。

opts.t: Illegal, meaning the court will refuse to assist either party in recovering money paid.
opts.w: 非法（illegal）针对违反公共政策或制定法的合同，题干明确指出全部七要素（含合法目的）均已具备，仅存在程序性缺陷。

checks.pt: 口头土地合同为何不可执行，以及成文法认可哪三条可执行路径
checks.stem: Under the exam rule based on Section 59 of the Law and Equity Act, what is the general consequence if a contract respecting land is made orally without any written record or act of part performance?
checks.zh: 根据基于《衡平法》第 59 条的考试口径规则，如果一份涉及土地的合同仅以口头达成，既无任何书面记录也无部分履行等确认行为，一般后果是什么？

opts.t: The agreement is illegal and both parties face statutory penalties.
opts.w: 口头达成土地买卖并不违反刑法或公共政策，不属于非法（illegal）合同，只是不满足成文法上的程序性证明要求。

opts.t: The agreement is completely void as if the parties had never spoken.
opts.w: 考试常见陷阱是把欠缺书面形式当成无效（void）；实际上口头土地合同本身并非无效，而是不可执行（unenforceable）。

opts.t: The agreement is unenforceable in court for lack of required formality.
opts.w: 依《衡平法》（Law and Equity Act）第 59 条的考试口径，涉及土地的合同一般须以书面形式作出，否则属于不可执行（unenforceable）；现行第 59(3) 条还允许通过行为确认（如收付定金）或不利变更依赖路径执行，但本题题干已排除这些情形。

opts.t: The agreement is automatically converted into an option agreement.
opts.w: 选择权合同（option agreement）需要专门约定并支付独立对价以锁住要约，口头土地合同不会自动转化为选择权合同。

checks.pt: 挂牌标价算不算要约、谁有资格接受要约、怎样才能真正锁住要约
checks.stem: A seller posts a property on the listing system at a price of $780,000. A prospective buyer immediately sends a written statement saying, 'I accept your offer of $780,000.' Has a binding contract been formed?
checks.zh: 卖方在挂牌系统上以 $780,000 的价格挂出一处房产。一位潜在买家立即发来书面声明说：「我接受你 $780,000 的要约。」双方之间是否成立了有约束力的合同？

opts.t: No, because a property listing is an invitation to treat, and the buyer's statement is actually the offer.
opts.w: 房源在挂牌系统上标价属于邀请磋商（invitation to treat），只是邀请对方来出价，本身不能被接受成合同；买方的出价才是要约（offer），卖方仍握有是否接受的主动权。

opts.t: Yes, because a listing is a standing offer open to the first member of the public who accepts it.
opts.w: 挂牌标价、报纸广告和橱窗展示通常都是邀请磋商，而不是面向公众发出的悬赏要约（standing offer）。

opts.t: Yes, provided the buyer delivers the statement in writing to satisfy the Law and Equity Act.
opts.w: 即便买方采用了书面形式，由于卖方的挂牌只是邀请磋商而非要约，没有卖方的承诺（acceptance）就不可能成立合同。

opts.t: No, because an offer for land cannot be accepted without first signing an option agreement.
opts.w: 选择权合同（option agreement）只用于锁住要约使其在期限内不可撤回，并不是普通地产买卖合同成立的前置条件。

checks.pt: 即时通讯与邮寄承诺分别几时生效，以及反要约与单纯询问的区别
checks.stem: A seller offers to sell a townhouse for $700,000. Before deciding, the buyer asks the seller's licensee, 'Is there any room to negotiate on the bottom-line price?' The seller replies, 'No.' The buyer then immediately accepts the $700,000 offer before it expires. What is the legal result?
checks.zh: 卖方提出以 $700,000 出售一套联排别墅。在作决定前，买方问卖方持牌人：「你的底价还有商量空间吗？」卖方回答：「没有。」买方随后在要约到期前立即接受了 $700,000 的要约。法律后果是什么？

opts.t: No contract is formed because asking about the price constituted a counter-offer that terminated the $700,000 offer.
opts.w: 改动了条款的回复才是反要约（counter-offer）；买方只是试探询问是否有商量空间，没有提出新条款，不会杀死原要约。

opts.t: A binding contract is formed because a mere inquiry does not terminate the original offer.
opts.w: 单纯问一句「你的底价还有商量空间吗」属于询问（inquiry），不会终止原要约；只要原要约尚未到期或被撤回，买方依然可以有效接受（acceptance）。

opts.t: No contract is formed because the seller's reply of 'No' operated as a revocation of the $700,000 offer.
opts.w: 卖方回答「没有商量空间」只是拒绝降价，并非传达撤回（revocation）原 $700,000 要约的意思表示。

opts.t: A binding contract is formed only if the seller re-signs the offer to revive it after the inquiry.
opts.w: 由于单纯询问（inquiry）从未终止原要约，原要约一直有效存在，不需要卖方重新签字「复活」。

checks.pt: 对价需不需要等价、过去的对价算不算数及无对价何时有效
checks.stem: A homeowner's neighbour voluntarily clears fallen branches from the homeowner's driveway while the homeowner is away. Upon returning, the grateful homeowner promises to pay the neighbour for the work done, but later refuses to pay. Why is the homeowner's promise unenforceable?
checks.zh: 房主外出期间，邻居自发帮房主清理了车道上的落枝。房主回来后十分感激，口头许诺给邻居一笔报酬，但后来拒绝支付。为什么房主的承诺不可强制执行？

opts.t: Because the neighbour's act was performed before the promise was made and constitutes past consideration.
opts.w: 如果对方的付出发生在许诺付款之前，事后再补一句给钱的承诺属于过去的对价（past consideration），在法律上不算有效对价（consideration），因此不能强制执行。

opts.t: Because courts always review whether the promised payment matches the market value of the service.
opts.w: 法院不审查对价是否划算或等价，只要有法律认可的价值交换即可；本案失效的原因是对价发生在过去，而非金额不对等。

opts.t: Because the homeowner affixed a corporate stamp rather than a red adhesive legal seal.
opts.w: 题干中房主只是事后口头许诺，并未涉及公司印章或法律印鉴（seal），失效的根本原因是过去的对价不算数。

opts.t: Because quantum meruit prohibits any payment whenever the parties did not sign a written contract first.
opts.w: Quantum meruit（合理补偿）恰恰用于在一方请求服务但未约定具体金额时补足合理报酬，而本案是邻居事先自发行为，属于过去的对价。

checks.pt: 未成年人与心智失能者签的合同效力如何，以及授权书何时失效
checks.stem: Before moving abroad, a property owner signs a general power of attorney (not an enduring power of attorney) authorizing a friend to sell her land and register the transfer. Under Section 56 of the Land Title Act, for how long is this power of attorney valid for land title registration purposes?
checks.zh: 在移居海外前，一位业主签署了一份一般授权书（非持久授权书），授权朋友出售其土地并办理过户登记。依《土地产权法》第 56 条，这份授权书在用于土地登记目的时的有效期是多久？

opts.t: One year from the date the principal leaves the province.
opts.w: 「一年」是《未成年人法》（Infants Act）中成年后履行或反悔的期限，不是《土地产权法》关于一般授权书有效期的规定。

opts.t: Three years from the date of its execution, unless it is an enduring power of attorney.
opts.w: 依《土地产权法》（Land Title Act）第 56 条，涉及地产登记的一般授权书（power of attorney）自签署之日起三年（3 years）内有效，而持久授权书（enduring power of attorney）不受这三年限制。

opts.t: Nineteen years, matching the statutory age of majority in British Columbia.
opts.w: 19 岁是 BC 省的法定成年年龄（age of majority），与授权书在土地登记处的有效期限无关。

opts.t: Indefinitely, even if the principal later loses mental capacity or goes bankrupt.
opts.w: 一般授权书不仅受土地登记三年期限限制，而且按普通法规则，一旦授权人丧失行为能力或破产便会失效（持久授权书才在失能后继续有效）。

checks.pt: 合同目的违法时，知情参与的一方能不能找法院追回已付的钱
checks.stem: A buyer and a seller knowingly structure a side agreement for an illegal purpose that violates a federal taxing statute, and the buyer pays an advance sum under that arrangement. When the seller backs out, how will a court treat the buyer's claim to recover the money?
checks.zh: 买方与卖方明知故犯地签订了一份旨在违反联邦税法的非法附带协议，买方按该安排预付了一笔款项。当卖方反悔时，法院会如何处理买方追回该笔款项的诉求？

opts.t: The court will enforce the agreement as long as it was executed under a personal seal.
opts.w: 加盖印鉴（seal）只能替代对价（consideration），不能使缺少合法目的（legal object）的非法合同变成合法有效。

opts.t: The court will treat the contract as merely voidable and allow the buyer to affirm it.
opts.w: 违反制定法或公共政策的合同属于非法（illegal）且通常无效，并非由一方选择是否继续履行的可撤销（voidable）合同。

opts.t: The court may refuse to help a party who knowingly joined the illegal deal recover the money paid.
opts.w: 合同必须具备合法目的（legal object）；对于违反制定法或公共政策的非法（illegal）合同，法院有权拒绝帮助明知违法仍参与其中的一方追回已经交出去的钱或财产。

opts.t: The court will award quantum meruit so that neither party suffers a financial loss.
opts.w: 法律不会替非法交易兜底，更不会用合理补偿（quantum meruit）去保护明知故犯规避法规的当事人。

checks.pt: 意见与事实陈述的界线、无心与故意虚假陈述的救济差异及缺陷披露
checks.stem: During an open house, a buyer asks the seller why the neighbours' house next door is vacant. Knowing that a notorious crime recently occurred next door and that the buyer is concerned about neighbourhood history, the seller gives an evasive, selective answer about why he is moving in order to mislead the buyer. Which statement is correct?
checks.zh: 在开放看房期间，买方问卖方隔壁邻居家为什么空置。卖方明知隔壁最近发生过恶性案件且买方很介意周边历史，却用含糊、有选择性的说辞解释自己搬家的原因以误导买方。下列哪项表述正确？

opts.t: Because a neighbourhood event is a stigma rather than a physical defect, the seller is free to give misleading answers when asked.
opts.w: 虽然污名事件通常不要求主动披露，但一旦买方主动问起，卖方与代理绝不能撒谎或用半真半假的说辞误导买方。

opts.t: Misleading the buyer through selective or evasive statements when asked can constitute fraudulent misrepresentation.
opts.w: 污名事件本身通常不算物业缺陷，卖方一般无须主动披露；但如果买方主动问起，通过含糊或有选择性的说辞误导买方，本身就可能构成欺诈性/故意虚假陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）。

opts.t: A neighbourhood crime is automatically classified as a patent defect under caveat emptor.
opts.w: 明显缺陷（patent defect）是指房屋本身肉眼可见或合理检查能发现的物理问题，周边发生过的社会事件属于污名事件而非明显物理缺陷。

opts.t: The standard exclusion clause in the contract of purchase and sale will shield the seller from liability for deliberate deception.
opts.w: 标准买卖合同里的排除条款（exclusion clause）只能挡住无心虚假陈述（innocent misrepresentation），绝对挡不住故意虚假陈述（fraudulent misrepresentation）。

checks.pt: 共同、相互、单方错误与胁迫、不当影响、显失公平各自的后果
checks.stem: A seller and a buyer sign a contract for the sale of a remote timber cabin. Unbeknownst to both of them, a wildfire had completely destroyed the cabin the night before they signed. How does contract law classify this situation?
checks.zh: 卖方与买方签署了一份出售偏远林区木屋的合同。双方都不知道的是，就在签约前一天晚上，一场山火已经把木屋彻底烧毁了。合同法如何归类这种情形？

opts.t: Frustration, which discharges future obligations arising after the contract was formed.
opts.w: 合同落空（frustration）是指「订约之后、履行之前」发生双方无法控制的事件导致标的物毁损；本题中木屋在签约前就已经灭失了。

opts.t: Mutual mistake, because each party was thinking of a different cabin.
opts.w: 相互错误（mutual mistake）是双方各自犯了不同的错误（如谈论两套不同的物业）；本题双方指向同一栋木屋，只是共同误以为它还存在。

opts.t: Common mistake, which makes the contract void because both shared the belief that the cabin existed.
opts.w: 当双方犯了同一个错误——都以为交易标的物在签约时还存在、其实早已灭失，属于共同错误（common mistake），合同自始无效（void）。

opts.t: Unilateral mistake under non est factum, making the contract voidable by the seller.
opts.w: 单方错误（unilateral mistake）是只有一方犯错而另一方明知却不纠正，non est factum 则是不知道自己签的是什么文件，均与双方共同不知标的物已灭失不符。

checks.pt: 合同终止的五种方式、先决条件的单方放弃要件及违约轻重之分
checks.stem: A standard real estate contract includes the clause 'time is of the essence.' On the scheduled completion date, the buyer fails to tender the purchase funds on time. How does the law treat this clause and the buyer's delay?
checks.zh: 一份标准地产买卖合同包含「时间是要素」条款。在约定的完成日当天，买方未能按时支付购房款。法律如何看待这一条款及买方的延误？

opts.t: The clause makes completion time a condition, so the delay lets the innocent party end the contract and sue.
opts.w: 「时间是要素」（time is of the essence）把完成日期变成了触及合同根本的条件（condition），哪怕迟延完成都构成违反条件，无辜方有权选择终止合同并索赔损害赔偿（damages）。

opts.t: The clause is merely a warranty, meaning the seller must still complete the transfer and can only claim minor interest.
opts.w: 保证（warranty）是不触及合同根本的次要条款，违反了不能终止合同；而「时间是要素」明确将按时完成提升为条件（condition）。

opts.t: The delay triggers frustration, automatically releasing both parties without any liability for damages.
opts.w: 合同落空（frustration）必须是由双方都无法控制的外部事件导致标的物毁损或合同性质根本改变，买方自身未按时付款属于违约（breach）而非落空。

opts.t: The buyer can unilaterally waive the completion date under Section 54 of the Law and Equity Act.
opts.w: 《衡平法》第 54 条的单方放弃只适用于仅为放弃方单方利益设立的条件先决条款（condition precedent），按时交割付款的义务对双方都重要，买方无权单方免除。

checks.pt: 损害赔偿与特定履行的适用边界，以及法定转让与代为履行的区别
checks.stem: A general contractor signs a contract with a landowner to pour a standard concrete driveway, and then hires a qualified subcontractor to carry out the pouring work. Shortly afterward, the concrete cracks due to poor workmanship. Under the principle of vicarious performance, who is legally liable to the landowner under the contract?
checks.zh: 总承包商与业主签订了一份浇筑标准水泥车道的合同，随后聘请了一家合格的分包商来执行浇筑工作。不久后，水泥因工艺低劣而开裂。根据代为履行原则，谁在合同下对业主承担法律责任？

opts.t: Only the subcontractor, because hiring a subcontractor automatically assigns all contractual liabilities.
opts.w: 合同法下只能转让权利，不能转让义务（liabilities cannot be assigned）；找分包商干活不会免除原承包商自己的责任。

opts.t: The general contractor remains liable to the landowner, because vicarious performance does not transfer contractual liability.
opts.w: 在不具高度人身属性的工作中，当事人可以找人代为履行（vicarious performance），但这不是转让义务——原来的合同当事人仍然就履行结果对另一方负责。

opts.t: Neither party, because delegating non-personal work renders the underlying contract void.
opts.w: 只有具有高度人身属性的合同（如请特定画家画肖像）才禁止找人代劳；标准水泥车道施工允许代为履行，合同依然有效。

opts.t: The landowner must bear the loss unless the subcontractor received written notice under Section 36 of the Law and Equity Act.
opts.w: 《衡平法》第 36 条规范的是债权/权利的法定转让（statutory assignment），与义务人聘请分包商代为履行（vicarious performance）完全是两回事。

checks.pt: 电子签名有哪些法定排除例外，以及网购冷静期能否套用到买房上
checks.stem: A buyer signs a residential contract of purchase and sale using an electronic signature platform. Under the Electronic Transactions Act and the Business Practices and Consumer Protection Act (BPCPA), which statement accurately describes the current legal boundary in British Columbia?
checks.zh: 买方通过电子签名平台签署了一份住宅买卖合同。根据《电子交易法》与《商业行为与消费者保护法》（BPCPA），下列哪项准确描述了 BC 省的现行法律边界？

opts.t: The electronic contract of purchase and sale is valid, and the buyer can use the general BPCPA door-to-door cooling-off right to cancel the land purchase.
opts.w: 依 BPCPA 第 2(2) 条，该法的一般消费者撤销权不适用于土地或不动产买卖，住宅买家的撤销权来自专门的地产立法（如住宅买家撤销权或 REDMA 第 21 条）。

opts.t: The electronic contract of purchase and sale is unenforceable because the Electronic Transactions Act excludes all agreements respecting land.
opts.w: 《电子交易法》第 2(4) 条排除的是「需要登记才能对抗第三方的土地权益转移文件本身」（过户登记文件），并不排除前面的买卖合同与要约承诺。

opts.t: The e-signed contract is valid, but land transfer documents that must be registered to bind third parties fall outside the Act.
opts.w: 依《电子交易法》第 5、11、15 条，电子形式的买卖合同与电子签名完全有效；但第 2(4) 条明文排除了需登记才能对抗第三方的土地转让登记文件本身，以及涉及财务事务或人身照护的授权书。

opts.t: Both the contract of purchase and sale and powers of attorney for financial affairs are fully covered by the Electronic Transactions Act without exception.
opts.w: 涉及财务事务或人身照护的授权书（power of attorney）属于《电子交易法》第 2(4) 条明文排除的类别。

checks.pt: 反要约拖延被截胡、高龄卖方心智存疑及电子签名误解的实务应对
checks.stem: A licensee is asked to list the home of an 84-year-old sole owner who repeatedly contradicts himself and forgets what he just said during meetings. What is the appropriate course of action for the licensee before taking the listing?
checks.zh: 持牌人受托为一位 84 岁的独居业主挂牌卖房，该业主在会面中多次出现前后矛盾的陈述，且记不清刚说过的话。在签署挂牌合同前，持牌人恰当的做法是什么？

opts.t: Proceed to sign the listing immediately, because every adult over 19 is conclusively presumed to have capacity regardless of circumstances.
opts.w: 成年人虽有行为能力推定，但当出现明显心智失能迹象时，贸然签约可能导致交易日后依《成年人监护法》第 60.2 条被撤销。

opts.t: Check for an enduring power of attorney or committee, suggest independent legal advice if none, and tell the managing broker.
opts.w: 当注意到高龄客户出现心智能力存疑的迹象时，持牌人应先核实是否已有持久授权书（enduring power of attorney）或法院指定的监护人（committee）；若无，应建议客户在签约前取得独立法律意见并向管理经纪汇报留痕。

opts.t: Conduct a clinical medical assessment personally to determine whether the owner meets the common law capacity test.
opts.w: 持牌人不具备医学与法律专业资质去亲自做临床或法律能力鉴定，正确动作是核实授权文件、建议独立法律意见并汇报管理经纪。

opts.t: Have the owner affix a red legal seal so that the contract cannot be challenged under Section 60.2 of the Adult Guardianship Act.
opts.w: 法律印鉴（seal）只能替代对价，无法治愈当事人缔约能力（capacity）不足的瑕疵。

checks.pt: 哪些房地产合同必须书面、不写字有何后果及服务协议必填项
checks.stem: A seller signs a written service agreement with a listing brokerage to sell a residential property, and the seller does not waive any statutory requirements. Which of the following statements accurately describes the requirements for this written service agreement?
checks.zh: 一位卖方与挂牌经纪行签署书面服务协议以出售住宅物业，且卖方未放弃任何法定要求。下列哪项准确描述了该书面服务协议的要求？

opts.t: It may be signed at any time before the Contract of Purchase and Sale is accepted, and only the total commission percentage needs to be stated.
opts.w: 错误。根据《地产服务规则》（Real Estate Services Rules）第43条（考试口径称旧规则第5-1条），交易服务协议必须在经纪行代表客户把物业挂牌出去之前签妥，且涉及合作经纪行分佣时不能只写总比例，此项混淆了签署时点与披露细则。

opts.t: It must be signed before the property is offered for sale, and with a cooperating brokerage it must split out what the seller pays, what is passed on and what is kept.
opts.w: 正确。根据《地产服务规则》第43条（考试口径引用2021年8月1日前的旧编号第5-1条，现行法规为 B.C. Reg. 209/2021 第43条），除非准客户明示放弃，交易类的书面服务协议（written service agreement）必须在挂牌前由双方签署、写明到期日，且在有合作经纪行分佣时必须分别写明：卖方付给挂牌行多少、挂牌行付给合作行多少、以及挂牌行自己留多少。

opts.t: It is only required if the listing period exceeds three years, mirroring the exemption threshold under section 59 of the Law and Equity Act.
opts.w: 错误。「三年或以下」是《法律与衡平法》（Law and Equity Act）第59条对短租约（lease for a term of three years or less）排除土地合同书面要求的门槛，与经纪行挂牌服务协议毫无关系，属于典型的「无效与不可执行混淆」及法条串位陷阱。

opts.t: It requires only the seller's signature to comply with the rules, provided the brokerage delivers a copy within three business days after an offer is received.
opts.w: 错误。书面服务协议必须由客户与经纪行的授权签署人双方签字（signed by both the client and an authorized signatory of the brokerage），并在提供挂牌服务前完成，而非只由卖方单方签字。

checks.pt: 持牌人挂牌前如何核查产权与边界、以及遇到隐蔽缺陷怎么办
checks.stem: When preparing to list a residential lot, the listing licensee relies on the seller's verbal memory of the lot depth instead of checking a survey, adds the words "more or less" after the depth figure in the contract, and does not conduct a title search. Which statement best describes the legal position?
checks.zh: 在准备挂牌一处住宅地块时，挂牌持牌人依赖卖方对地块深度的口头记忆而未核查测量图，在合同深度数字后加上「more or less（左右）」字样，且未做产权检索。下列哪项最准确地描述了其法律处境？

opts.t: Adding 'more or less' may not stop a misstated depth from making the contract unenforceable, and skipping the title search leaves the licensee exposed.
opts.w: 正确。考试资料判例明确指出，持牌人必须亲自做产权检索（title search）以核实登记业主与押记，且切勿自行丈量或轻信口头尺寸；即使在写错的深度数字后加上「more or less」或「approximately」，合同仍可能被法院判为不可执行（unenforceable），未做产权检索导致卖方无法交付清洁产权的后果由持牌人与经纪行承担。

opts.t: Adding "more or less" shifts the full legal duty to verify lot boundaries onto the buyer under the doctrine of caveat emptor, completely insulating the seller and licensee.
opts.w: 错误。在面积与边界写错时，「more or less」并不能免除虚假或错误描述的后果，考试资料援引的判例中加了该词的合同依然被判不可执行。

opts.t: A title search is the exclusive responsibility of the conveyancing lawyer after subject removal, so a listing licensee has no duty to check title before listing.
opts.w: 错误。挂牌前去土地登记处做产权检索（title search）以确认登记业主身份及按揭、地役权、路权、留置权等押记，是持牌人自己的核心核查义务，不能推给过户律师。

opts.t: The misstated lot depth is automatically treated as a material latent defect that can be cured by notifying the brokerage's managing broker after completion.
opts.w: 错误。尺寸写错属于对物业基本事实的失实陈述或错误，并非事后通知经理就能补救的事项。

checks.pt: 怎么区分要害条款、次要条款、条件条款以及新房法定保证口径
checks.stem: According to the course manual, what statutory warranty does the Homeowner Protection Act imply when a new home is built and sold by an unlicensed builder?
checks.zh: 根据课程考试资料（考试口径），当非持牌建筑商自建并出售新房时，《Homeowner Protection Act》默示了什么样的法定保证？

opts.t: A 3-business-day guarantee allowing the buyer to rescind the purchase upon paying 0.25% of the purchase price.
opts.w: 错误。3个工作日及0.25%撤销费是《Property Law Act》第42条下的住宅买家冷静期（Home Buyer Rescission Period），而非《Homeowner Protection Act》的新房质量保证，属于「考试口径与现行新规或楼花混同」陷阱。

opts.t: A 60-day warranty covering only electrical systems and common property parking allocations.
opts.w: 错误。60天是《Strata Property Act》下 Form F 付款证明的有效期，与新房法定保证无关。

opts.t: A 10-year implied warranty by the vendor to the purchaser that the home is fit for habitation, constructed of good materials, and designed and built to normal standards.
opts.w: 正确。按考试口径，《Homeowner Protection Act》对非持牌建筑商自建自售新房的情形，默示卖方向买方作出十年保证（10-year implied warranty）：房屋适宜居住、用料良好、设计与施工具备通常水准。现行法（《Homeowner Protection Act》第23条）则规定持牌建筑商或自建业主与新房卖方均被视为作出2年材料与做工、5年建筑围护结构（含渗水）、10年结构的分段法定保证。

opts.t: No implied warranty of any kind, because standard form Contracts of Purchase and Sale shift all physical risks to the buyer immediately upon signing.
opts.w: 错误。首先《Homeowner Protection Act》确实设有法定保证；其次标准格式买卖合同（CPS）用明文条款推翻了普通法「签约即转风险」的老规则，让物业风险在成交前留在卖方一侧。

checks.pt: 定金是不是对价、经纪行以什么身份管钱、以及罚没能否被救济
checks.stem: Under a Contract of Purchase and Sale stating that "time is of the essence," a buyer pays a $50,000 deposit (within the customary 5% to 10% range) and then fails to complete on the completion date. The seller terminates the contract, subsequently resells the property to a third party for $31,000 more than the original contract price, and the original buyer sues for relief from forfeiture under section 24 of the Law and Equity Act to recover the $50,000 deposit. Based on BC Supreme Court precedent, what is the outcome?
checks.zh: 在一份写明「time is of the essence（时间为要害）」的买卖合同下，买方支付了 $50,000 定金（处于行业惯例 5%–10% 范围内），随后未能在成交日如期完成交易。卖方终止合同，后来以比原合同价高出 $31,000 的价格将物业转售给第三人，原买方依《Law and Equity Act》第24条起诉请求罚没救济以追回 $50,000 定金。根据 BC 最高法院判例，结果如何？

opts.t: The buyer recovers the entire $50,000 deposit because the seller suffered no actual loss and profited by $31,000 on the resale.
opts.w: 错误。在 Lily Joyce Lee v. Nelson Skalbania 判例中，法院明确指出定金合理性以订立合同时为准，物业事后升值与是否救济罚没无关：卖方承担「实际损失大于定金」的风险，买方也承担「定金大于实际损失」的风险。

opts.t: The seller is entitled to retain the $50,000 deposit because reasonableness is judged at the time of contract formation, the contract made time of the essence, and retaining the deposit is not unconscionable.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Law and Equity Act》第24条及 Lily Joyce Lee v. Nelson Skalbania 案，法院虽有权对罚则与罚没给予救济（relief against penalties and forfeitures），但仅在该金额在订约时不是损失的合理预估、且允许卖方保留会构成显失公平（unconscionable）时才会动用；本案定金合理且写明 time is of the essence，即使卖方事后多卖了 $31,000，卖方仍有权留下 $50,000 定金。

opts.t: The court must split the $50,000 deposit by deducting the $31,000 resale gain and awarding only the remaining $19,000 to the seller.
opts.w: 错误。定金不是事后按转售差价多退少补的账目，只要订约时属于合理预估且不构成显失公平，卖方即可全额保留该定金。

opts.t: The brokerage holding the deposit must immediately transfer the $50,000 to the seller without waiting for a release or court order because the contract says the deposit is absolutely forfeited.
opts.w: 错误。合同写明「绝对没收（absolutely forfeited）」解决的是实体权利归属，但定金从信托账户出账仍受《Real Estate Services Act》第28条及第30条约束，没有双方书面协议或法院命令，经纪行不得擅自划款，属于「中立保管人擅自退定金」陷阱。

checks.pt: 住宅买家冷静期的3个工作日、0.25%费用、豁免与双向披露
checks.stem: A buyer and seller are negotiating the purchase of a freehold detached house in BC. To make the offer more attractive in a competitive market, the buyer asks their licensee to insert a clause stating that the buyer waives the Home Buyer Rescission Period under section 42 of the Property Law Act. How must the licensee respond?
checks.zh: 买卖双方正在洽谈购买 BC 省一处自有产权独立屋。为了让要约在竞争激烈的市场中更有吸引力，买方要求其持牌人在合同中加入一条声明「买方放弃《Property Law Act》第42条下的住宅买家冷静期」。持牌人应当如何回应？

opts.t: Draft the waiver clause as requested, provided the buyer also increases the deposit to at least 10% of the purchase price.
opts.w: 错误。根据《Home Buyer Rescission Period Regulation》第7条，这项撤销权在法律上不可放弃（cannot be waived），无论定金提高到多少，放弃条款都无效。

opts.t: Advise the buyer that the rescission right cannot be waived only if the purchase price exceeds $1,000,000.
opts.w: 错误。$1,000,000 只是省府用来演示 0.25% 撤销费（对应 $2,500）的示例金额，冷静期不可放弃规则适用于所有受规管的住宅不动产交易，没有价格门槛。

opts.t: Draft the waiver clause, because a freehold detached house is one of the four statutory exemptions from the rescission period.
opts.w: 错误。自有产权独立屋（detached house）明确属于适用冷静期的七类住宅不动产之一；四项法定豁免是：位于租赁土地上的住宅、住宅租赁权益、拍卖出售的住宅、以及依法院命令或监督出售的住宅。

opts.t: Explain that the 3-business-day rescission right cannot be waived by contract, and give the s.57.1 disclosure when preparing the offer.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Property Law Act》第42条及《Home Buyer Rescission Period Regulation》第7条，住宅买家冷静期（Home Buyer Rescission Period）的3个工作日撤销权不可放弃（cannot be waived），写进合同也无效且会误导客户；同时代表买方的持牌人必须在为买方准备购买要约时依《Real Estate Services Rules》第57.1条用总监批准表格作出强制披露。（注：2020版考试资料考试口径未收录2023年1月3日生效的冷静期制度，现行法规有此硬性要求。）

checks.pt: 如何区分转售3个工作日冷静期与REDMA楼花7天撤销权
checks.stem: How does the purchaser's statutory right of rescission for a development unit marketed by a developer under section 21 of the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA) differ from the Home Buyer Rescission Period (HBRP) under section 42 of the Property Law Act?
checks.zh: 向开发商购买依《Real Estate Development Marketing Act》（REDMA）第21条销售的开发单位（楼花）时，买方的法定撤销权与《Property Law Act》第42条下的住宅买家冷静期（HBRP）有何不同？

opts.t: REDMA gives 7 calendar days, no 0.25% fee and survives transfer of title; HBRP gives 3 business days, a 0.25% fee and ends on transfer.
opts.w: 正确。《Property Law Act》第42(2)条明确规定 REDMA 第21条适用的合同不适用冷静期（HBRP）。REDMA 第21条给的是7个日历日（7 days，非工作日）、从协议成立日与买方书面确认有机会阅读披露声明之日中较晚者起算、不收 0.25% 撤销费、且不因产权已移转而消灭；而 HBRP 是承诺签署日后的3个工作日、须付成交价 0.25% 的撤销费、且产权一旦移转即不适用。

opts.t: A buyer of a pre-sale development unit from a developer may use both the 7-day REDMA period and the 3-business-day HBRP sequentially for a total of 10 days.
opts.w: 错误。两套制度互斥（mutually exclusive）：《Property Law Act》第42(2)条明文排除受 REDMA 第21条规管的买卖合同，不能叠加使用，属于「考试口径与现行新规或楼花混同」陷阱。

opts.t: The REDMA rescission period is 7 business days excluding weekends and statutory holidays and requires a 0.25% fee paid to the developer.
opts.w: 错误。REDMA 第21条写的是「7 days（7天）」，不是工作日，且 REDMA 第21条本身不设 0.25% 撤销费。

opts.t: Under REDMA section 21, a buyer who never receives a required disclosure statement loses the right to rescind once 7 days have passed after signing the contract.
opts.w: 错误。根据 REDMA 第21(3)条，如果买方一直未收到应有的披露声明（disclosure statement），买方可以随时撤销（may rescind at any time），而非7天后丧权。

checks.pt: 先决与解除条件的区别、如何书面移除条件、以及主观条件的风险
checks.stem: A buyer enters into a contract to purchase a commercial property, subject to the buyer obtaining the existing landlord's agreement to assume the current five-year lease on or before Friday. On Thursday, the landlord verbally tells the buyer over the phone that he agrees. The buyer's licensee immediately advises the buyer to deliver a written notice waiving the condition. The landlord later refuses to sign a written lease assumption. Did the licensee act properly?
checks.zh: 买方签订一份商业物业买卖合同，条件是在周五当日或之前取得现有房东同意承接一份剩余五年的租约。周四，房东在电话里口头告诉买方他同意。买方持牌人立即建议买方发出书面通知放弃该条件。房东后来拒签书面租约承接文件。持牌人的做法是否正确？

opts.t: Yes, because a condition precedent can be declared fulfilled verbally or in writing as soon as the landlord gives oral assurances.
opts.w: 错误。首先移除条件（放弃 waive 或宣告成就 declare fulfilled）必须采用书面通知（written notice）；其次超过三年的租约受《Law and Equity Act》第59条约束，口头同意不具强制执行力。

opts.t: No; a lease over three years must be in writing under LEA s.59, so he should have advised against removing the condition before written consent.
opts.w: 正确。考试资料援引的 BC 判例表明，超过三年的租约依《Law and Equity Act》第59条必须有书面文件才可执行（enforceable）；在仅拿到房东口头答应、尚未取得有约束力的书面协议前，持牌人有义务劝阻客户移除该先决条件（condition precedent），草率建议移除条件构成失职。

opts.t: Yes, because once a subject clause is written for the buyer's sole benefit, the seller automatically bears the risk of the third-party landlord changing his mind after waiver.
opts.w: 错误。一旦受益方（买方）书面通知放弃（waive）条件，合同即成为无条件约束的合同，之后房东拒签的风险完全落在买方自己身上，卖方有权要求买方按期交割。

opts.t: No, because removing a condition precedent always requires the written consent and signature of both the buyer and the seller.
opts.w: 错误。为某一方单独利益（sole benefit）而设的条件条款，只需由受益方在期限当日或之前向另一方发出书面通知（放弃或宣告成就）即可单方移除，不需要对方签字同意修改合同。

checks.pt: 卖方接受带条件要约时，预审、设期限与时间条款怎么用
checks.stem: A seller accepts an offer subject to financing and includes a standard time clause (often called a "72-hour clause") that checks the box permitting the seller to give notice only "upon receipt of another acceptable offer." Two days later, the seller has not received any other offer, but regrets waiting and instructs the listing licensee to deliver written notice triggering the time clause immediately. Which statement is correct?
checks.zh: 卖方接受了一份附带融资条件的要约，并加入了标准时间条款（俗称「72小时条款」），其中勾选了仅允许卖方「在收到另一份可接受的要约后」发出通知的选项。两天后，卖方并未收到其他要约，但不想再等，遂指示挂牌持牌人立即发出书面通知启动时间条款。下列哪项正确？

opts.t: The seller may trigger the time clause immediately because every time clause gives the seller an unconditional right to demand subject removal at any time.
opts.w: 错误。时间条款（time clause）何时可以启动，完全取决于合同里勾选的是哪一个选项：「随时（at any time）」还是「在收到另一份可接受的要约后（upon receipt of another acceptable offer）」。

opts.t: The seller can trigger the time clause only if both parties sign a formal contract amendment shortening the subject removal date.
opts.w: 错误。启动时间条款靠的是发出一份独立于买卖合同之外的书面通知（separate written notice），该通知不是对买卖合同的修改（not an amendment），无需买方签字同意。

opts.t: The seller cannot trigger the time clause unless and until another acceptable offer is actually received, because that specific trigger option was selected in the contract.
opts.w: 正确。行业示范的时间条款（time clause）提供「随时（at any time）」与「在收到另一份可接受的要约后」两个二选一选项；既然合同勾选了后者，卖方在没有收到第二份可接受要约之前无权启动该通知要求买方提前移除条件。

opts.t: The notice period under a time clause is fixed by statute at exactly 72 hours including Sundays and statutory holidays.
opts.w: 错误。「72小时条款」只是俗称，其时长并非法定固定为72小时，而是由双方协商确定，且示范条款的常见措辞通常写明通知期不含周日与法定假日。

checks.pt: 修改合同为什么需要新对价或盖印、以及延期后严格时限还在不在
checks.stem: After entering into a binding Contract of Purchase and Sale that explicitly states "time is of the essence," the buyer and seller sign a written amendment under seal extending the completion date by two weeks, without mentioning the "time is of the essence" clause. Which statement accurately describes the legal effect of this amendment?
checks.zh: 在签订一份明确写有「time is of the essence（时间为要害）」的约束性买卖合同后，买卖双方以盖印（under seal）方式签署了一份书面修改协议，将成交日顺延两周，但修改协议中未提及「time is of the essence」字样。下列哪项准确描述了该修改协议的法律效果？

opts.t: The amendment is unenforceable because extending a completion date requires a cash payment as fresh consideration and cannot be made binding by seal alone.
opts.w: 错误。修改协议（amendment）本身是一份合同，需要新的对价（fresh consideration）或盖印（under seal）二者之一即可具备约束力，以盖印方式签署完全有效。

opts.t: Merely discussing the proposed extension before signing automatically terminated the original contract as an anticipatory breach.
opts.w: 错误。虽然重开谈判有被误解为违约的风险（因此实务上应先确认讨论不终止原合同、原合同在讨论期间继续有效），但双方合意签署的延期修改并不会使原合同自动终止。

opts.t: By extending the completion date without restating "time is of the essence," the parties permanently waived strict compliance with time limits.
opts.w: 错误。在 BC 省，只要原合同写明了 time is of the essence，双方事后修改成交日、调整日、交房日或条件移除日时，法律推定该严格时限条款在修改后的合同里仍然有效（尽管实务上仍建议显式写上「其余条款不变、time 仍为要害」以防争执）。

opts.t: It is enforceable, being under seal and signed by all, and time is presumed to remain of the essence unless that would be unjust.
opts.w: 正确。修改协议（amendment）由全部当事人签署并以盖印（under seal）方式订立，满足合同修改的对价/盖印要求；同时，原合同载明时间为要害（time is of the essence）的，事后修改日期时法律推定其在修改后的合同中继续有效，除非具体情形使该推定不公平。

checks.pt: 标准转让条款的适用范围、豁免对象、CSAIR报送与税务后果
checks.stem: An investor who purchased a pre-sale residential strata lot from a developer under the Real Estate Development Marketing Act (REDMA) one year ago now wishes to assign the purchase agreement to a third party for a profit before completion. Which statement correctly applies to this transaction?
checks.zh: 一位投资者一年前依《Real Estate Development Marketing Act》（REDMA）向开发商购买了一套住宅共管物业楼花，现在希望在交割前加价将该购买协议转让给第三人。下列哪项正确适用于该笔交易？

opts.t: Section 8.2 does not apply to REDMA developer sales, but the assignment is reported through CSAIR and the premium counts toward Property Transfer Tax.
opts.w: 正确。《Real Estate Services Regulation》第8.2(2)条明确规定，开发商依 REDMA 销售开发单位的合同不适用标准转让条款（Standard Assignment Terms）的强制写入规定；但住宅 strata lot 购买协议的转让受开发商合同条款约束并须由开发商向共管物业转让诚信登记册（Condo and Strata Assignment Integrity Register, CSAIR）收集报送，且转让人收取的溢价与费用要计入物业转让税（Property Transfer Tax）计税价款，持有不足 730 天转手还可能触发 BC 炒房税。

opts.t: Under section 8.2 of the Real Estate Services Regulation, any profit from assigning a REDMA pre-sale contract automatically belongs to the provincial government.
opts.w: 错误。首先规例第8.2条不适用于开发商依 REDMA 销售开发单位的合同；其次即使在适用第8.2条的二手交易中，标准转让条款也是把转让利润归于卖方（seller），而非归于省政府。

opts.t: Assigning a pre-sale contract before completion is exempt from the BC home flipping tax even if the original buyer held the contract for fewer than 730 days.
opts.w: 错误。讲义明确指出，BC 炒房税把楼花合同的转让（assignment）算在射程内，持有不足 730 天就转手的，不论转的是房子还是合同都可能触发该税。

opts.t: The assignment premium paid to the assignor is excluded from the taxable consideration for Property Transfer Tax purposes upon completion.
opts.w: 错误。转让人收取的溢价与费用（assignment profit and fees）必须计入物业转让税（Property Transfer Tax）的计税价款，且 CSAIR 的数据可与加拿大税务局共享。

checks.pt: 买方何时能请求具体履行、以及误判对方违约而提终止有什么风险
checks.stem: After all conditions precedent have been properly removed in a Contract of Purchase and Sale for a residential parcel, the seller changes her mind and refuses to transfer title on the completion date. Why can the buyer ask the court for an order of specific performance rather than being limited to monetary damages?
checks.zh: 在一份住宅地块买卖合同的所有先决条件均已妥善移除后，卖方改变主意，拒绝在成交日移转产权。为什么买方可以向法院请求具体履行（specific performance）命令，而不限于只拿金钱损害赔偿？

opts.t: Because section 28 of the Real Estate Services Act requires specific performance whenever a deposit is held by a brokerage as a stakeholder.
opts.w: 错误。《Real Estate Services Act》第28条只规定经纪行以中立保管人（stakeholder）身份保管定金，与法院是否判决具体履行无关。

opts.t: Because the law regards each parcel of land as unique, making monetary damages alone an inadequate remedy when a seller refuses to convey title.
opts.w: 正确。在合同法与衡平法救济中，由于每一块土地都被认为是独一无二的（each parcel of land is considered unique），当卖方违约拒绝移转土地时，无过错的买方可以向法院请求具体履行（specific performance），强制卖方按合同完成产权过户。

opts.t: Because specific performance is automatically granted for any breach of a minor warranty, even if the seller is willing to transfer title.
opts.w: 错误。违反次要条款（minor term / warranty）时，无过错方只能索赔损害赔偿（damages），这与卖方拒不移转土地时买方请求具体履行完全不同，属于「条款性质与违约救济错配」陷阱。

opts.t: Because any party who sends a termination notice first is automatically treated by the court as the innocent party entitled to specific performance.
opts.w: 错误。只有无过错方才有权在对方违反要害条款时终止合同；如果一方误判形势、在对方并未违反要害条款时贸然发出终止通知，发通知的人自己反而构成毁约（repudiation）。

checks.pt: Form B与Form F时限、保险例外及开发商7%扣款
checks.stem: A buyer is purchasing a residential strata lot and reviews the Form B Information Certificate provided by the strata corporation under section 59 of the Strata Property Act, as well as the rules for a Form F Certificate of Payment and builders lien holdbacks. Which of the following statements is accurate?
checks.zh: 一位买方正在购买一套住宅共管物业单位（strata lot），并审阅了共管物业公司依《Strata Property Act》第59条出具的 Form B 信息证书，以及关于 Form F 付款证明与建筑留置权扣款的规则。下列哪项陈述是准确的？

opts.t: All information in a Form B is binding on the strata corporation without exception, including the summary of the strata corporation's insurance coverage.
opts.w: 错误。虽然《Strata Property Act》第59(5)条规定 Form B 披露的信息对合理信赖的人具约束力，但第59(5.1)条明确设了例外：第59(3)(l.2)条下的保险承保范围摘要若来自 strata 的保险人或保险代理，则对 strata 不具约束力，买方必须自行核查保单。

opts.t: A Form F Certificate of Payment is valid for 30 days from the date of issue and must include all unliquidated damages claims that the strata council intends to pursue before a tribunal.
opts.w: 错误。根据《Strata Property Act》第115条，Form F 付款证明须在请求后一周内出具、自签发日起 60 天内有效（而非 30 天），且第115(5)条明确禁止把尚未由法院、仲裁或裁判庭确定的损害赔偿主张写进 Form F。

opts.t: Form B binds the strata toward those who reasonably rely on it except the insurer-sourced insurance summary, and a developer purchase needs a 7% holdback.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Strata Property Act》第59(5)及(5.1)条，Form B（Information Certificate）必须在请求后一周内出具并附上规则、当年预算、最近一次折旧报告及（如有）电气规划报告，其内容对合理信赖者具约束力，但来自保险人或保险代理的保险摘要除外；此外，依第88(2)条及规例第5.2条，向开发商（owner developer）购买 strata lot 的买方必须扣留成交总价 7% 的留置权扣款（builders lien holdback），直至留置权申报期届满或转让后第55天中较早者。（注：现行 Form B 已由 B.C. Reg. 6/2023 删去原(l)项，并新增停车位/储物柜、保险摘要及 B.C. Reg. 261/2023 的电气规划报告栏。）

opts.t: When purchasing a brand-new strata lot from an owner developer, the buyer may unilaterally keep the 7% statutory holdback to pay for minor paint touch-ups and construction delays.
opts.w: 错误。向开发商购买 strata lot 时强制扣留的 7% holdback，唯一法定目的是把买方对建筑留置权人的责任封顶，买方绝对不能拿这笔 7% 当作施工瑕疵或延误的单方面抵扣款。

checks.pt: 《竞争法》刑事合谋、误导广告与第90.1条的新旧口径对比
checks.stem: A licensee publishes a public advertisement stating that an agricultural parcel is zoned for industrial use and significantly overstating its square footage, having made no effort to verify either claim. Under section 52 of the federal Competition Act, which statement is correct regarding criminal liability for false or misleading representations?
checks.zh: 一名持牌人未经任何核实，便发布公开广告将一处农业用地称为工业用地，并大幅夸大其面积。根据联邦《Competition Act》第52条关于虚假或误导陈述的刑事责任，下列哪项是正确的？

opts.t: A person cannot be convicted under section 52 unless the prosecution proves that at least one buyer in Canada was actually deceived and suffered a financial loss.
opts.w: 错误。《Competition Act》第52(1.1)条明确规定，定罪不需要证明实际上有人被欺骗或误导（no need to prove anyone was deceived or misled），也不需要证明受众在加拿大境内。

opts.t: Knowingly or recklessly making a materially false or misleading public representation to promote a business is an offence, even if no one was misled.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Competition Act》第52(1)及(1.1)条，为推广产品或商业利益而明知或罔顾地（knowingly or recklessly）向公众作出在重要方面虚假或误导的陈述（false or misleading representation in a material respect）即构成犯罪，无需证明有人实际受骗；挂牌面积写大或把农业用地写成工业用地正是考试资料援引的典型违法形态。（注：现行法还于第52(1.3)条新增了「滴价 drip pricing」规则，因固定强制收费而无法实现的价格陈述亦属虚假或误导陈述。）

opts.t: Section 52 applies only when two or more competing brokerages conspire together to publish the same advertisement.
opts.w: 错误。要求两名或以上竞争者合谋（conspiracy）的是第45条刑事合谋罪；第52条虚假或误导陈述罪针对单方发布广告的持牌人或经纪行同样适用。

opts.t: Because the error concerned zoning and square footage rather than price, it falls outside the Competition Act and is governed solely by municipal bylaws.
opts.w: 错误。第52条涵盖在任何「重要方面（in a material respect）」的虚假或误导陈述，考试资料中的经典案例正是挂牌面积写大与把农业用地写成工业用地。

checks.pt: 本章9处新旧差异：冷静期、信托出账、条号、监管机构与竞争法
checks.stem: According to the course manual, in what ways can deposit money held by a brokerage as a stakeholder be released from the brokerage trust account when a transaction fails to complete?
checks.zh: 根据课程考试资料（考试口径），当交易未能完成时，经纪行以中立保管人（stakeholder）身份持有的定金可以通过哪几种方式从经纪行信托账户中放出？

opts.t: Only in two ways: upon a written release signed by all parties to the transaction, or by the brokerage paying the funds into court.
opts.w: 正确。按考试资料考试口径，定金从信托账户（trust account）出来只有两条路：全体当事人签署书面解款协议（written release），或者经纪行把钱缴入法院（payment into court）。现行法（《Real Estate Services Act》第30(2)(c)条及《Home Buyer Rescission Period Regulation》第6(3)条）则新增了第三条法定出账路径：依本法或《Property Law Act》第43条项下规定，在买方行使3个工作日住宅冷静期撤销权时，直接从信托账户划付 0.25% 撤销费给卖方并将定金余额退还买方。

opts.t: Whenever the listing brokerage's managing broker determines in good faith which party breached the contract and signs an internal authorization.
opts.w: 错误。经纪行是中立保管人（stakeholder），无权自行裁断谁违约并单方放款，属于「中立保管人擅自退定金」陷阱。

opts.t: Automatically to the buyer as soon as 30 days have elapsed after the scheduled completion date, unless the seller has already obtained a judgment.
opts.w: 错误。虽然经纪行可按行业指引向各方发出合理期限（如30天）的书面通知以查明是否有相反主张，但只要有一方不同意，钱就绝不会「自动」退给买方，仍须留存信托账户或缴入法院。

opts.t: Immediately to the seller upon presentation of the Contract of Purchase and Sale showing that the deposit is non-refundable upon default.
opts.w: 错误。标准合同里的没收定金条款明确写着「subject to section 28 of the Real Estate Services Act」，合同写明没收不等于经纪行可以绕过 RESA 的出账限制把钱直接付给卖方。

checks.pt: 从接委托、写要约、呈要约到签约后，持牌人每一步的合规动作
checks.stem: At what exact points in a residential real estate transaction must the buyer's licensee and the seller's licensee make the mandatory disclosures regarding the Home Buyer Rescission Period under section 57.1 of the Real Estate Services Rules, and why must the seller's contact information fields in the contract be completed carefully at that stage?
checks.zh: 在住宅不动产交易中，买方持牌人与卖方持牌人必须在什么确切时点依《Real Estate Services Rules》第57.1条作出关于住宅买家冷静期的强制披露？为什么在准备合同时就必须仔细填妥卖方联络信息栏？

opts.t: Both licensees must make the disclosure within three business days after the offer is accepted, and the seller's contact information is only needed by the land title office at completion.
opts.w: 错误。把冷静期披露当成签约后的手续就已经违规晚了；且卖方联络信息栏直接关系到3个工作日内撤销通知能否享受送达推定，绝非等到过户才有用。

opts.t: Only the buyer's licensee is required to make the disclosure before subject removal, while the seller's licensee has no disclosure obligation under section 57.1.
opts.w: 错误。Rules 第57.1条规定的是买卖双方持牌人的「双向强制披露义务」，卖方持牌人在呈交要约时同样必须向卖方披露。

opts.t: Buyer's licensee discloses when preparing the offer and seller's when presenting it; deemed delivery of rescission depends on the seller contacts in the contract.
opts.w: 正确。根据《Real Estate Services Rules》第57.1(2)及(3)条，代表买方的持牌人必须在为买方准备住宅购买要约时（when preparing the offer）向买方披露，代表卖方的持牌人必须在向卖方呈交购买要约时（when presenting the offer）向卖方披露；同时依《Home Buyer Rescission Period Regulation》第5条，挂号邮寄、传真或带已读回执的电邮「发出即视为送达（deemed delivery）」的前提是发往合同上载明的卖方地址、传真号或电子邮箱，因此在起草合同时就必须准确填妥。

opts.t: Both licensees must disclose at the time the listing agreement is signed, and the buyer may send a rescission notice with deemed delivery to any social media account used by the listing brokerage.
opts.w: 错误。买方在挂牌时还未出现；且享有送达推定的仅限按合同载明的卖方地址挂号邮寄、合同载明的传真号、或合同载明的电子邮箱（请求已读回执）三种法定方式。

checks.pt: 如何算准冷静期3个工作日与撤销费、处理止付及区分楼花转售
checks.stem: On Friday, April 3, a seller signs the acceptance of a buyer's offer to purchase a detached house in BC for $1,280,000, and the buyer places a $40,000 deposit into the brokerage trust account. Assuming there are no statutory holidays during the following week, what is the last day for the buyer to serve a written notice of rescission under the Home Buyer Rescission Period, and how must the brokerage disburse the $40,000 deposit if the buyer rescinds?
checks.zh: 4月3日（周五），卖方签署接受了买方以 $1,280,000 购买 BC 省一套独立屋的要约，买方将 $40,000 定金存入经纪行信托账户。假设下周没有法定假日，买方依住宅买家冷静期送达书面撤销通知的最后一天是哪一天？若买方行使撤销权，经纪行应如何划付这 $40,000 定金？

opts.t: Monday, April 6; the brokerage pays $3,200 to the seller and holds the remaining $36,800 until a court order is obtained.
opts.w: 错误。周六（4月4日）与周日（4月5日）都不是工作日（business days），4月6日周一只是第1个工作日；且根据规例第6条，扣除撤销费后的定金余额必须立即退还买方，无需等待法院命令。

opts.t: Sunday, April 5 at the exact 72-hour mark; the brokerage refunds the full $40,000 to the buyer and the seller must sue the buyer separately for $3,200.
opts.w: 错误。冷静期是承诺签署之日后的「3个工作日（3 business days）」，不是72小时，且已有定金存储在信托账户时，0.25%撤销费直接从定金中先付给卖方，属于「考试口径与现行新规或楼花混同」陷阱。

opts.t: Friday, April 10; the brokerage pays $2,500 to the seller and refunds $37,500 to the buyer.
Wednesday, April 8; the brokerage pays $3,200 (0.25% of $1,280,000) to the seller from the trust account and immediately refunds the $36,800 balance to the buyer.
opts.w: 正确。起算点是承诺被签署之日（4月3日周五）之后，4月4日周六与4月5日周日均非工作日（business days），因此第1、第2、第3个工作日分别为4月6日周一、4月7日周二、4月8日周三（若期间夹法定假日则再顺延一天）；撤销费为 $1,280,000 × 0.25% ＝ $3,200，依规例第6条及 RESA 第30(2)(c)条，经纪行从信托账户的 $40,000 定金中先付 $3,200 给卖方，余款 $36,800 立即退还买方。

checks.pt: 解释代理三方关系、授权担保责任以及代客户签字的法定条件
checks.stem: A seller is travelling abroad without printer access and telephones his listing licensee, instructing her to sign a buyer's counter-offer on his behalf immediately. How must the licensee proceed under the Real Estate Services Rules?
checks.zh: 一位卖家正在海外旅行且身边没有打印机，遂致电其挂牌持牌人，指示她立即代自己在买家的还价合同上签字。根据《地产服务规则》，该持牌人必须如何处理？

opts.t: Sign the seller's own name on the contract because the standard listing agreement already grants general signing authority.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。在 BC，挂牌合同（listing agreement）默认不包含代客户签署买卖合同的权限，且代签时绝不能摹写客户本人的签名。

opts.t: Obtain written authorization from the seller before signing, and sign her own name while indicating she is signing as agent on the seller's behalf.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.45（旧版规则 5-3），持牌人代客户签字前必须先取得客户的书面授权（written authorization），且签署时必须签持牌人自己的名字并注明是以代理人身份（as agent）代委托人签署。

opts.t: Sign the counter-offer right away based on the clear oral instruction, provided she keeps a contemporaneous phone log for the brokerage file.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。无论客户的口头指示（oral instruction）多么清楚，都不满足规则 s.45 必须在签字前取得书面授权的硬性要求。

opts.t: Ask her managing broker to co-sign the counter-offer so that the brokerage assumes the warranty of authority without needing written client consent.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。管理经纪（managing broker）联署并不能替代客户本人的书面授权，无书面授权代签依然违反 s.45 并可能触发违反授权担保（warranty of authority）的责任。

checks.pt: 梳理从推定卖方分代理到指定代理与禁止双重代理的演变逻辑
checks.stem: Which structural problem under the 1994 assumed buyer agency model directly prompted the introduction of designated agency in British Columbia in June 2012?
checks.zh: 1994 年推定买方代理模式下的哪一个结构性问题，直接促使 BC 省在 2012 年 6 月引入了指定代理模式？

opts.t: Every licensee brought in by a buyer was legally deemed to be a sub-agent of the seller, owing fiduciary duties exclusively to the seller.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。带买家的持牌人被推定为卖方分代理（assumed seller sub-agency）是 1994 年之前的问题，不是 1994 年至 2012 年期间的问题。

opts.t: Agency duties were owed by the entire brokerage, meaning every licensee in a 50-person brokerage was legally an agent of every client of that brokerage.
opts.w: 正确。1994 年推定买方代理（assumed buyer agency）下，代理人仍是整家经纪行（brokerage），一家 50 人的经纪行里另外 49 名从未见过客户的持牌人在法律上也是该客户的代理人；2012 年 6 月引入指定代理（designated agency）正是为了把代理义务收缩到被指定的持牌人身上。

opts.t: Cooperating brokerages were prohibited from sharing commissions collected by listing brokerages unless both parties signed a dual agency agreement.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。从 1994 年至今，挂牌经纪行与合作经纪行分佣一直是行业合同惯例，并非引入指定代理的原因。

opts.t: Real estate teams were operating without registration and automatically binding all brokerage staff to represent unrepresented parties.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。地产团队（real estate teams）的法定注册规则是在 2023-04-01 才生效的，与 2012 年 6 月引入指定代理无关。

checks.pt: 辨识旧版两段式议会规则条号与现行单号规则及监管机构名称
checks.stem: When comparing the 2020 course manual to the current Real Estate Services Rules (B.C. Reg. 209/2021), how has former Council Rule 3-4 (honesty and reasonable care and skill) been restructured, and whose approved forms are now used?
checks.zh: 将 2020 版考试资料与现行《地产服务规则》（B.C. Reg. 209/2021）相比，原议会规则第 3-4 条（诚实及合理的注意与技能）在结构上发生了什么变化，且现行条文规定使用谁批准的表格格式？

opts.t: Rule 3-4 was split into s.33 (act honestly) and s.34 (reasonable care and skill), and forms are now approved by the superintendent.
opts.w: 正确。旧版考试资料使用 Council Rules 3-4 且称表格由议会规定（Council prescribed）；2021-08-01 起现行规则将其拆分为 s.33（诚实行事）和 s.34（以合理的注意与技能行事）两条独立条文，且表格一律改为以总监即 BCFSA 批准的格式（in a form approved by the superintendent）。

opts.t: Former Rule 3-4 was merged into s.30 so that honesty and reasonable care apply only to clients, and forms are prescribed by the Real Estate Council.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.33 与 s.34 并未并入只针对客户的 s.30，而是独立适用于交易中的所有人，且「议会规定（Council prescribed）」已是作废的旧版表述。

opts.t: Former Rule 3-4 was renumbered as s.43, requiring written service agreements approved by the Independent Advisory Group.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。现行 s.43 对应的是旧版 5-1（书面服务协议），而独立顾问小组（IAG）只是 2016 年审查行业规范的顾问机构，并不负责批准表格。

opts.t: Former Rule 3-4 was repealed entirely when the dual agency ban took effect, leaving honesty governed solely by common law tort principles.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。诚实与合理注意义务并未被废止，而是拆分为现行规则 s.33 与 s.34 继续有效。

checks.pt: 掌握代理成立四路径、授权分类、书面协议要件与三种挂牌合同
checks.stem: An owner enters into an open listing with three different brokerages to sell her commercial lot, and two weeks later she sells the lot directly to a neighbour who saw her personal social media post without any licensee's involvement. Which brokerage is entitled to a commission?
checks.zh: 一位业主就其商业地块与三家不同的经纪行签订了公开挂牌合同；两周后，她通过自己的社交媒体帖子直接把地块卖给了邻居，全程没有任何持牌人参与。哪一家经纪行有权收取佣金？

opts.t: The brokerage that signed the earliest open listing agreement with the owner is entitled to the full commission.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。公开挂牌（open listing）不按签约先后付佣，只付给成为促成交易直接原因（effective cause of the sale）的那一家经纪行。

opts.t: All three brokerages are entitled to split a customary commission equally under quantum meruit.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。合理报酬原则（quantum meruit）仅在构成应得报酬但未约定具体金额时由法院裁量，公开挂牌下未促成交易的经纪行无权分佣。

opts.t: None of the brokerages is entitled to a commission because the owner found the buyer herself under an open listing.
opts.w: 正确。在公开挂牌（open listing）下，业主允许同时委托多家经纪行，只向促成交易的直接原因那一家付佣；若业主自行找到买家成交，则一家都不必付。只有独家挂牌（exclusive listing）或多重挂牌（multiple listing）才会在业主自售时仍触发付佣义务。

opts.t: Whichever brokerage spent the most money advertising the property is entitled to reimbursement of expenses plus a reduced fee.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。除非合同另有约定，地产代理被视为已放弃要求委托人补偿垫付费用（reimbursement of expenses）的共同法权利，且公开挂牌未促成交易无权收佣。

checks.pt: 判断代理终止的三种路径、违约代价及终止后永久保留的保密义务
checks.stem: Two years after a residential sale completes and the agency relationship has terminated, the former seller client's ex-business partner asks the licensee why the seller had been so desperate to sell back then. What is the licensee's legal obligation?
checks.zh: 在一宗住宅买卖交割、代理关系终止两年后，前卖方客户的昔日商业伙伴询问持牌人当年该卖家为什么那么急着卖房。持牌人的法律义务是什么？

opts.t: The licensee may share the information because all fiduciary duties, including confidentiality, expire once the property is sold and the listing terminates.
opts.w: 属于「保密与瑕疵混淆陷阱」。虽然物业成交会使代理关系因行为而终止，但保密义务（duty of confidentiality）不会随交易结束而终止。

opts.t: The licensee must keep the former client's motivation confidential because confidentiality is the one agency duty that continues permanently after termination.
opts.w: 正确。在对客户的全部代理义务中，保密义务（confidentiality）是唯一在代理关系终止后仍然永久延续的一项（除非双方另有约定或法律另有要求），客户的售房动机属于必须保密的非公开信息。

opts.t: The licensee may disclose the motivation unless the former client signed a post-closing non-disclosure addendum before completion.
opts.w: 属于「保密与瑕疵混淆陷阱」。持续保密是法定的默认共同法与规则义务（s.30(e)），不需要客户额外签署交割后保密附加条款才生效。

opts.t: The licensee must pull down the old yard sign to end apparent authority, after which any personal facts about the former client become public record.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。拔掉标牌是为了消除表见授权（apparent authority）的余威，绝不意味着前客户的保密信息在撤牌后就可以公开。

checks.pt: 区分单独代理、无代理方有限服务边界与双重代理偏远地区例外
checks.stem: In the rare case where a transaction qualifies for the remote, under-served location exception to the dual agency ban under s.64, which procedural step is mandatory?
checks.zh: 在极少数符合规则 s.64 偏远且持牌人服务不足地区双重代理例外的情形中，下列哪一项程序步骤是强制性的？

opts.t: The licensee may proceed on oral consent during negotiations as long as written agreements are signed before the subject removal date.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。适用 s.64 例外必须遵循严格的「先披露、再签书面双重代理协议、然后上报」三步程序，绝不能凭口头同意先行推进。

opts.t: Only the seller needs to sign the dual agency risk disclosure form because the seller pays the brokerage's commission.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。双重代理风险披露必须向交易各方（each party）提供，且经纪行必须与每一方分别签订书面双重代理协议。

opts.t: The managing broker must sign the risk disclosure explaining how all three conditions are met, and the brokerage must send it to the superintendent.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.64（旧版 5-17，旧版考试资料称上报给议会 Council，现行规则改为上报给总监即 BCFSA），双重代理风险披露表必须由管理经纪（managing broker）签字并写明三个要件如何满足，随后与各方签订书面协议并及时将披露件报送 BCFSA。

opts.t: The licensee must convert the buyer into an unrepresented party so that full fiduciary duties remain with the seller while dual agency is reported.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」。既然走的是 s.64 双重代理例外，各方都是客户（根据 s.31 修改限缩义务），而不是把其中一方变成无代理方（unrepresented party）。

checks.pt: 掌握共同法六项受托义务、s.30 十项义务及经纪行不可免除的三项责任
checks.stem: When a client and a brokerage agree under s.31 and s.32 to modify certain duties and establish designated agency, which responsibility can the brokerage NEVER contract out of?
checks.zh: 当客户与经纪行依规则 s.31 与 s.32 约定修改部分义务并建立指定代理时，下列哪一项责任是经纪行无论如何都绝对不能通过约定免除的？

opts.t: Having every licensee employed by the brokerage personally inspect each property that the client considers buying before an offer.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。在指定代理（designated agency，s.32）下，s.30 的客户义务只落在被指定的代理人身上，经纪行的其他持牌人并不承担这些义务。

opts.t: Supervising the designated agent's s.30 duties, protecting client confidential information, and treating all clients' interests even-handedly.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.31(4) 与 s.32(4)（旧版 3-3.1 与 3-3.2），无论怎么约定修改义务或实行指定代理，经纪行永远甩不掉三件事：监督指定代理人履行 s.30 义务、保守客户保密信息、以及以不偏不倚、客观、公平（even-handed, objective and impartial）的方式对待所有客户的利益。

opts.t: Guaranteeing that the seller will accept the buyer client's offer whenever it matches the listed price and the stated terms.
opts.w: 属于「授权与签署形式陷阱」。无论是经纪行还是指定代理人都没有保证卖方必然接受要约的义务。

opts.t: Shifting the burden of proof onto the client whenever a breach of fiduciary duty is alleged against the brokerage in court.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。当客户主张持牌人违反受托义务（fiduciary duties）时，举证责任是反过来的——由持牌人举证自己确实履行了义务，不能通过约定推给客户。

checks.pt: 理解三类冲突、s.30(j) 书面独立披露及 s.65 客户互撞处置
checks.stem: Under the current wording of s.30(j) of the Real Estate Services Rules (in force since February 1, 2024), how must a licensee disclose a conflict of interest to a client, and how does this compare with the 2020 course manual?
checks.zh: 根据 2024 年 2 月 1 日起生效的现行《地产服务规则》s.30(j)，持牌人必须如何向客户披露利益冲突？这与 2020 版考试资料的表述有何不同？

opts.t: The manual asked only for prompt, full disclosure; s.30(j) now requires it in writing and separate from the service agreement and trade contract.
opts.w: 正确。旧版考试资料（对应旧规则 3-3(j)）只要求及时、完整地向客户披露（未规定形式）；而 2024-02-01 起生效的现行 s.30(j) 明确要求冲突披露必须以书面形式（in writing）作出，且独立于服务协议及任何使交易生效的合同（separate from the service agreement and contract），副本交管理经纪留档。

opts.t: Both the 2020 manual and current s.30(j) allow conflict disclosures to be inserted as a standard clause inside the Contract of Purchase and Sale.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。自 2024-02-01 起，把利益冲突披露塞进买卖合同条款本身就是违规，必须单独成件。

opts.t: Current s.30(j) allows oral conflict disclosure if witnessed by the managing broker, whereas the 2020 manual required a notarized affidavit.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。恰好相反，旧版未限定书面形式，而现行 s.30(j) 强制要求所有利益冲突必须书面且独立披露。

opts.t: Current s.30(j) applies only when a licensee buys a client's property, whereas conflicts involving former clients never require disclosure.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。一切利益冲突（包括因前客户保密义务导致对现客户建议受限的情形）都必须向现客户书面披露。

checks.pt: 掌握 s.52–s.59 八种披露与规例 s.8.2 转让条款的触发时点与方式
checks.stem: A buyer client instructs her licensee in writing to prepare an offer on a detached house WITHOUT the two standard contract assignment terms. Under s.8.2 of the Real Estate Services Regulation, what must the buyer's licensee do?
checks.zh: 一位买方客户书面指示其持牌人在拟备一套独立屋的购买要约时，删去两条标准的合同转让条款。根据《地产服务规例》s.8.2，买方持牌人必须怎么做？

opts.t: Refuse to prepare the offer because the two standard assignment clauses are mandatory and cannot be omitted even on written client instructions.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。规例 s.8.2 允许在客户书面另行指示（instructed otherwise in writing）时省略这两条标准条款，并非绝对不可省略；不可放弃的是《财产法》s.42 项下的买家撤销权。

opts.t: Give the seller an approved-form notice, separate from the contract, when the offer is presented, advising independent advice before signing.
opts.w: 正确。依《地产服务规例》（Real Estate Services Regulation）s.8.2，若要约中未包含「未经卖方书面同意不得转让」及「转让利润归卖方」两条默认标准条款，代表买方的持牌人必须在呈交要约的同时，给出一份以总监批准格式写成、独立于合同的通知书，并建议卖方在签署前寻求独立专业意见。

opts.t: Write a brief note inside the terms section of the Contract of Purchase and Sale stating that the buyer reserves the right to assign the contract.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。规例 s.8.2 明确要求该通知书必须独立于合同（separate from the contract）并使用总监批准的格式，写在合同条款里不算合规。

opts.t: Send the notice directly to the superintendent within seven days after the seller accepts the offer.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.8.2 的转让通知书是在呈交要约时交给卖方（或卖方持牌人转交卖方）以供其在签字前权衡，而不是成交后报送给总监。

checks.pt: 掌握地产团队的注册触发条件、全员指定代理属性及禁止事项
checks.stem: Two trading services licensees at the same brokerage want to form a registered real estate team and invite a colleague who holds ONLY a rental property management licence to join their team. Is this permitted under the Rules?
checks.zh: 同一家经纪行的两名交易服务持牌人打算组建一个注册地产团队，并邀请一位仅持有出租物业管理牌照的同事加入该团队。根据规则，这是否被允许？

opts.t: Yes, as long as all three licensees are licensed with the same brokerage, belong to only one team, and register the team with BCFSA.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。虽然团队成员确实必须挂靠同一家经纪行且只能属于一个团队，但仅持有出租物业管理牌照的持牌人不能加入交易服务团队。

opts.t: Yes, provided the rental property manager's name is left off the trading services disclosure forms and the team's advertising.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。团队规则要求全体成员姓名都必须写进代表关系披露件，且不允许无交易服务牌照者入队。

opts.t: No. Every team member must be a designated agent for each team client, and a licensee holding only a rental management licence cannot be.
opts.w: 正确。依 2023-04-01 起生效的团队规则（s.42.1–42.4，旧版考试资料尚无此规定），经纪行必须把团队全体成员都指定为团队任何一位客户的交易服务指定代理人（designated agent）；而只有交易服务可以走指定代理，仅持有出租物业管理或共管物业管理牌照的人无权提供交易服务，因此不能加入团队。

opts.t: No, because a registered real estate team may have at most two licensees under s.42.2, so a third member is never allowed.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.42.2 规定的是「两名或以上（two or more）」交易服务持牌人触发团队注册，并未限制最多两人。

checks.pt: 掌握佣金触发条件、净额挂牌禁令、失权后果与最高纪律罚款金额
checks.stem: After a discipline hearing, the superintendent determines that a brokerage and one of its representative licensees committed a serious breach of the Real Estate Services Rules. Under RESA s.43(2), what are the maximum discipline penalties that may be imposed per contravention, in addition to an additional penalty up to the remuneration received?
checks.zh: 在纪律听证后，总监认定某经纪行及其旗下一名代表持牌人严重违反了《地产服务规则》。根据《地产服务法》（RESA）s.43(2)，除可另处不超过所收酬金的附加罚款外，针对每一项违规可处以的最高纪律罚款分别是多少？

opts.t: Up to $150,000 for a brokerage and up to $50,000 for an individual licensee.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。该数值不符合现行《地产服务法》（RESA）s.43(2) 的法定罚款上限。

opts.t: Up to $250,000 for a brokerage and up to $250,000 for an individual licensee.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。$250,000 是针对经纪行以外其他情形（如个人持牌人）的最高纪律罚款，经纪行的最高罚款上限更高。

opts.t: Up to $500,000 for a brokerage (or former brokerage) and up to $250,000 in any other case.
opts.w: 正确。依现行《地产服务法》（RESA）s.43(2) 及 s.43(2.1)，纪律罚款可按每一项违规分别处以：经纪行（或前经纪行）最高 $500,000，其他情形（如个人持牌人）最高 $250,000，并可另处一笔不超过该笔地产服务所收酬金的附加罚款。

opts.t: Up to $250,000 for a brokerage and up to $500,000 for an individual licensee, with no separate additional penalty.
opts.w: 错误。上限说反了：经纪行（或前经纪行）最高 $500,000，其他情形（如个人持牌人）最高 $250,000；另外还可另处一笔不超过所收酬金的附加罚款。

checks.pt: 串联从初次接触、签约、呈交要约到处理冲突的全流程合规动作
checks.stem: A listing licensee is hosting an advertised open house. A visitor walks in and asks what year the roof was replaced. The licensee answers that question and then immediately asks the visitor, 'What is your maximum budget and how soon do you need to move?' When must the licensee provide the Disclosure of Representation in Trading Services form under s.54?
checks.zh: 一名挂牌持牌人正在主持一场已公告的开放日。一位访客走进来询问屋顶是哪一年更换的。持牌人回答了该问题，随后立即追问访客：「您的最高预算是多少？需要多快搬家？」根据规则 s.54，持牌人必须在什么时候提供《交易服务中代表关系的披露》表？

opts.t: No disclosure form is required at any point during an advertised open house, regardless of what questions the licensee asks.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」。s.54(3) 的开放日豁免是有严格前提的：一旦持牌人开始向对方索取或收受关于购买动机、财务资格或地产需求的信息，豁免立刻消失。

opts.t: Before soliciting or receiving information from the visitor about their financial qualifications, motivations, or real estate needs.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.54(3)（旧版 5-10），只有在持牌人没有向对方索取或收受（solicit or receive）关于购买动机、财务资格或地产需求的信息时，主持已公告开放日或提供一般事实性回答才可豁免先给表；一旦要问预算（财务资格）或搬家急迫度（动机/需求），必须在此之前先做 s.54 披露。

opts.t: Only after the visitor decides to write a formal offer on the property.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」。等到写要约时再给 s.54 披露表已经太晚，只要走出豁免范围开始收集对方财务或动机信息，就必须事先披露。

opts.t: Within 24 hours after the open house concludes, by emailing the form to the visitor along with the listing sheet.
opts.w: 属于「无代理方越界陷阱」。s.54 要求在提供交易服务（或超出开放日豁免范围索取信息）之前（before）作出披露，事后补发邮件已属违规。

checks.pt: 在开放日无代理买家、双买方撞单与验房推荐费三个实务情景中排雷
checks.stem: A seller's designated agent receives two offers on a residential listing: one from a buyer represented by a cooperating brokerage, and another from an unrepresented buyer to whom the listing agent provided limited services. Under s.57, what must the listing agent give the seller when presenting these offers?
checks.zh: 卖方的指定代理人在一套住宅挂牌房源上收到了两份要约：一份来自有合作经纪行代表的买家，另一份来自仅由挂牌代理人提供有限服务的无代理买家。根据规则 s.57，挂牌代理人在呈交这两份要约时必须向卖方提供什么？

opts.t: A single oral estimate of the seller's net proceeds, because the commission rates were already set out in the listing contract signed earlier.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.57 的披露必须是书面的（依 s.52 且独立于合同），不能因为挂牌合同写过佣金比例就省略或改用口头估算。

opts.t: For each offer, a written disclosure in dollars of what the seller pays, the cooperating brokerage's share, what the listing brokerage keeps, and other pay.
opts.w: 正确。依现行规则 s.57（旧版 5-11.1），每一次（each time）向卖方客户呈交要约时，都必须书面披露四项预期酬金（卖方支付的总额、分给合作经纪行的金额、挂牌经纪行留存的金额、以及从他人处收到或预期收到的酬金），且以货币形式收取的必须写成具体金额（dollar amounts），不能只写百分比——这能让卖方清楚看到无代理买家要约下挂牌经纪行留存净收入更高的利害关系。

opts.t: A written disclosure for the unrepresented buyer's offer only, showing the commission as a percentage of the price rather than a dollar figure.
opts.w: 属于「新旧版本与条号陷阱」。s.57 要求对每一份呈交的要约都做披露，且明确规定凡以货币形式收取的酬金必须写成具体金额，不能只写百分比。

opts.t: An Agreement Regarding Conflict of Interest Between Clients, signed by both buyers before the seller is allowed to look at either offer.
opts.w: 属于「客户冲突处置陷阱」。这里的两名买家一位有合作经纪行代表、另一位是无代理方（non-client），都不是该挂牌代理人的客户，因此不适用 s.65 的「客户间利益冲突协议」。

checks.pt: 对照 2020 旧版考试资料与 2026 现行规则的八处核心差异
checks.stem: Under s.53 of the Real Estate Services Rules (Disclosure of Interest in Trade), how did the July 1, 2024 amendment (B.C. Reg. 101/2024) change the definition of who qualifies as an individual licensee's domestic partner within the definition of 'associate', compared to the 2020 course manual?
checks.zh: 在《地产服务规则》s.53（交易中利益的披露）项下，与 2020 版考试资料相比，2024 年 7 月 1 日生效的修订（B.C. Reg. 101/2024）如何修改了个人持牌人「关系人（associate）」中关于伴侣的定义？

opts.t: The manual said 'spouse or family partner'; the amendment repealed 'family partner' and defined 'spouse' to include married and marriage-like partners.
